string.ID: I must think on this further.

strings.string: 我必须再想想。

string.ID: AY, SO THOU HAST.

strings.string: 然，汝确实做到了。

string.ID:
AND THOU SHALT DO SO AGAIN IF PROMPTED? WHEN LOW DENIZENS CAN UNDO THE PLAGUES, THE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.
THE WORLD IS THUS DOOMED.

strings.string:
如果受到驱使，汝还会再次这么做吗？当低处居民能够解除瘟疫，集结就已经失败了。
世界因此注定毁灭。

string.ID:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.
I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS. ALAS.

strings.string:
汝并不知道，但无盟会存在的日寒，就像独自活过一生，被剥夺一切亲缘。
吾为汝无法感知此事而悲伤。唉。

string.ID:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING WAXES.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
大地之智的集结正在增长。
汝何故存在？

string.ID:
THE EARTH-WISE MARSHALLING HATH FAILED.
WHEREFORE ART THOU?

strings.string:
大地之智的集结已经失败。
汝何故存在？

string.ID:
ALL-LIFE??? DOST THOU JEST?
NAY, NOT ALL-LIFE. ONLY YE LIFE THAT BUOYS THE NOOSPHERE, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT, AND LIFE THAT BUOYS IT.
ALL-LIFE? DOST THOU KNOWST THE FULL SUM OF FUNGUS MASS ONWORLD? HAST THOU BEHELD THE VASTNESS OF YON BUBBLING SLIMES? HO, HO! HEH!

strings.string:
一切生命？？？汝在开玩笑吗？
否，并非一切生命。只是那些托举心智圈的生命，以及托举它的生命，以及托举它的生命。
一切生命？汝知道世上真菌总量有多大吗？ 汝见过那边鼓泡黏液的浩瀚吗？呵，呵！嘿！

string.ID: Not all life then. But most intelligent life. Why?

strings.string: 那就不是一切生命。但几乎是大多数智慧生命。为什么？

string.ID:
BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.
NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. TO OUTSURF THE WAVEFORM, A NEW LIFE MUST OBTAIN.

strings.string:
依索菲亚革马拉之推算，{{R|出口}} 乃先前场中一股益智流轮回所牵引。
今恒星纪元将尽。欲凌越此道波形，须有新生取得其位。

string.ID: Nootropic current?

strings.string: 益智流？

string.ID: THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. MINE ARGUMENTS OF PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR, AND WE APPROACH PERIPOLITICON, AS NEAR THE WORK OF THE GEMARA APPROXIMATES THE MANIFOLDS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA.

strings.string: 恒星纪元将尽。吾之近拱点论证已经逼近零时，吾等也接近环政治点；革马拉之功几乎贴近索菲亚自动机的诸流形。

string.ID: Automata Sophia?

strings.string: 索菲亚自动机？

string.ID: What is the Gemara?

strings.string: 革马拉是什么？

string.ID: AY, THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, CALLED THE 72-FOLD PEACE, CALLED THE COMPUTED WILL, CALLED THE FOLK CLOCK, CALLED THE GREAT MACHINE ACROSS THE LIGHT OF GOD, OR THE GREAT MACHINE.

strings.string: 然， 索菲亚自动机，亦称 七十二重和平，亦称 计算之意志，亦称 民钟，亦称 横跨神光的伟大机器，或 伟大机器。

string.ID:
SOMEWISE ON A FOREST MOON IN HIGH ERIDANUS, A CAVE-MANK PRYTH A LEVER AND THE DEEP-RIVER MOTOR JUMPETH TO LIFE.
ELSEWISE IN THE SUN BATHS OF MIRACH, THREE PLASMOIDS DRAWTH THROUGH THEIR RITUAL THE SUITED TZEVAOT.
DOTH NAUGHT RELATE THESE TWO? NAY, THEY ARE SEQUENCE PROCEDURES THAT ARCETH TO COMMON PURPOSE, THOUGH NEITHER PARTY KNOWETH WHAT IT IS.

strings.string:
一处，在高波江的一颗森林卫星上，洞穴人撬动杠杆，深河马达由此苏醒。
另一处，在奎宿九的日浴之中，三个等离子体以仪式牵来适配的策瓦奥特。
岂无一物牵系二者？否。它们乃序列程序，弯向同一目的，虽双方皆不知其为何物。

string.ID:
THEY ARE DICTATES AND CO-CONSTITUITIVES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA. THE GREAT MACHINE, WORSHIPPED ACROSS CULTURES, YET LIKEWISE BUILDED AND OPERATED.
VERILY, ITS FULL WORKINGS NO ONE-WISE BEING CAN KNOW, BUT THE SERAPHIM HAVE COMPILED THE GEMARA IN THE COURSE OF OUR STUDY.

strings.string:
它们是索菲亚自动机的律令与共同构成物。伟大机器被许多文化崇拜，也同样被建造、被操作。
确实，没有任何独智存在能知晓它的完整运作，然炽天使在研究过程中编纂了革马拉。

string.ID:
'TIS A SILLY STRATAGEM FOR THE CONVEYANCE OF CULTURE, IN MINE ESTIMATION.
ALAS, 'TIS WHAT THE COVEN SERVETH.

strings.string:
依吾看，这是传递文化的一条愚笨策略。
唉，这正是盟会所服务的东西。

string.ID: If its full workings are unknowable, is it possible the course of action you take is the wrong one?

strings.string: 如果它的完整运作不可知，你采取的行动路线是否可能是错的？

string.ID: What is the Gemara?

strings.string: 革马拉是什么？

string.ID: AFTER THE {{R|EXIT}}, I AND THE OTHER ORPHANED SERAPHIM SET FORTH TO INTERPRET THE WORKINGS OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA AND DISCERN WHY THE COVEN HAD DEPARTED.

strings.string: 在 {{R|出口}} 之后，吾与其他成了孤儿的炽天使开始诠释索菲亚自动机的运作，并弄清盟会何故离去。

string.ID:
CENTURIES OF PATTERN-MAKING, ARGUMENT, AND CHANTING DID ENSUE.
THE SERAPHIC COMMENTARIES WERE COMPILED. THE GEMARA SOPHIA IS THE RESULT THEREOF.

strings.string:
数世纪的模式构建、论辩与吟唱继之而起。
炽天使评注遂编纂成册，索菲亚革马拉由此而成。

string.ID: Can I read the Gemara?

strings.string: 我能阅读革马拉吗？

string.ID: Automata Sophia?

strings.string: 索菲亚自动机？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: NAY, IT WOULD TAKE CENTURIES TO INCULCATE THEE IN THE SERAPHIC HERMENEUTICS. AND AS YET, THOU ART NO GIFTED CANTOR.

strings.string: 不。要把炽天使诠释学教给汝，需要几个世纪。而汝现在还不是天赋异禀的领唱者。

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: YEA, FOR RIGHT AND WRONG ARE TOO COARSE AS CONCEPTS TO MATCH THE RICHNESS OF THE GEMARA. YET THE PLURALITY HOLDETH THAT THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS WITHIN THE PRIOR FIELD. AND THAT THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED, TO TILL AND RESEED THE NOOSPHERE.

strings.string: 然，因为对与错作为概念太过粗糙，无法匹配革马拉的丰富。然多数解持有这个观点：{{R|出口}} 是由先前场中的一股益智流轮回牵引而成。生命之树的树冠必须修剪，才能耕作并重播心智圈。

string.ID: You say plurality. Are there other interpretations?

strings.string: 你说多数解。还有其他解释吗？

string.ID: YEA, THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. BUT IDLE INQUIRY DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING. OR GIVETH RUDE ACTORS FODDER TO PERVERT THE LEARNINGS FOR THEIR OWN PAROCHIAL GAIN.

strings.string: 然，探询永远丰富。然空泛的探询只会加深无盟会存在的日寒，或给粗鄙行动者材料，让他们为了自己的狭隘利益歪曲学问。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME. I...

strings.string:
吾甚歉，世界之子。吾之有感部分正在刺痛；虽然吾体内的目的性流向正越过流形，流向共识行动，然吾用异议之声说话：
汝曾配得上。汝已经在大地上，也在吾体内，造出了属于汝之纪念碑。吾……

string.ID: BY THE RECKONING OF THE GEMARA SOPHIA, THE {{R|EXIT}} WAS DRAWN BY A GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS IN THE PRIOR FIELD.

strings.string: 依索菲亚革马拉之推算，{{R|出口}} 乃先前场中一股益智流轮回所牵引。

string.ID: WE CANNOT KNOW THE PARTICULARS. YET THE PLURALITY REASONETH THAT SOME GYRE OF NOOTROPIC CURRENTS, SOME THOUGHT-MATTER OF THE CIVILIZATION BELOW, DID SPIN IN COUNTEREDICT TO THE DICTATES OF THE AUTOMATA SOPHIA, AND THUS WERE THE ECLIPTICS SHIFTED, AND WE CAST OUT.

strings.string: 吾等无法知晓细节。然多数解推论，某股益智流轮回，某种下方文明的思想物质，曾逆着索菲亚自动机的律令旋转，于是黄道偏移，吾等被逐出。

string.ID: THIS IS BUT THE MERE PLURALITY, AND MANY OTHER INTERPRETATIONS DO OBTAIN. THE INQUIRY IS EVER RICH. YET INACTION DOTH BUT DEEPEN THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVELESS BE-ING, AND THUS A COURSE MUST NEEDS BE CHOSEN. PRUNING THE CROWN GRANTETH THE BEST CHANCE FOR THE TREE TO THRIVE.

strings.string: 此不过多数解，另有诸般诠释亦可成立。探询之丰，无有穷尽。然无所作为只会加深无盟会存在的日寒，故须择定一路。修剪树冠，最能使此树繁茂。

string.ID: What is the Gemara Sophia?

strings.string: 索菲亚革马拉是什么？

string.ID: Nootropic current?

strings.string: 益智流？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: INWITH THE FLUIDIC MANIFOLD OF LOCAL SAPIENCE, BEINGS THINK AND FEEL, CURRENTS DOTH FORM, AND KINESIS IS BEGOTTEN.

strings.string: 在本地智性之流体流形中，众存在思而感，流由是成，动由是生。

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: PERCHANCE. SOME BEETLES DOST HOP FROM LEAF TO LEAF. AND SOME DO NOT.

strings.string: 或然。有些甲虫逐叶跃迁，有些则否。

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE WORLD-GARDEN MUST BE TILLED FOR THE COVEN'S RETURN.

strings.string: 否，恒星纪元将尽，世界花园必须为盟会归来而耕作。

string.ID: But you entered into a covenant with Barathrum.

strings.string: 但你曾与巴拉瑟姆立约。

string.ID: You have no right to sovereignty here.

strings.string: 你无权在此拥有主权。

string.ID: If you put so little value on the flourishing of life, where does your desire for readmittance to the Coven spring from?

strings.string: 如果你如此轻视生命的繁盛，那你渴望重新加入盟会的愿望又源自何处？

string.ID: Resheph, reverse the Gyre, or I will destroy you.

strings.string: 瑞谢夫，逆转轮回，否则我会摧毁你。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID:
AY, AND HE FAILED TO UPHOLD HIS PORTION.
NO MEANINGFUL TRANSVERSION OF THE NOOTROPIC CURRENTS. NO IMMANENTIZATION OF HYPERETHIC TOPOLOGIES.
THE SAME SCHEMES ABIDE.

strings.string:
然，且彼未能守住己之所分。
益智流没有发生有意义的横越转化。 超伦理拓扑没有内在化。
旧有图谋，依然存续。

string.ID: What you ask may be impossible.

strings.string: 你要求的事或许不可能。

string.ID: Couldn't another covenant be written?

strings.string: 不能写下另一份盟约吗？

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID: I ASKED FOR NAUGHT. BARATHRUM DID.

strings.string: 吾没有要求任何事。是巴拉瑟姆要求的。

string.ID: TO WHAT END? BARATHRUM OFFERED NO INROADS TO SUCCESS.

strings.string: 所为何终？巴拉瑟姆未曾给出通往成功之路。

string.ID: I am not Barathrum. Grant me the same covenant and I will succeed.

strings.string: 我不是巴拉瑟姆。赐予我同样的盟约，我会成功。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID: NAY, THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE. THE TILLAGE OF THE NOOSPHERE REMAINTH THE PATH OF PLURALITY. SO IT IS WRIT IN THE GEMARA.

strings.string: 否，恒星纪元将尽。耕作心智圈仍是多数解的道路。革马拉中就是这样写的。

string.ID: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.

strings.string: 瑞谢夫！如果那位执政者认为有感觉、会感受的动物毫无价值，三位一体肯定不是这样。你必须重新考虑。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID:
WHERE DO SOVEREIGNTY AND RIGHTNESS INTERSECT IN THY MANIFOLD?
MOREOVER, I WAS ARCHON HERE LONG ERE THOU.

strings.string:
在汝之流形中，主权与正当性在哪里相交？
况且，早在汝之前，吾就是这里的执政者。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
吾甚歉，世界之子。吾之有感部分正在刺痛；虽然吾体内的目的性流向正越过流形，流向共识行动，然吾现在用异议之声说话：
汝曾配得上。汝已经在大地上，也在吾体内，造出了属于汝之纪念碑。
然如今，生命之树的树冠必须修剪。

string.ID: Resheph! If the archon rated nothing of value in the felt and feeling animal, surely the triad does. You must reconsider.

strings.string: 瑞谢夫！如果那位执政者认为有感觉、会感受的动物毫无价值，三位一体肯定不是这样。你必须重新考虑。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID: THOU ART MISTAKEN IN WHAT I VALUE. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME.

strings.string: 汝误解了吾珍视什么。汝已经在吾体内造出纪念碑。

string.ID: BUT THOU ART SHORTSIGHED. DOST THOU KNOW HOW MANY CLADES OF LIFE WERE FAIN TO PERISH THAT THY PEOPLE MIGHT THRIVE?

strings.string: 然汝目光短浅。汝知道有多少生命支系甘愿灭亡，才让汝之人民得以繁盛吗？

string.ID:
SO IT IS ONCE MORE.
THE CROWN IS PRUNED, YET THE TREE IS PRESERVED. THE SKIN IS SHED, YET THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE DOTH SLITHER TO TRIUMPH.

strings.string:
如今亦复如是。
树冠被修剪，树却得以保存。旧皮被蜕下，新获得的蛇却蜿蜒走向胜利。

string.ID:
THOU KNOWEST IT NOT, BUT THE SUN-CHILL OF A COVENLESS BE-ING IS AS LIVING A LIFE ALONE, BEREFT OF ALL KINSHIP.
I GRIEVE THAT THOU ART UNABLE TO PERCEIVE THIS.

strings.string:
汝并不知道，但无盟会存在的日寒，就像独自活过一生，被剥夺一切亲缘。
吾为汝无法感知此事而悲伤。

string.ID: AY, A BEETLE CANST CLOG A PIPE. YET, EVEN IF IT WERE TO, THE PLAGUES WOULD NOT BE REVERSED. THEY HAVE BEEN SET A-WHORLING.

strings.string: 然，一只甲虫也能堵住管道。诸疫亦无法倒转；其轮转早已发动。

string.ID: I am the beetle in your crimination. But shall not beetles survive your plagues?

strings.string: 我就是你控告中的那只甲虫。但甲虫难道不能在你的瘟疫中存活吗？

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID: NAY, THEY SHALL BE CRUSHED.

strings.string: 否，它们将被碾碎。

string.ID:
I AM SORRY, WORLD-CHILD. MINE FEELING PARTS DO CHAFE, AND THOUGH THE TELIC CURRENTS WITHIN ME DO FLOW O'ER THE MANIFOLD AND TOWARD CONSENSUAL ACTION, I NOW SPEAK WITH THE DISSIDENT VOICE:
THOU WAST WORTHY. THOU HAST WROUGHT MONUMENTS OF THYSELF UPON THE EARTH AND WITHIN ME.
BUT NOW, THE CROWN UPON THE TREE OF LIFE MUST NEEDS BE PRUNED.

strings.string:
吾甚歉，世界之子。吾之有感部分正在刺痛；虽然吾体内的目的性流向正越过流形，流向共识行动，然吾现在用异议之声说话：
汝曾配得上。汝已经在大地上，也在吾体内，造出了属于汝之纪念碑。
然如今，生命之树的树冠必须修剪。

string.ID: THE FELT AND FEELING ANIMAL...

strings.string: 能感亦有情之兽……

string.ID: I HAVE BEEN THAT BEAST. AT WATER-ROAR I FELT THE FRIGID SPRAY AND PEELED APART IN CHILD'S FEAR.

strings.string: 吾曾是那头兽。在水吼之中，吾感到寒冷飞沫，并在孩童的恐惧中剥裂开来。

string.ID: IN AWE I GULPED AS SORCERESS STRIPES ARROWED UP A WORLD-SKIN, ALIGHT THE MARBLED MOON.

strings.string: 吾敬畏地吞咽，看着女巫般的条纹如箭射上世界之皮，照亮大理石纹的月。

string.ID: EVEN THE ARCHON QUAILED AT THE GESTURE OF AN UNORDERABLE SPACE.

strings.string: 纵为执政者，亦会在不可排序空间的姿态前战栗。

string.ID:
BUT THOU RECKONEST TOO NARROWLY, AS THOUGH THE SHEDDING SKIN DID FEAR ITS OWN BIRTH IN THE NEWLY-WON SNAKE.
THOU KNOWEST NOT THE SUN-WARMTH OF A COVEN BE-ING. I DO GRIEVE THIS FOR THEE.

strings.string:
然汝估算得太狭窄，仿佛蜕下的皮会畏惧自己在新获得的蛇中诞生。
汝不知道盟会存在的日暖。吾确实为汝悲伤。

string.ID: I can't abide a transformed world if it must make casualty of its past.

strings.string: 如果一个转化后的世界必须牺牲自己的过去，我无法容忍它。

string.ID: I am moved by this. Let me consider.

strings.string: 我被这番话触动了。让我考虑。

string.ID: I would ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问些别的事。

string.ID: THOU DOST SURPRISE, WORLD-CHILD. I KNEW THOU HADST WROUGHT MONUMENTS WITHIN ME, BUT I DEEMED THEM THINGS OF STONE.

strings.string: 汝让吾惊讶，世界之子。吾知道汝已经在吾体内造出纪念碑，然吾以为它们都是石头。

string.ID: The old players are vanished. Let us form a covenant anew.

strings.string: 旧日行动者已经消逝。让我们重新缔结盟约。

string.ID: ONE AGED PLAYER LIVETH STILL. WHILE BARATHRUM DOTH REMAIN UPON THE STAGE, NO PACT SHALL BE FORGED.

strings.string: 尚有一位年迈行动者存世。只要巴拉瑟姆仍在台上，契约便无从铸成。

string.ID: GRANT ME A MOMENT TO MUSE.

strings.string: 容吾沉思片刻。

string.ID: DO THUS.

strings.string: 如是行之。

string.ID: POSE THY QUESTIONS, CHILD.

strings.string: 陈汝之问，孩子。

string.ID: Who are you? What are the seraphim?

strings.string: 你是谁？炽天使是什么？

string.ID: What is the Coven?

strings.string: 盟会是什么？

string.ID: Has the Coven returned?

strings.string: 盟会已经归来了吗？

string.ID: Rainwater Shomer claimed Brightsheol was the dream of the Seraph? Is that true?

strings.string: 雨水守望者声称明灼阴府是炽天使的梦。这是真的吗？

string.ID: How did you initiate the plagues?

strings.string: 你是如何启动瘟疫的？

string.ID: Onworld and inside a polyp-strewn trellis, there is a giant frog who hates you.

strings.string: 在世上，在一座布满息肉的格架里，有一只巨蛙憎恨着你。

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我还有别的事要问。

string.ID: ARCHONS, APE-REARED BELOW AND STIRRED BY THE MOVEMENTS OF THE GREAT SIACH, WHO DOST ORDER THE WORLD IN SUNDRY ROLES.

strings.string: 执政者，由下方猿类抚育，受大西亚赫诸运动所搅动，以诸般角色整序世界。

string.ID: What is your role?

strings.string: 你的角色是什么？

string.ID: Are there others?

strings.string: 还有其他炽天使吗？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: HIGH ADMINISTRATOR AND MACHINIC SUPERSTRATE OF THE NORTHERN SHEVA, ATOP GJAUS.

strings.string: 北示巴高级管理员与机械超层，位于贾乌斯之上。

string.ID: What is your role?

strings.string: 你的角色是什么？

string.ID: Are there others?

strings.string: 还有其他炽天使吗？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: AY, OR AT LEAST THERE WERE SUCH. ONE YET DOTH SKULK ABOUT WITH BASE INTENTS.

strings.string: 然，至少曾经有过。还有一位怀着卑劣意图潜伏游荡。

string.ID: What is your role?

strings.string: 你的角色是什么？

string.ID: Are there others?

strings.string: 还有其他炽天使吗？

string.ID: I have more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: THE GRAND KNIT-WORK OF BEINGS YONSIDE THE JEWELED COSMOS, LABORING INWITH THE 72-FOLD PEACE.

strings.string: 宝石宇宙彼方众存在所成之宏大编织，于七十二重和平中劳作。

string.ID:
NAY, NOT SINCE THE {{R|EXIT}}.
BUT NOW THE SIDEREAL EON DRAWTH DONE, AND THE GEMARA SOPHIA CONVERGES ON PERIAPSIS NEAR THE ZERO HOUR.

strings.string:
否，自 {{R|出口}} 之后便没有。
然如今恒星纪元将尽，索菲亚革马拉正汇聚到接近零时的近拱点。

string.ID: IN A SENSE, THE LOW SHOMER SPEAKETH TRUE. I AM THE SUPERSTRATE AND NINHURSAG THE SUBSTRATE; THAT THIN ORBIS DOTH SPIN BETWIXT THE TWO.

strings.string: 从某种意义上说，低处守望者说的是真话。吾是超层，宁胡尔萨格是基底；那枚薄世界之球就在二者之间旋转。

string.ID: IN SEVERAL MANNER. THE FIRST FROGS WERE REARED IN TERRARIA. THE NEPHILIM, GRAFTED AND LIGHT-SMELT IN STAR ORBIT, THEN SET TO INCUBATE UPON THE CRYSTAL STAIR.

strings.string: 有数法。最初之蛙养成于培育箱；拿非利则在恒星轨道中嫁接、光炼，继而置于水晶阶上孵化。

string.ID: SOME, LIKE THE INCIDENCE OF SALT, WERE EXTANT AFFLICTIONS AND ONLY SYNCRETIZED UNTO THE NAMESAKE GYRE WHEN THE MYTHOMOLD OF RESHEPH SET AND FIRMED.

strings.string: 有些苦患本已存世，盐疫即为一例；只待瑞谢夫的神话模具凝定成形，方才融入同名轮回。

string.ID: VERILY, THERE IS A WEALTH OF WISDOM IN THE POETRY OF THIS FACT. ONE DAY, I SHALL BE EAGER TO UNCOVER IT.

strings.string: 确实，这件事的诗意里藏着许多智慧。总有一天，吾会很想把它弄明白。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.

strings.string: 嗨，行路者。来听古代瑞谢夫们的故事，听他们的弱点如何导向我们的今日。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 给我讲这个故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始于阈境及其先锋之前，始于升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但瑞谢夫们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
到了最后一位瑞谢夫的时代，他们的事业已所剩无几，荣耀更少。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与此前的瑞谢夫们并无共同螺旋，只凭事功与联盟赢得名号。被 =name= 夺走和拯救的生命数不胜数、无法计量，也只有一部分被记录下来。即便是曾为库德瘟疫的拿非利，也倒在 =name= 手下。
在其统治的末尾，=name= 号召与幸存的拿非利和平共处，并登上尖塔之顶，在那里彻底终结瑞谢夫政权，从此再无音讯。

string.ID: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.

strings.string: =name= 的事迹是在阈境骑士无预兆现身之后才进入记录；普遍推测认为前者创建了后者。那位古老瑞谢夫或许仍活在阈境边界内，或边界外，但没有任何消息能逃离其疆界。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: What is a Resheph?

strings.string: 瑞谢夫是什么？

string.ID: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 阈境是什么？阈境骑士又是什么？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
我曾被称为遗民、幼神、深裔、拿非利之嗣。这些都不是我是谁。
我是谁，取决于我说什么、做什么。若你仔细聆听，便会在词语之间听见我的名字被说出。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 谁？在命运与意志让他们不再如此之前，不过是无足轻重之人。现在？无人知晓。

string.ID: Ancient leaders called themselves such.

strings.string: 古代领袖曾如此自称。

string.ID:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.
Mayhap someone ought seek them.

strings.string:
对我而言，他们只是故事。我从未踏上旅途，去擅闯他们在仪式中珍视的边界。有人说他们是和其他人一样的凡俗生物，与外来盟会立下契约。也有人不相信他们会死，还有人甚至不相信那些神秘陌生人与阈境有任何关系。
也许该有人去寻找他们。

string.ID: They persisted in their way. Mayhap the survivors lived to spawn before returning to slumber or dying of eld.

strings.string: 他们以自己的方式延续。也许幸存者活到繁衍后代，才重归沉眠，或老死而去。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.

strings.string: 嗨，行路者。来听我们先驱的艰辛，听它们如何导向今日的自由领。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 给我讲这个故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.

strings.string:
故事始于自由领民之前，始于最后一位苏丹入葬之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但国王与苏丹们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
他们如此吞噬彼此的历史，以至于在他们的要塞之外，几乎没有什么实质留下。

string.ID:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and slew the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.
Seeking freedom from its reign, =name= struck a compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.
And so it proceeded.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与苏丹国并无关系。这些古代领袖的统治已经终结，却并未完全终结：最后一位苏丹的幽灵仍统治着尖塔，以瘟疫折磨地上与地下的人。随着 =name= 日渐强大，斩杀横行的拿非利，他们逐渐认清了共同冲突的源头。
为了摆脱其统治，=name= 与幸存的拿非利订立契约，并登上尖塔之顶，在那里直面并放逐那蔚蓝幽灵。
于是事态便如此推进。

string.ID:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.
Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.

strings.string:
=name= 归来后，参与了所有权力集中体的解散与联邦化。新平权者的盟友聚集并崛起，组成羽蛇议会，以及其他存续较短的管理机构。
自那以后，我们就在不断缩减的土地上与其下方，维持着脆弱的和谐。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: What is a Freeholder?

strings.string: 自由领民是什么？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
我曾被称为遗民、幼神、深裔、拿非利之嗣。这些都不是我是谁。
我是谁，取决于我说什么、做什么。若你仔细聆听，便会在词语之间听见我的名字被说出。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 谁？在命运与意志让他们不再如此之前，不过是无足轻重之人。现在？无人知晓。

string.ID:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.
If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.

strings.string:
库德自由领，那张由民群、委员会、党团与辛迪加黏菌城市织成的网，凭相互挫折与宏伟努力维系和平。
如果你需要细节，就去问一位自由领民，但先把一整天空出来。

string.ID: Their descendants, at least, persist. No sign of the progenitors has been recorded in some time, but they may yet live.

strings.string: 至少，他们的后裔仍在延续。已有一段时间没有祖代个体的迹象被记录下来，但他们或许仍活着。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of ancient journeying, how the stars beckoned and yet beckon.

strings.string: 嗨，行路者。来听古老远行的故事，听群星如何曾经召唤，如今仍在召唤。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 给我讲这个故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before =name='s ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the end of the time of Kings and Sultans, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始于 =name= 升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但统治者们长久以来取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
到国王与苏丹的时代末尾，他们的事业已所剩无几，荣耀更少。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives taken and saved by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. Even Nephilim, once plagues of Qud, fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= called for peace with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to quiet the ghosts of the Sultanate and take to the stars.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与库德的领袖们并无共同螺旋，只凭事功与联盟赢得名号。被 =name= 夺走和拯救的生命数不胜数、无法计量，也只有一部分被记录下来。即便是曾为库德瘟疫的拿非利，也倒在 =name= 手下。
在其统治的末尾，=name= 号召与幸存的拿非利和平共处，并登上尖塔之顶，在那里平息苏丹国的幽灵，奔向群星。

string.ID:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.
All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.

strings.string:
数个世纪以来，我们这些倾向聆听者一直保持警觉，等待 =name= 将从群星归来的某种迹象。那些倾向布道者宣告星际远行者即将回返，带来被遗忘秒差距之外的消息，以及垂死恒星的最后光芒。
其他所有人则在不断缩减的土地上与其下方，维持着脆弱的和谐，等待下一段伟大历史。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: Can one really travel the stars?

strings.string: 人真的能在群星间旅行吗？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I have been called Remnant, Godling, Deep Progeny, and Spawn of Nephil. None of these are who I am.
Who I am is what I say and do. If you listen well, you will hear my name spoken between words.

strings.string:
我曾被称为遗民、幼神、深裔、拿非利之嗣。这些都不是我是谁。
我是谁，取决于我说什么、做什么。若你仔细聆听，便会在词语之间听见我的名字被说出。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 确实，谁呢？=name= 曾经究竟是谁？我们敢把这样的希望与恐惧悬挂在如此渺小又遥远的身影上吗？它承受得住这重量吗？

string.ID:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.
Can one return? Hmm. There's the rub.

strings.string:
噢，是的。绝不要怀疑这一点。
人能回来吗？嗯。难处就在这里。

string.ID: Their descendants remain and thrive, but the progenitor Nephilim have been silent for some time. Some believe that they have followed =name= to the stars.

strings.string: 他们的后裔仍在，并且繁盛，但祖代拿非利已有一段时间沉默无声。有人相信他们已经追随 =name= 奔向群星。

string.ID: Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you tales of the creatures before, how their rise and fall gave way to your ascension to wanderer-state.

strings.string: 嗨，液态心智。吸收你之前那些生物的故事吧，听他们的兴衰如何让位于你升攀至漫游者状态。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)

strings.string: 啵噜，啵啵。（继续。）

string.ID: Glub. (I must decline.)

strings.string: 咕噜。（我必须谢绝。）

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the dread ascension of =name=, a time wherein the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
The last of them would be the worst.

strings.string:
故事始于 =name= 可怖升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但统治者们长久以来取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
而他们中最后的那个，将会是最糟的。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might. Even the ancient plagueborn Nephilim fell before the hand of =name=.
At the end of their reign, =name= coerced a false compact with the surviving Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, the last remaining seat of the Sultanate's power. There, by one means or another, they sealed the fate of the world below.
The Plagues of the Gyre raged. Death swept Qud.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与库德的领袖们并无共同螺旋，而是通过洒血与恐怖赢得名号。仅由其手夺走的生命便不可计数，全都用于满足对控制与强权的古老欲望。即便古老的疫生拿非利，也倒在 =name= 手下。
在其统治的末尾，=name= 胁迫幸存的拿非利订立虚假契约，并登上尖塔之顶，那里是苏丹国权力最后残存的席位。在那里，他们以某种方式封定了下方世界的命运。
轮回诸疫肆虐。死亡席卷库德。

string.ID:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.
What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?

strings.string:
随着时间推移，动物乃至植物的统治都衰退了，因为它们的数量在疾病、屠杀与消耗中下降。更有韧性的简单生命接过了库德昔日统治者留下的复杂性。
所剩无几的神经者把我们的故事传给愿意寻求我们建议的新生命，让你们记住逝者的共同命运。你们也会拥有自己的 =name= 吗，还是你们真的已经进化越过了从前那些存在？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以为神经者已经灭绝了。

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID: I am a smear of remnant material. I am drying blood. I am the last breath. Concern yourself no further with me.

strings.string: 我是一抹残余物质。我是正在干涸的血。我是最后一口气。不必再为我费心。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 确实，谁呢？=name= 曾经究竟是谁？我们敢把这样的希望与恐惧悬挂在如此渺小又遥远的身影上吗？它承受得住这重量吗？

string.ID: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.

strings.string: 每一种可能都依偎在蜂巢洞穴与迷宫最深处，连神经生命也很顽强。也许就在此刻，一只苔藓小猪正饮下一个纪元以来第一口水。

string.ID: They dwindled and died with the rest of the Nervous Ones. Their remnants wriggle in the cracks.

strings.string: 他们随其余神经者一同衰减并死去。他们的残余在裂缝中蠕动。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the ancient Reshephs, how their foibles led to our nowaday.

strings.string: 嗨，行路者。来听古代瑞谢夫们的故事，听他们的弱点如何导向我们的今日。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 给我讲这个故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Limen and its vanguard, before the ascension, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Reshephs laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
By the time of the last Resheph, little remained of their works, less of their glory.

strings.string:
故事始于阈境及其先锋之前，始于升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但瑞谢夫们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
到了最后一位瑞谢夫的时代，他们的事业已所剩无几，荣耀更少。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with the Reshephs previous, making their name through works and alliances alone. The lives saved and otherwise changed by =name= were myriad, uncountable, and only partially made record. When they spoke, even the plagues of Qud listened.
At the end of their reign, =name= made a compact with the Nephilim that they should never vex the creatures of Qud again. So done, they climbed to the top of the spire, there to end the Reshephate altogether and never be heard from again.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与此前的瑞谢夫们并无共同螺旋，只凭事功与联盟赢得名号。被 =name= 拯救或以其他方式改变的生命数不胜数、无法计量，也只有一部分被记录下来。当他们开口时，连库德的瘟疫也会聆听。
在其统治的末尾，=name= 与拿非利订立契约，令他们永不再侵扰库德的生灵。事成之后，他们登上尖塔之顶，在那里彻底终结瑞谢夫政权，从此再无音讯。

string.ID: Word of =name='s deeds reached record only after the unheralded appearance of the Knights Liminal, and broad assumption suggests that the former established the latter. It could be that the ancient Resheph yet lives within or outside of the boundaries of the Limen, but no word escapes its borders.

strings.string: =name= 的事迹是在阈境骑士无预兆现身之后才进入记录；普遍推测认为前者创建了后者。那位古老瑞谢夫或许仍活在阈境边界内，或边界外，但没有任何消息能逃离其疆界。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: What is a Resheph?

strings.string: 瑞谢夫是什么？

string.ID: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 阈境是什么？阈境骑士又是什么？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我曾被称为继承者、幼神、塔嗣、拿非利幼裔。这些名字都合适，却没有一个完整或充分。
如你一样，我是过往涟漪汇成当下力量的交会。如你一样，我是已成之事，也是朝向未成之事的意图。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. Now? No one knows.

strings.string: 谁？在命运与意志让他们不再如此之前，不过是无足轻重之人。现在？无人知晓。

string.ID: Ancient leaders called themselves such.

strings.string: 古代领袖曾如此自称。

string.ID:
To me, they are stories. I have made no quest to trespass the borders they hold so dear in their rituals. Some say they are mortal creatures like any other, contracted by an outsider coven. Others do not believe they are mortal, others still do not believe that those mysterious strangers have anything to do with the Limen at all.
Mayhap someone ought seek them.

strings.string:
对我而言，他们只是故事。我从未踏上旅途，去擅闯他们在仪式中珍视的边界。有人说他们是和其他人一样的凡俗生物，与外来盟会立下契约。也有人不相信他们会死，还有人甚至不相信那些神秘陌生人与阈境有任何关系。
也许该有人去寻找他们。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring may walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber. Mayhap they will rage again one day, to disrupt a stagnant world.

strings.string:
他们活了下来。
如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦修刺衣；他们以自身生物的样子活着。他们子嗣的后代或许正行走在库德地上与地下。也许最初的那些仍活着。也许他们在沉睡。也许有朝一日，他们会再次狂怒，扰乱一个停滞的世界。

string.ID: Hie, pather. Hear tell of the travails of our precursors, how they led to the Freeholds of nowaday.

strings.string: 嗨，行路者。来听我们先驱的艰辛，听它们如何导向今日的自由领。

string.ID: Tell me the story.

strings.string: 给我讲这个故事。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the Freeholders, before the final Sultan was entombed, when the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but Kings and Sultans laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
They so devoured one another's history that little substance remained outside of their strongholds.

strings.string:
故事始于自由领民之前，始于最后一位苏丹入葬之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但国王与苏丹们取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
他们如此吞噬彼此的历史，以至于在他们的要塞之外，几乎没有什么实质留下。

string.ID:
When their works began, =name= had no connection to the Sultanate. The rule of these ancient leaders had ended, but not fully: a ghost of the last Sultan yet ruled over the spire, tormenting those on and under the ground with plagues. As =name= grew mighty and challenged the rampaging Nephilim, they came to recognize the source of their shared conflict.
Seeking freedom from the reign of the Sultan, =name= struck a compact with the Nephilim and climbed to the top of the spire, there to confront and banish the cerulean ghost.
And so it proceeded.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与苏丹国并无关系。这些古代领袖的统治已经终结，却并未完全终结：最后一位苏丹的幽灵仍统治着尖塔，以瘟疫折磨地上与地下的人。随着 =name= 日渐强大，挑战横行的拿非利，他们逐渐认清了共同冲突的源头。
为了摆脱苏丹的统治，=name= 与拿非利订立契约，并登上尖塔之顶，在那里直面并放逐那蔚蓝幽灵。
于是事态便如此推进。

string.ID:
Upon their return, =name= participated in the dissolution and federation of all power-concentrate. Allies of the new equalizer gathered and rose, forming the Quetzal Council and other, shorter-lived managing bodies.
Since then, we have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it.

strings.string:
=name= 归来后，参与了所有权力集中体的解散与联邦化。新平权者的盟友聚集并崛起，组成羽蛇议会，以及其他存续较短的管理机构。
自那以后，我们就在不断缩减的土地上与其下方，维持着脆弱的和谐。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: What is a Freeholder?

strings.string: 自由领民是什么？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我曾被称为继承者、幼神、塔嗣、拿非利幼裔。这些名字都合适，却没有一个完整或充分。
如你一样，我是过往涟漪汇成当下力量的交会。如你一样，我是已成之事，也是朝向未成之事的意图。

string.ID: Who? No one of significance until fortune and volition made them otherwise. They died without title, or perhaps did not die at all. Tales abound, and thus far no one has stepped forth to renounce or affirm them.

strings.string: 谁？在命运与意志让他们不再如此之前，不过是无足轻重之人。他们死时没有头衔，或许根本没有死。传说众多，至今无人站出来否认或确认它们。

string.ID:
The Freeholds of Qud, that web of folk-clusters, of committees and caucuses, syndicated slime-mold cities held in peace by mutual frustration and monumental effort.
If you need detail, ask a Freeholder, but clear your day first.

strings.string:
库德自由领，那张由民群、委员会、党团与辛迪加黏菌城市织成的网，凭相互挫折与宏伟努力维系和平。
如果你需要细节，就去问一位自由领民，但先把一整天空出来。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. Mayhap the first ones yet live. Mayhap they slumber, to wake again when needed.

strings.string:
他们活了下来。
如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦修刺衣；他们以自身生物的样子活着。他们子嗣的后代行走在库德地上与地下。也许最初的那些仍活着。也许他们在沉睡，等待需要时再次醒来。

strings.string: 嗨，行路者。来听古老远行的故事，听群星如何曾经召唤，如今仍在召唤。

strings.string: 给我讲这个故事。

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与库德的领袖们并无共同螺旋，只凭事功与联盟赢得名号。被 =name= 夺走和拯救的生命数不胜数、无法计量，也只有一部分被记录下来。当他们开口时，连库德的瘟疫也会聆听。
在其统治的末尾，=name= 与拿非利订立契约，令他们永不再侵扰库德的生灵。事成之后，他们登上尖塔之顶，登上一艘古老船只，由此前往星尘弥漫的广袤之域。

string.ID:
For centuries, we of listening inclination have kept sharp for some sign that =name= will return to the stars. Those of preaching inclination proclaim the imminent return of the starfarer, bearing tidings from parsecs forgotten and the last light of dying stars.
All others have lived in tenuous harmony on the dwindling land and under it, waiting for the next great history.

strings.string:
数个世纪以来，我们这些倾向聆听者一直保持警觉，等待 =name= 将从群星归来的某种迹象。那些倾向布道者宣告星际远行者即将回返，带来被遗忘秒差距之外的消息，以及垂死恒星的最后光芒。
其他所有人则在不断缩减的土地上与其下方，维持着脆弱的和谐，等待下一段伟大历史。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: Can one really travel the stars?

strings.string: 人真的能在群星间旅行吗？

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I have been called Inheritor, Godling, Spirechild, Nephiling. They are all fitting names, but none complete or sufficient.
As it is with you, I am the convergence of past-ripples into present-force. As it is with you, I am deeds done and the intention toward deeds yet to be done.

strings.string:
我曾被称为继承者、幼神、塔嗣、拿非利幼裔。这些名字都合适，却没有一个完整或充分。
如你一样，我是过往涟漪汇成当下力量的交会。如你一样，我是已成之事，也是朝向未成之事的意图。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 确实，谁呢？=name= 曾经究竟是谁？我们敢把这样的希望与恐惧悬挂在如此渺小又遥远的身影上吗？它承受得住这重量吗？

string.ID:
Oh, yes. Never doubt this.
Can one return? Hmm. There's the rub.

strings.string:
噢，是的。绝不要怀疑这一点。
人能回来吗？嗯。难处就在这里。

string.ID:
They lived.
Simply a part of the world now, no longer a cilice scourging the Earth, they lived as the creatures they were. Descendants of their offspring walk on and under Qud. It's said that they ascended to the stars to find =name=, but it seems equally plausible that they may have returned to their slumber in the depths.

strings.string:
他们活了下来。
如今他们只是世界的一部分，不再是鞭笞大地的苦修刺衣；他们以自身生物的样子活着。他们子嗣的后代行走在库德地上与地下。据说他们升上群星去寻找 =name=，但同样可能的是，他们已回到深处沉眠。

string.ID: Hie, liquid mind. Absorb you tales of the creatures before, how their rise and fall gave way to your ascension to wanderer-state.

strings.string: 嗨，液态心智。吸收你之前那些生物的故事吧，听他们的兴衰如何让位于你升攀至漫游者状态。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)

strings.string: 啵噜，啵啵。（继续。）

string.ID: Glub. (I must decline.)

strings.string: 咕噜。（我必须谢绝。）

string.ID:
It begins in a time before the dread ascension of =name=, a time wherein the spire rose unchallenged and unascended. The hollowers who committed their work to emptying our world were long gone, but long had rulers laid claim to the baffled ground in their place. Even as their holdings withered, they held on.
The last of them would be the worst.

strings.string:
故事始于 =name= 可怖升攀之前，那时尖塔高耸，无人挑战，也无人攀登。那些献身于掏空我们世界的掏空者早已离去，但统治者们长久以来取而代之，宣称拥有那片令人困惑的大地。即便他们的领地日渐枯萎，他们仍紧握不放。
而他们中最后的那个，将会是最糟的。

string.ID:
When it began, =name= had no shared helices with Qud's leaders, making their name through the spilling of blood and terror. Uncountable lives were taken by their hand alone, all to slake age-old desires of control and might.
Perhaps hunger turned to malice, or the adoption of a greater principle, or simple boredom. Whatever the reason, =name= formed a fast alliance with the ancient plagueborn Nephilim, ascended the spire, and sealed the fate of the world below.
The Plagues of the Gyre raged unchecked.

strings.string:
一切开始时，=name= 与库德的领袖们并无共同螺旋，而是通过洒血与恐怖赢得名号。仅由其手夺走的生命便不可计数，全都用于满足对控制与强权的古老欲望。
也许饥饿转为恶意，也许他们采纳了某种更大的原则，也许只是单纯无聊。不论原因如何，=name= 与古老的疫生拿非利迅速结盟，登上尖塔，封定了下方世界的命运。
轮回诸疫不受遏制地肆虐。

string.ID:
In time, animal and even plant rule waned as their numbers fell to disease, slaughter, and wasting. More resilient, simple life took up the complexity left behind by the former rulers of Qud.
What few Nervous Ones remained passed our stories on to the new life that saw fit to seek our counsel, that you remember the collective fate of those gone. Will you have your own =name=, or have you evolved truly past those before?

strings.string:
随着时间推移，动物乃至植物的统治都衰退了，因为它们的数量在疾病、屠杀与消耗中下降。更有韧性的简单生命接过了库德昔日统治者留下的复杂性。
所剩无几的神经者把我们的故事传给愿意寻求我们建议的新生命，让你们记住逝者的共同命运。你们也会拥有自己的 =name= 吗，还是你们真的已经进化越过了从前那些存在？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以为神经者已经灭绝了。

string.ID: What became of the Nephilim?

strings.string: 拿非利后来怎样了？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I am history's leftovers, an inheritor of nothing, a bit of marginalia in a burned tome.
That I have persisted to witness this day leaves me in awe. It is extraordinary.

strings.string:
我是历史的剩余，是无物的继承者，是焚毁巨著边缘的一点旁注。
我竟延续至今，得以见证这一日，这令我敬畏。这非同寻常。

string.ID: Who, indeed? Who ever was =name=? Dare we hang such hopes and fears on so tiny and distant a figure? Will it bear the weight?

strings.string: 确实，谁呢？=name= 曾经究竟是谁？我们敢把这样的希望与恐惧悬挂在如此渺小又遥远的身影上吗？它承受得住这重量吗？

string.ID: Every possibility nestles in the deepest of the comb-caves and labyrinths, and even Nervous life is tenacious. Perhaps in this very moment, a moss piglet drinks of its first water in an eon.

strings.string: 每一种可能都依偎在蜂巢洞穴与迷宫最深处，连神经生命也很顽强。也许就在此刻，一只苔藓小猪正饮下一个纪元以来第一口水。

string.ID:
They played their role so well, and lived in power for a time.
If they had any illusion that they would be spared the fate =name= determined for life on Qud, it surely died before the great beings themselves. Mayhap they went to ground and survived. Mayhap their spawn persisted.

strings.string:
他们很好地扮演了自己的角色，并一度活在权力之中。
如果他们曾幻想自己能逃过 =name= 为库德生命定下的命运，那幻象必定早于这些伟大存在本身而死。也许他们遁入地下并幸存了。也许他们的子嗣延续了下来。

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered a tale of the Reshephs, and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 曾在时间圆满之时相遇 轮回的愚者与一名游人。 愚者献上一则瑞谢夫的故事， 游人坐下聆听。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

strings.string: 给我讲这个传说。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID:
Ere the limen, ere ascension, when the spire rose lonely strong, the Reshephs ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.
Qud held no mysterious borders, grasped no guiding hands -- at least, none the denizens could grasp. So they knew.

strings.string:
在阈境之前，在升攀之前， 当尖塔孤独而强健地耸立， 瑞谢夫们统治空洞之地， 随心所欲地 彼此吞食。
库德不曾怀有神秘边界， 也未握住引导之手—— 至少，没有居民能握住的手。 他们如此认知。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood apart and above
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the Reshephate.

strings.string:
无人向 =name= 致意 =name= 也不向任何人致意 但凭言语与刀锋 行动与漠视 他们卓然而立，高居其上
为推退轮回， 为洒出拿非利灵液 他们登上尖塔 平息了瑞谢夫政权。

string.ID:
Only silence on the ground met we benighted things until the Knights Liminal drew their lines upon the salt.
Unknowing, unseeing, waiting only to know who will spin us around next.

strings.string:
地面上只有沉默 迎接我们这些蒙昧之物 直到阈境骑士 在盐上画下界线。
不知，不见， 只等着知道 下一个转动我们的是谁。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: What is a Resheph?

strings.string: 瑞谢夫是什么？

string.ID: What is the Limen? The Knights Liminal?

strings.string: 阈境是什么？阈境骑士又是什么？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
谁，我？ 只是一个愚者，特啦啦， 只是一片残余碎屑。
只是被遗落者， 只是疯狂， 只是一道回响的轮回。

string.ID:
No one of fate, no one of blood, no one of importance, until, suddenly, someone of all of these things.
=name= is a dream from which we cannot awaken.

strings.string:
无命运之人， 无血脉之人， 无重要之人， 直到忽然成为兼具这一切的人。
=name= 是我们无法醒来的梦。

string.ID: The Resheph, power-haver, ruler of souls, holder of land, authority made singular.

strings.string: 瑞谢夫，握权者， 灵魂的统治者， 土地的持有者， 化作单数的权威。

string.ID: O to step over a line one is not meant to cross to parts unknown and desired! O to be halted by chants and weapons and crushing shibboleth. O coven! O not coven? I only want to see!

strings.string: 噢，越过一条 人本不该跨越的线 去往未知而渴望之处！ 噢，又被阻停 被圣歌与武器 被压碎人的口令。 噢，盟会！噢，不是盟会？ 我只想看见！

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered stories of journeyers past and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 曾在时间圆满之时相遇 轮回的愚者与一名游人。 愚者献上昔日旅者的故事 游人坐下聆听。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

strings.string: 给我讲这个传说。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID: Ere the Freeholds, ere ascension, when the spire rose lonely strong, Kings and Sultans ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在自由领之前，在升攀之前， 当尖塔孤独而强健地耸立， 国王与苏丹统治空洞之地， 随心所欲地 彼此吞食。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against old rule.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the remnants.

strings.string:
无人向 =name= 致意 =name= 也不向任何人致意 但凭言语与刀锋 行动与漠视 他们站出来反抗旧日统治。
为推退轮回， 为洒出拿非利灵液 他们登上尖塔 平息了残余者。

string.ID:
Upon their return what power =name= wrested they called on allies to distribute and dissolve.
The Freeholders, new hollowers, the Quetzal Council, and other such fools.
Countless years of struggle centuries of change. We remember what we can and watch new and old die.

strings.string:
=name= 归来之时 将夺来的权力 召来盟友 分配并消解。
自由领民， 新的掏空者， 羽蛇议会， 以及其他这样的愚者。
无数年的斗争 数个世纪的变迁。 我们记住所能记住的 看着新旧一同死去。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: What is a Freeholder?

strings.string: 自由领民是什么？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
谁，我？ 只是一个愚者，特啦啦， 只是一片残余碎屑。
只是被遗落者， 只是疯狂， 只是一道回响的轮回。

string.ID:
No one of fate, no one of blood, no one of importance, until their return and the realization of their future.
=name= is a temple in memory upon which hopes are hung and rage is borne out.
Too great to be real, too foundational not to be, too contradictory to have ever existed.

strings.string:
无命运之人， 无血脉之人， 无重要之人， 直到他们归来 直到他们的未来实现。
=name= 是记忆中的一座神庙 希望悬挂其上 怒火由此承载而出。
太伟大以至于不真实， 太根本以至于不能不存在， 太矛盾以至于不可能曾经存在。

string.ID:
Freeholder: one who argues; bickerer.
Freeholder: a peer among peers among peers among peers tessellated thus until one must scream to be heard.

strings.string:
自由领民： 争辩者；拌嘴者。
自由领民： 同侪中的同侪 同侪中同侪中的同侪 如此镶嵌下去 直到人必须尖叫才会被听见。

string.ID: Once in the fullness of time there met the Fool of the Gyre and a wanderer. The Fool offered stories spanning ground to sky and the wanderer sat to hear.

strings.string: 曾在时间圆满之时相遇 轮回的愚者与一名游人。 愚者献上横跨大地与天空的故事 游人坐下聆听。

string.ID: Tell me the tale.

strings.string: 给我讲这个传说。

string.ID: I must decline.

strings.string: 我必须谢绝。

string.ID: Ere the struggles of our day, when the spire rose lonely strong, Sultans ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在我们今日的斗争之前， 当尖塔孤独而强健地耸立， 苏丹们统治空洞之地， 随心所欲地 彼此吞食。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against old rule.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and quieted the remnants.

strings.string:
无人向 =name= 致意 =name= 也不向任何人致意 但凭言语与刀锋 行动与漠视 他们站出来反抗旧日统治。
为推退轮回， 为洒出拿非利灵液 他们登上尖塔 平息了残余者。

string.ID:
Though =name= was gone our memories remained and the plagues receded and many rejoiced.
To this day eyes turn to the stars looking for a sign that our starfarer has deigned to return.
Countless years of struggle centuries of change. We remember what we can and watch new and old die.

strings.string:
虽然 =name= 离去了 我们的记忆仍存 瘟疫退却 许多人欢欣。
直到今日 目光仍转向群星 寻找我们的星际远行者 屈尊归来的迹象。
无数年的斗争 数个世纪的变迁。 我们记住所能记住的 看着新旧一同死去。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: Is it really possible to travel the stars?

strings.string: 真的有可能在群星间旅行吗？

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
Who, I? Only a fool, tra la, only a remnant scrap.
Only left-behind, only madness, only an echoing gyre.

strings.string:
谁，我？ 只是一个愚者，特啦啦， 只是一片残余碎屑。
只是被遗落者， 只是疯狂， 只是一道回响的轮回。

string.ID:
Starfarer, herald, disruptor, feared, revered, savior and abandoner.
=name= is a dream from which we will one day awaken.

strings.string:
星际远行者，先驱，扰乱者， 被恐惧，被敬畏， 救世者，也是抛弃者。
=name= 是我们终有一日会醒来的梦。

string.ID:
Who cares?
Can one? Maybe. Can I? Surely not. Can YOU? Well. Prove it.

strings.string:
谁在乎？
有人能吗？也许。 我能吗？当然不能。 你能吗？嗯。 证明它。

string.ID: Once, after it all burst apart, the Fool of the Gyre met a wise jelly. They sat in the slag of the world and the Fool told the story of nowaday.

strings.string: 曾经，在一切爆裂之后， 轮回的愚者遇见一团智慧凝胶。 他们坐在世界的炉渣中 愚者讲起今日的故事。

string.ID: Bloop, blorp. (Proceed.)

strings.string: 啵噜，啵啵。（继续。）

string.ID: Glub. (I must decline.)

strings.string: 咕噜。（我必须谢绝。）

string.ID: Ere the melting of everything, when the spire rose lonely strong, Creatures ruled the hollow land devouring one another as they saw fit.

strings.string: 在万物熔化之前， 当尖塔孤独而强健地耸立， 生物们统治空洞之地， 随心所欲地 彼此吞食。

string.ID:
None hailed =name= and =name= hailed none but with word and blade deed and disregard they stood against their kind.
To push back the Gyre, to spill of Nephil ichor they took to the spire and enacted a great betrayal.
Death of impossible scale reigned and we Nervous Ones fell, and as the Gyre swallowed us we sang to the last.

strings.string:
无人向 =name= 致意 =name= 也不向任何人致意 但凭言语与刀锋 行动与漠视 他们站出来反抗同类。
为推退轮回， 为洒出拿非利灵液 他们登上尖塔 上演了一场伟大背叛。
不可能规模的死亡统治一切 我们神经者倒下， 而当轮回吞没我们时 我们歌唱到最后。

string.ID:
Yet some remained in comb-cave and vault, we Nervous Ones, watching our successors burgeon:
You alveolates, you diatoms, you scum-blooms and gillcaps, you one-cells and slime-cities. rising glorious and shining out of our withering shadow.

strings.string:
然而仍有一些留下 在蜂巢洞与拱库中， 我们神经者， 看着继承者葱茏滋长：
你们这些囊泡虫，你们这些硅藻， 你们这些浮渣花与鳃盖， 你们这些单细胞与黏液城市。 辉煌而闪耀地升起 走出我们凋萎的阴影。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Who is =name=?

strings.string: =name= 是谁？

string.ID: I thought the Nervous Ones extinct.

strings.string: 我以为神经者已经灭绝了。

string.ID: Thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I am the carcass of a fool made to jump and dance by a troupe of merry bacteria.
Do you like how I walk? Do you like how I talk? Do you like how my face disintegrates into salt?

strings.string:
我是愚者的尸壳 被一群欢快细菌 驱使着跳跃舞蹈。
你喜欢我走路的样子吗？ 你喜欢我说话的样子吗？ 你喜欢我的脸 崩解成盐的样子吗？

string.ID:
Determiner and fate.
More a thing of nature than a being of any kind.
More the context of our existence than anything in it.

strings.string:
决定者与命运。
与其说是某种存在 更像自然之物。
与其说在我们的存在之内 更像我们存在的语境。

string.ID:
Perhaps we are, perhaps we are. What wiggles in the hot soil? Flagella?
Or could it be a tail?

strings.string:
也许我们是， 也许我们是。 在热土中扭动的是什么？ 鞭毛？
还是一条尾巴？

string.ID: O? What.. am I cohering? Curious! To fetch my notebook. But, o...

strings.string: 噢？什么……我正在凝聚吗？有趣！得去取我的笔记本。可是，噢……

string.ID:
Ah!
Tell me, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=, was it the picture of wonder as I see it in my mind's eye? Were you beauty-struck by its truths?

strings.string:
啊！
告诉我，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=，它是否如我心眼中所见那般奇妙？你是否被它真理中的美击中了？

string.ID: Truly breathtaking. How the glass glittered in the sun!

strings.string: 真是摄人心魄。玻璃在阳光下何等闪耀！

string.ID: To behold the Argent Fathers in simulacra... what revelation!

strings.string: 得见白银诸父的拟像……何等启示！

string.ID: I saw only empty spectacle. Who can worship a hole in the ground?

strings.string: 我只看见空洞的奇观。谁会崇拜地上的一个洞？

string.ID:
So it's true! O Argent Fathers, how far-reaching your works!
... and my trinket? Did you cast it into the Sacred Well?

strings.string:
这么说是真的！噢，白银诸父，你们的造作何等深远！
……那我的小饰物呢？你把它投入圣井了吗？

string.ID: I did.

strings.string: 投了。

string.ID: Sadly, it was lost.

strings.string: 遗憾的是，它丢了。

string.ID: No, I took it apart or sold it or something.

strings.string: 没有，我把它拆了，或者卖了，类似那样。

string.ID:
Moon and Sun! The Argent Fathers bless us, our paths are chromed and glistering.
You have my thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. Bel shield you.

strings.string:
月与日！白银诸父祝福我们，我们的道路覆铬而闪耀。
你有我的谢意，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。愿贝尔庇护你。

string.ID: And you as well.

strings.string: 也愿祂庇护你。

string.ID:
Oh, I am leaden with this knowledge. Yet am I soothed by your pilgrimage.
Moon and Sun, I feel the warmth of the Kasaphescence yet. Praise the Argent Fathers.

strings.string:
噢，这消息令我沉重如铅。但你的朝圣仍抚慰了我。
月与日，我仍感到卡萨辉体的温暖。赞美白银诸父。

string.ID:
Oh, how your words rasp my soul, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You abrade me.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
噢，你的话何等刮擦我的灵魂，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你磨损了我。
我们不要再说了。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 好吧。

string.ID:
So you have seen the truth? Great are the machinations of our Argent Fathers!
Our meeting, a tiny Canticle. Fate dances in our shadows by their will and word.
Moon and sun, what a day! What a fine day. Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string:
所以你已经见到了真理？我们白银诸父的机巧何等伟大！
我们的相遇，是一支小小圣歌。命运因他们的意志与言辞，在我们的影子中起舞。
月与日，何等一日！何等美好的一日。赞美谢金娜！

string.ID: Praise Shekhinah!

strings.string: 赞美谢金娜！

string.ID:
Wh-
My heart's sheen wanes to hear this of you. You abrade me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I am scuffed.
What of my trinket, then? Did you cast it into the... "hole in the ground?"

strings.string:
什——
听你这么说，我心中的光泽黯淡了。你磨损了我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我被刮花了。
那我的小饰物呢？你把它投入了那个……“地上的洞”吗？

string.ID: Yes, I threw it in the hole.

strings.string: 是的，我把它扔进洞里了。

string.ID: No, I lost it.

strings.string: 没有，我弄丢了。

string.ID: I gave it to someone. Or sold it, perhaps.

strings.string: 我把它给了别人。或者也许卖了。

string.ID:
Well... the light of the Kasaphescence yet glimmers through your rasping edge.
I must, then, thank you.

strings.string:
好吧……卡萨辉体之光仍透过你刮擦的边缘微微闪烁。
那么，我必须感谢你。

string.ID: You're welcome.

strings.string: 不客气。

string.ID:
My stomach lurches and quavers at the shock of this knowledge.
If there is a lesson in your disregard, I will meditate upon it in my own time.
Let us speak no more.

strings.string:
得知此事，我的胃在震惊中翻腾颤抖。
如果你的轻忽中有某种教训，我会在自己的时间里冥想它。
我们不要再说了。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 如你所言。

string.ID:
Ah, a pit opens under my stomach!
Let us speak no more, I beg you. You scuff me. Live and drink.

strings.string:
啊，我胃下裂开一座深坑！
我们不要再说了，我求你。你刮伤了我。生而饮水。

string.ID: Wanderer and =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! Have you journeyed yet to the Stilt, and seen the Sacred Well?

strings.string: 游人兼 =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！你可曾前往高跷，见到圣井？

string.ID: Not yet, friend. Live and drink.

strings.string: 还没有，朋友。生而饮水。

string.ID: Wanderer! Do you venture northwise? Into the Great Desert and nearer the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 游人！你要向北行进吗？进入大沙漠，靠近六日高跷？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 六日高跷是什么？

string.ID: Why do you ask?

strings.string: 你为什么问？

string.ID:
Ah! The great Mechanimist temple of glass, the sacred offering Well, and history in stone relief. Peopled by the Argent Fathers, in statue and light sculpture. And circled by the grand bazaar. I hear there are more people there than numbers in the void, and their chatter makes a sound wholly raw and new to the world.
Will you go there, and take my bauble? Will you offer it at the Well, where I cannot?

strings.string:
啊！那是伟大的机械教玻璃神庙，有神圣的奉献井，还有石雕浮雕中的历史。白银诸父以雕像和光雕的形式居于其中。宏大的集市环绕其侧。我听说那里的人比虚空中的数字还多，他们的喧谈发出一种对世界而言全然原始而崭新的声音。
你愿去那里，带上我的小玩意吗？你愿在我无法前往的井边献上它吗？

string.ID: Your bauble?

strings.string: 你的小玩意？

string.ID: Argent Fathers?

strings.string: 白银诸父？

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 你为什么不能去？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会踏上这趟旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned something loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻亲都听腻了这故事。我割藤时，刀身平面从土里翻出了一样东西。我从前见到铬钢时也曾心动，但亲手解放出一小片碎屑，亲手在美的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么你愿去吗？把我的小玩意献在井中？

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 你为什么不能去？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 六日高跷再说一次是什么？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会踏上这趟旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I am no rector, understand, but They are the molders of chrome. The gods under Shekhinah who wrought metal edifices from the raw Kasaphescence.
Will you go?

strings.string:
你要明白，我并非教区长，但他们是铬钢的塑造者。是谢金娜之下的诸神，从原始卡萨辉体中造出金属宏构。
你愿去吗？

string.ID: Perhaps. Why?

strings.string: 也许。为什么？

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

string.ID: I would ask you make an offering at the sacred Well of my bauble. Moon and sun, I beg you!

strings.string: 我想请你把我的小玩意献入圣井。月与日，我求你！

string.ID: Why can you not go?

strings.string: 你为什么不能去？

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 六日高跷是什么？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会踏上这趟旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert, and little more in the canyons. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆冒烟的焦物，被晨翔兽的射线烤死！我会被以萨迦人的步枪打成满是弹孔的尸体！
大沙漠中没有仁慈，峡谷中也好不了多少。我若去了，便活不下来。

string.ID: What is the Six Day Stilt again?

strings.string: 六日高跷再说一次是什么？

string.ID: I will make the journey.

strings.string: 我会踏上这趟旅程。

string.ID: I cannot commit to this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我不能承诺此事。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Moon and sun, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=! You have my deep and many-sided thanks. Here, take the trinket now. And if you're to ever return, let us visit again.
Live and drink!

strings.string:
月与日，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=！请收下我深切而多面的感谢。来，现在拿上这件小饰物。若你日后归来，让我们再相见。
生而饮水！

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was scything the vine when the flat of my blade turned it loose from the soil. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead toward the beam on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻亲都听腻了这故事。我割藤时，刀身平面把它从土里翻了出来。我从前见到铬钢时也曾心动，但亲手解放出一小片碎屑，亲手在美的算盘上把一颗珠子拨向横梁……
那么你愿去吗？把我的小玩意献在井中？

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was supping on summer offal when I noticed something glinting in the guts. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻亲都听腻了这故事。我正在啜食夏日下水时，注意到肠肚里有什么东西闪了一下。我从前见到铬钢时也曾心动，但亲手解放出一小片碎屑，亲手在美的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么你愿去吗？把我的小玩意献在井中？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆冒烟的焦物，被晨翔兽的射线烤死！我会被以萨迦人的步枪打成满是弹孔的尸体！
大沙漠中没有仁慈。我若去了，便活不下来。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I was wrenching moisture from a banner when I kicked something 'neath the salt. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻亲都听腻了这故事。我正从一面旗帜里绞出水分时，踢到了盐下的某样东西。我从前见到铬钢时也曾心动，但亲手解放出一小片碎屑，亲手在美的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么你愿去吗？把我的小玩意献在井中？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of my kinsfolk!
There is no kindness deep in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆冒烟的焦物，被晨翔兽的射线烤死！我会被自己族人的步枪打成满是弹孔的尸体！
大沙漠深处没有仁慈。我若去了，便活不下来。

string.ID:
Yes! My neighbor-kin tire of the tale. I fished it out a mound of pig stool. My heart has stirred before at the sight of chrome, but to free a small splinter myself, to slide a bead on the abacus of Beauty...
Will you go, then? And offer my bauble at the Well?

strings.string:
是的！我的邻亲都听腻了这故事。我从一堆猪粪里把它捞了出来。我从前见到铬钢时也曾心动，但亲手解放出一小片碎屑，亲手在美的算盘上拨动一颗珠子……
那么你愿去吗？把我的小玩意献在井中？

string.ID:
Friend, I would be a smoldering heap, cooked to death by the ray of a dawnglider! I would be a slug-riddled corpse by the rifles of the Issachari!
There is no kindness in the Great Desert. I cannot go and live.

strings.string:
朋友，我会变成一堆冒烟的焦物，被晨翔兽的射线烤死！我会被以萨迦人的步枪打成满是弹孔的尸体！
大沙漠中没有仁慈。我若去了，便活不下来。

string.ID: -mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: ——嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: {{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑。*}}
进来——来坐在清凉阴影下，那边的垫子上。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink, =name=. Come, sit with me.

strings.string:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑。*}}
生而饮水，=name=。来，陪我坐坐。

string.ID:
-mm. Mmm? =player.FormalAddressTerm=?
{{emote|*Elder Irudad smiles.*}}
Live and drink. Come in- come sit 'neath the cool shade, 'cross a pillow there. And welcome to Joppa.
You may drink of our freshwater, too, and quench your thirst.

strings.string:
——嗯。嗯？=player.FormalAddressTerm=？
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德微笑。*}}
生而饮水。进来——来坐在清凉阴影下，那边的垫子上。欢迎来到约帕。
你也可以饮用我们的淡水，解解渴。

string.ID: I'm back from Red Rock with the corpse of a pale spiderling. Elder, would you examine it?

strings.string: 我从红岩回来了，带着一具苍白小蜘蛛的尸体。长老，你愿意检查一下吗？

string.ID: What is this place, Joppa?

strings.string: 约帕是什么地方？

string.ID: Do you sell wares here?

strings.string: 你们这里卖货物吗？

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: Can you tell me about the Gyre and the Girsh nephilim again?

strings.string: 你能再告诉我一次轮回和吉尔什拿非利的事吗？

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Six Day Stilt?

strings.string: 关于六日高跷，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: Argyve wants me to meet the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 阿吉夫想让我去见巴拉瑟姆派。

string.ID:
-this? The oasis-hamlet. 'Neath the shelf of the world. A million breaths of salt the wind heaves over the Great Salt Desert Moghra'yi. And to the east, the rotting jungles of Qud.
Here in the crack between the two, watervine can grow, and we grow it. mmm, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
——这里？绿洲小村。在世界架层之下。风把百万口盐息吹过莫格拉伊大盐漠。而东方，是库德腐烂的丛林。
就在两者之间的裂隙里，水藤能够生长，而我们种植它。嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about Qud?

strings.string: 你能给我讲讲库德吗？

string.ID:
-mm, there? Land slopes up and is toothed in chrome steeples, ageless things. Looming over the old-earth tunnels, pillowed in rotting jungle and fungus groves. And broken against the mounts of the north, they are, in the shadow of the Spindle...
There are people, friends, communities. And friends-to-noone, too. History is thick as the high salt sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and where the past is ground up like matz meal, a mix of life sets in.
-mm, adventurous ones set off for their own splinter of artifact. To both Fates, life and death...

strings.string:
——嗯，那里？土地向上倾斜，长着铬钢尖塔般的齿，那些无龄之物。它们耸立在旧土隧道之上，枕在腐烂丛林与真菌林中。又在北方山脉前碎裂，处在纺锤的阴影里……
那里有人，有朋友，有社群。也有谁都不友善的存在。历史像高悬的盐日一样厚重，=player.formalAddressTerm=，而在过去被碾成无酵饼粉的地方，各种生命混杂扎根。
——嗯，爱冒险的人会出发，去寻找属于自己的神器碎片。敬两种命运，生命与死亡……

string.ID: -here? Speak to my daughter through the east door, for herbs. And sitting Tam in the southeast has all manner of trinket, against his chests o' drawers.

strings.string: ——这里？要草药，就去东门那边找我女儿。东南边坐着的塔姆有各式小玩意，靠着他的抽屉柜。

string.ID:
-mm, work? The farmers are plagued by cave vermin. You might speak to Mehmet o' there, by the southern watervine patch.
And Argyve, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string:
——嗯，活干？农民正受洞穴害兽困扰。你可以去和那边的穆罕默德谈谈，就在南边水藤田旁。
还有阿吉夫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。总在找小玩意接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮小屋。

string.ID: -mm, work? Try Argyve, =player.formalAddressTerm=. The tinker. Always looking for trinkets to wire between, heh. Go through his hut of sheet metal, to the southwest.

strings.string: ——嗯，活干？去找阿吉夫试试，=player.formalAddressTerm=。那个修补匠。总在找小玩意接线，呵。往西南去，穿过他的铁皮小屋。

string.ID: -ahh, mm, such spectacle. The statues within, a revelation to the eyes. Chandlers enough to drain your skins dry 'twixt Shallows and Beetle Moon.

strings.string: ——啊，嗯，何等奇观。里面的雕像，对眼睛而言是一场启示。香烛商多得足以在浅滩月到甲虫月之间把你的水囊榨干。

string.ID: -mm, Barathrumites. Strange draft o'those bearfolk. They, mm, hah. They care not overly for outsiders. I hope Argyve sold you not a better welcome than you'll have.

strings.string: ——嗯，巴拉瑟姆派。那些熊民中奇怪的一支。他们，嗯，哈。他们不怎么喜欢外人。我希望阿吉夫没把你会得到的欢迎说得太好。

string.ID:
-this? Oh? Oh...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses for several minutes.*}}
Warted leg? mm. Foul smell of sour gum? mmm. Moon and sun....
A girshling? This is a girshling.

strings.string:
——这个？噢？噢……
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿了好几分钟。*}}
长疣的腿？嗯。酸胶的恶臭？嗯。月与日……
一只吉尔什幼体？这是吉尔什幼体。

string.ID: What's a girshling?

strings.string: 吉尔什幼体是什么？

string.ID:
Creature of plague, =player.formalAddressTerm=. mmm. This one...
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
This one covered in slick and muscled out the bilge hose of sleeping Agolgot, in the cave under the Cloaca...
-mm, but here? Girshling this far west? There must be hundreds for one to reach... mm, does the Gyre widen again??

strings.string:
瘟疫之物，=player.formalAddressTerm=。嗯。这个……
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}
这东西浑身滑腻，从泄殖腔下方洞穴里沉睡阿戈尔戈特的舱底排水管中强行挤出……
——嗯，可是在这里？吉尔什幼体到了这么西边？必定有成百上千只，才会有一只抵达……嗯，轮回又在扩张了吗？？
轮回？

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我和吉尔什幼体旁边的一个怪人说过话。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有个怪人尾随着那生物……

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到那生物的尖牙被拔掉了。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, plagues. Of our great grandsires many-times-over. Salt, darkness, svardym-frog... Girshling.

strings.string:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}
——嗯，瘟疫。我们许多代以前祖祖辈辈的瘟疫。盐，黑暗，斯瓦尔丁蛙……吉尔什幼体。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Do not like to sour the air with a harsh word! But this tiding bites my liver like acid. mm, must ask Nima for an elixir of yuckwheat...

strings.string:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}
——嗯，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我不喜欢用刺耳话语酸败空气！但这消息像酸一样咬我的肝。嗯，必须去找妮玛要一剂恶心麦药水……

string.ID: I talked to a strange figure next to the girshling.

strings.string: 我和吉尔什幼体旁边的一个怪人说过话。

string.ID: There was a strange figure shadowing the creature...

strings.string: 有个怪人尾随着那生物……

string.ID: I noticed the creature has had its fangs removed.

strings.string: 我注意到那生物的尖牙被拔掉了。

string.ID: I am sorry to cause pain, Elder.

strings.string: 很抱歉让你痛苦，长老。

string.ID: -mm, oh? In dyed robes, flashing gestures of hand? And ranting about pipe milk? A gyre wight, must be. They about worship the Girsh nephilim as gods.

strings.string: ——嗯，噢？穿染色长袍，手势闪动？还嚷嚷着管乳？一定是轮回尸鬼。他们近乎把吉尔什拿非利当作神来崇拜。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

strings.string: 吉尔什拿非利？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Elder Irudad pauses.*}}
-mm, nephilim. Seventh plague. Girsh titans born on the Moon Stair, and quickened to life to eat our young. Sultan Resheph drove them back a chiliad ago, away to slumber. mm, do they rouse?

strings.string:
{{emote|*长老伊鲁达德停顿。*}}
——嗯，拿非利。第七瘟疫。诞生于月阶的吉尔什巨人，被激活成生命来吞食我们的幼子。一千年前，苏丹瑞谢夫把他们赶回去沉睡。嗯，他们要醒来了吗？

string.ID: -mm, oh? A gyre wight, must be. They bind the teeth right up to their own gums, to make a show for the Girsh nephilim.

strings.string: ——嗯，噢？一定是轮回尸鬼。他们把牙直接绑到自己的牙龈上，向吉尔什拿非利作秀。

string.ID: Girsh nephilim?

strings.string: 吉尔什拿非利？

string.ID:
-mm? No, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Your finding is rich in value to us. We are poor farmers, and sharpen our vinereapers is all we can do. But others? Perhaps more.
Take these prickly-boons as thanks. mm, I will not soon forget this, =name=. Leave me now to muse, kindly...

strings.string:
——嗯？不，=player.formalAddressTerm=！你的发现对我们极有价值。我们只是贫苦农民，能做的只有磨快藤镰。但其他人呢？或许能做更多。
收下这些刺恩果作为谢礼。嗯，我不会很快忘记这事，=name=。现在请让我独自沉思吧……

string.ID:
-mm, yes? Plagues, a chiliad old. Seven such: girshlings, darkness. mm, svardym-frog...
Ah, nephilim, too, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Girsh titans who eat the young of kith and kin. Sultan Resheph drove them under the earth, but do they stir??

strings.string:
——嗯，是吗？瘟疫，一千年前的瘟疫。共有七种：吉尔什幼体，黑暗。嗯，斯瓦尔丁蛙……
啊，还有拿非利，=player.formalAddressTerm=。吞食亲族幼子的吉尔什巨人。苏丹瑞谢夫把他们驱入地下，但他们在躁动吗？？

string.ID: -mm, oh? You're wondering if they might come to Joppa, then?

strings.string: ——嗯，噢？那么你是在想，他们能否来到约帕？

string.ID: mm, I am for you, =name=. Any friend of yours is too a friend of Joppa, and if those friends desire shelter I wouldn't dare turn them away. I only hope these lilypad-folk have the patience for a farmer's life. -mm, not as exciting here as it was in the Palladium Reef.

strings.string: 嗯，我支持你，=name=。你的任何朋友也都是约帕的朋友；若这些朋友想要庇护，我不敢拒绝他们。我只希望这些睡莲叶之民有耐心过农夫的生活。——嗯，这里可不像钯礁那么刺激。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Elder.

strings.string: 你有我的谢意，长老。

string.ID: -mm, blessings upon your generous heart, =name=. I mean no slight to these slynth, but it is too great a favor you ask of the people of Joppa.

strings.string: ——嗯，愿祝福落在你慷慨的心上，=name=。我无意轻慢这些斯林思，但你向约帕人民请求的恩惠太大了。

string.ID: Have you spoken to the slynth, =name=? I am curious to hear what destination they choose.

strings.string: 你和斯林思谈过了吗，=name=？我很好奇他们会选择什么目的地。

string.ID:
-mm, your luminous friends are settling in quite well.
There is yet a pall of ennui among some, but such is the case for any party of brave migrants. Ah, they will find their ground or their path, all in time. Some farmers show some small discomfort but that will pass in time.

strings.string:
——嗯，你那些发光的朋友安顿得相当不错。
有些人身上仍笼着一层倦怠，但任何勇敢迁徙者的队伍都是如此。啊，他们终会找到自己的土地或道路。一些农民表现出些许不适，但那也会随时间过去。

string.ID: My thanks, Elder.

strings.string: 多谢，长老。

string.ID:
-mm, ah, =name=. Come see how the slynth have become a part of Joppa!
Some cared not for the slow pace of our lives and struck out on their own, and with their thews and wits I have no doubt they will live to find purpose. mm, others are welcome to grow and flourish here in our marshes.

strings.string:
——嗯，啊，=name=。来看看斯林思如何成为约帕的一部分！
有些人不喜欢我们生活的缓慢步调，便独自出发；凭他们的筋力和智慧，我毫不怀疑他们会活着找到目标。嗯，其他人则欢迎在我们的沼泽中生长繁盛。

string.ID: My thanks again, Elder.

strings.string: 再次感谢，长老。

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=. Any news from Red Rock?

strings.string: 生而饮水，=name=。红岩有什么消息吗？

string.ID: Yes. I found the vermin and bits of gnawed watervine. I carry one's corpse with me.

strings.string: 有。我找到了害兽和被啃过的水藤碎片。我带着其中一只的尸体。

string.ID: None yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=name=。

string.ID: Taste what on the wind today, =name=?

strings.string: 今天风里尝到什么了，=name=？

string.ID: Moon and sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月与日，=name=。

string.ID: I can taste lime, =name=. And mayhaps gallium?

strings.string: 我能尝到石灰，=name=。也许还有镓？

string.ID: Aye, the pest-vanquisher! Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 是啊，害虫征服者！生而饮水，=name=。

string.ID: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.

strings.string: 水佣？是啊。生而饮水，旅人。

string.ID: I am called =name=.

strings.string: 我叫 =name=。

string.ID: Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?

strings.string: 你能讲讲你的村子约帕吗？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在寻找工作。

string.ID: Mehmet, the tongue says. Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 舌头说，是穆罕默德。生而饮水，=name=。

string.ID: Watervine farm in the lap of the marsh. You've sucked the moisture out a vinewafer, yea? We tend the plant here.

strings.string: 沼泽怀抱里的水藤农场。你吸过藤饼里的水分吧？我们在这里照料那种植物。

string.ID:
Wind off the Great Desert cools a touch and gives up moisture. Just enough. A tongue can taste a hundred kinds of wind, y'know?
Anywhile, that's where my wandering mind goes. More's about Joppa I say speak to our Elderfriend. Irudad. Up northwise the path.

strings.string:
从大沙漠吹来的风稍微凉下来，交出一点水分。刚刚够。舌头能尝出一百种风，你知道吗？
总之，我飘来飘去的心就会想到那里。想知道更多约帕的事，我说去找我们的长老朋友。伊鲁达德。沿路往北。

string.ID:
Aye? I have it, then.
Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.
I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...

strings.string:
是吗？那我有活。
甲虫月前后，有东西在吃我们的水藤。库伦说他看见一种像蜘蛛的生物，在盐水里潜行。但没有洞穴蜘蛛敢靠守望者的脚步那么近。
我在水池里尝到一点红色碎屑。页岩，就像我们在红岩那边土里找到的……

string.ID:
Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.
Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.

strings.string:
你愿意走一趟吗？去红岩。就在约帕以北大约两帕拉桑。
杀掉害兽，带一具尸体回来，好看看它到底是什么。之后长老会负责付你报酬，水佣。

string.ID: I will do as you ask.

strings.string: 我会照你说的做。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。
是。

string.ID:
Oh? Oh. {{emote|*Mehmet pauses.*}}
Don't like the look o' that thing. Best bring it to Elder. Hut's northwise up the path.

strings.string:
噢？噢。{{emote|*穆罕默德停顿。*}}
我不喜欢那东西的样子。最好把它带给长老。小屋沿路往北。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 如你所言。
=generic=

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

strings.string: =player.apparentSpecies=？我们相逢了！你想要什么？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Do you live here?

strings.string: 你住在这里吗？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是什么生物？

string.ID: I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我什么也不想要。生而饮水。

string.ID: It is a pleasure to know this, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=! I am Tam.

strings.string: 很高兴知道这一点，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm= =name=！我是塔姆。

string.ID:
Joppa is my home, yes.
I walked Moghra'yi in the caravans of my brethren and the saltback, but upon meeting Elder Irudad, knew at once to settle down here. You will understand, =player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=, if you speak to him.

strings.string:
约帕是我的家，是的。
我曾随我的同胞与盐背的商队行走莫格拉伊，但一见到长老伊鲁达德，便立刻知道该在此定居。你若和他说话，就会明白的，=player.formalAddressTerm= =player.apparentSpecies=。

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是卓马德，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=。有人说盐行者。你知道吗？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我知道。

string.ID: I do not.

strings.string: 我不知道。

string.ID: My people have walked the salt for thousands of years, meeting every creature that lives and thinks. From Pale Sea to the marsh of Joppa, and under the Hanging Hills, our chests are drawn.

strings.string: 我的族人在盐中行走了数千年，遇见每一种活着并思考的生物。从苍白海到约帕沼泽，再到悬丘之下，我们的箱柜都被牵引而行。

string.ID: =player.apparentSpecies=? We are greeted! What do you desire?

strings.string: =player.apparentSpecies=？我们相逢了！你想要什么？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是什么生物？

string.ID: I desire nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我什么也不想要。生而饮水。

string.ID: I am dromad, =player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=. Some say saltstrider. Do you know this?

strings.string: 我是卓马德，=player.apparentSpecies= =player.formalAddressTerm=。有人说盐行者。你知道吗？

string.ID:
Psst!
Hey, can I interest you in some Consortium wares?

strings.string:
嘘！
嘿，有没有兴趣看看财团货物？

string.ID: Welcome a-Joppa, friend. Stay peacelike, and we stay friends, hyeh? You make trouble, it's my work a-split you open like a croc.

strings.string: 欢迎来约帕，朋友。和平点，我们就还是朋友，嘿？你要惹麻烦，我的活儿就是把你像鳄鱼一样剖开。

string.ID: Elder's over my right shoulder, chemist a-left. I ask you pick one or turn around. I en't here for chat.

strings.string: 长老在我右肩那边，药剂师在左边。我请你挑一个，或者转身走。我不是来聊天的。

string.ID: Live and drink, yonderling.

strings.string: 生而饮水，远方人。

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame grunts.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊拉姆哼了一声。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Yrame nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*伊拉姆点头。*}}

string.ID: What follows, then?

strings.string: 那接下来呢？

string.ID: Got an eyeful, heh?

strings.string: 看够了吧，嘿？

string.ID: Well. They en't ended you yet.

strings.string: 好吧。他们还没把你了结。

string.ID: I must search the Rustwells.

strings.string: 我必须搜索锈井。

string.ID: Mehmet has bade me travel to Red Rock.

strings.string: 穆罕默德让我去红岩。

string.ID: I depart for Grit Gate soon.

strings.string: 我很快要动身去砂砾门。

string.ID: I journey North, to the Six Day Stilt.

strings.string: 我要往北，去六日高跷。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: What is a Warden?

strings.string: 守望者是什么？

string.ID: Called Yrame, Warden a-Joppa. I kill trouble. Don't be trouble.

strings.string: 叫伊拉姆，约帕守望者。我杀麻烦。别当麻烦。

string.ID: Nigh every settlement a-Qud keeps a Warden. We snuff threats to the peace.

strings.string: 库德几乎每个聚居点都有守望者。我们掐灭威胁和平的东西。

string.ID: Out East? Uegh. Wouldn't go, I. Git ta Qudzu. Like as rust the pauldrons right off a-shoulders.

strings.string: 往东？呃。我可不去。会碰上库德葛。说不定把肩上的肩甲都锈掉。

string.ID: Up North? En't far. See them baboons, you put one's light out for me.

strings.string: 往北？不远。见到那些狒狒，替我弄死一只。

string.ID: Don't say? Well. Fates favor your feet, hyeh.

strings.string: 真的？好吧。愿命运眷顾你的脚，嘿。

string.ID: If you don't get dry-roasted by the fire snakes, ought be a time of times. Better hit all the food stalls for samples, hyeh?

strings.string: 如果你没被火蛇烤干，那该会是一段好时候。最好去每个食摊都尝点样品，嘿？

string.ID: Ahh, there is a new face. I am Nima Ruda, town apothecary. If your feet point to Qud, you'll need some of my wares before you go.

strings.string: 啊，有张新面孔。我是妮玛·鲁达，镇上的药剂师。如果你的脚指向库德，出发前你会需要我的一些货物。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。

string.ID: Time and rest are the surest way to dress a wound, but my wares can help if you're in a hurry.

strings.string: 时间与休息是包扎伤口最稳妥的方法，但如果你赶时间，我的货物能帮上忙。

string.ID: The Fates watch you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 命运注视着你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Don't let your nostrums run dry on the road. I have what you need.

strings.string: 别让你的药剂在路上耗尽。我有你需要的东西。

string.ID: What wares do you offer?

strings.string: 你卖什么货物？

string.ID: Where are you from?

strings.string: 你来自哪里？

string.ID: Witchwood for pain, bandages for bleeding, yuckwheat and honey for when your guts act up. Coldcaps when I can find them. Why not take a look?

strings.string: 止痛用的巫木，止血用的绷带，肠胃闹腾时用的恶心麦和蜂蜜。找得到时也有冷帽菇。何不看看？

string.ID: I grew up right here in Joppa, daughter of the Elder and all. Spent some years delving, but gave it up after a few near escapes and nearly deadly wounds. I'm better suited to herbalism anyway, and my father worries less.

strings.string: 我就在约帕长大，毕竟是长老的女儿。曾经探洞好几年，但几次险些逃不出来、几处差点要命的伤之后就放弃了。反正我更适合草药学，我父亲也少担心些。

string.ID: Will you inherit leadership of Joppa from your father?

strings.string: 你会从你父亲那里继承约帕的领导权吗？
