string.ID: Fates forfend. I would hardly like to lead a village and run a shop at the same time.

strings.string: 命运可别如此。我可不想一边领导村子，一边经营店铺。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 有道理。生而饮水。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Moist starapples for the road?

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。路上要些多汁星苹果吗？

string.ID: Mind the trees, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They ain't yours.

strings.string: 注意那些树，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们不是你的。

string.ID: Now you keep your eyes off my young, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 你可别盯着我的小崽看，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Can't go wrong with starapples, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Good for what ails ya.

strings.string: 星苹果不会错，=player.formalAddressTerm=。有啥毛病都管点用。

string.ID: You know how to make starapple jam? If not, you can buy it from me.

strings.string: 你知道怎么做星苹果酱吗？不知道的话，可以从我这儿买。

string.ID: Spread starapple on yer matz! It's proof against thirst and harm alike.

strings.string: 把星苹果抹在你的无酵饼上！既防渴，也防伤。

string.ID: See my whiskers? Starapples. They'll boost your virility threefold.

strings.string: 看见我的胡须了吗？星苹果。它们能让你的精力强上三倍。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Are you hungry?

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。饿了吗？

string.ID: Git ta pig mud. Mud?

strings.string: 去猪泥那边。泥？
咋？

string.ID: Mind the pig leavins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 小心猪留下的东西，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Now don't you go breaking my fence.

strings.string: 你可别弄坏我的围栏。

string.ID: You best not hurt my critters.

strings.string: 你最好别伤我的小家伙。

string.ID: I en't filthy. I'm muddy. Big difference.

strings.string: 我不脏。我只是沾泥。差得远呢。

string.ID: It's get meat here or risk a slugsnout ball in the gut. Your choice, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 要么在这儿买肉，要么冒着肚子里挨一发蛞蝓嘴弹丸的风险。你选吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Good clean meat! Well. Clean as it gets.

strings.string: 好干净的肉！呃。能干净到这份上。

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Now don't you fret. My crabs are docile as dogs.

strings.string: 别担心。我的蟹温顺得像狗。

string.ID: Get close if you like, they don't pinch.

strings.string: 你愿意就靠近点，它们不夹人。

string.ID: You ever run into one of these in the wild? The lengths some folks will go for a crab leg!

strings.string: 你在野外碰见过这种东西吗？有些人为了蟹腿真是什么都肯干！

string.ID: I hand-reared each one of these critters. They've had a life of luxury.

strings.string: 这些小家伙每一只都是我亲手养大的。它们过的是奢华日子。

string.ID: Stressed crab means tough crab meat. Buy domesticated meat.

strings.string: 有压力的蟹，肉就硬。买驯养肉吧。

string.ID: Ain't they precious? Cute little buggers.

strings.string: 它们不宝贝吗？可爱的小东西。

string.ID: My crabs are as gentle as can be. Delicious, too.

strings.string: 我的蟹温柔得不能再温柔。也很好吃。

string.ID: They say we'll all be crabs, eventually.

strings.string: 他们说，我们最终都会变成蟹。

string.ID: Need something?

strings.string: 需要什么？
嗯。

string.ID: Sorry bout the smell.

strings.string: 抱歉这味儿。

string.ID: Watch for blood puddles.

strings.string: 小心血洼。

string.ID: No lie, I love my job.

strings.string: 说真的，我喜欢我的工作。

string.ID: Leeches. Blood. If that's what you want, I got what you want.

strings.string: 水蛭。血。如果你想要这个，我有你想要的。

string.ID: I feed these critters what blood the ranchers have to spare.

strings.string: 牧场主们有多余的血，我就拿来喂这些小家伙。

string.ID: Sorry. Lost focus a bit. What do you need?

strings.string: 抱歉。有点走神。你需要什么？

string.ID: Blood tastes all right, but I can't fathom living on it.

strings.string: 血味道还行，但我想象不了靠它过活。

string.ID: By the Eaters, I'm exhausted. May I help you?

strings.string: 食客在上，我累坏了。需要帮忙吗？

string.ID: Please don't open the gate.

strings.string: 请别打开门。

string.ID: I beg you. Do not release the cats.

strings.string: 我求你。别把猫放出来。

string.ID: I'll buy your shiniest things, if you'll sell them.

strings.string: 如果你肯卖，我会买下你最闪亮的东西。

string.ID: I'm a cat herder. My parents were cat herders. Their parents were cat herders, and their parents. I don't understand why we do what we do but it is all I know.

strings.string: 我是牧猫人。我父母是牧猫人。他们的父母是牧猫人，再往上也是。我不明白我们为什么要做这些，但我只懂这个。

string.ID: I've a glimmer of light for sale if you need one, wanderer.

strings.string: 如果你需要，我有一缕光可卖，游人。

string.ID: The cats are not for sale.

strings.string: 猫不卖。

string.ID: I'm like to faint from this heat.

strings.string: 我快被这热气弄晕了。

string.ID: Mind your footing! Ha ha ha!

strings.string: 小心脚下！哈哈哈！

string.ID: Takes a simple person to tend a simple creature. I don't mind it.

strings.string: 照料简单生物需要简单的人。我不介意。

string.ID: Bless this mess and bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 祝福这一团乱，也祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: What can I do for you? Need slime?

strings.string: 我能为你做什么？需要黏液吗？

string.ID: Have you ever taken a swig of slime? It's not half bad!

strings.string: 你喝过一大口黏液吗？还不算坏！

string.ID: I keep my amoebas happy! Or, you know, whatever they got in place of happy.

strings.string: 我让我的变形虫保持快乐！或者，你懂的，它们用来替代快乐的那种状态。

string.ID: See how their skin glisters in the salt sun? Lovely.

strings.string: 看它们的皮肤在盐日下多闪亮？真可爱。

string.ID: Now don't you dare pop my amoeba.

strings.string: 你可别敢弄爆我的变形虫。

string.ID: I think I got all the puddles, but watch for slime all the same.

strings.string: 我想我已经清掉所有水洼了，但还是小心黏液。

string.ID: Step in. Take shelter from the salt.

strings.string: 进来吧。躲躲盐。

string.ID: What mazes and mandalas could be crafted by human hands that hope to surpass what nature wrought eons before our creation?

strings.string: 人手能造出什么迷宫与曼荼罗，竟希望超越自然在我们诞生前亿万年便已造就之物？

string.ID: How sublime, the striations of the snail shell. And such a lovely word, striation.

strings.string: 蜗牛壳的条纹何等崇高。而“条纹”也是个多可爱的词。

string.ID: I think often upon the gyre, from Resheph's gospels. Why do you imagine it is so named?

strings.string: 我常常思索瑞谢夫福音中的轮回。你觉得它为什么会如此命名？

string.ID: Even in the imperfections of a spiral shell we see the perfection of nature.

strings.string: 即便在螺旋壳的不完美中，我们也能看见自然的完美。

string.ID: My snails aren't so suited to this climate. Some days I spend more water keeping them properly slimy than I make in sales.

strings.string: 我的蜗牛不太适应这种气候。有些日子，我为了让它们保持足够黏滑，花掉的水比卖货赚来的还多。

string.ID: Snails find the spiral of another shell familiar and comforting. Should you wear one, they will look upon you favorably.

strings.string: 蜗牛会觉得另一只壳的螺旋熟悉而安心。如果你戴上一只，它们会友善地看待你。

string.ID: There is kinship from mollusk to mollusk. What secrets do they know that we do not?

strings.string: 软体动物与软体动物之间自有亲缘。它们知道哪些我们不知道的秘密？

string.ID: What d'ya want.

strings.string: 你想要啥。

string.ID: Goat meat keeps good. Buy some afore you head back to the salt.

strings.string: 山羊肉耐放。回盐地之前买点吧。

string.ID: What, you need a menu? I got goat meat and goat jerky.

strings.string: 怎么，你还要菜单？我有山羊肉和山羊肉干。

string.ID: I hate my goats and they hate me, but we both hate every other body more.

strings.string: 我恨我的山羊，它们也恨我，但我们都更恨其他所有人。

string.ID: Absolutely miserable weather. Whatcha want?

strings.string: 这天气糟透了。你想要啥？

string.ID: Meat for sale.

strings.string: 卖肉。

string.ID: Goats ain't fun to travel with, but they're good protection.

strings.string: 带山羊旅行不好玩，但它们很能护身。

string.ID: I didn't ask for this life, but here we are. Wanna buy something?

strings.string: 我没主动要这种生活，但事已至此。想买点什么吗？

string.ID: Some say beetle jerky is too sour. I say, learn to cook!

strings.string: 有人说甲虫肉干太酸。我要说，学学做饭吧！

string.ID: Look at their chitin! See the sheen? Means they're healthy.

strings.string: 看看它们的几丁质！看见光泽了吗？说明它们很健康。

string.ID: Beetles are fine companions, but don't leave your backpack and your pet beetlebum in the same room.

strings.string: 甲虫是好伙伴，但别把你的背包和宠物甲虫屁股留在同一个房间里。

string.ID: Nothing wrong with beetle meat. Come, try it.

strings.string: 甲虫肉没什么不好。来，试试。

string.ID: Beetle jerky holds its own. You learn to appreciate the aftertaste.

strings.string: 甲虫肉干自有本事。你会学会欣赏它的回味。

string.ID: Meat, fresh and preserved alike, all at reasonable prices.

strings.string: 肉，新鲜的和腌存的都有，价格都公道。

string.ID: Come to see my beasts? All hale and well-fed, I assure you.

strings.string: 来看我的牲口？我保证，它们都健康，吃得也好。

string.ID: Live and eat honey.

strings.string: 长生，食蜜。

string.ID: Oh, look. It is a not-bear. Greetings, not-bear.

strings.string: 噢，看啊。是一只非熊。你好，非熊。

string.ID: Live and drink, little friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，小朋友。

string.ID: I would enjoy some honey.

strings.string: 我想来点蜂蜜。
{{emote|*哼哼*}}
{{emote|*嗅嗅*}}
{{emote|*呼哧嗅气*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*heavy sigh*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*重重叹气*}}
{{emote|*叹气*}}

string.ID: Oh my, what a cute not-bear. Greetings, cute not-bear.

strings.string: 哎呀，多可爱的非熊。你好，可爱的非熊。
噢。
嗯。

string.ID: Hmm. Oh! Greetings.

strings.string: 嗯。噢！你好。
嗯？

string.ID: Excuse me.

strings.string: 劳驾。

string.ID: Oh. Live and drink, not-bear.

strings.string: 噢。生而饮水，非熊。

string.ID: I cannot decide which I like best: berries, meat, or honey? I simply cannot decide.

strings.string: 我决定不了自己最喜欢哪一种：浆果、肉，还是蜂蜜？我就是决定不了。

string.ID: Glowfish are not the tastiest food, but they are the prettiest.

strings.string: 辉光鱼不是最美味的食物，但它们最漂亮。

string.ID: I once traveled over a mountain, believing I would see something that I had not seen before once past the summit. I was disappointed to find that the other side of the mountain bore a striking resemblance to the one I'd just left. What is the purpose of mountains?

strings.string: 我曾经翻过一座山，相信越过山顶后就会看见未曾见过的东西。结果我失望地发现，山的另一侧与我刚离开的那一侧惊人相似。山的目的是什么？

string.ID: Live and eat honey, bear friend.

strings.string: 熊朋友，长生，食蜜。
嗯嗯。
猎物。
嗯呃呃呃。

string.ID: I'm hungry.

strings.string: 我饿了。

string.ID: Live and... be eaten.

strings.string: 生而……被吃。

string.ID: {{emote|*licks lips*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*舔舔嘴唇*}}
肉。

string.ID: Keep your distance, friend.

strings.string: 保持距离，朋友。

string.ID: {{emote|*nods mutely*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*默默点头*}}

string.ID: Shh. Listen.

strings.string: 嘘。听。

string.ID: I am peaceful.

strings.string: 我无意争斗。

string.ID: Any dangers?

strings.string: 有危险吗？

string.ID: {{emote|*ignores you*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*无视你*}}

string.ID: Let's not linger together.

strings.string: 我们别一起久留。

string.ID: May the Eaters gift you.

strings.string: 愿食客赐予你。

string.ID: Scrap for goods?

strings.string: 用废料换货？

string.ID: I might be willing to trade.

strings.string: 我或许愿意交易。

string.ID: {{emote|*shakes =pronouns.possessive= head*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*摇摇=pronouns.possessive=头*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*puts a finger to =pronouns.possessive= lips*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*把一根手指放到=pronouns.possessive=唇边*}}

string.ID: I'm armed. Don't try anything.

strings.string: 我有武器。别耍花样。

string.ID: {{emote|*tenses as you approach*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*在你靠近时绷紧身体*}}

string.ID: Found anything good?

strings.string: 找到什么好东西了吗？

string.ID: Finders keepers.

strings.string: 谁找到就是谁的。

string.ID: Lot of good stuff down here. Lots of bad stuff too.

strings.string: 下面有很多好东西。坏东西也很多。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。
诶嘿嘿嘿嘿。
诶嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

string.ID: ehe. ehehe. ehehehehehehe!

strings.string: 诶嘿。诶嘿嘿。诶嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

string.ID: you food?

strings.string: 你食物？

string.ID: give food?

strings.string: 给食物？

string.ID: bite you?

strings.string: 咬你？

string.ID: gn. grn. hrf. hn. hf.

strings.string: 咯。呃。呼。嗯。哼。

string.ID: nyeh heheheheheh.

strings.string: 捏嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
什么！

string.ID: eheh. heh. what. eheheh. what!

strings.string: 诶嘿。嘿。什么。诶嘿嘿。什么！
咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

string.ID: livendrinkenlivendrinkenlivendrink ehehehehe.

strings.string: 生饮水生饮水生饮水，诶嘿嘿嘿。
生饮水。
森饮水。

string.ID: liffen drick.

strings.string: 森而饮。

string.ID: libm drin. ehehehe. lipum dronk! ahahahahah!

strings.string: 生嗯饮。诶嘿嘿。哩噗咚！啊哈哈哈哈！

string.ID: live and drink, ehehe.

strings.string: 生而饮水，诶嘿嘿。

string.ID: gnaa! live and drink!

strings.string: 嘎啊！生而饮水！
咯嘿嘿。

string.ID: ek ekekekekeke!

strings.string: 咔 咔咔咔咔咔！

string.ID: {{emote|*drools silently, staring*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一边凝视，一边默默流口水*}}
咿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿……
呜呼呼呼……
rrrrrr……
呼。

string.ID: ehehe! ehehehe! AHAHAHAH!

strings.string: 诶嘿嘿！诶嘿嘿嘿！啊哈哈哈！

string.ID: ehh, what for you talk me?

strings.string: 呃，你为啥跟我说话？
诶嘿。
哈！
嘎哈哈！
啊哈哈哈！
哆嚯嚯嚯嚯。

string.ID: oooh hohohohoho.

strings.string: 噢嚯嚯嚯嚯。

string.ID: geh heh heh heh heh.

strings.string: 咯嘿嘿嘿嘿。
啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

string.ID: ...live and drink.

strings.string: ……生而饮水。

string.ID: By the sun, you're ugly.

strings.string: 以太阳之名，你真丑。

string.ID: Pick a direction and walk in it.

strings.string: 选个方向，然后走过去。

string.ID: What do you want, lack-salt?

strings.string: 你想干什么，缺盐人？

string.ID: Got nothing to say to a lack-salt.

strings.string: 我跟缺盐人没什么好说的。

string.ID: Keep your eyes moving, lack-salt.

strings.string: 眼睛放活点，缺盐人。

string.ID: Hey lack-salt. How much water you got? No, don't ever answer that question.

strings.string: 嘿，缺盐人。你有多少水？不，永远别回答这种问题。

string.ID: Be respectful of the red-and-white and we will get along.

strings.string: 尊重红白，我们就能相安无事。

string.ID: Keep your mouth covered, or the brine air will cure your lungs to jerky.

strings.string: 把嘴遮好，不然盐水气会把你的肺腌成肉干。

string.ID: Stay warm, lack-salt.

strings.string: 别冻着，缺盐人。

string.ID: Stay dry, lack-salt.

strings.string: 别沾湿，缺盐人。

string.ID: Glory to Shekhinah.

strings.string: 荣耀归于谢金娜。

string.ID: Humble before my Fathers, I walk.

strings.string: 我谦卑于诸父之前而行。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Show mercy to a weary pilgrim.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。怜悯一位疲惫的朝圣者吧。

string.ID: Praise be upon Nisroch, who shelters us stiltseekers.

strings.string: 愿赞美归于尼兹洛克，祂庇护我们这些寻高跷者。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。

string.ID: Live and drink, wayfarer.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。

string.ID: Come. Browse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=!

strings.string: 来吧。看看我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=！

string.ID: I see my wares catch your eye, =player.formalAddressTerm=. They can be yours.

strings.string: 我看我的货入了你的眼，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它们可以归你。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I have what you need, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我有你需要的东西，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, thank the Eaters that you have found Qud's only honest shopkeep.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，感谢吞噬者，你找到了库德唯一诚实的店主。

string.ID: On my honor, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my goods are of only the highest quality and I offer a fair trade.

strings.string: 以我的荣誉起誓，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的货只有最高品质，我也只做公平买卖。

string.ID: Welcome, traveler.

strings.string: 欢迎，旅行者。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. How may I serve you today?

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。今天我能为你效劳什么？

string.ID: Do your waterskins grow heavy, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你的水囊是不是沉起来了，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I beseech you. Enter.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我恳请你。请进。

string.ID: Buy something, will you?

strings.string: 买点东西，行吗？

string.ID: May you find shade and vittle, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿你找到阴凉和口粮，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Be quick about it.

strings.string: 动作快点。

string.ID: By the Eaters, have you ever seen so much treasure?

strings.string: 以吞噬者之名，你见过这么多宝贝吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler. Welcome to the Stilt.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。欢迎来到高跷。

string.ID: Praise be to Shekhinah! O, sovereign Fathers... at last, I am here!

strings.string: 赞美谢金娜！噢，至高诸父……我终于到了！

string.ID: This is the Six Day Stilt, huh. It's... colossal, beautiful. I see why the chrome stewards gather here.

strings.string: 这就是六日高跷啊。它……庞大，美丽。我明白铬钢司事为什么聚集在这里了。

string.ID: So... many... folks....
Is it true what they say? That it's a petrified kraken?

strings.string: 他们说的是真的吗？这里是一头石化海怪？

string.ID: What a grand bazaar! What's in each of these tents?

strings.string: 好宏伟的集市！这些帐篷里都有什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, wardens.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫们。

string.ID: You are among friends here, pilgrim. Stay peaceful.

strings.string: 你在朋友之中，朝圣者。保持和平。

string.ID:
Then you're not of the faith =player.reflexive=, huh? Me neither. Do go inside, though. She's a beauty. Got dyed glass high in her rafters, she does. And two marvelous carvings on the wings. Plus a light-sculpture of a god. Hear the sermon, too, as you like. The high priest is persuasive, but not half as persuasive as the cathedral herself. In beauty there is power, you know.
Either way, while you're in the cathedral or on the Stiltgrounds, stay peaceful.

strings.string:
那么你自己也不是信徒，是吧？我也不是。不过还是进去看看吧。她很美。她的高椽上有染色玻璃，两翼还有两座精妙雕刻。还有一座神祇的光雕。你愿意的话，也可以听听布道。大祭司很有说服力，但还不到大教堂本身的一半。美之中有力量，你知道的。
不管怎样，在大教堂里或高跷地上，都要保持和平。

string.ID:
Aye, aye. The clamor of it all can overwhelm.
The glowcrows say 'twas a bird-god who taught folks to gather like this, in large flocks. So blame birds.

strings.string:
是啊，是啊。这一切喧嚣能把人压垮。
辉鸦说，是一位鸟神教会了人们像这样大群聚集。所以怪鸟吧。

string.ID:
Who knows? I've wondered it myself. Sometimes she'll catch my eye, when the moon's silver-bright, and she's there bearing down on the flats.
Whatever she is, she's gigantic. And old. Real old. Way older than the cathedral the Mechanimists built inside her.

strings.string:
谁知道呢？我自己也想过。有时月光银亮，她压在盐滩上，我就会忽然注意到她。
不管她是什么，她都巨大无比。而且古老。非常古老。比机械信徒建在她体内的大教堂古老得多。

string.ID:
Are you mad? You think I keep a tally of every shopkeeper that steps foot on the Stiltgrounds? They come and go as they please. You've got merchants of all types here. Winesellers, honey hawkers, bookbinders, cobblers.
Have a look around for =player.reflexive=. Following the road around the Stilt. There's tents the whole way round.

strings.string:
你疯了吗？你以为我会给每个踏上高跷地的店主记账？他们想来就来，想走就走。这里什么样的商人都有。卖酒的，叫卖蜂蜜的，装订书的，做鞋的。
自己四处看看吧。沿着路绕高跷走一圈。一路上都是帐篷。

string.ID: Live and learn, wanderer. Have you come across any books or scrolls in your travels? Do you care to donate one to the cathedral library? Whenever you return, you may speak to me and read anything you've donated.

strings.string: 流浪者，长生，求知。你在旅途中遇到过什么书或卷轴吗？愿意捐一本给大教堂图书馆吗？你以后回来时，可以找我阅读自己捐赠过的任何东西。
愿意。

string.ID: Where is the library?

strings.string: 图书馆在哪里？

string.ID: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 图书馆在这盐窝里有什么用？或者在那些被野草扼住、被辉光毒害的沼泽里有什么用？一堆藤割镰不是更有用吗？

string.ID: Not today. Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 今天不了。生而饮水，编年者。

string.ID: You imagine they will thrive here at the Stiltgrounds, among the faithful?

strings.string: 你认为他们能在高跷地这里、在信众之间兴盛起来？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我认为能。

string.ID: This wouldn't be the first time the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees, =name=, and make no mistake: it is a burden upon the church, Catechists and Protectors in particular. But your words echo loud in our hearts as our hallways. Some in our number will see the slynth as the chosen of chosen, and if I speak to them first, everyone else will take it as Shekhinah's will. Which, arguably, it would be. Tell the slynth that the Mechanimists will have them.

strings.string: 这不会是高跷地第一次接纳难民，=name=，而且别弄错：这对教会是个负担，尤其对教理师和护持者更是如此。但你的话在我们心中回响，正如在我们的廊道中回响一样响亮。我们之中有些人会把斯林斯视作被选者中的被选者；如果我先与他们谈，其他人都会把这视为谢金娜的旨意。可以说，那也确实会是。告诉斯林斯，机械信徒会接纳他们。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Sheba.

strings.string: 感谢你，示巴。

string.ID: I mean no slight to these slynth folk, =name=, but the Stiltgrounds have hosted refugees before and it is a substantial burden upon our stewards. Our resources and space are scant, and I must request that you find another home for them. May the Kasaphescence shine upon them, and you, in this endeavor.

strings.string: 我无意轻慢这些斯林斯人，=name=，但高跷地过去接纳过难民，这对我们的司事是沉重负担。我们的资源和空间都很有限，我必须请求你为他们另寻家园。愿卡萨辉体在这份事业中照耀他们，也照耀你。

string.ID: =name=, bless you. Have you brought tidings of the slynth?

strings.string: =name=，愿你受福。你带来了斯林斯的消息吗？

string.ID:
Praise be to Shekhinah, =name=, your slynth friends are hard workers and quick learners!
I can't help but feel a bit concerned at their ethic, and who in the church might take advantage of it. I hope to foster an interest in reading in them if I can, before they are taught incuriosity. Perhaps a book club?

strings.string:
赞美谢金娜，=name=，你的斯林斯朋友们勤劳肯干，学得也快！
他们这种品性让我忍不住有些担心，担心教会里会有人利用这一点。我希望能在他们被教会冷漠之前，尽力培养他们对阅读的兴趣。也许办个读书会？

string.ID: My thanks, chronicler.

strings.string: 多谢，编年者。

string.ID:
Live and learn, =name=.
The slynth are settling in as folk do. I see some flank the Priests and Catechists with empty eye, but some have proven hungry for knowledge. I have established a weekly Canticle study group, and its numbers grow each meeting.
Praise be to Shekhinah for this meeting, =name=.

strings.string:
=name=，长生，求知。
斯林斯正在像普通人那样安顿下来。我看到有些人目光空洞地侍立在祭司和教理师两侧，但也有些人展现出了对知识的渴求。我开办了每周一次的圣歌研习小组，每次聚会人数都在增加。
为这次相遇赞美谢金娜，=name=。

string.ID: My thanks again, chronicler.

strings.string: 再次感谢，编年者。

string.ID: Oh, we're in but the first phase of its foundation. The church has amassed a splendid collection of scripts through the years. Glorious Shekhinah, praise be upon Him, gifted us with several caches. The eremites work day and night reproducing them in the scriptorium, and I have taken it upon myself to beseech travelers, for the rarest finds often come from the least likely places.

strings.string: 哦，我们还只是在奠基的第一阶段。多年来，教会积攒了一批极好的经文。荣耀的谢金娜，愿赞美归于祂，赐给了我们数个藏匣。隐修士们日夜在抄经室里复制它们，而我则主动承担起恳请旅行者的职责，因为最稀有的发现往往来自最意想不到的地方。

string.ID: I will donate a book.

strings.string: 我会捐一本书。

string.ID: What use is a library in this salt den? Or in the marshes, strangled by wild plants and poisoned by the glow? Wouldn't a stash of vinereapers serve us better?

strings.string: 图书馆在这盐窝里有什么用？或者在那些被野草扼住、被辉光毒害的沼泽里有什么用？一堆藤割镰不是更有用吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 生而饮水，编年者。

string.ID:
You share the pessimism of my kin, and several of the priests as well. My heart hears you, but listen to my words, and maybe you will come to feel as I do.
To devalue wisdom is to devalue the Kasaphescence. She shines in the void, refracting light, illuminating those around her. So does the written wisdom of our elders.
The machinery of chromium is complex in its divinity. Don't we do a disservice to our Fathers when we remain ignorant of it, of our past, of our future? Don't we deserve the joy of knowing? Bless Eschelstadt II, first Child, for he believes as I do.

strings.string:
你和我的族人，还有几位祭司一样悲观。我的心听见了你的话，但也请听听我的话，也许你会开始感受到我所感受的。
贬低智慧，就是贬低卡萨辉体。她在虚空中闪耀，折射光芒，照亮周遭之物。我们长者书写下来的智慧亦是如此。
铬钢机械的神性复杂而深奥。若我们对它、对我们的过去、对我们的未来一无所知，岂不是辜负了诸父？难道我们不配享有知晓的喜悦？愿首位子嗣埃舍尔施塔特二世受福，因为他与我所信相同。

string.ID: I will donate a book.

strings.string: 我会捐一本书。

string.ID: Where is the library?

strings.string: 图书馆在哪里？

string.ID: Live and drink, chronicler.

strings.string: 生而饮水，编年者。

string.ID: Peace and health in the light of the Star, pilgrim. Brood with me on the life of Resheph, if you are willing.

strings.string: 愿你在星辰之光中得享和平与健康，朝圣者。若你愿意，就与我一同沉思瑞舍夫的一生。

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 我愿意。

string.ID: Who is Resheph?

strings.string: 瑞舍夫是谁？

string.ID: What's inside the tent?

strings.string: 帐篷里面是什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 生而饮水，祭司。

string.ID:
A spiritual patron of kith and kin, who did so much for us, and who leads me and others like me to the path of healing. For, above all, he was a healer. He dressed the wounds of the sick and rid the land of the plagues of the Gyre.
He was also a sultan, but he was the last sultan. He unbricked the walls of monocracy so we could pick berries in the orchards they hid.

strings.string:
他是亲友族类的精神庇护者，为我们做了许多，也引领我和我这样的人走上疗愈之路。因为归根结底，他是一位医者。他包扎病患的伤口，把轮回之灾的瘟疫从大地上清除。
他也曾是苏丹，但他是最后一位苏丹。他拆开了独治王权的砖墙，让我们得以在墙后隐藏的果园里采摘浆果。

string.ID: I've more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有事要问。

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 生而饮水，祭司。

string.ID:
A quiet shrine to the Coiled Lamb, centuries old. Tucked away here, outside the marble parapets and cloaked in the dust of time, it's lost to those who'd sneer at the veneration of Resheph over other fathers.
Step inside and voice a prayer, if you are willing.

strings.string:
一座献给盘绕羔羊的静谧圣龛，已有数百年历史。它藏在这里，位于大理石胸墙之外，披覆着时间的尘埃，对那些会嘲笑人们敬奉瑞舍夫甚于其他诸父的人来说，它已经失落无踪。
若你愿意，就走进去，念出一声祈祷吧。

string.ID: I've more to ask.

strings.string: 我还有事要问。

string.ID: Live and drink, priest.

strings.string: 生而饮水，祭司。

string.ID: Don't breathe in too deep, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I've set some glue to dry.

strings.string: 别吸得太深，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我放了些胶水等它干。

string.ID: Live and drink, but please do it elsewhere. I fear spills.

strings.string: 生而饮水，但请到别处去饮。我怕泼洒。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Feel free to examine my books closely.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。尽管仔细查看我的书。

string.ID: Please inspect only the quality of the letters. I am not a librarian.

strings.string: 请只检视字母的质量。我不是图书管理员。

string.ID: These books can weather the salt and jungle alike.

strings.string: 这些书经得起盐地，也经得起丛林。

string.ID: I assure you, the smell fades once the glue is dry.

strings.string: 我向你保证，胶水干了之后味道就会散。

string.ID: I've books for trade, if you're interested.

strings.string: 我有书可供交易，如果你有兴趣的话。

string.ID: Everything I sell is the product of many hours of toil.

strings.string: 我卖的每一样东西，都是许多小时辛劳的成果。

string.ID: Come closer, so I can see your face.

strings.string: 靠近些，让我看看你的脸。

string.ID: Ink runs in my very veins, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 墨水就在我的血管里流淌，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: If you're looking to read, I have what you need.

strings.string: 如果你想读点什么，我有你需要的。

string.ID: Please be gentle with the parchment.

strings.string: 请轻拿羊皮纸。

string.ID: Do be quick, =player.formalAddressTerm=, as I've much work to do.

strings.string: 请快些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我还有许多工作要做。

string.ID: Live and drink, reader.

strings.string: 生而饮水，读者。

string.ID: Come here. No, closer. Don't mind the bees, they rarely sting.

strings.string: 过来。不，再近点。别在意蜜蜂，它们很少蜇人。

string.ID: Don't be afraid to approach. The bees rarely sting.

strings.string: 别怕靠近。蜜蜂很少蜇人。

string.ID: Care for some beejuice?

strings.string: 要来点蜂汁吗？

string.ID: Drink a dram of honey every morning, Slog itself couldn't make you sick.

strings.string: 每天早晨喝一打兰蜂蜜，就算斯洛格亲自来也别想让你生病。

string.ID: You know, bees communicate by dancing. Got a whole language.

strings.string: 你知道吗，蜜蜂靠跳舞交流。那是一整套语言。

string.ID: Without bees, all life in Qud would eventually die.

strings.string: 没有蜜蜂，库德的一切生命终将死去。

string.ID: Bees are smarter than you think. They got that hive mind, see.

strings.string: 蜜蜂比你想的聪明。它们有蜂巢心智，懂吧。

string.ID: I eat honey matz every morning and I ain't been sick in decades.

strings.string: 我每天早晨都吃蜂蜜薄饼，几十年没病过。

string.ID: We'd all be dead without bees, you know.

strings.string: 没有蜜蜂，我们全都得死，你知道吧。

string.ID: Use your gadgets hard, don't you? I can fix them.

strings.string: 你用小玩意用得挺狠，是吧？我能修。

string.ID: I can repair, recharge, and identify whatever you have! Within reason.

strings.string: 你有什么东西，我都能修、充能、鉴定！在合理范围内。

string.ID: If you've got anything you can't make heads or tails of it, give it here.

strings.string: 如果你有东西怎么看都看不明白，拿来给我。

string.ID: You've got to respect a machine. Machines bite harder than any croc.

strings.string: 你得尊重机器。机器咬人比任何鳄鱼都狠。

string.ID: You a maker?

strings.string: 你是造物匠？

string.ID: Take out what you've busted and I'll jury-rig it for a fair price.

strings.string: 把你弄坏的东西拿出来，我收个公道价给你临时修好。

string.ID: Need scrap?

strings.string: 要废料吗？

string.ID: You get used to the nicks and burns, after years working with spark and solder.

strings.string: 和火花、焊料打了多年交道，划伤和烫伤也就习惯了。

string.ID: They say some folks can talk to machines. I say we all can, if we listen right.

strings.string: 他们说有些人能和机器说话。依我看，只要听得对，我们都能。

string.ID: My fees for battery charging depend how empty the battery is when you bring it to me.

strings.string: 我给电池充能的收费，取决于你拿来时电池有多空。

string.ID: Absolutely no refunds or returns on scrap.

strings.string: 废料一经售出，概不退款，概不退货。

string.ID: I would prefer not to interrupt this task long.

strings.string: 我不想让这项工作被打断太久。

string.ID: How my joints ache! Buy something to justify my pain.

strings.string: 我的关节疼得厉害！买点东西，让我的痛苦有点意义。

string.ID: Unfinished schematics are obviously not for sale. Everything else is.

strings.string: 没完成的设计图显然不卖。其他都卖。

string.ID: Disturb the trash if you must, but do not touch any of my papers.

strings.string: 你非要翻垃圾就翻吧，但别碰我的任何纸张。

string.ID: Are you a tinker? Surely I have something you wish to build.

strings.string: 你是修补匠吗？我这里肯定有你想造的东西。

string.ID: If you've the wits to build, I've got something you want.

strings.string: 如果你有本事制造，我就有你想要的东西。

string.ID: I have lost much to my dedication. Help me gain anew, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 我为自己的奉献失去了许多。帮我重新得到些东西吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: So help me, Argent Fathers, if someone has changed the order of my papers...

strings.string: 白银诸父在上，要是有人改了我纸张的顺序……

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, buy a schematic. I'm sure it will be of use to you.

strings.string: 拜托，=player.formalAddressTerm=，买张设计图吧。我相信它会对你有用。

string.ID: Even if you can't make a thing now, you could gain the insight later.

strings.string: 即使你现在造不出来，日后也可能得到灵感。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 我有治你病痛的药。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你看起来不太好。你的饮食里需要更多恶心麦和蜂蜜。

string.ID: In the market for a tonic, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Spend water now or blood later, your choice.

strings.string: 想买补剂吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？现在花水，还是以后流血，你自己选。

string.ID: Prickly-boons and yuckwheat for trade.

strings.string: 刺恩果和恶心麦可交易。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 如果觉得不舒服，就用恶心麦做饭。疾病发现得够早，就能把它扼杀。

string.ID: If you came for the humble pie, you had best not have led any mind-hunters here.

strings.string: 如果你是为了谦卑派来的，最好没把任何猎心者引到这里。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: “缓痛，乱脑。”咀嚼巫木树皮时小心些。

string.ID: Don't eat the hoarshrooms too fast, now.

strings.string: 别把白霜菇吃得太快，听见没。

string.ID: Have you got enough tonics?

strings.string: 你的补剂够用吗？

string.ID: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.

strings.string: 感染真菌了？你会需要我这里的喷瓶来上药。

string.ID: Got a fungal infection? You'll want one of my spray bottles to apply the cure.

strings.string: 感染真菌了？你会需要我这里的喷瓶来上药。

string.ID: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.

strings.string: 弄一本《Corpus Choliys》，里面有疾病和真菌的疗法。

string.ID: Get your hands on the Corpus Choliys for disease and fungus cures.

strings.string: 弄一本《Corpus Choliys》，里面有疾病和真菌的疗法。

string.ID: I've the cure for what ails you.

strings.string: 我有治你病痛的药。

string.ID: You don't look so good. You need more yuckwheat and honey in your diet.

strings.string: 你看起来不太好。你的饮食里需要更多恶心麦和蜂蜜。

string.ID: Cook your meals with yuckwheat if you feel sick. Catch a disease early enough and you can kill it.

strings.string: 如果觉得不舒服，就用恶心麦做饭。疾病发现得够早，就能把它扼杀。

string.ID: "Ease the pain, addle the brain." Be careful when you chew witchwood bark.

strings.string: “缓痛，乱脑。”咀嚼巫木树皮时小心些。

string.ID: Best not leave town without some bark and bandages, wayfarer.

strings.string: 最好别不带树皮和绷带就离镇，旅人。

string.ID: Live and drink. Keeping well, I hope?

strings.string: 生而饮水。希望你身体还好？

string.ID: How are you feeling today, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 今天感觉如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Moon and sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Keeping healthy?

strings.string: 月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。身体安康吗？

string.ID: I tell you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, my recipes come from years of experience. There's none the like.

strings.string: 我告诉你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我的食谱来自多年经验。别处没有这样的。

string.ID: Finest food for parasangs! Finest food in Qud! Recipes and samples!

strings.string: 数帕拉桑之内最好的食物！库德最好的食物！食谱和样品！

string.ID: I will share my food-secrets with you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, if you're willing to make it worth my while.

strings.string: 我愿意与你分享我的食物秘方，=player.formalAddressTerm=，只要你愿意让我觉得值得。

string.ID: Do you cook, =player.formalAddressTerm=? So long as you aren't the type to throw whatever local debris you find in the pot, I have wares for you.

strings.string: 你做饭吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？只要你不是那种把本地捡到的什么破烂都往锅里扔的人，我这里就有适合你的货。

string.ID: Not a word of lie, I studied under a chef who studied under Agate Severance Star herself. That's why my recipes are the best.

strings.string: 一句假话没有，我师从一位曾向玛瑙·断离星本人学艺的厨师。这就是为什么我的食谱最好。

string.ID: Try my recipe. You'll believe =player.reflexive= to be judging the Carbide Chefs in the Kitchen Heptagon itself.

strings.string: 试试我的食谱。你会觉得自己正在厨房七角厅里评判碳化物厨师。

string.ID: Cookbooks are best named from the heart. Those who ridicule the name of a cookbook have lost their sense of wonder.

strings.string: 食谱书最好凭真心命名。嘲笑食谱书名字的人，已经失去了惊奇之心。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，长生，进食。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Smell a bit strong? That's how you know it's good.

strings.string: 气味有点重？这正说明它好。

string.ID: You can preserve almost anything. Al... most.

strings.string: 几乎什么东西都能腌存。几……乎。

string.ID: Preserved ingredients cook better, safer.

strings.string: 腌存过的食材烹调起来更好，也更安全。

string.ID: Everything I sell is safe to eat as it is.

strings.string: 我卖的每样东西都可以直接安全食用。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Need vittle?

strings.string: 欢迎，=player.formalAddressTerm=。需要口粮吗？

string.ID: Crave a bit of salt, =player.formalAddressTerm=, or a load of salt?

strings.string: 想来点盐吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还是想来一大堆盐？

string.ID: Nothing sadder than a cookfire and nothing to cook over it.

strings.string: 没有什么比有炊火却没东西可烹更悲伤了。

string.ID: Are you a chef, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My vittles are of the highest quality.

strings.string: 你是厨师吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的口粮品质最高。

string.ID: Nourishment for the road, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 路上的补给，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink deeply, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，生而畅饮。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, please come in.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，请进。

string.ID: My wares are sweet and strong, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care to try them?

strings.string: 我的货又甜又烈，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想尝尝吗？

string.ID: Tell me, =player.formalAddressTerm=, is there any sight more sad than a hookah tent without wine?

strings.string: 告诉我，=player.formalAddressTerm=，还有什么景象比没有酒的水烟帐篷更悲伤？

string.ID: Wine, cheese, bread. =player.FormalAddressTerm=, tell me, is there anything else you truly need?

strings.string: 酒、奶酪、面包。=player.FormalAddressTerm=，告诉我，你真正需要的还有别的吗？

string.ID: The kipper and I both know that the finest ingredient is time.

strings.string: 腌货商和我都知道，最好的配料是时间。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Try some rose wine? One rose is fair, but as you may know from hanging around the Stiltgrounds, five is death.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。要尝点玫瑰酒吗？一朵玫瑰尚好，但你在高跷地待久了也许知道，五朵便是死亡。
液体……

string.ID: Aren't they beautiful, =player.formalAddressTerm=? The bottles, the phials, the light shining through them.

strings.string: 它们美得很，不是吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？瓶子，小瓶，穿透它们的光。

string.ID: Live and drink, but not everything. Some things you don't drink.

strings.string: 生而饮水，但不是什么都能喝。有些东西不能喝。

string.ID: Is there any state of form so fine as a liquid?

strings.string: 还有哪一种形态能像液体这样精妙？

string.ID: Pouring, decanting, collecting, mixing. I adore my calling.

strings.string: 倾倒、滗析、收集、混合。我热爱我的天职。

string.ID: If it flows, I desire it. You should too, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 只要它会流动，我就渴望它。你也该如此，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Do you ever stop and think about fluids? Are they not divine?

strings.string: 你有没有停下来想过流体？它们难道不神圣吗？

string.ID: Someday I will plumb the depths of Bethesda Susa, that I may meet the Alchemist.

strings.string: 总有一天，我会探入贝塞斯达苏萨的深处，去见那位炼金术士。

string.ID: Live and drink, and collect, and combine...

strings.string: 生而饮水，收集，结合……

string.ID: Hold, aristocrat! I have wares to claim your interest.

strings.string: 慢着，贵胄！我有些货能引起你的兴趣。

string.ID: My implants are acquired peaceably, I assure you.

strings.string: 我向你保证，我的植入体都是和平取得的。

string.ID: How becoming you look, Aristocrat! But you could be more becoming.

strings.string: 你看起来多么成形啊，贵胄！但你还可以更加成形。

string.ID: Tire of your legs? Arms? Hands? See what I have that fits you.

strings.string: 厌倦你的腿了？手臂？双手？看看我这里有什么适合你。

string.ID: Luxury internal adornments for the discerning Aristocrat.

strings.string: 为有眼光的贵胄准备的奢华内在饰物。

string.ID: No additional sterilisation required, of course.

strings.string: 当然，不需要额外灭菌。

string.ID: Quality implants for sale at reasonable prices!

strings.string: 优质植入体，价格公道！

string.ID: You strike me as an Aristocrat who knows the value of artisanal organs.

strings.string: 你看起来像是懂得手工器官价值的贵胄。

string.ID: I recommend everything I carry. Not all at once, of course.

strings.string: 我推荐我带的每一样东西。当然，不是一次全装。

string.ID: Hope you'll "becoming" back, ha ha.

strings.string: 希望你还会“成形”回来，哈哈。

string.ID: Live and drink, Aristocrat.

strings.string: 生而饮水，贵胄。

string.ID: Kill anyone valuable?

strings.string: 杀过什么值钱的人吗？

string.ID: You look dangerous. Ever go hunting for parts?

strings.string: 你看起来挺危险。去猎过零件吗？

string.ID: Got guts?

strings.string: 有内脏吗？

string.ID: Can you imagine sticking one of these things inside you? Disgusting.

strings.string: 你能想象把这些东西塞进自己体内吗？恶心。

string.ID: I've plenty water if you've got implants to sell.

strings.string: 如果你有植入体要卖，我有的是水。

string.ID: Always check becoming nook shelves for parts.

strings.string: 找零件时一定要看看成形龛的架子。

string.ID: Y'ain't peeled open any Sons or Daughters, have you?

strings.string: 你没剥开过什么儿子或女儿吧？

string.ID: Less I know about where my stock comes from, the better.

strings.string: 我越少知道存货从哪来，就越好。

string.ID: I'll still take parts you ain't washed off, it's fine.

strings.string: 没洗过的零件我也收，没事。

string.ID: If you can butcher a boar, you can do the same to a man. Just ain't meat you're looking for.

strings.string: 你能宰一头野猪，就能对人做同样的事。只是你找的不是肉。

string.ID: My best customers don't ask questions. My best stock asked too many.

strings.string: 我最好的顾客不问问题。我最好的存货问了太多问题。

string.ID: Need something to complete your ensemble, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要点什么来补完整身行头吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: With a good hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=, you'll last longer in the salt sun.

strings.string: 有顶好帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你就能在盐阳下撑得更久。

string.ID: Peruse my wares, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Adorn your head or heads.

strings.string: 细看我的货吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。装点你的头，或者你的那些头。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Care for a new topper?

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。想来顶新帽吗？

string.ID: You need a new hat, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Or a helmet, if that's the life you lead.

strings.string: 你需要一顶新帽子，=player.formalAddressTerm=。或者一顶头盔，如果你过的是那种日子。

string.ID: If you're passing through baboon country, you'll want to protect your head, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 如果你要穿过狒狒地盘，就会想保护好自己的头，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Hello, hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=, let's get your weary feet covered.

strings.string: 你好，你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来给你疲惫的双脚找点遮护吧。

string.ID: Come in, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and let me 'shoe' you around, ha ha!

strings.string: 进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让我给你“鞋”着逛逛，哈哈！

string.ID: Boots! Shoes! Slippers! Sabatons! How would you prefer to cover your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 靴子！鞋！拖鞋！铁靴！你想怎样覆盖双脚，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Even as high-quality as my products are, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I don't suggest you go walking in the fracti to test them out.

strings.string: 我的产品再怎么高品质，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我也不建议你去分形林里走路测试它们。

string.ID: Anything you need to ask 'a boot', =player.FormalAddressTerm=? Just a little cobbler's joke, there.

strings.string: 有什么关于“靴”要问的吗，=player.FormalAddressTerm=？只是个鞋匠小笑话。

string.ID: Hot sands out there, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Is your footwear protecting you?

strings.string: 外头沙子很烫，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你的鞋履能保护你吗？

string.ID: Hello, =player.formalAddressTerm=! Care to be shod?

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=！想穿上鞋吗？

string.ID: Walk a few parasangs in my shoes, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and you'll wonder how you ever did otherwise.

strings.string: 穿着我的鞋走上几帕拉桑，=player.formalAddressTerm=，你会奇怪自己以前怎么能不这样走。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Please, =player.formalAddressTerm=, do come in. Take your time browsing my wares.

strings.string: 请吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，一定要进来。慢慢看我的货。

string.ID: Welcome, =player.formalAddressTerm=, to the sole bastion of class in this wretched place.

strings.string: 欢迎你，=player.formalAddressTerm=，来到这可怜地方唯一的品味堡垒。

string.ID: Please knock the sand from your feet, =player.formalAddressTerm=. It gets everywhere.

strings.string: 请把脚上的沙子磕掉，=player.formalAddressTerm=。它会钻得到处都是。

string.ID: Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I can certainly help you.

strings.string: 啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，我当然能帮你。

string.ID: How may I clothe you, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 我该怎样为你添衣，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Now, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I know you must have an eye for fashion, if you're here.

strings.string: 好了，=player.formalAddressTerm=，既然你来了，我知道你一定有时尚眼光。

string.ID: Oh dear. Who dressed you, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Let me help you, please.

strings.string: 噢天哪。是谁给你穿成这样的，=player.formalAddressTerm=？请让我帮帮你。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: {{emote|*silent nod*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*沉默点头*}}

string.ID: Careful. It's hot.

strings.string: 小心。很烫。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Need protection?

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=。需要防护吗？

string.ID: Be quick about it, eh?

strings.string: 动作快点，嗯？
你好。
嗯？

string.ID: I've got my eye on you.

strings.string: 我盯着你呢。

string.ID: Leather, ring, and plate, to keep you alive.

strings.string: 皮甲、环甲和板甲，保你活命。

string.ID: Don't get near the hearth.

strings.string: 别靠近炉膛。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=. Live and drink.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=。生而饮水。

string.ID: Hand-coats for sale! Spare your digits the indignity of early removal!

strings.string: 出售手衣！让你的指头免遭过早移除的屈辱！

string.ID: Best protect your hands, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You don't know how much you need them until a madpole takes one.

strings.string: 最好保护好你的手，=player.formalAddressTerm=。直到疯蝌蚪咬走一只，你才知道自己多需要它们。

string.ID: Light gloves, heavy gloves, gauntlets. Don't let your hands go bare, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 轻手套、重手套、护手甲。别让你的手裸着，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: One size fits all, =player.formalAddressTerm=. If I sell it to you, it fits.

strings.string: 均码通用，=player.formalAddressTerm=。只要我卖给你，它就合适。

string.ID: How do I get my gloves so supple? I'll never tell.

strings.string: 我是怎么把手套做得这么柔软的？我永远不说。

string.ID: Moving on soon, =player.formalAddressTerm=? My gloves and gauntlets need no maintenance, so finely are they crafted.

strings.string: 很快要上路吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？我的手套和护手甲工艺精良，不需要保养。

string.ID: Live and eat, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，长生，进食。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: You can't go wrong with my slugspitters, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 买我的吐弹枪准没错，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Guns, guns, guns! Don't they just make you smile?

strings.string: 枪，枪，枪！它们难道不会让你微笑吗？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I tell you: there is no defense like a good, and distant, offense.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我告诉你：最好的防御就是一次漂亮而遥远的进攻。

string.ID: Ahh, I love the smell of cordite. You know, that sulfury smell? Accelerants make a fine perfume, if you ask me.

strings.string: 啊，我喜欢无烟火药的味道。你知道，那股硫磺味？要我说，助燃剂就是很好的香水。

string.ID: You know, =player.formalAddressTerm=, I once had an traveler from Yawningmoon tell me my shop smelled of home. Now I want to visit! Hah!

strings.string: 你知道吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=，曾有个来自呵欠月的旅行者告诉我，我的店闻起来像家。现在我倒想去看看了！哈！

string.ID: May you find adequate cover and more loot than you can carry, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿你找到足够的掩体，以及多到带不动的战利品，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I used to be a wayfarer like you, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but old wounds slow you down. Cherish the time while you have it.

strings.string: 我以前也和你一样是个旅人，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但旧伤会拖慢脚步。趁还有时间，好好珍惜吧。

string.ID: I wish I could allow you to test my wares in the shop, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but walk a parasang in any direction and you'll find a target.

strings.string: 我也希望能让你在店里试试我的货，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但你朝任意方向走上一帕拉桑，就能找到靶子。

string.ID: Might not want to touch anything on the workbenches, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 工作台上的东西最好别碰，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live, drink, and shoot, =player.formalAddressTerm=, in whichever order you like.

strings.string: 生存、饮水、射击，=player.formalAddressTerm=，顺序随你喜欢。

string.ID: Need something blown up, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 需要炸掉什么东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Grenades do no good sitting in a pack. Don't forget to use them.

strings.string: 手榴弹放在包里没用。别忘了用。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, there is little you can't solve with a well-thrown grenade... as long as you don't stand too close.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，只要手榴弹扔得好，几乎没什么解决不了……只要你别站得太近。

string.ID: Defoliant and fungicide are perfectly safe, but you may wish to avoid breathing too deeply all the same.

strings.string: 落叶剂和杀菌剂完全安全，不过你可能还是别吸得太深。

string.ID: Can I serve you something explosive, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 要我给你来点会爆炸的东西吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: You'll be back, =player.formalAddressTerm=, provided you don't blow =player.reflexive= up.

strings.string: 你会回来的，=player.formalAddressTerm=，前提是别把自己炸飞。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Be careful with my wares as you peruse them.

strings.string: 你好，=player.formalAddressTerm=。查看我的货时请小心些。

string.ID: How is your throwing arm, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Barring that, do you feel lucky?

strings.string: 你的投掷手感如何，=player.formalAddressTerm=？不行的话，你觉得自己够走运吗？

string.ID: It's a dangerous job, =player.formalAddressTerm=, but well worth it.

strings.string: 这是份危险工作，=player.formalAddressTerm=，但很值得。

string.ID: The vintners say that 'one rose is fair, but five is death'. I can sell you blossoms that mean death no matter the number.

strings.string: 酒商说“一朵玫瑰尚好，五朵便是死亡”。我能卖给你不论几朵都意味着死亡的花。

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: There's a shape in every stone waiting to be brought out.

strings.string: 每块石头里都有一个形状，等着被释放出来。

string.ID: If you bend the light just so, it frays into brilliance.

strings.string: 只要把光折得恰到好处，它就会散成辉煌。

string.ID: I can wait years for the inspiration to craft another figurine. I have before.

strings.string: 为了等来雕出下一尊小像的灵感，我可以等上几年。我以前就等过。

string.ID: What manner of jewel are our eyes, to skew light into thought?

strings.string: 我们的眼睛是什么样的宝石，竟能把光偏折成思想？

string.ID: Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and behold my jewels and figurines.

strings.string: 进来吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=，看看我的珠宝和小像。

string.ID: Uncrafted jewels and metals buy and sell for the same cost, but my art's price tag is up to me.

strings.string: 未经雕琢的珠宝和金属买卖价格相同，但我的艺术要标什么价，由我决定。

string.ID: Every statuette is a tribute, of a kind, but not every tribute is received well.

strings.string: 每尊小雕像都算是一种献礼，但不是每份献礼都能被好好接受。

string.ID: Wouldn't these make a fine conversation piece for a water ritual?

strings.string: 这些难道不是水仪式上很好的谈资吗？

string.ID: Beautiful baubles and gleaming gemstones over here!

strings.string: 漂亮饰物和闪亮宝石，都在这里！

string.ID: A well-polished and well-picked gem, no matter how rough, is as beautiful a work of art as any figurine.

strings.string: 一颗选得好、抛得亮的宝石，不管原本多粗糙，都和任何小像一样是一件美丽艺术品。

string.ID: Lean in close to see the detail. No, don't touch.

strings.string: 靠近点看细节。不，别碰。

string.ID: Within my gemstones there burns a brighter fire than in some hearts.

strings.string: 我的宝石里燃着比某些心中更明亮的火。

string.ID: Water-wealth means nothing if you cannot carry it. Need jewels?

strings.string: 如果带不走，水财富就毫无意义。需要珠宝吗？

string.ID: Friend, I have precious metals and jewels to adorn or trade.

strings.string: 朋友，我有贵金属和珠宝，可作装饰，也可交易。

string.ID: Raw metals and gems buy and sell for a fixed water-cost.

strings.string: 原料金属和宝石按固定水价买卖。

string.ID: Come, wanderer, change some of that heavy water for a pocketful of riches.

strings.string: 来吧，流浪者，把那些沉重的水换成一口袋财富。

string.ID: Water Barons don't adorn themselves with water, after all.

strings.string: 毕竟，水男爵也不会用水来装饰自己。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...exceeding mass thresholds, perhaps a ganglionic teleprojector fitted with suspensors...

strings.string: {{emote|*咕哝*}} ……超过质量阈值，也许要给神经节远程投射器装上悬浮器……

string.ID: Oh, I didn't notice you there. That's because I was ignoring you.

strings.string: 哦，我没注意到你在那儿。因为我正在无视你。

string.ID: {{emote|*mumbling*}} ...waste heat from the thermo cask? Or centrifugal extraction to the p-density of sunslag...

strings.string: {{emote|*咕哝*}} ……来自热能桶的废热？还是用离心萃取达到日渣的 p 密度……

string.ID: Where can I find a cave?

strings.string: 我在哪里能找到洞穴？

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。

string.ID: There are caves everywhere, you dolt! Scoop the surface of the marsh, or head on east to the rust wells, or wander into the Desert for all I care...

strings.string: 到处都是洞穴，你这笨蛋！去沼泽表面刨刨，或者往东去锈井，或者随便你游荡进沙漠……

string.ID: I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 我会带着你要的小玩意回来。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。

string.ID: You're standing in my light! What do you want?

strings.string: 你挡住我的光了！你想要什么？

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.

strings.string: 这是你要的小玩意。

string.ID: Nothing. I will return with your knickknack.

strings.string: 没什么。我会带着你要的小玩意回来。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，唔。你终究还是有点用？再去给我拿一个！

string.ID: If I must.

strings.string: 如果必须的话。

string.ID: Ah, mmm, hmmm. Are you a useful one, after all? Go fetch me another!

strings.string: 啊，嗯，唔。你终究还是有点用？再去给我拿一个！

string.ID: Here is your knickknack.

strings.string: 这是你要的小玩意。

string.ID: If I must.

strings.string: 如果必须的话。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve whistles.*}}
Impressive, you! Maybe you're fit to poke around my workshop and swap scrap with me. I have been wanting another apprentice. So unfortunate about Skref, what with the disembowelment and all. Take a seat, there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿吉夫吹了声口哨。*}}
令人刮目相看，是你！也许你适合在我的工坊里翻翻东西，和我交换废料。我一直想再收个学徒。斯克雷夫实在不幸，毕竟都开膛破肚什么的。坐那儿吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve raises both eyebrows.*}}
Now, to screw the nut on the bolt with an explanation! I'm on the cusp, you see. A grand discovery. The Weirdwire Conduit is near assembled, and once it is, we'll be able to chat with anyone... in instant time! from here to the Yd Freehold. But before I can finish, I need wire. As much as you can find... at least two hundred feet. You should be able to scavenge it from the rust wells.

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿吉夫扬起双眉。*}}
现在，该把说明这颗螺母拧到螺栓上了！你看，我正处在临界点。一项伟大发现。怪线导管快组装好了；一旦完成，我们就能和任何人交谈……即时交谈！从这里一直到伊德自由堡都行。但在我完成之前，我需要电线。你能找到多少就要多少……至少两百英尺。你应该能从锈井里搜刮到。

string.ID: I'll fetch you your wire.

strings.string: 我会给你取来电线。

string.ID: I'm not interested.

strings.string: 我没兴趣。

string.ID: The wire! Give it to me!

strings.string: 电线！给我！

string.ID: Take the wire.

strings.string: 拿走电线。

string.ID: I don't have enough yet.

strings.string: 我还没有足够的电线。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Argyve hoots*}}
Yes, yes! Beautiful wire! -oh, before I forget, I repaired an old recoiler for you. Use it whenever you wish to hop back to Joppa quickly. Now, give me a few moments to attach the wire...

strings.string:
{{emote|*阿吉夫欢叫起来*}}
对，对！漂亮的电线！——哦，在我忘记之前，我给你修好了一个旧回弹器。你想快速跳回约帕时就用它。现在，给我一点时间把电线接上……

string.ID: I will return.

strings.string: 我会回来的。

string.ID: It's working! Genius! Genius! Noise in the static- I hear it! I hear!... what's this? What *is* that? Wait...

strings.string: 它工作了！天才！天才！静电噪声里有声音——我听见了！我听见了！……这是什么？那*是什么*？等等……

string.ID: It's repeating itself...

strings.string: 它在重复自己……

string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉夫自言自语地咕哝了好几分钟。*}}

string.ID: Apprentice! Come, here! Something strange is occurring. The Conduit is picking up a signal, some sort of repeating transmission. I cannot decipher it, however. I lack cryptogull eggs and, well, never you mind! I have a great task for you, my apprentice. Do you accept it?

strings.string: 学徒！过来，到这儿来！有怪事发生。导管接收到一个信号，某种重复传输。不过我无法破译它。我缺少隐鸥蛋，还有，呃，你别管！我有一项重大任务给你，我的学徒。你接受吗？

string.ID: Can I know what it is?

strings.string: 我能知道是什么任务吗？

string.ID: -yes. You must seek out Barathrum the Old, the eldest and wisest tinker alive. He lives with his followers the Barathrumites under the arch of Grit Gate to the northeast, in the jungle-strangled ruins of Qud. He will know what to make of the signal.

strings.string: ——可以。你必须去寻找老巴拉瑟姆，现世最年长、最睿智的修补匠。他和追随者巴拉瑟姆派住在东北方砂砾门的拱门下，那里是库德被丛林扼住的遗迹。他会知道该如何看待这个信号。

string.ID: Who are these Barathrumites?

strings.string: 这些巴拉瑟姆派是什么人？

string.ID: I require no further information. I will go.

strings.string: 我不需要更多信息。我这就去。

string.ID: Disciples of Barathrum. Mostly urshiib, like their mentor- quilled albino bears who prefer their candle-dim caves to the sun-salted surface of the jungle. A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the rusting heart of Qud. He has spent centuries peeling the chrome shells off time's artifacts in his workshop. If he cannot decipher the signal, no one can.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟姆的门徒。大多是乌尔希布，和他们的导师一样——带刺的白化熊，宁愿待在烛光昏暗的洞穴里，也不愿去丛林那被太阳晒盐的地表。一千年前，巴拉瑟姆和他的族人越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入库德锈蚀的心脏。数百年来，他一直在工坊里剥开时间遗物的铬钢外壳。如果他无法破译信号，那就没人能。

string.ID: I accept the task, Argyve.

strings.string: 我接受这项任务，阿吉夫。

string.ID: I must think on this.

strings.string: 我必须考虑一下。

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再会，阿吉夫。

string.ID:
Splendid! Perfect! Let me record the signal to disk, which you'll need to guard with your life, I'm afraid.
I'll rig up a droid scrambler for you, too. You see, the Barathrumites have programmed a troupe of waydroids to guard the approach to Grit Gate. With the scrambler, you'll needn't worry about them. Wait there.

strings.string:
好极了！完美！让我把信号记录到磁盘上，恐怕你得用性命保护它。
我还会给你装一个机器人扰频器。你看，巴拉瑟姆派编程了一队路行机器人，守卫通往砂砾门的道路。有了扰频器，你就不用担心它们了。在那儿等着。

string.ID: {{emote|*Argyve mumbles to himself for several minutes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉夫自言自语地咕哝了好几分钟。*}}

string.ID: Here you are. Now, go! Off with you! May you live long enough to do my bidding. Away, away!

strings.string: 给你。现在，去！快走！愿你活得够久，好替我办事。走吧，走吧！

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再会，阿吉夫。

string.ID: The Barathrumites say I must plumb a cave called Golgotha before joining them.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟姆派说，我必须先探入一个叫各各他的洞穴，才能加入他们。

string.ID: Argyve, I am no apprentice. The Barathrumites call me =factionaddress:Barathrumites= now.

strings.string: 阿吉夫，我不是学徒了。巴拉瑟姆派现在称我为 =factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Need anything, Argyve?

strings.string: 需要什么吗，阿吉夫？

string.ID: Farewell, Argyve.

strings.string: 再会，阿吉夫。

string.ID: My apprentice! What?

strings.string: 我的学徒！什么事？

string.ID: Who are the Barathrumites again?

strings.string: 巴拉瑟姆派又是什么人来着？

string.ID:
Did they, now? Well you're not MY =factionaddress:Barathrumites=!
Grit Gate is not Joppa, you pridesome solder-nail, and in this house you are apprentice still.
Now, what did you want? Be quick!

strings.string:
他们这么叫了，是吗？可你不是我的 =factionaddress:Barathrumites=！
砂砾门不是约帕，你这自负的焊钉；在这屋子里，你仍然是学徒。
现在，你想要什么？快点！

string.ID:
-what?
No, no, I'm far too engrossed to see to your curiosity. I'm sure the Barathrumites have something for you to do.

strings.string:
——什么？
不，不，我太专注了，没空照料你的好奇心。我相信巴拉瑟姆派会有事情给你做。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You demonstrate tremendous promise to have returned from Golgotha with such inexperience. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile. Take this bracelet, as well.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥托，巴拉瑟姆的管事。请原谅我们以这种方式相识，但我们必须采取防范。库德是个非常无情的地方。
你经验如此不足，却能从各各他返回，显示出巨大的潜力。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最优秀枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的标记。也收下这只手镯。
等你准备好讨论信号时再回来。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 谢谢。我会回来的。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
I am pleased to see that you've returned with the waydroid, though you still know little of the dangers you bear. Take this firearm as your reward. It bears the mark of our finest gunsmith, Sparafucile.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥托，巴拉瑟姆的管事。请原谅我们以这种方式相识，但我们必须采取防范。库德是个非常无情的地方。
我很高兴看到你带着路行机器人返回，尽管你仍然不太明白自己承载的危险。收下这把火器作为奖赏。它带有我们最优秀枪匠斯帕拉富奇莱的标记。
等你准备好讨论信号时再回来。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 谢谢。我会回来的。

string.ID:
Welcome to Grit Gate. I am Otho, Barathrum's steward. I apologize for the manner of our introduction, but we must take precautions. Qud is a very unforgiving place.
You are worthy to study with us. Take these.
Return when you are ready to discuss the signal.

strings.string:
欢迎来到砂砾门。我是奥托，巴拉瑟姆的管事。请原谅我们以这种方式相识，但我们必须采取防范。库德是个非常无情的地方。
你配与我们一同学习。收下这些。
等你准备好讨论信号时再回来。

string.ID: Thank you. I will return.

strings.string: 谢谢。我会回来的。

string.ID:
It takes more than a willing spirit to be trusted here, wayfarer.
Prove your worth and bring us a waydroid, and we will have more to speak of.

strings.string:
要在这里获得信任，光有愿意效劳的精神还不够，旅人。
证明你的价值，给我们带来一台路行机器人，那时我们就有更多可谈。

string.ID: Are you ready to discuss the signal?

strings.string: 你准备好讨论信号了吗？
准备好了。
还没有。

string.ID:
The signal is a repeat transmission being broadcast from an unknown source.=V0tinkeraddendum= One of our tinkers, {{m|Q Girl}}, discovered it while rigging a long wave detector. Unfortunately, it's encrypted, and we do not have the means here to decrypt it. You may be of some help in this matter, however.
We've long known the location of a fully functioning {{W|baetyl}} within the bowels of the great hall {{C|Bethesda Susa}}. The Mechanimists have consecrated the site around it and built a temple there. Q Girl claims to have developed a means to decrypt the signal, but she needs the computing power of the baetyl. If you can infiltrate the Mechanimist compound, you may be able to engage the baetyl and decode the signal.

strings.string:
这个信号是一段来自未知来源的重复传输。=V0tinkeraddendum= 我们的一名修补匠，{{m|Q 女孩}}，在架设长波探测器时发现了它。遗憾的是，它被加密了，而我们这里没有解密手段。不过，你或许能在此事上提供帮助。
我们很早就知道，在大殿 {{C|贝塞斯达苏萨}} 的腹腔中，有一块完全运作的 {{W|贝特尔}}。机械信徒将其周围的地点祝圣，并在那里建了一座神殿。Q 女孩声称已经开发出解密信号的方法，但她需要贝特尔的计算能力。如果你能潜入机械信徒的建筑群，或许就能接入贝特尔并解码信号。

string.ID: What is a baetyl?

strings.string: 贝特尔是什么？

string.ID:
They are antique stones located in certain places deep within the caverns of Qud. We believe they are some sort of hyper-advanced machines built by the Eaters. Often one claims to possess a sentience of its own. However, most of them have gone haywire in the eons since their creation; it is rare indeed to discover one whose circuitry is wholly uncorroded.
The Mechanimists worship this one as an idol, and they will protect it at all costs. You will need to find a way through their host to the baetyl itself.
Do you believe you can accomplish this task?

strings.string:
它们是古老的石头，位于库德洞穴深处的某些地点。我们认为它们是吞噬者建造的某种超先进机器。它们常常声称自己拥有独立感知。然而，自被创造以来经过无数宙纪，大多数都已经失控；能发现一块电路完全未被腐蚀的，实在罕见。
机械信徒把这一块当作偶像崇拜，并会不惜一切保护它。你需要想办法穿过他们的队伍，抵达贝特尔本身。
你认为自己能完成这项任务吗？

string.ID: Yes, I do.

strings.string: 是的，我能。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必须考虑一下这项任务。

string.ID:
Good, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Speak to {{m|Q Girl}} in the workshop. She'll encode her instructions for the baetyl onto a copy of the disk.
There's one more thing. The baetyl is located beneath the ancient cryobarrios of the Eaters. Time has worked to erode the mechanisms that contain their cryogenic mist. That freezing vapor billows out of the chambers freely now, cooling the entire cavern. You will want to procure warm clothing to protect =player.reflexive=.
The spoils of the Mechanimists are yours to keep. Remember, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=, Barathrum will look kindly upon your service.

strings.string:
很好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。去工坊找 {{m|Q 女孩}}。她会把自己给贝特尔的指令编码到一份磁盘副本上。
还有一件事。贝特尔位于吞噬者古老低温街区的下方。岁月侵蚀了封存低温雾的机制。如今，那冻结蒸气从舱室中肆意涌出，冷却了整座洞穴。你最好弄些暖和衣物来保护自己。
机械信徒的战利品归你所有。记住，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=，巴拉瑟姆会善待你的效劳。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我会带着数据回来，管事。

string.ID: Luck be with you in the lair of Bethsaida, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string: 愿好运在伯赛大的巢穴中与你同在，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: I will return with the data, Steward.

strings.string: 我会带着数据回来，管事。

string.ID: You return. Have you succeeded in decoding the signal?

strings.string: 你回来了。你成功解码信号了吗？
成功了。

string.ID: Well done, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Present the disk.

strings.string: 做得好，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。呈上磁盘。

string.ID: [Give Otho the disk]

strings.string: [把磁盘交给奥托]

string.ID: I must bring the decoded signal to Barathrum immediately. Return in a few hours. By then I'll have discussed our next course of action with Barathrum and will have further instructions for you.

strings.string: 我必须立刻把解码后的信号带给巴拉瑟姆。几小时后回来。到那时，我会和巴拉瑟姆讨论完我们的下一步行动，并给你进一步指示。

string.ID: As you say, steward.

strings.string: 遵命，管事。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=, I have no further instructions for you yet. Return soon.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=，我暂时还没有进一步指示给你。尽快回来。

string.ID: As you say, steward.

strings.string: 遵命，管事。

string.ID: =name=, I've brought the decoded signal to Barathrum, and he's finished musing on it. We have fresh instructions for you, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Are you ready to hear them?

strings.string: =name=，我把解码后的信号带给了巴拉瑟姆，他已经思索完毕。我们有新的指示给你，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。你准备好听了吗？
准备好了。

string.ID:
Barathrum needs you for an undertaking of great importance. You must journey to {{C|Omonporch}} far to the north. There the Spindle stretches from earth to sky. Unfortunately, a troublesome merchant from the Consortium of Phyta has relocated there and declared xerself Earl of Omonporch. We need you to broker a deal so that we may lease control of the Spindle. Failing that, you'll need to dispose of the self-appointed Earl.
Be careful on your approach to Omonporch, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. So far east into the reaches of Qud, the Putus Templar lie in wait.

strings.string:
巴拉瑟姆需要你去做一件极其重要的事。你必须前往遥远北方的 {{C|奥蒙廊}}。在那里，纺锤从大地延伸至天空。不幸的是，一名来自植生财团的麻烦商人迁居到了那里，并自称奥蒙廊伯爵。我们需要你促成一项交易，好让我们租赁纺锤的控制权。若做不到，你就得除掉这位自封伯爵。
接近奥蒙廊时要小心，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。在库德如此东远之境，普图斯圣殿骑士正在潜伏。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?

strings.string: 普图斯圣殿骑士是什么人？

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?

strings.string: 这件事的目的是什么？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉瑟姆确保纺锤。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必须考虑一下这项任务。

string.ID:
The Putus Templar, or the Sons and Daughters, as they call themselves, are an order of knights who claim descendancy from the Eaters, the ancient folk who wrought the chrome halls of Qud. Beware them, for while they despise all mutants, they harbor a special malice for Barathrum.
Take care that you do not find =player.reflexive= inside one of their slave pens.

strings.string:
普图斯圣殿骑士，或者按他们自己的称呼，诸子诸女，是一个骑士团，自称继承自吞噬者，也就是铸造库德铬钢大厅的古代族民。小心他们，因为他们憎恶一切变异者，而对巴拉瑟姆怀有格外的恶意。
小心别让自己落进他们的奴隶围栏里。

string.ID: What is the purpose of this?

strings.string: 这件事的目的是什么？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉瑟姆确保纺锤。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必须考虑一下这项任务。

string.ID:
That will be revealed to you in due time.
Do not forget your place, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=.

strings.string:
时机到了，你自然会知道。
别忘了自己的位置，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。

string.ID: Who are the Putus Templar?

strings.string: 普图斯圣殿骑士是什么人？

string.ID: I will secure the Spindle for Barathrum.

strings.string: 我会为巴拉瑟姆确保纺锤。

string.ID: I must think on this task.

strings.string: 我必须考虑一下这项任务。

string.ID:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
果然如我所惧，=name=。砂砾门正遭到攻击。普图斯圣殿骑士一定是从奥蒙廊一路跟着你回来了。
趁他们抵达前这点珍贵时间，我们来准备防御。

string.ID: What can I do?

strings.string: 我能做什么？

string.ID: Go to the mainframe room and scan the shale surrounding Grit Gate for anomalies. Now, =name=!

strings.string: 去主机房，扫描砂砾门周围页岩中的异常。现在就去，=name=！

string.ID: I'll go now.

strings.string: 我现在就去。

string.ID:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
凭我给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以访问我们的电网。飞地各处都有链式激光炮位和力场投射器。利用埃列什基伽勒的侦察结果，决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过接入埃列什基伽勒来广播超频指令，或激活罗达尼斯 Y。
不过要注意电流负载。如果从电网抽取过量，你可能会造成降压停电。
快行动，=name=！我们说话时，圣殿骑士仍在逼近。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会尽力保卫砂砾门。

string.ID: That rumbling... what was it? An explosion? Hmm...

strings.string: 那阵隆响……是什么？爆炸？嗯……

string.ID: What are you thinking, Otho?

strings.string: 你在想什么，奥托？

string.ID:
Grave thoughts, =name=. Listen to me now. Take this key card, go to Ereshkigal's room, and-- oh, that's the mainframe. It's what she prefers to be called.
Go to her room, access Ereshkigal, and scan the shale surrounding the enclave for anomalies. I've asked her to ready her sensors.
Update me with what you learn. You may use the intercom in the northeast corner of Ereshkigal's room to deliver your update.
Go, quickly! I'd soon be disabused of my fears.

strings.string:
沉重的想法，=name=。现在听我说。拿着这张钥匙卡，去埃列什基伽勒的房间，然后——哦，那是主机。她更喜欢别人这样称呼她。
去她的房间，访问埃列什基伽勒，扫描飞地周围的页岩是否存在异常。我已经请她准备好传感器。
把你发现的情况告诉我。你可以使用埃列什基伽勒房间东北角的对讲机来传达更新。
快去！我希望自己的恐惧能尽快被证明是误会。

string.ID: I'll go now.

strings.string: 我现在就去。

string.ID:
You can still activate our defenses, =name=. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.

strings.string:
你仍然可以激活我们的防御，=name=。飞地各处都有链式激光炮位和力场投射器。利用埃列什基伽勒的侦察结果，决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过接入埃列什基伽勒来广播超频指令，或激活罗达尼斯 Y。
不过要注意电流负载。如果从电网抽取过量，你可能会造成降压停电。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会尽力保卫砂砾门。

string.ID: Have you secured the Spindle yet?

strings.string: 你确保纺锤了吗？

string.ID: Yes, the Spindle is ours.

strings.string: 是的，纺锤归我们了。

string.ID: No, not yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Leave me alone for a moment, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I have duties to attend.

strings.string: 让我独处片刻，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我有职责要处理。

string.ID: I will return later, Otho.

strings.string: 我稍后再回来，奥托。

string.ID: That is sterling news, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. I'll go inform Barathrum straightaway.

strings.string: 这是极好的消息，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。我会立刻去告知巴拉瑟姆。

string.ID:
Furthermore, I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
另外，我和巴拉瑟姆谈过了。他称赞你处理奥蒙廊伯爵一事的方式，并感谢你在保卫砂砾门时展现出的勇气。
今天的袭击提醒了我们：长久以来，我们太相信行会的与世隔绝，也太相信普图斯圣殿骑士无暇他顾。另一场袭击的迫近威胁促使巴拉瑟姆加快他的计划，也随之提升你在我们行会中的位置。
你被晋升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉瑟姆希望立刻与你谈话。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想和我谈话？巴拉瑟姆本人？

string.ID:
I spoke with Barathrum. He praised your handling of the Earl of Omonporch, and he thanks you for the bravery you exhibited in defending Grit Gate.
The attack today reminds us: for too long have we put our faith in the isolation of our guild and the preoccupations of the Putus Templar. The looming threat of another attack impels Barathrum to accelerate his plans, and with them, your position in our guild.
You are raised to Disciple, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum wishes to speak with you immediately.

strings.string:
我和巴拉瑟姆谈过了。他称赞你处理奥蒙廊伯爵一事的方式，并感谢你在保卫砂砾门时展现出的勇气。
今天的袭击提醒了我们：长久以来，我们太相信行会的与世隔绝，也太相信普图斯圣殿骑士无暇他顾。另一场袭击的迫近威胁促使巴拉瑟姆加快他的计划，也随之提升你在我们行会中的位置。
你被晋升为门徒，=player.formalAddressTerm=。巴拉瑟姆希望立刻与你谈话。

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想和我谈话？巴拉瑟姆本人？

string.ID: He wishes to speak to me? Barathrum himself?

strings.string: 他想和我谈话？巴拉瑟姆本人？

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Take this key and follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。拿着这把钥匙，沿楼梯下到他的书房。他正在等你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你，奥托。

string.ID: Yes, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Follow the stairs down to his study. He awaits.

strings.string: 是的，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。沿楼梯下到他的书房。他正在等你。

string.ID: Thank you, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你，奥托。

string.ID: I am busy, wayfarer. Please talk to Mafeo in the trade square if you need something.

strings.string: 我很忙，旅人。如果你需要什么，请去贸易广场找马费奥。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=! You have my deepest gratitude. Few =player.personTerm|pluralize= could have defended Grit Gate so deftly.
Now, give me time to assess our losses and consult with Barathrum. Return soon.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:Barathrumites|capitalize=！请接受我最深的感谢。少有 =player.personTerm|pluralize= 能如此娴熟地保卫砂砾门。
现在，给我些时间评估损失并与巴拉瑟姆商议。尽快回来。

string.ID: Live and drink, Otho.

strings.string: 生而饮水，奥托。

string.ID: Given the circumstances, this is a remarkable lack of destruction. Your defense of Grit Gate was first-class, =name=.

strings.string: 考虑到当时的状况，破坏程度如此之低，实在惊人。你对砂砾门的防御堪称一流，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你的告知，奥托。

string.ID: Much was lost, but such is what I expected. Once again, thank you for efforts, =name=.

strings.string: 我们损失了许多，但这正是我所预料的。再次感谢你的努力，=name=。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你的告知，奥托。

string.ID: Such tremendous loss. I wonder if more could have been done to prevent it.

strings.string: 如此惨重的损失。我不禁想，是否本可以做更多来避免它。

string.ID: Thank you for the update, Otho.

strings.string: 谢谢你的告知，奥托。

string.ID: Yes, =name=?

strings.string: 什么事，=name=？

string.ID: Live and drink, steward.

strings.string: 生而饮水，管事。

string.ID: Be straightforward, disciple. You mean to ask if we will house them.

strings.string: 直说吧，门徒。你是想问我们是否会收容他们。

string.ID: I am uncertain that you know the enormity of what you ask me, =name=. Nonetheless, I cannot deny what you have done for our order. These slynth must be tested as you were, but should they show the mettle and drive set by your example, we will accept them as apprentices.

strings.string: 我不确定你是否知道自己向我提出的请求有多重大，=name=。尽管如此，我不能否认你为我们教团所做的一切。这些斯林斯必须像你一样接受考验；但若他们展现出与你榜样相称的胆魄与干劲，我们会接纳他们为学徒。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Otho.

strings.string: 感谢你，奥托。

string.ID: You have grown bold beyond your station. What you have asked of us you have not earned. If you must ask again, become worthier first.

strings.string: 你的胆量已经越过了自己的身份。你向我们请求的东西，你尚未赢得。若你必须再次请求，就先让自己更配得上。

string.ID: Has this slynth situation been settled yet?

strings.string: 斯林斯的情况已经解决了吗？

string.ID:
I did not expect to admit this, disciple, but the refugees have met my expectations. Like you, they have shown more than a willing spirit in work and curiosity both.
The slynth have promise, and you may have been right to bring them to us.

strings.string:
我没想到自己会承认这一点，门徒，但这些难民达到了我的期望。与你一样，他们在工作和好奇心上展现出的不只是愿意效劳的精神。
斯林斯有前途，你把他们带给我们也许是对的。

string.ID: My thanks, Otho.

strings.string: 多谢，奥托。

string.ID:
Live and drink, disciple.
You will be pleased to know that the slynth have proven themselves worthy of apprentice status. They will reside here for as long as they uphold and serve the tenets of our order.

strings.string:
生而饮水，门徒。
你会高兴地知道，斯林斯已经证明自己配得上学徒身份。只要他们维护并服务于我们教团的信条，他们就会在这里居住。

string.ID: My thanks again, Otho

strings.string: 再次感谢，奥托

string.ID:
It's as I feared, =name=. Grit Gate is being assailed. The Putus Templar must have followed you back from Omonporch.
Let us use the precious little time we have before they arrive to prepare our defenses.

strings.string:
果然如我所惧，=name=。砂砾门正遭到攻击。普图斯圣殿骑士一定是从奥蒙廊一路跟着你回来了。
趁他们抵达前这点珍贵时间，我们来准备防御。

string.ID: What can I do?

strings.string: 我能做什么？

string.ID:
With the chrome key card I gave you, you now have access to our power grid. There are chain laser emplacements and force projectors across the enclave. Use Ereshkigal's reconnaissance to decide which defenses to enable. You can also broadcast an overclock command or activate Rodanis Y by interfacing with Ereshkigal.
Be mindful of the amperage draw, though. If you overdraw the grid, you could cause brownouts.
Act quickly, =name=! The Templar near us even as we speak.

strings.string:
凭我给你的铬钢钥匙卡，你现在可以访问我们的电网。飞地各处都有链式激光炮位和力场投射器。利用埃列什基伽勒的侦察结果，决定启用哪些防御。你也可以通过接入埃列什基伽勒来广播超频指令，或激活罗达尼斯 Y。
不过要注意电流负载。如果从电网抽取过量，你可能会造成降压停电。
快行动，=name=！我们说话时，圣殿骑士仍在逼近。

string.ID: I'll do my best to defend Grit Gate.

strings.string: 我会尽力保卫砂砾门。

string.ID: {{emote|*loud static*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*响亮静电噪声*}}

string.ID: Quetzal! Who are you, stranger?

strings.string: 格查尔！你是谁，陌生人？

string.ID: I must be going.

strings.string: 我必须走了。

string.ID: It's time to fight, =name=. Are you with me?

strings.string: 该战斗了，=name=。你站在我这边吗？

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 我站在你这边。

string.ID: Quetzal, quetzal, quetzal! Welcome to the workshop, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 格查尔，格查尔，格查尔！欢迎来到工坊，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Barathrum asked me to deliver your blueprints to Pax Klanq.

strings.string: 巴拉瑟姆让我把你的蓝图交给帕克斯·克兰克。

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Q Girl?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵隆响了吗，Q 女孩？

string.ID: What does 'quetzal' mean?

strings.string: “格查尔”是什么意思？

string.ID: Your hair is a quasar of red ochre and indigo.

strings.string: 你的头发是一颗由红赭石与靛青构成的类星体。

string.ID: Do you like my goggles?

strings.string: 你喜欢我的护目镜吗？

string.ID: There must be a hundred gadgets here. What are you working on?

strings.string: 这里肯定有上百个小玩意。你在做什么？

string.ID: Otho informs me that you have a method for decoding the signal. Can you encode your instructions for the baetyl onto this disk?

strings.string: 奥托告诉我你有解码信号的方法。你能把给贝特尔的指令编码到这张磁盘上吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修补匠。

string.ID: Yikes! Yes! The intensity was too great to be the result of one of my experiments. What was it, I wonder?

strings.string: 哎呀！是的！强度太大了，不可能是我的某个实验造成的。我想知道那是什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修补匠。

string.ID: It's a word I say out of excitement. Sort of a semantic extension of the feeling I get when I see a quetzal. Oh, a quetzal is a pretty bird in the trogon family. I tend to incorporate things I like into my idiolect.

strings.string: 这是我激动时说的词。算是我看到格查尔鸟时那种感觉的语义延伸。哦，格查尔鸟是一种漂亮的咬鹃科鸟。我喜欢把自己喜欢的东西并入个人语汇。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修补匠。

string.ID: Quetzal! Thank you, thank you. What a poetic metaphor! You're a regular Shakesprig, aren't you?

strings.string: 格查尔！谢谢，谢谢。多有诗意的比喻！你简直就是莎枝翁，对吧？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修补匠。

string.ID: Yes, yes, yes. They are so quetzal!

strings.string: 喜欢，喜欢，喜欢。它们太格查尔了！

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修补匠。

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修补匠。

string.ID: I do, brave friend. I'll imprint them now.

strings.string: 可以，勇敢的朋友。我现在就把它们印写进去。

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.

strings.string: 谢谢你，Q 女孩。

string.ID: Here they are, brave friend. Good luck!

strings.string: 给你了，勇敢的朋友。祝你好运！

string.ID: Thank you, Q Girl.

strings.string: 谢谢你，Q 女孩。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile lifts one brow, giving you a wary look.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱抬起一边眉毛，戒备地看着你。*}}

string.ID: I'll be going.

strings.string: 我这就走。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives =pronouns.possessive= carbine a once-over and gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱扫了一眼=pronouns.possessive=卡宾枪，然后坚定地向你点头。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *回以点头*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile gives you a resolute nod.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱坚定地向你点头。*}}

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *回以点头*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile nods.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱点点头。*}}

string.ID: Greetings, Sparafucile.

strings.string: 你好，斯帕拉富奇莱。

string.ID: *nod back*

strings.string: *回以点头*

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile raises one long-fingered hand in greeting.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱举起一只长指手向你致意。*}}

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你知道贝塞斯达苏萨的事吗？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Sparafucile?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵隆响了吗，斯帕拉富奇莱？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克兰克吗？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须经由吞噬者之墓进入明灼阴府。

string.ID: What do you think of Klanq's presence?

strings.string: 你怎么看克兰克的到来？

string.ID: Your carbine is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的卡宾枪是我用过的最精良器具之一。

string.ID: Your pistol is as fine an instrument as I have ever wielded.

strings.string: 你的手枪是我用过的最精良器具之一。

string.ID: You are a bear of few words.

strings.string: 你是只寡言的熊。

string.ID: Are you happy living in this cave, away from the sun and open sky?

strings.string: 远离太阳与开阔天空，住在这洞穴里，你快乐吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, harm-artisan.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伤害艺匠。

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile frowns. After several moments of paper-shuffling, he presents you with a charcoal drawing depicting a gelatinous creature in the shape of a gumdrop. Sketches below depict the ooze enveloping a bipedal figure, then falling through the floor.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱皱起眉头。翻动纸张片刻后，=pronouns.subjective=向你展示一幅炭笔画，画中是一只橡皮糖形状的胶质生物。下方的草图描绘了软泥包裹一个双足身影，随后穿过地板落下。*}}

string.ID: An ooze that can melt through the floor...

strings.string: 一种能熔穿地板的软泥……

string.ID: {{emote|*Sparafucile furrows his brow for a few moments, then shakes his head, sighs, and offers you a shrug. He puts a paw on your shoulder and squeezes.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*斯帕拉富奇莱蹙眉片刻，然后摇头、叹气，向你耸了耸肩。=pronouns.Subjective=把一只爪子放在你肩上，轻轻捏了捏。*}}

string.ID: Fair enough, friend.

strings.string: 也有道理，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Sparafucile instructs you to wait, and spends a minute or so rifling through the papers and scraps scattered across =pronouns.possessive= workbench.
