string.ID:
It's sort of like this. You go to the baetyl. You talk to it and you say, "Look, where is every beaded bracelet in the jungle? Where is every beaded bracelet in the watervine marsh? Where is every beaded bracelet in the River Svy?"
Then it tells you and you go get the bracelets.

strings.string:
有点像这样。你去找贝特尔。你和它说话，然后你说：“你看，丛林里的每一只珠串手镯在哪里？水藤沼泽里的每一只珠串手镯在哪里？斯维河里的每一只珠串手镯在哪里？”
然后它告诉你，你就去拿手镯。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID: Asphodel!! I like xem. I get it. It's sort of like you don't want to be here, you don't want to there, you want to be somewhere else. Your own earldom, maybe.

strings.string: 阿斯福德尔！！我喜欢 xem。我懂。就像你不想在这里，也不想在那里，你想在别的某个地方。也许是你自己的伯爵领。

string.ID: I see, Neek.

strings.string: 我明白了，尼克。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID: You felt it too! Every. rock. moved. Wooooooow! It's sort of like a community dance we all performed together. Mafeo. Sparafucile. The chromelings. The rocks. Everyone else.

strings.string: 你也感觉到了！每。一。块。石。头。都。动。了。哇哦哦哦哦！那有点像我们大家一起跳了一支共同体之舞。马费奥。斯帕拉富奇莱。铬灵。石头。其他所有人。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID: What's Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 帕克斯·克兰克是什么？
哦。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID:
Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Klanq. Pax Klanq.
I would ask to go downstairs but there is not mush room there. Or there is but that's why there's not. It's like, “Neek doesn't need to hear about it.”

strings.string:
克兰克。克兰克。克兰克。克兰克。帕克斯·克兰克。
我本想问能不能下楼，但那里没有多菇空间。或者说有蘑菇，所以才没有空间。就像是，“尼克不需要听这个。”
哦。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID: {{emote|*Neek stares at you awkwardly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*尼克尴尬地盯着你。*}}

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

strings.string: 生而饮水，尼克。

string.ID:
It's like what I *don't* do is drink Hortensa's sludge soup samples. I drank them once and she saw me and just sort of smiled tactfully but I could tell on the inside she was like "WOOOOOOOOW" so I don't do it.
Neek winks at you! Ha ha ha. She knows I still do it.

strings.string:
比如我*不会*做的事，就是喝霍滕西娅的淤泥汤样本。我喝过一次，她看见了我，只是很得体地笑了笑，但我能感觉到她心里其实在“哇哦哦哦哦哦”，所以我不喝。
尼克朝你眨眼！哈哈哈。她知道我还在喝。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

strings.string: 生而饮水，尼克。

string.ID:
Neek, chanting: "RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR! RECTANGLE HAIR!"
It's sort of like when prehistoric lizards would grow big sails to regulate their body temperatures and you'd say, "I like it, but it looks so organically generated. What if you filed it into a sharp rectangle?"

strings.string:
尼克吟唱：“矩形头发！矩形头发！矩形头发！”
这有点像史前蜥蜴长出大帆来调节体温，然后你说：“我喜欢，但它看起来太有机生成了。要是把它锉成尖锐的矩形呢？”

string.ID: You go and run at Q Girl and tap all the gadgets and tap her on the head. Then you sneak by Otho's office. Then you hug Shem -1 and you drag them to the library and read to them. Sometimes Barathrum and Hortensa are in there, and they smile at you. Then you get hungry and you roll toward the kitchen. You slurp honey from the vase and Dardi glares at you. You say, "I'm just 'jidding'." Then you climb the pipes and whisper to Aloysius, "Live and drink, live and drink, live and drink." Then you pat the chromelings on their heads. You say to Ereshkigal, "boom boom boom boom boom I love you." Then you sneak into storage and pat all the chromelings on their heads. You take a nap in the peptic chair. Then you get a bright idea and go back to your room to write it in your notebook.

strings.string: 你跑向 Q 女孩，拍拍所有小装置，再拍拍她的头。 然后你悄悄经过奥托的办公室。 然后你抱抱舍姆 -1，把他们拖去图书馆，读书给他们听。有时巴拉瑟姆和霍滕西娅也在那里，他们会对你微笑。 然后你饿了，就朝厨房滚过去。你从花瓶里吸蜜，达迪瞪着你。你说：“我只是在‘尼开玩笑’。” 然后你爬上管道，对阿洛伊修斯低声说：“生而饮水，生而饮水，生而饮水。” 然后你拍拍铬灵的头。你对埃列什基伽勒说：“砰砰砰砰砰我爱你。” 然后你偷偷溜进储藏室，拍拍所有铬灵的头。 你在消化椅上打个盹。 然后你有了一个明亮的点子，就回到房间，把它写进笔记本。

string.ID: Live and drink, Neek.

strings.string: 生而饮水，尼克。

string.ID:
{{B|[{{C|Voice transmitting through panel}}]}}
Be gone, wayfarer. This is no place for you.

strings.string:
{{B|[{{C|声音通过面板传来}}]}}
离开吧，旅人。这里不是你该来的地方。

string.ID: I come by way of Joppa. The elder Irudad calls me friend.

strings.string: 我从约帕而来。长老伊鲁达德称我为朋友。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。我得到了一张压有奇特印记的数据磁盘。这对你们修匠团有什么意义吗？你们能检查一下吗？

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I've come into possession of a data disk stamped with a peculiar sigil. Does this have meaning to your order of tinkers? Might you examine it?

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。我得到了一张压有奇特印记的数据磁盘。这对你们修匠团有什么意义吗？你们能检查一下吗？

string.ID: I am a merchant, cave dweller. I wish only to trade.

strings.string: 我是商人，洞穴居民。我只想交易。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. I bring a message from Argyve of Joppa.

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。我带来了约帕的阿吉夫的口信。

string.ID: Wait! My name is =name=. The people of =villageZeroName= recently came into possession of a data disk, onto which a strange signal was recorded. At their behest I carry the disk with me. They say your tutelage is to be my reward.

strings.string: 等等！我的名字是 =name=。=villageZeroName= 的人最近得到了一张数据磁盘，上面记录着一个奇怪信号。受他们所托，我随身带着这张磁盘。他们说，你们的教导会是我的报酬。

string.ID: [A slot opens from the center of the door and a metal tray slides out]

strings.string: [门中央打开一道槽口，一只金属托盘滑了出来]

string.ID: [Place stamped disk in tray]

strings.string: [把压印磁盘放进托盘]

string.ID: [Place scratched disk in tray]

strings.string: [把刮花的磁盘放进托盘]

string.ID: [Place disk in tray]

strings.string: [把磁盘放进托盘]

string.ID: Uh, I'll come back later with it.

strings.string: 呃，我之后带着它再回来。

string.ID:
[several minutes pass]
So you wish to study with us. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
Qud is not =villageZeroName=. You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted to our order. Otherwise, you will not be.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
[几分钟过去]
所以你想向我们学习。遗憾的是，我们要求的不只是一颗愿意的心。
库德不是 =villageZeroName=。你需要证明自己的价值，免得浪费我们的时间和努力。前往北方的大洞窟各各他。在它的厅堂里，你会找到一批失灵的路行机器人。
取回一台，修好它，然后回到这里。如果我们对你的工作满意，你会被接纳进我们的团体。否则，你不会。
你接受这个安排吗？
是。

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

strings.string: 不，我没有兴趣。

string.ID:
[several minutes pass]
The disk you bring is encoded with an important signal. To discuss it further, we must admit you to our order. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted as an apprentice. Otherwise, you will be turned away.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
[几分钟过去]
你带来的磁盘编码着一个重要信号。若要进一步讨论它，我们必须接纳你进入我们的团体。遗憾的是，我们要求的不只是一颗愿意的心。
你需要证明自己的价值，免得浪费我们的时间和努力。前往北方的大洞窟各各他。在它的厅堂里，你会找到一批失灵的路行机器人。
取回一台，修好它，然后回到这里。如果我们对你的工作满意，你会被接纳为学徒。否则，你会被拒之门外。
你接受这个安排吗？
是。

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

strings.string: 不，我没有兴趣。

string.ID:
[several minutes pass]
So it seems that you are indeed Argyve's apprentice. He wishes you to study with us. Unfortunately, we require more than a willing spirit.
Qud is not Joppa. You will need to prove your worth, that you might not waste our time and efforts. Travel to the great cavern Golgotha to the north. Within its halls you will find a cache of dysfunctional waydroids.
Recover one, repair it, and return here. If we are satisfied with your work, you will be admitted to our order. Otherwise, you will not be.
Do you accept this arrangement?

strings.string:
[几分钟过去]
看来你确实是阿吉夫的学徒。他希望你向我们学习。遗憾的是，我们要求的不只是一颗愿意的心。
库德不是约帕。你需要证明自己的价值，免得浪费我们的时间和努力。前往北方的大洞窟各各他。在它的厅堂里，你会找到一批失灵的路行机器人。
取回一台，修好它，然后回到这里。如果我们对你的工作满意，你会被接纳进我们的团体。否则，你不会。
你接受这个安排吗？
是。

string.ID: No, I'm not interested.

strings.string: 不，我没有兴趣。

string.ID: Have you completed the task?

strings.string: 你完成任务了吗？
是。

string.ID: Not yet. But I require entrance to the city for the purposes of trade.

strings.string: 还没有。但我需要进城进行交易。

string.ID: Welcome, wayfarer.

strings.string: 欢迎，旅人。

string.ID: I require entrance to the city.

strings.string: 我需要进城。

string.ID: Enter then, traveler.

strings.string: 那就进入吧，旅人。

string.ID:
[The slot opens from the center of the door. A bright red light shines through.]
[Several minutes pass.]
You may enter. Simply walk through the force barrier. Make your first two lefts and speak to Steward Otho in his office.

strings.string:
[门中央的槽口打开。一道明亮的红光透了出来。]
[几分钟过去。]
你可以进入。直接穿过力场屏障。前两个路口都左转，然后去奥托管事的办公室找他。

string.ID:
I always knew this part of our story would come. Our efforts today determine the genre of the tale we tell. Is this a triumphant epic, or a tale of woe?
Fight well, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
我一直知道我们的故事会走到这一章。我们今日的努力，将决定我们所讲述的故事属于何种体裁。这会是凯旋史诗，还是悲苦故事？
好好战斗，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: I will.

strings.string: 我会的。

string.ID:
Such interesting times we inhabit, =name=!
Good to see you well. Is there anything you need?

strings.string:
我们身处多么有趣的时代，=name=！
很高兴见你安好。有什么需要吗？

string.ID: I must enter Brightsheol through the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我必须经由吞噬者之墓进入明灼阴府。

string.ID: What do you think of the situation?

strings.string: 你怎么看现在的情况？

string.ID: Not at this time. Live and drink.

strings.string: 现在不用。生而饮水。

string.ID:
What novelty, to shelter the mysterious Klanq! I have heard no stories of this tinker-fungus that could be described as dull, though ‘calamitous' could apply to more than one.
My mind tells tales of what might be brewing in the basement, but I am quite relieved to be out here rather than down there.

strings.string:
庇护神秘的克兰克，真是新鲜事！我听过不少关于这位修匠真菌的故事，没有一个称得上乏味，倒是有不止一个可以称为“灾难性”。
我的脑子会替地下室里可能正在酝酿的事编出一堆故事，不过我很庆幸自己在外面，而不是在下面。

string.ID: So they do. Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 确实如此。生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
Coming from anyone else, I would ask that further japery be left to me.
But from you? I wouldn't startle to see you return wearing a Sultan's burial mask, having destroyed half a dozen invincible cherubim in the doing. Fates be with you.

strings.string:
若是换作别人说这话，我会要求把后续玩笑都留给我来开。
但若是你？就算看见你戴着一副苏丹葬面具回来，途中还毁掉了半打无敌智天使，我也不会吃惊。命运与你同在。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 多谢你。生而饮水。

string.ID: Welcome to Grit Gate, =factionaddress:Barathrumites=. Care to enhance the quality of your stay with a wise purchase?

strings.string: 欢迎来到砂砾门，=factionaddress:Barathrumites=。想用一次明智购物提升你停留的品质吗？

string.ID: I have been tasked to travel to Golgotha.

strings.string: 我受命前往各各他。

string.ID: Do you know anything about Bethesda Susa?

strings.string: 你知道贝塞斯达苏萨的事吗？

string.ID: What do you know about Omonporch and the self-appointed Earl?

strings.string: 你知道奥蒙廊和那位自封的伯爵吗？

string.ID: Did you feel that rumbling, Mafeo?

strings.string: 你感觉到那阵轰隆了吗，马费奥？

string.ID: Have you ever met Pax Klanq?

strings.string: 你见过帕克斯·克兰克吗？

string.ID: What wares do you sell?

strings.string: 你卖什么货？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: What kind of creature are you?

strings.string: 你是什么生物？

string.ID: Live and drink, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
My condolences to your sense of smell, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Golgotha is an execrable place in more ways than one, and I would advise you not to visit without a healthy stock of yuckwheat and honey. If you can cook, a meal with yuckwheat may banish a disease before it comes into its own. Bring salves or urberries, too, and mind your feet in the Cloaca.

strings.string:
我向你的嗅觉致以哀悼，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
各各他在不止一层意义上都可谓恶劣，我建议你若没有备足恶心麦和蜂蜜，就别去那里。如果你会烹饪，一顿带恶心麦的饭菜也许能在疾病真正发作前把它驱散。药膏或乌尔莓也带上，在泄殖腔里还要小心脚下。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID: Bethesda Susa? Lovely, but a bit dangerous for a holiday destination. You'll want to bring bandages and warm clothing. Why not take a look at my stock in case something suits you?

strings.string: 贝塞斯达苏萨？可爱，但作为度假地有点危险。你最好带上绷带和保暖衣物。不如看看我的存货，也许有适合你的东西？

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
It's a lovely place, and the bananas are delicious.
As for the so-called Earl, well. I'm loath to recognize nobility to begin with, and I cannot decide whether Asphodel claiming xyr own title is better or worse than if xe inherited it.

strings.string:
那是个可爱的地方，香蕉也很好吃。
至于所谓伯爵，嗯。我本就不乐意承认什么贵族，也说不准阿斯福德尔自封头衔到底比继承头衔更好还是更糟。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
Nothing short of explosives or heavy equipment could have made such a sound.
Be ready for the worst, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
除了爆炸物或重型设备，没什么能发出那样的声音。
做好最坏的准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
The Rainbow Wood is a fair bit too dangerous for a casual promenade, but nothing compares to its beauty. Once, I viewed it from above by means of a gyrocopter, and I will never forget the sights that I saw.
Nor will I forget crashing to the ground because the gyrocopter broke, but every adventure has its complications, wouldn't you say?

strings.string:
彩虹林对于随意散步来说危险得很，但没有什么能比得上它的美丽。有一次，我乘着旋翼机从空中俯瞰它，我永远不会忘记我所见的景象。
我也不会忘记旋翼机坏掉后我摔到地上的事，不过每场冒险都有它的麻烦，不是吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
Oh, I sell whatever sundries that meet my standards of quality, with some measure of curation. I try to ensure that my shelves carry a bit of many things, but you can count on finding more than enough ammunition and a few recoilers that can lead you back here in difficult times.
If you have anything in need of identification or repair, I can take care of that for you for a few drams as well.

strings.string:
哦，我卖各种符合我品质标准的杂货，多少也经过一点筛选。我会尽量保证货架上各类东西都有一些，不过你肯定能找到充足的弹药，还有几枚能在困难时刻把你带回这里的回弹器。
如果你有什么东西需要鉴定或修理，我也可以收几打兰替你处理。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
Why, this place is Grit Gate! O the vaulted halls, the glint of chrome, the gentle hum of chain turret emplacements!
There's nowhere like Grit Gate in the whole of Qud, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I've journeyed in my comparatively short time, but I always return here. The very air buzzes with knowledge, as well as quite a few other things.

strings.string:
哎呀，这里可是砂砾门！哦，那穹顶大厅，那铬钢闪光，那链式炮塔阵地温柔的嗡鸣！
整个库德都没有别处像砂砾门这样，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我在自己相对短暂的岁月里也旅行过，但总会回到这里。连空气都因知识而嗡嗡作响，当然，也因不少别的东西。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID:
We are called the Urshiib, =player.formalAddressTerm=.
Our kind are smarter than the average bear. Sharper, too, and a bit more handy.

strings.string:
我们被称为乌尔希布，=player.formalAddressTerm=。
我们这种族比普通熊聪明。也更尖锐，还更灵巧一些。

string.ID: Live and drink, Mafeo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，马费奥。

string.ID: What is it?

strings.string: 什么事？

string.ID: Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Why did you come to Omonporch?

strings.string: 你们为什么来到奥蒙廊？

string.ID: To make preparations, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Barathrum instructed us here after you secured the grounds.

strings.string: 为了做准备，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你拿下这片场地后，巴拉瑟姆指示我们来这里。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID: [The Baetyl emits an almost subliminal glow.]

strings.string: [贝特尔发出几乎低于知觉阈限的微光。]

string.ID: [Insert Disk]

strings.string: [插入磁盘]
[离开]

string.ID: [Press tab or T to open trade]

strings.string: [按 Tab 或 T 打开交易]
[离开]

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Why are you hiding in the bush?

strings.string: 你为什么躲在灌木里？

string.ID: Your twinblades are works of art. Where did you get them?

strings.string: 你的双刃是艺术品。你从哪里得到它们的？

string.ID: Crowsong, Deathwonder, a colony of ants eating me, the leaves, the light, and there on.

strings.string: 鸦歌，死亡奇观，一群正在吃我的蚂蚁，叶子，光，还有那边。

string.ID: Hiding, no. Being grass. The feeling of animate being. Radiate inward like a turned out star.

strings.string: 躲藏，不。做草。有生命者的感觉。像翻出的星辰一样向内辐射。

string.ID: Why are you here, in Kyakukya?

strings.string: 你为什么在这里，在克亚库克亚？

string.ID: Death is the color of everything but sometimes it waves in bright ribbons, like here. The whittlers weigh their passing goods, and the walls are corpse eaters.

strings.string: 死亡是万物的颜色，但有时它会像这里一样，摇曳成明亮的缎带。削刻者称量他们转瞬即逝的货物，墙壁则吞食尸身。

string.ID: Tugged from the claws of one who had become a cord in time's silly carpet. I outrooted the hilts and sheathed the blades, and now I am he. I still have the nail dirt.

strings.string: 从一位已成为时间愚蠢地毯上一根线的人爪中拽出。我连根拔起剑柄，收鞘刀刃，于是我现在就是他。我指甲里还留着泥。

string.ID: Friend! Guns? Knives? Hats? Cucumbers?

strings.string: 朋友！枪？刀？帽子？黄瓜？

string.ID: You're a member of the Consortium of Phyta, right? What do you know about the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 你是植群商会的成员，对吧？你知道奥蒙廊伯爵的什么事？

string.ID: What are you? What's your story?

strings.string: 你是什么？你有什么故事？

string.ID: I'm Yurl, chandler and Consortium notary. As for my story, I've been growing out of this pot for a while now. Before that, I was in another pot.

strings.string: 我是尤尔，杂货商兼商会公证人。至于我的故事，我已经从这个盆里长出来有一阵子了。在那之前，我在另一个盆里。
商会？

string.ID:
Yes, the Consortium of Phyta. We're a merchant fellowship of trees, vines, shrubs, weeds, flowers, herbs, cacti, algae -- most sorts of plants, really.
I can't say I trust any of them, but there is no doubting their usefulness. My shelves are full and the gossip flows.

strings.string:
是的，植群商会。我们是树木、藤蔓、灌木、杂草、花卉、草本、仙人掌、藻类组成的商人同业会，说真的，差不多各种植物都有。
我不能说我信任其中任何一个，但它们的用处毋庸置疑。我的货架满满当当，闲话也流个不停。

string.ID: What about fungi?

strings.string: 真菌呢？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Yurl flicks a leaf in displeasure.*}}
What about fungi?

strings.string:
{{emote|*尤尔不悦地弹动一片叶子。*}}
真菌怎么了？

string.ID: Are there any fungi in the Consortium?

strings.string: 商会里有真菌吗？

string.ID: Let's change the subject.

strings.string: 我们换个话题吧。
可是……

string.ID:
I am a gentleplant, -friend-. Uncross your roots and figure it out.
Live and DRINK.

strings.string:
我是个文雅植物，-朋友-。把你的根解开，自己想明白。
生而饮水。

string.ID:
Asphodel the socialite? Asphodel the scoundrel? You can hate xym -- and I do -- but you have to admire xym (I don't).
The truth of it is that Plysago had the idea first, to lay claim to the Spindle per some precedent of law established in Abram's time. Of course, Plysago isn't around to make their case, are they?

strings.string:
阿斯福德尔，那个社交名流？阿斯福德尔，那个无赖？你可以憎恨 xym，而我确实憎恨，但你不得不佩服 xym（我不佩服）。
真相是普利萨戈先有了这个主意，想依据亚伯兰时代确立的某个法律先例，对纺柱提出权利主张。当然，普利萨戈如今不在这里陈述自己的理由了，不是吗？

string.ID: How can I convince Asphodel to lease the Spindle to Barathrum?

strings.string: 我怎样才能说服阿斯福德尔把纺柱租给巴拉瑟姆？

string.ID:
Asphodel trades on reputation and favors. Xe is likely to want to leverage your connections, so be in good social standing with a few factions for xem to even consider it.
Now, alternatively, if you're loved by the Consortium, xe will feel the pressure to acquiesce. Xe has enough enemies among phyta.
Of course, where all else fails, you can always sharpen your shears, if you get my meaning.
{{emote|*Yurl winks with one of their leaves.*}}

strings.string:
阿斯福德尔靠名声和人情做买卖。Xe 很可能想利用你的人脉，所以你得和几个派系保持良好关系，xem 才会考虑这件事。
另一个办法是，如果你深受商会喜爱，xe 就会感到压力而不得不让步。Xe 在植群里已经有够多敌人了。
当然，若其他办法全都失败，你总还可以磨快你的修枝剪，如果你懂我的意思。
{{emote|*尤尔用一片叶子眨了眨眼。*}}

string.ID: I see. Live and drink, Yurl.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水，尤尔。

string.ID: Be ape-still and muse, wanderer, and welcome to my village, Kyakukya. Have some mulled mushroom cider!

strings.string: 像猿一样静止并沉思吧，旅人，欢迎来到我的村庄克亚库克亚。来点热蘑菇苹果酒！

string.ID: You are... an albino ape.

strings.string: 你是……一只白化猿。

string.ID: Why do you call it "your" village?

strings.string: 你为什么称它为“你的”村庄？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Kyakukya?

strings.string: 你能告诉我克亚库克亚的事吗？

string.ID: Is there work to be found here?

strings.string: 这里有活可干吗？

string.ID: Have you heard news of girshlings on Qud's surface? The watervine farmers of Joppa confirm it is true.

strings.string: 你听说库德地表出现吉尔什幼体的消息了吗？约帕的水藤农确认这是真的。

string.ID: I am at your service.

strings.string: 愿为你效劳。
正确！

string.ID:
Ah, bad habit. It's a possessive feeling I should work to scrub myself of, perhaps?
But I am its mayor, and I have been for some time. You see, years ago I deserted my people. We were of two different minds -- they desired nothing but to bludgeon everything to death, while I asked, "What is the nature of this thing we bludgeon? Or of the act itself?"
Recognizing that my answers lay elsewhere, I cast myself into the swell of the wilds, as a sailor from Perth with no windweird casts their ship to the whims of the Pale Sea!

strings.string:
啊，坏习惯。也许我该努力洗去这种占有欲？
但我是它的村长，而且已经当了一段时间。你看，多年前我离开了自己的族人。我们心思各异——他们只想把一切都敲打至死，而我则问：“我们所敲打之物的本质是什么？这个行为本身的本质又是什么？”
意识到答案在别处之后，我便把自己投入荒野的涌浪，就像一名没有风怪的珀斯水手，把船交给苍白海的任性！

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *继续聆听*

string.ID: Some years later and twenty ago, I came upon these mushrooms huts and their goodly inhabitants. They are a people full of earthen poetry, and I was charmed by the warmth they welcomed me with. Surely, I owed my acceptance at first to the countenance I share with their mighty god, but they soon grew to love me, and I them. I've remained here ever since in contemplation of those questions that first stirred in me all those years ago.

strings.string: 又过了二十余年，我遇见了这些蘑菇小屋和其中善良的居民。他们是充满泥土诗意的族群，他们迎接我时的温暖令我着迷。当然，我最初能被接纳，是因为我与他们那位伟大神祇有着相似面貌，但他们很快便爱上了我，我也爱上了他们。从那以后，我一直留在这里，沉思许多年前最初在我心中萌动的那些问题。

string.ID:
We're watered by the river spray -- we pluck the fruit of the wood, and we hunt. The worshippers of Oboroqoru whittle and brood, too. They will pay you no mind unless you ask of them. Here you can be with friends, or muse alone.
If it's trade goods that interest you, take a gander at Yurl's wares in the northwest corner. The odd one Crowsong's, too, if you can scry them in the bush.
I must warn you, however; cast no villain's shadow on these grounds. Warden Indrix will be watching.

strings.string:
我们由河流飞沫浇灌——我们采摘林木的果实，也狩猎。奥博罗科鲁的崇拜者也削刻、沉思。除非你主动问起，他们不会理会你。在这里，你可以与朋友相伴，也可以独自沉思。
如果你感兴趣的是货物，可以去西北角看看尤尔的商品。还有古怪的鸦歌，如果你能在灌木里窥见他们的话。
不过我必须警告你，别让恶徒的影子落在这片土地上。守卫因德里克斯会看着。

string.ID: Who is Yurl?

strings.string: 尤尔是谁？

string.ID: Who is Crowsong?

strings.string: 鸦歌是谁？

string.ID: Who is Indrix?

strings.string: 因德里克斯是谁？

string.ID: I have some other questions.

strings.string: 我还有其他问题。

string.ID: Yurl is a harmless cucumber vine. They came to Kyakukya a few years ago after the last Consortium chandler, a wicked little hyacinth named Plysago, suffered something of an... accident. In Tarotep's defense, Plysago shouldn't have berated someone with claws so close in resemblance to pruning shears. At any length, Yurl stocks a plethora of goods; you will be satisfied with your visit.

strings.string: 尤尔是一株无害的黄瓜藤。几年前，上一任商会杂货商，一株名叫普利萨戈的邪恶小风信子，遭遇了某种……意外，随后他们便来到克亚库克亚。替塔罗泰普说句公道话，普利萨戈不该责骂一个爪子看起来那么像修枝剪的人。总之，尤尔备有大量货物；你这趟去访会满意的。

string.ID: Oh, another of our dwellers. I won't speak to what Crowsong's deal is. Best you find them and ask yourself.

strings.string: 哦，我们的另一位居民。鸦歌究竟是怎么回事，我不好说。最好你自己找到他们问问。

string.ID: Warden Indrix is one of the most ferocious warriors I've ever met. Once upon a time, he and his brothers gorged themselves on the flesh of beasts by starlight, but now I count myself lucky to call him my warden. Some believe he is of sour kind, though I assure you, he's but a victim of his goatish nature.

strings.string: 守卫因德里克斯是我见过最凶猛的战士之一。从前，他和兄弟们曾在星光下狼吞虎咽地吞食野兽之肉，但如今能称他为我的守卫，我觉得自己很幸运。有些人认为他生性恶劣，不过我向你保证，他只是自己那山羊本性的受害者。

string.ID: A waterhand, you are? Speak to my friend and warden Indrix. You'll find him patrolling the village.

strings.string: 你是水佣？去和我的朋友兼守卫因德里克斯谈谈吧。你会看到他在村里巡逻。

string.ID: As far west as Joppa, you say? Oh, grim! Yes, we found the remains of pale-things in the mouth of Svy. Does the Gyre widen again? Hrmmmm.

strings.string: 你说远到西边的约帕？哦，真阴沉！是的，我们在斯维之口发现了苍白之物的残骸。轮回又在扩张了吗？嗯嗯嗯。

string.ID: I don't imagine you brought me this information merely to observe. Are you suggesting that these slynth might take up residence here in my village?

strings.string: 我想你把这个消息带给我，不只是为了让我旁观。你是在建议这些斯林斯可以在我的村庄里定居吗？

string.ID: Coming from anyone else, =name=, I might refuse outright. Housing recently-sentient refugees is no mean favor, I think you'll agree. My people are slow to trust, as well, so I fear that the slynth may feel unwelcome for some time. But then, grafted branches grow the best starapples, do they not? Yes, your lilypad friends are welcome here if they wish.

strings.string: 若是别人来开口，=name=，我或许会直接拒绝。安置新近开智的难民可不是小小人情，我想你会同意。我的族人也很慢才会信任他者，所以我担心斯林斯会有一段时间觉得不受欢迎。不过话说回来，嫁接的枝条结出的星苹果最甜，不是吗？是的，只要你的睡莲叶朋友们愿意，他们在这里会受到欢迎。

string.ID: You have my thanks, mayor.

strings.string: 多谢你，村长。

string.ID: Had I no responsibility to represent my people, I might accept out of the goodness of my own heart alone. Sadly, I do not consider my heart, or even my mind, to be more important than my duty. Perhaps if you were a more renowned figure among my people, I would reconsider.

strings.string: 若我没有代表族人的责任，也许只凭自己内心的善意，我就会接受。遗憾的是，我并不认为自己的心，甚至自己的头脑，比职责更重要。也许如果你在我的族人中更有名望，我会重新考虑。

string.ID: Have the slynth yet to choose a destination, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 斯林斯已经选择目的地了吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID:
Never has Kyakukya seen such bustle. These slynth are seem to be as good citizens as any, but I am at my limit with the stress of keeping track of everything.
Please check in again after some time, when I have my wits about me once again.

strings.string:
克亚库克亚从未见过这样的忙乱。这些斯林斯看起来和任何人一样都能成为好村民，但光是要理清所有事情，就已经让我压力到了极限。
请过一段时间再来看看，等我重新找回清醒头脑之后。

string.ID: My thanks, Mayor.

strings.string: 多谢，村长。

string.ID:
Greetings once again, =name=. I am pleased to report that the settling-in of the slynth has gone well, more or less. The villagers are yet wary, but as some slynth have joined in the rituals and worship of Oboroqoru that wariness has waned somewhat.
They've settled in across the village over time. Crowsong has taught the basics of hunting to a select few, and I'll be teaching a cooking class once I can wrest aside the time.

strings.string:
再次问候，=name=。我很高兴地报告，斯林斯的安顿过程大体顺利。村民们仍有戒心，但随着一些斯林斯加入奥博罗科鲁的仪式和崇拜，这份戒心已经稍稍减退。
随着时间推移，他们已经在村庄各处安顿下来。鸦歌把狩猎基础教给了少数被选中的人，而我一旦能挤出时间，也会开一门烹饪课。

string.ID: My thanks again, Mayor.

strings.string: 再次感谢，村长。

string.ID: Be nimble, wayfarer. Take in a draught of cider before leaving.

strings.string: 灵活些，旅人。离开前喝一口苹果酒。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Why is the cider chunky?

strings.string: 为什么苹果酒里有块状物？

string.ID: Is that a Naphtaali mask over there?

strings.string: 那边那是纳夫塔利面具吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, cider-friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，苹果酒朋友。

string.ID: I am called Erah. Branches part for you, =name=.

strings.string: 我被称作埃拉。枝条为你分开，=name=。

string.ID: That'd be the mushrooms. Bit heartier, a-ye?

strings.string: 那是蘑菇。更厚实些，欸，是吧？

string.ID: Why would you put mushrooms in cider?

strings.string: 你为什么要把蘑菇放进苹果酒？

string.ID:
...
Bit heartier, a-ye?

strings.string:
……
更厚实些，欸，是吧？

string.ID: Is. Was naphtaali once.

strings.string: 是。曾经是纳夫塔利。

string.ID: Was? Not any more?

strings.string: 曾经？现在不是了？

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.

strings.string: 我们说点别的吧。

string.ID: Mmm. Have cider?

strings.string: 嗯。喝苹果酒？

string.ID: A-ye, quit. Lost most my minyan to goatfolk. The sower's eye fell upon us and so we fell too.

strings.string: 欸，是，退出了。我的祈祷团大多死于羊民之手。播种者的眼落在我们身上，于是我们也倒下了。

string.ID: What is a minyan?

strings.string: 什么是祈祷团？

string.ID: What became of your Godhed?

strings.string: 你的神首后来怎样了？

string.ID: May their memories bless you.

strings.string: 愿他们的记忆祝福你。

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.

strings.string: 我们说点别的吧。

string.ID:
As the very canopy, they will.
Thank you.

strings.string:
他们会的，如同这整片树冠。
谢谢。

string.ID: Let us speak of something else.

strings.string: 我们说点别的吧。

string.ID: Live and drink, ciderer.

strings.string: 生而饮水，酿酒人。

string.ID:
Pilgrims, drawn together by need and awe and inspiration. Tinkers and sodders and guards and scouts, alloyed under the pressure of lifeswork.
Family, like.

strings.string:
朝圣者，被需要、敬畏和灵感牵引到一起。修匠、泥工、守卫和斥候，在终生事业的压力下熔铸成合金。
像家人。

string.ID:
Don't know. Wrecked? Fled?
I crawled away, never looked back. That's the all of it.

strings.string:
不知道。毁了？逃了？
我爬走了，再没回头。就这些。

string.ID: Klanq puff at you. =MARKOVSENTENCE=

strings.string: 克兰克向你喷孢。=MARKOVSENTENCE=

string.ID: [begin pax quest]

strings.string: [开始帕克斯任务]

string.ID: [pick a limb to infect]

strings.string: [选择一条肢体感染]

string.ID: Klanq puff at you?

strings.string: 克兰克向你喷孢？

string.ID: Didn't you die?

strings.string: 你不是死了吗？

string.ID: Aren't you supposed to be helping Barathrum in his study?

strings.string: 你不是应该在巴拉瑟姆的书房里帮忙吗？

string.ID: Excuse me?

strings.string: 你说什么？

string.ID: Why are you the color of coral? And why did the brick road outside only appear after I ate the Eater's fleshcap?

strings.string: 你为什么是珊瑚的颜色？还有，为什么外面的砖路只在我吃下吞噬者肉帽后才出现？

string.ID: I'm here to collect a debt for the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 我是来替巴拉瑟姆派讨债的。

string.ID: Fine. Puff away.

strings.string: 好吧。喷吧。

string.ID: No, thanks. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不了，谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.

strings.string: 克兰克分布！无法以有意义方式杀死克兰克。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Here, there.

strings.string: 克兰克分布！这里，那里。

string.ID: Klanq puff at you.

strings.string: 克兰克向你喷孢。

string.ID: Live and drink, mushroom.

strings.string: 生而饮水，蘑菇。

string.ID: Klanq want no visitors, so Klanq relocate workshop. Half dimension away. Tasties alter viewing plane.

strings.string: 克兰克不想要访客，所以克兰克搬走工坊。半个维度之外。好吃的改变观看平面。

string.ID: Live and drink, mushroom.

strings.string: 生而饮水，蘑菇。

string.ID: Prickles? Klanq miss prickles.

strings.string: 刺刺？克兰克想念刺刺。

string.ID: Why do you owe... "prickles"... a debt?

strings.string: 你为什么欠……“刺刺”……债？

string.ID: Well, you can repay the debt now. Barathrum wants you to build something. A climber. He says only you can do it.

strings.string: 好吧，你现在可以还债了。巴拉瑟姆想让你造个东西。一台攀登器。他说只有你能做到。

string.ID: Klanq puff on prickles during lecture on light refraction. Prickles angry.

strings.string: 克兰克在光折射讲座上对刺刺喷孢。刺刺生气。

string.ID: Klanq care little for debt.

strings.string: 克兰克不太在乎债。

string.ID: But you owe Barathrum. He needs your help.

strings.string: 但你欠巴拉瑟姆。他需要你的帮助。

string.ID: Klanq puff on debt.

strings.string: 克兰克向债喷孢。

string.ID: Is there anything I can do change your mind?

strings.string: 我能做什么让你改变主意吗？

string.ID: Klanq think...

strings.string: 克兰克想……

string.ID: Klanq got it! Klanq puff on you.

strings.string: 克兰克想到了！克兰克向你喷孢。

string.ID: Excuse me?

strings.string: 你说什么？

string.ID: Puff on yourself, mushroom. I'm leaving.

strings.string: 喷你自己吧，蘑菇。我要走了。

string.ID:
Klanq puff on you. You host Klanq. You spread Klanq for Klanq. Then your Klanq shrivels away.
Klanq puff on you, then Klanq build jalopy.

strings.string:
克兰克向你喷孢。你寄宿克兰克。你为克兰克传播克兰克。然后你的克兰克枯萎。
克兰克向你喷孢，然后克兰克造破车。

string.ID: Fine. Puff away.

strings.string: 好吧。喷吧。

string.ID: Puff off. Bye.

strings.string: 喷一边去。再见。

string.ID: Klanq puff on you! Klanq build jalopy.

strings.string: 克兰克向你喷孢！克兰克造破车。
呃。

string.ID:
Klanq puff on you...
..later. Now, Klanq pause puff for prickles favor.

strings.string:
克兰克向你喷孢……
……以后。现在，克兰克暂停喷孢，为刺刺做人情。

string.ID: Is the Creature ready?

strings.string: 造物准备好了吗？

string.ID: I am ready for the Creature to be moulded and catalyzed.

strings.string: 我已经准备好让造物塑形并被催化。

string.ID: Didn't you die?

strings.string: 你不是死了吗？

string.ID: Can you tell me about the components I must gather?

strings.string: 你能告诉我必须收集哪些组件吗？

string.ID: What should I know about the Creature?

strings.string: 关于造物，我该知道什么？

string.ID: Do you live in Grit Gate now?

strings.string: 你现在住在砂砾门吗？

string.ID: I would like to ask some questions about the large creature.

strings.string: 我想问些关于大型造物的问题。

string.ID: Klanq distribute! Cannot kill Klanq in a way that matters.

strings.string: 克兰克分布！无法以有意义方式杀死克兰克。

string.ID: Materials ready? Circuits to solder. Klanq stir the soup?

strings.string: 材料准备好？电路要焊。克兰克搅汤？
是的。

string.ID: You haven't provided the mound with all the necessary materials.

strings.string: 你还没有向土丘提供所有必要材料。

string.ID: You don't have enough primordial soup.

strings.string: 你的原初汤不够。

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Klanq stir! Come back three days and Creature arrive. Now, take operating manual.

strings.string: 克兰克搅！三天回来，造物抵达。现在，拿操作手册。

string.ID: I'll return in three days.

strings.string: 我三天后回来。

string.ID: No! Be back =mound.complete.days=.

strings.string: 没有！=mound.complete.days= 后回来。
好。

string.ID: Soup, body, catalyst, atzmus, armament, incantation, hamsa, power source, soup. Ask component!

strings.string: 汤、身体、催化剂、阿兹穆斯、武装、咒文、汉萨、动力源、汤。问组件！

string.ID: Tell me about the soup.

strings.string: 告诉我汤的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the body.

strings.string: 告诉我身体的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the catalyst.

strings.string: 告诉我催化剂的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the atzmus.

strings.string: 告诉我阿兹穆斯的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the armament.

strings.string: 告诉我武装的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the incantation.

strings.string: 告诉我咒文的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the hamsa.

strings.string: 告诉我汉萨的事。

string.ID: Tell me about the power source.

strings.string: 告诉我动力源的事。

string.ID: Where do I place components once they are gathered?

strings.string: 组件收集好后，我要把它们放在哪里？

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我还有别的事要问。

string.ID: Primordial soup 20 drams. Act as Creature circulatory liquid. Catalyzed and boom! Animating substance. Electromagnets induce sinusoidal flow.

strings.string: 原初汤 20 打兰。作为造物循环液。催化然后砰！活化物质。电磁体诱导正弦流动。

string.ID: Body of creature friend to form Creature after. Must follow you and be experience. No worry, friend not consumed in creation.

strings.string: 生物朋友的身体，之后形成造物。必须跟随你，而且有经验。别担心，朋友不会在创造中被消耗。

string.ID: Three dram of pure liquid to catalyze soup and circulate nutrient. Liquid choice alter sanguine mixture, change Creature.

strings.string: 三打兰纯净液体，用来催化汤并循环养分。液体选择改变血性混合物，改变造物。

string.ID: Atzmus transcendental imprint of being. Pattern trait after creature part, crossed with Body.

strings.string: 阿兹穆斯是存在的超验印记。以生物部件为蓝本塑造特质，与身体交叉。

string.ID: Zetachrome weapon. Attune Creature to the martial art and shape metachrome fist-types in the fashion after.

strings.string: 泽塔铬武器。使造物与武艺调谐，并依其样式塑造超铬拳型。

string.ID: Words spoken from your experience and inscribed to form being-bond. First sounds heard in Creature's early dreambrain.

strings.string: 由你的经历说出并铭刻的话语，用以形成存在纽带。造物早期梦脑听见的第一批声音。

string.ID: Chosen token to palm-solder and orient with object-meaning, 5 lbs. or less. Like others, choice alters Creature trait and behavior.

strings.string: 所选信物，用来掌焊并以物义定向，重量 5 磅或更少。和其他选择一样，它会改变造物特质和行为。

string.ID: Ascending Creature need mightful battery with rare electromagnet shielding. Purple prickles make neutron cell with 3 flux drams, or must find different source.

strings.string: 升攀造物需要带稀有电磁屏蔽的强大电池。紫色刺刺能用 3 打兰通量造中子电池，或者必须找别的来源。

string.ID: Interact with scrap-clay mound. Then chat Klanq to solder circuits and stir the soup.

strings.string: 与废料黏土土丘互动。然后和克兰克说话，焊电路，搅汤。

string.ID: What ask! Klanq say.

strings.string: 问什么！克兰克说。

string.ID: I will bond with the Creature. How does this work?

strings.string: 我会与造物结下纽带。这要怎么运作？

string.ID: I am bonded with the Creature. How does this work?

strings.string: 我已经与造物结下纽带。这要怎么运作？

string.ID: Barathrum and I will ascend the Spindle inside the Creature?

strings.string: 巴拉瑟姆和我会在造物体内升攀纺柱？

string.ID: Can the Creature wear equipment?

strings.string: 造物能穿戴装备吗？

string.ID: What if it's damaged or destroyed?

strings.string: 如果它受损或被毁怎么办？

string.ID: I have something else to ask.

strings.string: 我还有别的事要问。

string.ID: Creature follow you like friend. Also, can enter Creature and take control. One friend fit inside with you.

strings.string: 造物像朋友一样跟随你。另外，可以进入造物并取得控制。一个朋友能和你一起装进去。

string.ID: Creature is large creature, can only wear gigantic gear. Like kraken or saltback.

strings.string: 造物是大型生物，只能穿戴巨型装备。像海怪或盐背那样。

string.ID: Prickles install reshaping nook in Court of Sultans at Omonporch. There, respackle Creature with one dram of sunslag. Or recall creature if lost.

strings.string: 刺刺在奥蒙廊的苏丹庭院安装重塑角。在那里，用一打兰日渣重新填补造物。或者造物丢失时召回。

string.ID: Yes! But before then, can walk around with creature. Talk, fight, sleep... the normal. Friend.

strings.string: 是！但在那之前，可以和造物四处走。说话、战斗、睡觉……正常。朋友。

string.ID: Klanq live! Tragedy of jalopy invite Klanq to dimcandlespace. Klanq soften stone floor with plushes, dust shelves of boring jars with happy and spores. Prickles look at it.

strings.string: 克兰克住！破车悲剧邀请克兰克到暗烛空间。克兰克用毛绒软化石地板，用快乐和孢子拂去无聊罐子架上的尘。刺刺看着它。

string.ID: Impudent swine! You would bear that stygian charm in my presence?

strings.string: 无礼的猪猡！你竟敢在我面前带着那件幽冥护符？

string.ID: Make haste, traveller.

strings.string: 快些，旅人。

string.ID: Why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 为什么你被称作“弃民”？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID: Is Mamon dead? Have you recovered the talisman?

strings.string: 马蒙死了吗？你取回护符了吗？

string.ID: Yes. Mamon is dead and I possess the prism.

strings.string: 是的。马蒙死了，棱镜在我手里。

string.ID: Where will I find him again?

strings.string: 我会在哪里找到他？

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Live and drink, traveler.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.

strings.string: 别在我面前提那个名字。我警告过你了。

string.ID: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 我必须追问：为什么你被称作“弃民”？

string.ID: I am in search of work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID: Speak nothing of that name to me. You are warned.

strings.string: 别在我面前提那个名字。我警告过你了。

string.ID: I must insist; why are you called "pariah"?

strings.string: 我必须追问：为什么你被称作“弃民”？

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID: I will ravage your nubile heart!

strings.string: 我要撕碎你那初熟的心！

string.ID: Grrrraaaah! There is but one task I know to offer. It is most treacherous, and in all likelihood you will perish. Is your interest waned?

strings.string: 咕噜噜啊啊！我只知道一件可交付的任务。它极其险恶，而且你多半会死。你的兴趣减退了吗？

string.ID: No. Continue.

strings.string: 没有。继续。

string.ID: Yes. Goodbye.

strings.string: 是的。再见。

string.ID: There is a river just south of the village that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Along its bank lies a goatfolk village. There resides a mighty shaman, Mamon Souldrinker. He is in possession of a talisman of great power, an amaranthine prism that refracts the psyche of its handler in much the same way, as Mayor Nuntu has explained to me, a common prism refracts light. The thing is cursed, traveler. No man or goat may safely wield it for long. You must travel to the village and retrieve the prism from Mamon by any means necessary. Do you understand?

strings.string: 村庄正南有一条河，向东流入丛林。沿着河岸有一座羊民村庄。那里住着一位强大的萨满，马蒙·饮魂者。他拥有一件力量巨大的护符，一枚不凋棱镜；按照努恩图村长向我解释的说法，它会折射持有者的心魂，就像普通棱镜折射光线一样。那东西受了诅咒，旅人。无论人还是羊，都无法安全持有太久。你必须前往那座村庄，以任何必要手段从马蒙手中取回棱镜。你明白吗？

string.ID: Why don't you retrieve it yourself?

strings.string: 你为什么不自己去取？

string.ID: Yes. Is there anything else I should know?

strings.string: 明白。还有什么我该知道的吗？

string.ID: Because, traveler, Mamon is my elder brother. He would discern my presence before I could strike.

strings.string: 因为，旅人，马蒙是我的兄长。我尚未出手，他就会察觉我的存在。

string.ID: Is there anything else I should know?

strings.string: 还有什么我该知道的吗？

string.ID:
There is. Firstly, Mamon will likely have several goatfolk under his enthrallment, and they will protect him at all costs.
Secondly, take care to stay out of Mamon's reach, for his power is most potent when he may lay hands on you.
Finally, once you recover the prism, do not under any circumstances wield it. I needn't warn you of the consequences should you return to me bearing that charm.
That is all. Are you willing?

strings.string:
有。首先，马蒙很可能奴役着几名羊民，他们会不惜一切代价保护他。
其次，小心别进入马蒙触手可及的范围，因为当他能把手放到你身上时，他的力量最为强大。
最后，一旦取回棱镜，无论如何都不要使用它。若你带着那护符回到我面前，我无需再警告你后果。
就这些。你愿意吗？

string.ID: I am willing.

strings.string: 我愿意。

string.ID: No, I would risk too much.

strings.string: 不，风险太大。

string.ID: Just south of the village, there's a river that runs an eastwardly course into the jungle. Follow it to the goatfolk village. There you will find Mamon.

strings.string: 村庄正南有一条河，向东流入丛林。沿着它走到羊民村庄。你会在那里找到马蒙。

string.ID: My thanks, warden.

strings.string: 多谢，守卫。

string.ID: Is it so? Only a ferocious warrior could have slain Mamon. You must be such a warrior. Now hand over the prism and choose your reward.

strings.string: 果真如此？只有凶猛的战士才能杀死马蒙。你必定就是这样的战士。现在交出棱镜，并选择你的奖赏。

string.ID: [Give the amaranthine prism to Warden Indrix]

strings.string: [将不凋棱镜交给守卫因德里克斯]

string.ID: No, warden. It is mine.

strings.string: 不，守卫。它是我的。

string.ID: You! Are you come to attend his waking dream? Nor do I have cloven hooves, but, yes, a cloven mind.

strings.string: 你！你是来参与他的醒梦的吗？我没有裂蹄，但，是的，我有一颗分裂的心智。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: What are you talking about?

strings.string: 你在说什么？

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必须和萨满马蒙·饮魂者谈谈。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我得走了。

string.ID: Who am I? Who are you? What does it matter? You and I are nothing, the most insignificant afterthoughts of an amaranthine shade.

strings.string: 我是谁？你是谁？那有什么要紧？你我什么都不是，只是不凋幽影最微不足道的余念。

string.ID: What are you talking about?

strings.string: 你在说什么？

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必须和萨满马蒙·饮魂者谈谈。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我得走了。

string.ID: The amaranthine dream! The heights within ourselves we might yet reach with his guidance. There it is in all of us -- shades of our elder selves. Within each man, a goat. Within each goat, a man!

strings.string: 不凋之梦！在他的指引下，我们或许还能抵达自身之内的高处。它就在我们所有人里面——我们更古老自我的影子。每个人之内都有一只羊。每只羊之内都有一个人！

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: I must talk with the shaman Mamon Souldrinker.

strings.string: 我必须和萨满马蒙·饮魂者谈谈。

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我得走了。

string.ID: You don't talk with that mangoat -- you listen to him.

strings.string: 你不是和那个人羊谈话——你聆听他。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: What are you talking about?

strings.string: 你在说什么？

string.ID: I must go.

strings.string: 我得走了。

string.ID:
Liquids are better.
I prefer liquids.

strings.string:
液体更好。
我更喜欢液体。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Live and drink, hermit.

strings.string: 生而饮水，隐士。

string.ID:
A connoisseur of liquids. Sure, I dabble in other states of matter.
But I prefer the shifting and tumbling of angleless motion.
Not too hot, not too cold, not too indeterminate.

strings.string:
液体鉴赏家。当然，我也涉猎其他物态。
但我更喜欢无角运动的变换与翻滚。
不太热，不太冷，也不太不确定。

string.ID: Live and drink, hermit.

strings.string: 生而饮水，隐士。

string.ID: Welcome to Omonporch, traveler. Enjoy your visit to my earldom. Feast your eyes upon my tall and glorious Spindle. Take in the scent of roasted musa.

strings.string: 欢迎来到奥蒙廊，旅人。愿你享受造访我伯爵领的时光。尽情欣赏我高耸而荣光的纺柱。吸入烤芭蕉的香气吧。

string.ID: Are you truly the Earl of Omonporch?

strings.string: 你真的是奥蒙廊伯爵吗？

string.ID: Earl Asphodel, the Barathrumites request your permission to lease control of the Spindle. Their inquiries into the past have led them here.

strings.string: 阿斯福德尔伯爵，巴拉瑟姆派请求你准许他们租用纺柱的控制权。他们对过去的探询把他们带到了这里。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伯爵。

string.ID: Indubitably, for I've proclaimed it so! There was no Earl to tell me otherwise.

strings.string: 毫无疑问，因为我已经如此宣告！没有别的伯爵能告诉我并非如此。

string.ID: Lease control of my Spindle, you say? Well, well... That's a colossal request. There's no simple price I can assign to such a thing. Were I to grant such a request, you would owe me a great debt. You and several of your allies.

strings.string: 你说租用我的纺柱控制权？嗯，嗯……这是个庞大的请求。这种事我可没法标一个简单价格。若我要准许这样的请求，你会欠我一大笔债。你和你的几位盟友都是。

string.ID: So you say. How can I appease you?

strings.string: 既然你这么说。我该如何安抚你？

string.ID: I will convene a council. The First Council of Omonporch. Send word to four of your allied factions. Have them send delegates. Together, perhaps, you can appease me.

strings.string: 我会召集一场议会。奥蒙廊第一议会。给你的四个盟友派系传话，让他们派遣代表。你们合力，也许能安抚我。

string.ID: Hear me, Asphodel. I am a dear friend to the Consortium. I ask that you reconsider.

strings.string: 听我说，阿斯福德尔。我是商会的亲密朋友。我请求你重新考虑。

string.ID: Convene the council, then. I am willing.

strings.string: 那就召集议会吧。我愿意。

string.ID: Not today, Asphodel. Live and drink.

strings.string: 今天不行，阿斯福德尔。生而饮水。

string.ID: Oh... oh! It's you! You are a dear friend, indeed. Of course, of course! You and your bear friends are most welcome to my Spindle.

strings.string: 哦……哦！是你！你确实是亲密朋友。当然，当然！你和你的熊朋友们非常欢迎来到我的纺柱。

string.ID: You are kind, Earl Asphodel. You have my thanks.

strings.string: 你真仁慈，阿斯福德尔伯爵。多谢你。

string.ID: Greetings, my viceroy. Sit your rump on a cushion or lie your long back on a kline. Soak in the natural light.

strings.string: 问候你，我的总督。把你的屁股坐到软垫上，或把你的长背躺到克林卧榻上。沐浴自然光吧。
总督？

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伯爵。

string.ID:
That's right. I've leased your friends the Spindlegrounds and appointed you viceroy to oversee their operation.
Welcome to court, asphodelyte. You serve at my pleasure.

strings.string:
正是。我已将纺柱地租给你的朋友们，并任命你为总督，监督他们的运作。
欢迎入廷，阿斯福德尔侍从。你按我的意愿效劳。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伯爵。

string.ID: Are you ready to begin negotiations?

strings.string: 你准备好开始谈判了吗？
是的。

string.ID: Not yet.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: That was awful!

strings.string: 那太糟了！

string.ID: I am a servant of chaos. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我是混沌的仆人。生而饮水。

string.ID: Your friends may lease the Spindle, as we agreed.

strings.string: 你的朋友们可以按我们的约定租用纺柱。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伯爵。

string.ID: Delegates from your allied factions are on their way.

strings.string: 你盟友派系的代表正在路上。

string.ID: Live and drink, Earl.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伯爵。

string.ID: Kneel before the Rock, =player.offspringTerm=.

strings.string: 跪在磐石面前，=player.offspringTerm=。

string.ID: As the flaming sun warms the empty void, so the Rock warms us.

strings.string: 正如炽燃太阳温暖空洞虚空，磐石也温暖我们。

string.ID: Be here, and be granted.

strings.string: 在此存在，并被赐予。
欸，是？
高个民。

string.ID: You wandering? Be nimble.

strings.string: 你在游荡？灵活些。

string.ID: Branches part for you.

strings.string: 枝条为你分开。

string.ID: Be nimble, broadfinger.

strings.string: 灵活些，宽指人。

string.ID: Need aught?

strings.string: 需要什么？

string.ID: Hm hm hm.

strings.string: 嗯嗯嗯。
哦欸？

string.ID: Trees shield you.

strings.string: 树木护佑你。

string.ID: Sower's eye pass over you.

strings.string: 愿播种者的眼掠过你。

string.ID: Forage fruitfully.

strings.string: 采食丰盛。

string.ID: Danger, a-ye?

strings.string: 危险，欸，是吧？

string.ID: Be nimble.

strings.string: 灵活些。

string.ID: Be sodder-handed.

strings.string: 让手沾泥。

string.ID: Where is your minyan?

string.ID: Don't be coy, =name=. Emboldened by your incursions into our village, you wish to fill it with your indigent foundlings on the weight of your reputation alone. Am I correct?

strings.string: 别装含蓄了，=name=。你几次闯入我们的村庄后胆子大了起来，想仅凭自己的名声分量，就把你那些贫困的弃儿塞进这里。对吗？

string.ID: I... suppose so, yes.

strings.string: 我……想是的。

string.ID: Then I overestimated your intellect further than I realized. Get out.

strings.string: 那看来我对你智力的高估，比我以为的还要严重。出去。

string.ID: The slynth? What of them?

strings.string: 斯林斯？他们怎么了？

string.ID:
Live and drink, kendren. I am Hindriarch Keh; welcome to Bey Lah.
It's nearly unprecedented for one such as you to pass by our scouts unaccosted, but these are unprecedented circumstances. I have a task for you. Are you interested?

strings.string:
生而饮水，肯德伦。我是欣德族女族长凯；欢迎来到贝拉。
像你这样的人能不受阻拦地经过我们的斥候，几乎没有先例，但现在也是前所未有的情势。我有一件任务交给你。你有兴趣吗？

string.ID: Yes. Go on.

strings.string: 有。说下去。
没有。

string.ID:
Good.
We hindren are a close-knit and staid people, and our safety depends on our solidarity. In order to preserve our safety and culture, we ask that any of our number who leave us never come back. Recently, one such exile took the treasure of our village, a bracelet named Kindrish, with her when she left. None of our number can leave to get it back, or it will be a violation of the values that I have guarded, and the Hindriarchs before me, for countless generations.
Will you help us recover our treasure? We have a small cache of valuables we can offer as a reward.

strings.string:
很好。
我们欣德伦是紧密而稳重的族群，我们的安全依赖于团结。为了保存我们的安全与文化，我们要求任何离开我们的人永不回来。最近，一名这样的流放者离开时带走了我们村庄的宝物，一只名为金德里什的手镯。我们之中无人能离开去取回它，否则就会违背我以及我之前无数代欣德族女族长所守护的价值。
你愿意帮我们找回宝物吗？我们有一小批贵重物可以作为报酬。

string.ID: All right. I'll find your treasure.

strings.string: 好。我会找到你们的宝物。

string.ID: No thank you. I don't care for this job.

strings.string: 不，谢谢。我不喜欢这份差事。

string.ID:
Excellent. I will do my best to reward you to your satisfaction.
Though her name is sand in my mouth now, the exile who stole Kindrish is called Eskhind. She left a few weeks ago, and took her sister and brother with her. I don't know where she's gone, but Warden Neelahind might, as they were close friends as children.
Find the exile called Eskhind and retrieve Kindrish from her, even... even if the cost is the life of her and her siblings. Kindrish has been handed down over countless generations, and it belongs to my people, not any individual. Go, kendren. Speak to Warden Neelahind, and find out where Eskhind is hidden.

strings.string:
很好。我会尽力给你满意的报酬。
虽然如今她的名字在我口中如同沙砾，偷走金德里什的流放者名叫埃斯欣德。她几周前离开，还带走了她的姐妹和兄弟。我不知道她去了哪里，但守卫尼拉欣德也许知道，因为她们小时候曾是亲密朋友。
找到名叫埃斯欣德的流放者，从她手中取回金德里什，即便……即便代价是她和她手足的性命。金德里什已经传承了无数代，它属于我的族人，而非任何个人。去吧，肯德伦。和守卫尼拉欣德谈谈，查出埃斯欣德藏在哪里。

string.ID: As you say.

strings.string: 如你所言。

string.ID: Then I will thank you to leave as quickly as possible. I don't want the faundren to become used to our borders being permeable.

strings.string: 那我会感谢你尽快离开。我不希望幼欣德伦习惯于我们的边界可以被穿过。

string.ID: As you say. Live and drink.

strings.string: 如你所言。生而饮水。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed. Take this as thanks.
That said, the exile must answer for her crimes. There is further reward for you if you see this case through to the end.

strings.string:
你找到了我们的宝物？我承认，肯德伦，我非常佩服。收下这个作为谢礼。
话虽如此，流放者必须为她的罪行负责。如果你把这案子查到底，还有额外报酬给你。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? I'll admit, kendren, I'm very impressed.
Take this as thanks, and... well. I suppose you've earned your stay for a while. Just try not to give the faundren any ideas.

strings.string:
你找到了我们的宝物？我承认，肯德伦，我非常佩服。
收下这个作为谢礼，而且……好吧。我想你已经赢得了在这里停留一阵的资格。只是尽量别让幼欣德伦产生什么想法。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

string.ID: You're back. Have you found the exile and retrieved our treasure?

strings.string: 你回来了。你找到流放者并取回我们的宝物了吗？

string.ID: I have found Kindrish, but not Eskhind.

strings.string: 我找到了金德里什，但没找到埃斯欣德。

string.ID: Eskhind is dead, but Kindrish was not on her body.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德死了，但金德里什不在她身上。

string.ID: I have not.

strings.string: 还没有。

string.ID: Perhaps you should get back to it rather than hanging around my village. Warden Neelahind may be able to help you.

strings.string: 也许你该继续办事，而不是在我的村庄里闲逛。守卫尼拉欣德或许能帮你。

string.ID: As you say. Live and drink.

strings.string: 如你所言。生而饮水。

string.ID: Ayvah. She must have sold it. Tell no one about this. Please understand that I cannot reward you, as you did not complete the task I asked of you.

strings.string: 艾瓦。她一定把它卖了。别把这事告诉任何人。请理解，我不能奖赏你，因为你没有完成我托付给你的任务。

string.ID: Understandable. Live and drink.

strings.string: 可以理解。生而饮水。

string.ID: Unacceptable. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 不可接受。准备受死。

string.ID: Why is an exile standing in my village? Are you trying to play me for a fool?

strings.string: 为什么一名流放者站在我的村庄里？你想把我当傻子耍吗？

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish, but Eskhind did not have it.

strings.string: 欣德族女族长，我找到了金德里什，但它不在埃斯欣德手里。

string.ID: Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德声称自己遭到诬告。

string.ID:
The pariah claims to be wrongfully accused, and you believe her?
She is obviously lying. Are all kendren so gullible?

strings.string:
那个弃民声称自己遭到诬告，而你相信她？
她显然在撒谎。所有肯德伦都这么轻信吗？

string.ID: There is no proof that she is lying.

strings.string: 没有证据证明她在撒谎。

string.ID:
Fine! Go to the Warden, then, and have her solve this mystery.
But know this: until a thief is found and Kindrish is recovered, I cannot reward you. You get nothing. Live and drink, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string:
好！那就去找守卫，让她解开这个谜。
但你要明白：在找到窃贼并取回金德里什之前，我不能奖赏你。你什么都得不到。生而饮水，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: ...live and drink.

strings.string: ……生而饮水。

string.ID: Why are you speaking to me? You have work to do.

strings.string: 你为什么来和我说话？你还有事要做。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: I have questions for you.

strings.string: 我有问题要问你。

string.ID: Fine. What are they?

strings.string: 好吧。什么问题？

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: Why was Eskhind exiled?

strings.string: 埃斯欣德为什么被流放？

string.ID: Who is your bodyguard?

strings.string: 你的护卫是谁？

string.ID: Is Neelahind a good warden?

strings.string: 尼拉欣德是个好守卫吗？

string.ID: Why did you tell me Eskhind had a brother?

strings.string: 你为什么告诉我埃斯欣德有个兄弟？

string.ID: That's all. Live and drink.

strings.string: 就这些。生而饮水。

string.ID:
She exiled herself by leaving Bey Lah. Our codes demand that no hindren who leaves us ever return.
She knew this, and still she chose to leave.

strings.string:
她离开贝拉，便是自我流放。我们的准则要求任何离开我们的欣德伦永不回来。
她知道这一点，却仍选择离开。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kesehind is a good boy. He lost his parents long ago, but has been like a son to me.
Now his axe-arm is strong where mine is not, and so he lends it.

strings.string:
凯瑟欣德是个好孩子。他很久以前失去了父母，但一直像我的儿子一样。
如今他的持斧之臂强壮，而我的不够强，所以他把它借给我。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Warden Neelahind attends to her duties admirably. She is not terribly assertive, but she need not be.
I'm surprised she's going along with this outsider-led investigation, but she always had a soft spot for the exile.

strings.string:
守卫尼拉欣德履行职责的样子令人钦佩。她不算特别强硬，但她也不必如此。
我很惊讶她会配合这场由外人主导的调查，不过她一直对那名流放者有些心软。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
If you ask the exile, I'm sure she'll spin some kind of accusation that I believe gender to be an immutable prison, that I impose it on others.
She's lying. Our people have a long history of two-gender hindren called {{w|hartind}}, respected and consecrated. There is a proper path to gender variance in our society, of which the male exile could have availed himself years ago.
He never did, so I do not recognize him.

strings.string:
如果你问那名流放者，我肯定她会编出某种指控，说我相信性别是一座不可改变的牢笼，说我把它强加给别人。
她在撒谎。我们的族人有着悠久历史，尊重并圣化被称为 {{w|哈特欣德}} 的双性别欣德伦。在我们的社会中，性别差异有一条正当道路，那名男性流放者多年前本可利用它。
他从未这样做，所以我不承认他。

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID: I... see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我……明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Poem? I detest poetry. Why would one go about learning to write only to use purposefully unclear language, choosing rhyme scheme over clarity?
Of course it's not mine. Take it back.

strings.string:
诗？我厌恶诗。一个人为什么要费心学习书写，却只用故意不清不楚的语言，把押韵格式置于清晰之上？
当然不是我的。拿回去。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Gone...
All gone...

strings.string:
没了……
全都没了……

string.ID: My condolences.

strings.string: 请节哀。

string.ID:
I have a terrible feeling that I've brought ill fortune to my village.
Perhaps it was a mistake to have hired you.

strings.string:
我有一种可怕的感觉，是我给自己的村庄带来了厄运。
也许雇用你是个错误。

string.ID: If you say so. Live and drink.

strings.string: 既然你这么说。生而饮水。

string.ID:
They conspired against me. It is the only explanation.
You! Leave me alone.

strings.string:
他们合谋反对我。这是唯一的解释。
你！别来烦我。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I should have kept them apart.
I should have kept all of you apart.

strings.string:
我本该让他们分开的。
我本该让你们所有人都分开的。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Ah, you again. I'd been doing so well at forgetting your countenance.
Leave me be.

strings.string:
啊，又是你。我本来都快顺利忘掉你的面容了。
别管我。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。生而饮水。

string.ID: You have a great deal of nerve to speak to me after what you've done.

strings.string: 做了那种事之后，你还敢来和我说话，胆子真大。

string.ID:
You again?
It is only a matter of time until we are overtaken by hostile kendren. Your presence mocks our fate.

strings.string:
又是你？
我们被敌对肯德伦淹没只是时间问题。你的存在是在嘲弄我们的命运。

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 欣德族女族长，我找到了金德里什。

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Some help you are! Now our village lacks a warden.
How are we to protect ourselves?

strings.string:
你可真会帮忙！现在我们的村庄没有守卫了。
我们该如何保护自己？

string.ID: You will find a way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 你会找到办法的。生而饮水。

string.ID: Ah, welcome back to the village, =name=. You won't be staying long, will you?

strings.string: 啊，欢迎回到村庄，=name=。你不会待太久，对吧？

string.ID: No. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不会。生而饮水。

string.ID:
While I appreciate your help, kendren, I would prefer that you not stay longer than you must.
The faundren might get ideas.

strings.string:
虽然我感谢你的帮助，肯德伦，但我还是希望你不要停留得超过必要时间。
幼欣德伦可能会产生什么想法。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*The warden's gaze is distant.*}} Esk...

strings.string: {{emote|*守卫的目光遥远。*}} 埃斯克……

string.ID: *leave her be*

strings.string: *别打扰她*

string.ID: Follow the road =EskhindRoadDirection= to find the hollow tree where Esk and I used to play.

strings.string: 沿着 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的道路走，找到我和埃斯克过去玩耍的空心树。

string.ID: Thank you.

strings.string: 谢谢。

string.ID: {{emote|*The warden is lost in rumination.*}} It can't be. It simply can't be.

strings.string: {{emote|*守卫陷入反刍般的沉思。*}} 不可能。不可能的。

string.ID: Warden Neelahind?

strings.string: 守卫尼拉欣德？

string.ID: Kendren, do you... have any news of Eskhind, and Kindrish?

strings.string: 肯德伦，你……有埃斯欣德和金德里什的消息吗？

string.ID: Eskhind is dead.

strings.string: 埃斯欣德死了。
没有。

string.ID: Ah! Yes. My apologies, kendren. Live and drink. I am Neelahind, Warden of Bey Lah. How... may I help you?

strings.string: 啊！是。抱歉，肯德伦。生而饮水。我是尼拉欣德，贝拉的守卫。我……能帮你什么？

string.ID: Hindriarch Keh told me that you were once friends with Eskhind.

strings.string: 欣德族女族长凯告诉我，你曾经和埃斯欣德是朋友。

string.ID: I will return later.

strings.string: 我稍后再来。

string.ID:
We were... yes. We were close.
I can scarcely believe that she would be capable of doing such a thing. Stealing our greatest treasure? Eskhind wouldn't possibly... but if Grand-Doe says it, it must be so.

strings.string:
我们曾经……是的。我们很亲近。
我几乎无法相信她会做出这种事。偷走我们最伟大的宝物？埃斯欣德不可能……但如果大母鹿这么说，那一定是真的。

string.ID: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?

strings.string: 你知道埃斯欣德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.Friends with Eskhind.Hindriarch is lying?Choice.Text
string.ID: Is it possible that the Hindriarch is lying?

strings.string: 欣德族女族长有没有可能在撒谎？

string.ID: Wh—no! No! What? No, that's not possible! Ayvah, what an absurd idea!

strings.string: 什——不！不！什么？不，那不可能！艾瓦，多荒唐的想法！

string.ID: Why not?

strings.string: 为什么不可能？

string.ID: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?

strings.string: 你知道埃斯欣德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

string.ID:
Grand-Doe speaks only truth! Grand-Doe only ever speaks truth!
It's not possible. She didn't lie.

strings.string:
大母鹿只说真话！大母鹿从来只说真话！
不可能。她没有撒谎。

string.ID: Anyone can lie.

strings.string: 任何人都会撒谎。

string.ID: You ruminant people are impossible. I will find Eskhind myself.

strings.string: 你们这些反刍人真没法沟通。我会自己去找埃斯欣德。

string.ID:
No. It's not true, and I won't hear any more of your poisonous ideas, kendren. Consider the topic closed.
Do you actually have a question?

strings.string:
不。那不是真的，我不想再听你这些有毒的想法了，肯德伦。这个话题到此为止。
你到底有没有真正的问题？

string.ID: Do you know where Eskhind and her siblings might have gone?

strings.string: 你知道埃斯欣德和她的手足可能去了哪里吗？

string.ID: Forget it. I don't need your help.

strings.string: 算了。我不需要你的帮助。

string.ID:
Oh. Esk and I, we had a place... there's a path to the =EskhindRoadDirection= that leads to the remains of a lightning-struck tree, made hollow by the fire from above. It was the furthest from the village either of us had ever been, until I attended my first warden's moot.
She and I would spend time there, back then. Perhaps she is there now, but I don't dare check.

strings.string:
哦。埃斯克和我，我们有个地方……有一条通往 =EskhindRoadDirection= 的小路，会通到一棵遭雷击的树的残骸，来自天上的火把它烧成了空心。那是我们两人去过离村庄最远的地方，直到我参加第一次守卫会议为止。
那时候，她和我会在那里消磨时间。也许她现在就在那里，但我不敢去查看。

string.ID: I'll look there, thank you.

strings.string: 我会去那里看看，谢谢。

string.ID:
Oh.
Oh.
Did... you recover Kindrish?

strings.string:
哦。
哦。
你……取回金德里什了吗？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No. I'm sorry.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. She must have sold the artifact.

strings.string: 没有。她一定把神器卖了。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No. The Hindriarch lied to you.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. The Hindriarch lied to you.

strings.string: 没有。欣德族女族长骗了你。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No, this was for fun.Choice.Text
string.ID: No, this was for fun.

strings.string: 没有，这只是为了好玩。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.Eskhind is dead..No. I'm sorry.Choice2.Text
string.ID: No. I'm sorry.

strings.string: 没有。抱歉。

string.ID:
No... no, I can't... and the artifact is lost?
It was all for nothing... for nothing...

strings.string:
不……不，我不能……而且神器也丢了？
这一切都毫无意义……毫无意义……

string.ID: I will leave you to your grief. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我让你独自哀悼。生而饮水。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. The Hindriarch lied to you..Text
string.ID:
No, it can't be... how. This place. This accursed village!
This whole village be damned!

strings.string:
不，不可能……怎么会。这个地方。这个受诅咒的村庄！
这整座村庄都该被诅咒！

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. The Hindriarch lied to you..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: *back away slowly*

strings.string: *慢慢后退*

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No, this was for fun..Text
string.ID: You monster! You monster! How dare you!

strings.string: 你这个怪物！你这个怪物！你怎么敢！

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No, this was for fun..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: You're next.

strings.string: 下一个就是你。

string.ID:
Oh! Kendren, thank you, thank you! You've done so much for us. Here is a reward for your hard work.
Um, that said, there's still the matter of finding out who stole our treasure. It'd mean a great deal if you could still help with the resolution of the case.

strings.string:
哦！肯德伦，谢谢你，谢谢你！你为我们做了这么多。这是你辛劳的报酬。
呃，话虽如此，仍然要查明是谁偷走了我们的宝物。如果你还能帮助解决这桩案子，那会意义重大。

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink.

strings.string: 明白。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Wh-what's going on? Esk is here, a-and Grand-Doe seems very upset.
Would you please speak to her, kendren?

strings.string:
怎、怎么回事？埃斯克在这里，而、而且大母鹿看起来非常不安。
你能去和她谈谈吗，肯德伦？

string.ID: I will.

strings.string: 我会的。

string.ID: Wait, why... why is Esk here? What's going on? Do you have Kindrish?

strings.string: 等等，为什么……为什么埃斯克在这里？发生了什么？你拿到金德里什了吗？

string.ID: Yes, I do, but Eskhind didn't have it.

strings.string: 是的，我拿到了，但它不在埃斯欣德手里。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.Start2.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused.

strings.string: 没有。埃斯欣德声称自己遭到诬告。

string.ID: Ah, one moment...

strings.string: 啊，稍等……

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..Text
string.ID:
Oh.
But... what now?

strings.string:
哦。
可是……现在怎么办？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..You're the Warden. You tell me.Choice.Text
string.ID: You're the Warden. You tell me.

strings.string: 你是守卫。你告诉我。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..We will investigate and find the truth.Choice.Text
string.ID: We will investigate and find the truth.

strings.string: 我们会调查并找出真相。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.No. Eskhind claims to be wrongfully accused..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.

strings.string: 你真没用。我会查个水落石出。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..Text
string.ID:
I... I don't know. Grand-doe usually resolves Bey Lah's disputes. I am present to defuse violence, or keep the peace through the threat of it.
What do you think?

strings.string:
我……我不知道。贝拉的纠纷通常由大母鹿解决。我在场是为了化解暴力，或以暴力威慑来维持和平。
你怎么想？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..We will investigate and find the truth.Choice.Text
string.ID: We will investigate and find the truth.

strings.string: 我们会调查并找出真相。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.You're the Warden. You tell me..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: You are useless. I'll get to the bottom of this.

strings.string: 你真没用。我会查个水落石出。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..Text
string.ID:
Oh. Well, yes, that's... that's a good idea. You'll help, right? My axe-arm and conviction are strong, but deduction has never been my greatest strength.
I can answer questions about the people in town, if that would be helpful.

strings.string:
哦。嗯，是的，那……那是个好主意。你会帮忙，对吧？我的持斧之臂和信念都很强，但推理从来不是我最擅长的事。
如果有帮助，我可以回答关于镇上居民的问题。

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..Questioning NeelahindChoice.Text
string.ID: It would. Could you answer some questions now?

strings.string: 会有帮助。你现在能回答几个问题吗？

string.Context: Conversation Neelahind.We will investigate and find the truth..EndChoice.Text
string.ID: I will return when I have questions... or an accusation.

strings.string: 等我有问题……或者有指控时，我会回来。

string.ID:
Ah, =name=, live and drink!
Has your investigation reached a conclusion? Our fate is in your hands.

strings.string:
啊，=name=，生而饮水！
你的调查有结论了吗？我们的命运在你手中。

string.ID: Not yet. How are you and Eskhind?

strings.string: 还没有。你和埃斯欣德怎么样？

string.ID: Warden, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 守卫，我找到了金德里什。

string.ID: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.

strings.string: 是的，我准备好指控窃贼了。

string.ID: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 还没有。我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.

strings.string: 没有，我还没有足够证据。

string.ID:
Oh, =name=! I'm so happy!
I can scarcely believe she loves me, much less that... that we could be together. But it's true. Wherever we go from now on, we go together.

strings.string:
哦，=name=！我太高兴了！
我几乎不敢相信她爱我，更不敢相信……我们可以在一起。但这是真的。从今以后，无论去哪里，我们都一起去。

string.ID: May your journeys favor you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 愿旅途眷顾你们。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Oh dear, a mystery.
Perhaps I should have accepted Angohind's lessons after all.

strings.string:
哎呀，一桩谜案。
也许我当初终究该接受安戈欣德的课程。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

string.ID: May I ask some questions about the suspects?

strings.string: 我可以问些关于嫌疑人的问题吗？

string.ID: Patience, Warden. I'll get to the bottom of this.

strings.string: 耐心些，守卫。我会查个水落石出。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren. Have you... come to a conclusion?

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。你……得出结论了吗？

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

string.ID: Yes, I am ready to accuse the thief.

strings.string: 是的，我准备好指控窃贼了。

string.ID: Not yet. May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 还没有。我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: No, I do not have enough evidence yet.

strings.string: 没有，我还没有足够证据。

string.ID: I see. What is it?

strings.string: 我明白了。是什么？

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我发现一片被鲜血染红的水藤，这是近期暴力事件的迹象。

string.ID: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.

strings.string: 我还不是完全确定。让我再想想。

string.ID: Signs of =circumstance.influence=, seemingly hidden from the village. But that can't be your only evidence, can it? There's no culprit!

strings.string: =circumstance.influence= 的迹象，似乎被瞒过了村庄。但那不可能是你唯一的证据，对吧？还没有罪犯！

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我发现一片被鲜血染红的水藤，这是近期暴力事件的迹象。

string.ID: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.

strings.string: 我还不是完全确定。让我再想想。

string.ID: I'm afraid that well is poisoned due to your false accusation: =thief.name|strip= isn't the culprit.

strings.string: 恐怕这条线已经被你的错误指控污染了：=thief.name|strip= 不是罪犯。

string.ID: Hmm. But the only fur there was from a hindren's pelt, and kendren warriors fight to the death. With no corpse and no other fur, it seems unlikely that a hindren fought an outsider.

strings.string: 嗯。但那里唯一的毛来自欣德伦的毛皮，而肯德伦战士会战至死。既没有尸体，也没有其他毛发，欣德伦与外人交战的可能性似乎很低。

string.ID: I'm afraid that makes no sense. Why would an outsider invite a trader to our village, when they could simply meet one outside of Bey Lah?

strings.string: 恐怕这说不通。一个外人明明可以在贝拉外面见商人，为什么还要邀请商人到我们的村庄里来？

string.ID: But weren't the rumors of sore throats in the village? That wouldn't have anything to do with kendren.

strings.string: 但喉咙痛的传闻不是在村里吗？那和肯德伦没有关系。

string.ID: Why wouldn't an outsider bring their own leather? It would better disguise Kindrish. It seems a lot of work to find and raid our leather stores.

strings.string: 外人为什么不带自己的皮革？那样更能伪装金德里什。寻找并洗劫我们的皮革储藏处，未免太费工夫。

string.ID: Bracers are a Bey Lah craft! It would make no sense for a kendren to have one, then throw it away in the village.

strings.string: 护腕是贝拉工艺！肯德伦拥有一只护腕，又把它丢在村里，这毫无道理。

string.ID: Kesehind wields Ari, a battleaxe handed down through generations. It cannot break, and if it broke a weapon there would be scorch marks on it. This evidence does not hold up.

strings.string: 凯瑟欣德挥舞的是阿里，一把世代相传的战斧。它不会断裂，而且如果它打断了武器，那武器上会有焦痕。这项证据站不住脚。

string.ID: There are few voices as low as Kesehind's in our village. Witnesses report a higher-pitched voice, don't they? They would know if Kesehind were speaking.

strings.string: 我们村里很少有声音像凯瑟欣德那样低沉。目击者报告的是更尖的声音，不是吗？如果说话的是凯瑟欣德，他们会知道的。

string.ID: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.

strings.string: 哦，不，那不会是凯瑟欣德。他宁愿发烧而死，也不会强咽下一根恶心麦茎。

string.ID: Oh, no, that wouldn't be Kesehind. He'd sooner die of fever than choke down a single stem of yuckwheat.

strings.string: 哦，不，那不会是凯瑟欣德。他宁愿发烧而死，也不会强咽下一根恶心麦茎。

string.ID: That would be nigh unto impossible for Kesehind. He cannot perform fine tasks by torchlight; his night vision is too poor.

strings.string: 这对凯瑟欣德来说几乎不可能。他无法在火炬光下做精细活；他的夜视太差。

string.ID: No, that can't be it. Eskhind hates everything about watervine and keeps a wide berth from it. If her blood was spilled, it would have happened nearer to the path.

strings.string: 不，不可能是这样。埃斯欣德厌恶水藤的一切，并且总是远远避开。如果她流了血，那也会发生在更靠近道路的地方。

string.ID: No, no. Eskhind makes the most of what few possessions she keeps, and if she traded a treasure for so much water, she'd never have lost track of any.

strings.string: 不，不。埃斯欣德会充分利用自己保有的少数财物，如果她用宝物换了这么多水，就绝不会忘记其中任何一袋的去向。

string.ID: Oh, no, Eskhind is deathly afraid of saltbacks. She would never get close enough to trade with a dromad merchent.

strings.string: 哦，不，埃斯欣德极度害怕盐背。她绝不会靠近到足以和卓玛德商人交易。

string.ID: I doubt it. If Eskhind were sick, the last place she would stumble to evacuate her guts would be a watervine field.

strings.string: 我怀疑不是。如果埃斯欣德生病了，她最不可能跌跌撞撞跑去排空肠胃的地方就是水藤田。

string.ID: I'm afraid that Eskhind has no idea how to use proper leatherworking tools, much less pay for a set so fine. This surely isn't hers.

strings.string: 恐怕埃斯欣德根本不知道如何使用正规的皮革工具，更别说花钱买这么精良的一套。这肯定不是她的。

string.ID: I know the rumor you mean, but villagers heard the clash of weapons. Keh is too old for a prolonged fight like that, so I do not believe it was her.

strings.string: 我知道你说的是哪条传闻，但村民听见的是武器交击声。凯年纪太大，打不了那种持久战，所以我不认为是她。

string.ID: Grand-Doe cannot swim, and panics even near the shallow pools of our paddies. I cannot imagine she would make splashing noises without adding screaming noises to them.

strings.string: 大母鹿不会游泳，甚至靠近我们稻田里的浅池都会惊慌。我无法想象她会弄出泼水声却不同时发出尖叫声。

string.ID: Copper causes Grand-Doe to break out in great welts. She would not have traded for it, and if she saw a trader drop it, surely she would have told them to pick it up. She hates mess.

strings.string: 铜会让大母鹿起大片肿痕。她不会为了铜而交易，如果她看见商人掉下铜，肯定会让对方捡起来。她讨厌杂乱。

string.ID: I cannot bring myself to believe that Grand-Doe would allow anyone to stumble upon her own severed tongue. She would surely burn it as soon as she saw it.

strings.string: 我无法相信大母鹿会让任何人偶然发现她自己被割下的舌头。她一看见它，肯定会立刻烧掉。

string.ID: No, Grand-Doe is absolutely meticulous about work clutter. She wouldn't leave scraps lying about.

strings.string: 不，大母鹿对工作杂物极其讲究。她不会把碎料随地乱放。
啊。

string.ID:
Oh. Yes, this does indicate that some kind of =motive.influence= transpired, and =thief.name|strip= was trying to hide it.
So what you're saying is....

strings.string:
哦。是的，这确实表明发生过某种 =motive.influence=，而 =thief.name|strip= 试图掩盖它。
所以你的意思是……

string.ID: That's right. By concealing =all.influence=, it was =thief.name|strip= who stole Kindrish!

strings.string: 没错。通过隐瞒 =all.influence=，偷走金德里什的人正是 =thief.name|strip=！

string.ID: I'm still not completely certain. Let me ponder it more.

strings.string: 我还不是完全确定。让我再想想。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear. In violation of sacred law and the will of her people, Eskhind stole the artifact called Kindrish from Bey Lah. She will be stripped of honor, stripped of water, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will her name be spoken here again, and she will never return... on pain of death.
And I... I will go with her. May my property be payment for the harm she has done to our people, and I will gladly pay it for the privilege of walking by her side.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind is free to go, and I'm... I'm going with her. I cannot serve under Hindriarch Keh while my beloved returns to exile.
I have no doubt that Bey Lah will thrive in my absence as it did before I became warden. Live and drink, my kin. Long may Hindriarch Keh lead you.

strings.string:
证据清楚：埃斯欣德没有偷走金德里什。事实上，我相信没有任何欣德伦对它的失窃负责，而是某个早在调查者到来之前就穿过我们边界的肯德伦所为。他们任何一个都可能犯下盗窃。
埃斯欣德可以自由离开，而我……我会和她一起走。当我的挚爱重返流放时，我无法继续在欣德族女族长凯麾下效劳。
我毫不怀疑，贝拉会像我成为守卫之前那样，在我缺席时继续兴盛。生而饮水，我的亲族。愿欣德族女族长凯长久引领你们。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. In fact, I believe that no hindren was responsible for its theft, but rather one of the kendren who permeated our borders well before our investigator arrived. Any of them could have committed the theft.
Eskhind helped us cleave to the path of justice. She is free to go, and her name will not be forgotten, but she must remain in exile.
Just is the leadership of Hindriarch Keh. Long may she live!

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Eskhind did not steal Kindrish. The crime was committed by none other than Grand-Doe's protector, Kesehind. He will be stripped of the ancestral axe he carries, stripped of his property, and stripped from our oral histories. Never will his name be spoken here again, and he will never return... on pain of death.
Moreover... Keh's attempt to pin blame on Eskhind without due process opened my eyes to her abuses of power. She need not leave Bey Lah, but she is Keh-hind once more-- stripped of her title and standing.
As for the hindriarchy, Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:
证据清楚：埃斯欣德没有偷走金德里什。犯下罪行的不是别人，正是大母鹿的保护者凯瑟欣德。他将被剥夺所持的祖传斧，剥夺财产，并从我们的口述史中剥除。他的名字永远不会再在这里被提起，他也永远不得回来……违者处死。
此外……凯未经正当程序便试图将罪责推给埃斯欣德，这让我看清了她对权力的滥用。她不必离开贝拉，但她重新只是凯欣德——被剥夺头衔和地位。
至于欣德女族长之位，埃斯欣德将担任临时领袖，直到我们作为一个族群弄清下一步该怎么做。愿欣德族女族长埃斯克带领我们走向更明亮的未来！

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.
With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:
证据清楚：贝拉自己的欣德族女族长背叛了她的族人。她把我们的祖传宝物据为己有，把罪行推到一名她明知无法自辩的流放者身上。因这项背叛，她在此被剥夺头衔，剥夺财产，剥夺家园。
随着凯欣德被流放，欣德女族长之位空缺，且没有合适的长者可以继任。埃斯欣德将担任临时领袖，直到我们作为一个族群弄清下一步该怎么做。愿欣德族女族长埃斯克带领我们走向更明亮的未来！

随着凯欣德被流放，欣德女族长之位空缺，且没有合适的长者可以继任。埃斯欣德将担任临时领袖，直到我们作为一个族群弄清下一步该怎么做。愿欣德族女族长埃斯克带领我们走向更明亮的未来！

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.
With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. May Hindriarch Esk lead us to a brighter future!

strings.string:

证据清楚：贝拉自己的欣德族女族长背叛了她的族人。她把我们的祖传宝物据为己有，把罪行推到一名她明知无法自辩的流放者身上。因这项背叛，她在此被剥夺头衔，剥夺财产，剥夺家园。
