With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people. It will be a challenge to accept change, but we will be stronger for it.

strings.string:
证据清楚：贝拉自己的欣德族女族长背叛了她的族人。她把我们的祖传宝物据为己有，把罪行推到一名她明知无法自辩的流放者身上。因这项背叛，她在此被剥夺头衔，剥夺财产，剥夺家园。
随着凯欣德被流放，欣德女族长之位空缺，且没有合适的长者可以继任。埃斯欣德将担任临时领袖，直到我们作为一个族群弄清下一步该怎么做。接受改变会是一项挑战，但我们会因此更加强大。

string.ID:
The evidence is clear: Bey Lah's own Hindriarch has betrayed her people. She took our ancestral treasure as her own, pinning the crime on an exile she knew could not defend herself. For this treason, she is hereby stripped of title, stripped of property, stripped of home.
With the exile of Keh-Hind, the hindriarchy lies vacant, with no elders fit to take it. Eskhind will act as an interim leader until we figure out what to do next, as a people.
I fear dark times ahead. We must remain strong in the coming days.

strings.string:
证据清楚：贝拉自己的欣德族女族长背叛了她的族人。她把我们的祖传宝物据为己有，把罪行推到一名她明知无法自辩的流放者身上。因这项背叛，她在此被剥夺头衔，剥夺财产，剥夺家园。
随着凯欣德被流放，欣德女族长之位空缺，且没有合适的长者可以继任。埃斯欣德将担任临时领袖，直到我们作为一个族群弄清下一步该怎么做。
我担心前方会有黑暗时日。接下来的日子里，我们必须保持坚强。

string.ID: My job here is done. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我在这里的事完成了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
For me? Are you sure?
But... this is a poem. In Esk's handwriting. Are you s-sure this is for me?

strings.string:
给我的？你确定吗？
可是……这是一首诗。是埃斯克的笔迹。你、你确定这是给我的？

string.ID: Yes. Please read it.

strings.string: 是的。请读一读。

string.ID: Perhaps I'm mistaken. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许是我弄错了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Oh.
Ayvah, she-- Eskhind wrote this about... me? How my head swims at these lavish words. If she wrote this and meant it for me, she must... love me.
But it can't be. Can it?

strings.string:
哦。
艾瓦，她——埃斯欣德写的是……我？这些华美的词句让我头晕目眩。如果她写下这些，并且是写给我的，她一定……爱我。
但这不可能。可能吗？

string.ID: Can't it?

strings.string: 不可能吗？

string.ID: It is. Live and drink.

strings.string: 是真的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kendren, you must understand. I spent so many years trying in vain to fall out of love with Eskhind. I thought it the only way to endure our adolescence, watching her poor attempts at courtship with other hindren.
I thought it the only way to endure her departure, as well. But she is returned, and she loves me. Ayvah. I am terrified to speak to her of this, but I must.
Thank you.

strings.string:
肯德伦，你必须明白。我花了许多年徒劳地试图不再爱埃斯欣德。我以为这是忍受我们青春岁月的唯一办法，看着她笨拙地试图追求其他欣德伦。
我也以为这是忍受她离开的唯一办法。但她回来了，而且她爱我。艾瓦。我害怕极了，不敢和她谈这件事，但我必须谈。
谢谢你。

string.ID: Will this affect the investigation?

strings.string: 这会影响调查吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, Neelahind.

strings.string: 生而饮水，尼拉欣德。

string.ID:
No. You are the one investigating, so my bias need not enter play. If you determine that Eskhind is guilty, I will heed your word and carry out a just sentence.
After that, I'm not sure.

strings.string:
不会。调查的人是你，所以我的偏见不必参与其中。如果你判定埃斯欣德有罪，我会听从你的话，执行公正的判决。
至于之后，我不确定。

string.ID: In that case, I have further questions.

strings.string: 既然如此，我还有更多问题。

string.ID: Of course, kendren. Ask away.

strings.string: 当然，肯德伦。尽管问。

string.ID: What can you tell me about Hindriarch Keh?

strings.string: 你能告诉我欣德族女族长凯的事吗？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Eskhind?

strings.string: 你能告诉我埃斯欣德的事吗？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Kesehind?

strings.string: 你能告诉我凯瑟欣德的事吗？

string.ID: What do you know about the outsiders? The kendren?

strings.string: 你知道外来者的事吗？肯德伦？

string.ID: I should return to my investigation. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该回去调查了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Keh is very wise and very careful, which makes up for her lack of strength or... tact. She always knows what's right, and she runs a very tight shift.
She hates clutter from work like nothing else and cleans up any mess she makes--unless it's a spill, then she makes Kesehind do it. It's because Grand-Doe has a terrible fear of standing pools of water, refusing to touch them. Copper and bronze afflict her with allergy-sores and she can't touch them. She's too old to spar with me, but her bow-arm still aims true.
That's all I can think of.

strings.string:
凯非常睿智，也非常谨慎，这弥补了她力量上的不足，或者说……圆融上的不足。她总是知道什么是正确的，也把值守安排得极其严密。
她最讨厌工作留下的杂乱，会清理自己制造的一切脏乱——除非是洒出的液体，那时她会让凯瑟欣德去做。因为大母鹿非常害怕静止的水池，拒绝触碰它们。铜和青铜会让她起过敏疮，所以她碰不得。她年纪太大，不能和我对练，但她的持弓之臂仍然瞄得很准。
我能想到的就这些。

string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以，我还有一个问题。

string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢，这就够了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Oh. She's, well, she's a good person with strong convictions, or has always seemed so. I suppose that isn't helpful.
Esk has a good eye for detail. She hates watervine so much that she avoids the paddies and won't eat matz without lah broth to make it taste better. Umm, she's afraid of saltbacks. She's good at foraging and terrible at crafting.
I've missed her so much.

strings.string:
哦。她，嗯，她是个信念坚定的好人，或者一直看起来如此。我想这没什么帮助。
埃斯克很善于注意细节。她讨厌水藤到会避开水田，没有拉汤调味就不肯吃马茨。呃，她害怕盐背。她擅长采集，手工制作却糟透了。
我太想念她了。

string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以，我还有一个问题。

string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢，这就够了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kesehind is completely loyal to Grand-Doe. We used to be friends, but his disposition has become so sour since he was appointed her protector, and he's quite cold to me now. He can't see well in darkness. He's the holder of Ari, an unbreakable heirloom fire axe, and he's very skilled with it.
He's terribly finicky about food. He'll only eat bland food and meat, and... oh! Once, when he had a bad cough as a faundren, a caretaker tried to feed him yuckwheat, and he kicked her so hard it dislocated her jaw. Poor Elder Eselhind.

strings.string:
凯瑟欣德完全忠于大母鹿。我们过去是朋友，但自从他被任命为她的保护者后，性情变得很阴郁，现在对我也相当冷淡。他在黑暗中看不清。他持有阿里，那是一把不可摧毁的传家火斧，他也非常擅长使用它。
他对食物极其挑剔。他只吃清淡食物和肉，而且……哦！有一次，他还是幼欣德伦、咳嗽得很厉害时，一名照料者试图喂他恶心麦，他一脚踢得她下巴脱臼。可怜的埃塞尔欣德长老。

string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以，我还有一个问题。

string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢，这就够了。生而饮水。

string.ID: Oh, not very much. The only kendren who were allowed in the village before you are traders, and it's always a very big fuss when one comes by. It's been a while since that happened, though, so any kendren who have visited must have come in secret.

strings.string: 哦，不多。在你之前，唯一被允许进入村庄的肯德伦是商人，而且每次有商人来都会闹出很大阵仗。不过那已经有一阵子没发生了，所以任何来访过的肯德伦都必定是秘密进来的。

string.ID: I have another question, if you please.

strings.string: 如果可以，我还有一个问题。

string.ID: Thank you, that will do. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢，这就够了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Live and drink, kendren.
Please forgive me; I am grateful that you opened my eyes, but the sight of you is yet a bitter leaf. Let me grieve my people in peace.

strings.string:
生而饮水，肯德伦。
请原谅我；我感激你让我睁开眼睛，但看见你仍像一片苦叶。让我平静地哀悼我的族人吧。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: My condolences.

strings.string: 请节哀。

string.ID:
You've found our treasure? Thank you, kendren!
Please take this reward, we set it aside for just this purpose. I apologize if it's too little. Thank you so much, again.

strings.string:
你找到了我们的宝物？谢谢你，肯德伦！
请收下这份报酬，我们正是为此留出的。如果太少，我很抱歉。再次非常感谢你。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID: There's a fear deep in my breast, kendren. What's to become of Bey Lah?

strings.string: 我胸中深处有一种恐惧，肯德伦。贝拉会变成什么样？

string.ID: Warden, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 守卫，我找到了金德里什。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kendren! I mean, =name=! My heart sings to see you.
Thank you for clearing Esk's name. Thank you for bringing us together. You are always welcome here.

strings.string:
肯德伦！我是说，=name=！见到你，我的心在歌唱。
谢谢你洗清埃斯克的名字。谢谢你让我们走到一起。这里永远欢迎你。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客气。生而饮水。

string.ID: Ah! Kendren! =name=! I'm so happy! Live and drink.

strings.string: 啊！肯德伦！=name=！我太高兴了！生而饮水。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID: =name=, it is good to see you. Rest and sup before you move on.

strings.string: =name=，很高兴见到你。继续上路前，先休息并进些食吧。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

string.ID: Live and drink, warden.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守卫。

string.ID:
Kendren, thank you for clearing Esk's name!
You're so decisive. I wish I had that strength.

strings.string:
肯德伦，谢谢你洗清埃斯克的名字！
你如此果断。我希望自己也有那样的力量。

string.ID: I believe this poem was meant for you.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是写给你的。

string.ID:
Oh! Is this what... Esk!
I could have gone years unknowing that my love for her was returned. But this is her script, and these words describe me.
Ayvah, I have to speak to her! Thank you so much, kendren.

strings.string:
哦！这是……埃斯克！
我本可能许多年都不知道，我对她的爱也得到了回应。但这是她的笔迹，而这些词写的是我。
艾瓦，我必须去和她谈谈！非常感谢你，肯德伦。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客气。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Thank you again for opening my eyes, kendren.
I have trouble smiling for my grief, my loss. Nonetheless, Eskhind and I have a brighter future because of you, and we are together. The road is hazardous, but we will walk it in time.

strings.string:
再次感谢你让我睁开眼睛，肯德伦。
因我的悲伤与失去，我很难微笑。尽管如此，因为你，埃斯欣德和我有了更明亮的未来，而且我们在一起。道路危险，但我们终会走下去。

string.ID: My condolences. Live and drink.

strings.string: 请节哀。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kendren...
I have so much anger at what has been done, but you opened my eyes. Thank you.

strings.string:
肯德伦……
对已经发生的一切，我心中有太多愤怒，但你让我睁开了眼睛。谢谢你。

string.ID: Ah, =name=. The sight of you is yet a bitter leaf, but you are welcome here.

strings.string: 啊，=name=。看见你仍像一片苦叶，但这里欢迎你。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID:
Kendren.
Forgive me for seeming ungrateful. I am more affected by Esk's return and departure than I knew. Please give me space.

strings.string:
肯德伦。
请原谅我显得不知感恩。埃斯克的归来与离去对我的影响，比我自己意识到的还要深。请给我一点空间。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID:
What is this?
Poetry. In the exile's handwriting. Extolling love for... me, or someone very like me.
Is... is this a cruel joke? This cannot be real.

strings.string:
这是什么？
诗。是那名流放者的笔迹。赞颂对……我，或某个很像我的人的爱。
这……这是残酷的玩笑吗？这不可能是真的。

string.ID: It is real. Take the poem.

strings.string: 这是真的。收下这首诗吧。

string.ID: I must be mistaken. Live and drink.

strings.string: 一定是我弄错了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
She loved me.
She loved me and I ... I exiled her. Oh, my heart.
Kendren I, I am grateful that you have opened my eyes to the truth, but how dearly I wish you had intervened earlier. This poem serves only as a harsh reminder that I must give up everything for my duty.
Please. Please leave me be. My heart... Esk, my heart...

strings.string:
她爱我。
她爱我，而我……我流放了她。哦，我的心。
肯德伦，我、我感激你让我看见真相，但我多么希望你能更早介入。这首诗只是一种严酷的提醒：我必须为了职责放弃一切。
求你。请别管我。我的心……埃斯克，我的心……

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID:
I must admit, =name=, that I can think of few notions more challenging to my people than to welcome a flower-people into our town. Some will see them as no better than walking lah.
But if the notion came from you, they might consider putting it to a vote, at least. If you'll stand by, I will call a referendum.

strings.string:
我必须承认，=name=，对我的族人来说，没几个想法会比欢迎花之民进入我们的镇子更具挑战。有些人会把他们看得不比会走路的拉好多少。
但如果这个想法来自你，他们至少可能会考虑把它付诸投票。如果你愿意稍候，我会召集一次公投。

string.ID: Please do.

strings.string: 请这么做。

string.ID:
I'll have Warden Neelahind gather everyone as soon as they can spare the eyes and ears for it.
{{emote|*Hindriarch Esk canters away, voice already raised.*}} Hey, Warden!

strings.string:
我会让守卫尼拉欣德在大家一有余裕来听来看时，就把所有人召集起来。
{{emote|*欣德族女族长埃斯克小跑离去，声音已经扬起。*}} 嘿，守卫！

string.ID: {{emote|The moments pass in hundreds, filled with dust and noise. Voices rise, hooves stamp the packed earth, and a fledgling democratic process takes its first faltering steps.}}

strings.string: {{emote|数百个瞬间流逝，满是尘土与喧声。声音扬起，蹄子踏响夯实的土地，一场初生的民主进程迈出最初踉跄的步伐。}}

string.ID: Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?

strings.string: 站住！你是谁？想要什么？

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我这就走。

string.ID: Hold there! Who are you? What do you want?

strings.string: 站住！你是谁？想要什么？

string.ID: I am =name=. Hindriarch Keh sent me.

strings.string: 我是 =name=。欣德族女族长凯派我来的。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Start2.Give back what you stole.Choice.Text
string.ID: I am justice. Give back what you stole.

strings.string: 我是正义。把你偷的东西还回来。

string.ID: I am your worst nightmare. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 我是你最可怕的噩梦。准备受死。

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 没什么。生而饮水。

string.ID: Keh? I'm shocked that she even deigned to speak my name. I am a pariah now, beneath discussion. Does she demand remuneration for the scant supplies I stole?

strings.string: 凯？我很惊讶她竟然屈尊提起我的名字。我现在是弃民，不值得议论。她是要我为自己偷走的那点微薄补给赔偿吗？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Hindriarch Keh sent me..You stole Kindrish.Choice.Text
string.ID: She says that you stole Kindrish, the village's treasure.

strings.string: 她说你偷走了村庄的宝物金德里什。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Give back what you stole..Text
string.ID: What I stole? I stole supplies to sustain myself and my sisters, nothing more, and little enough that no one would suffer for its absence. You would cut those from my hide?

strings.string: 我偷的东西？我偷的是维持我和姐妹们生存的补给，仅此而已，而且少到不会有人因它们缺失而受苦。你要从我皮上割下那些东西吗？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Give back what you stole..You stole Kindrish.Choice.Text
string.ID: No. You stole the treasure called Kindrish.

strings.string: 不。你偷走了名为金德里什的宝物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Eskhind bursts into forced, nervous laughter*}}
Is that her angle? To claim that I stole Kindrish? Her influence must be waning more than even I knew.

strings.string:
{{emote|*埃斯欣德爆发出勉强而紧张的笑声*}}
这就是她的手法？声称我偷了金德里什？她的影响力一定衰退得比我知道的还厉害。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..What are you saying?Choice.Text
string.ID: What are you saying?

strings.string: 你在说什么？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..You claim innocence?Choice.Text
string.ID: You claim innocence?

strings.string: 你声称自己无罪？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You stole Kindrish..I suspected this.Choice.Text
string.ID: A frame-up. I suspected this.

strings.string: 栽赃。我早有怀疑。

string.ID:
What do you imagine I am saying? The aging, ineffectual leader of a village in isolation. A system that strives to forget anyone who sees the outside, no matter how much its inhabitants strive for a better tomorrow.
Bey Lah's isolationism provides ideal patsies for any crime the Hindriarch chooses to commit.

strings.string:
你以为我在说什么？一座孤立村庄里年迈而无能的领袖。一个努力遗忘任何见过外界之人的制度，无论其中居民如何渴望更好的明天。
贝拉的孤立主义为欣德族女族长想犯的任何罪行提供了理想替罪羊。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你认为凯偷了宝物？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

strings.string: 我为什么要相信你？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.What are you saying?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What do you expect me to do, then?

strings.string: 那你希望我怎么做？

string.ID:
Yes. I am falsely accused.
See, Bey Lah strives to forget anyone who sees the outside. The gerontocracy ensures that its leaders will always be aging and fearful. Pariahs like me can be easily accused of crimes committed by Keh or her cronies.

strings.string:
是的。我遭到了诬告。
你看，贝拉努力遗忘任何见过外界的人。长老统治确保它的领袖永远年迈而恐惧。像我这样的弃民，很容易被指控犯下凯或她爪牙所犯的罪。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你认为凯偷了宝物？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

strings.string: 我为什么要相信你？

string.ID: Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.

strings.string: 谎言。你想操纵我。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You claim innocence?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What do you expect me to do, then?

strings.string: 那你希望我怎么做？

string.ID:
Well, good. I would give you a prize for your insight, but times have been lean.
As you say, the Hindriarch is obviously framing me. As a pariah, I am an ideal patsy for Keh. Much as I love my people, they are weak of will and do not question the Grand-Doe.

strings.string:
嗯，很好。我本该因你的洞察给你奖赏，但时日清苦。
正如你所说，欣德族女族长显然在栽赃我。作为弃民，我是凯理想的替罪羊。尽管我深爱自己的族人，他们意志薄弱，不会质疑大母鹿。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..You think Keh stole the treasure?Choice.Text
string.ID: You really think Keh stole the treasure?

strings.string: 你真的认为凯偷了宝物？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..Why should I believe you?Choice.Text
string.ID: Why should I believe you?

strings.string: 我为什么要相信你？

string.ID: Lies. You are trying to manipulate me.

strings.string: 谎言。你想操纵我。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What can be done, then?

strings.string: 那还能做什么？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.I suspected this..Eskhind is rudeChoice.Text
string.ID: You didn't need to be rude about it.

strings.string: 你没必要说得这么无礼。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.Text
string.ID:
Ay, you kendren are just as thick as the elders. I'd hoped otherwise.
Yes, I am suggesting that old Grand-Doe is trying to fool you, and the village as well. I'm not certain that she stole it herself, but an investigation might undermine her authority, and she cannot have that.

strings.string:
唉，你们肯德伦和长老一样迟钝。我还盼着不是这样。
是的，我是在暗示老大母鹿试图愚弄你，也愚弄整个村庄。我不确定是不是她亲自偷的，但调查可能削弱她的权威，而她不能容忍这种事。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What should I do, then?

strings.string: 那我该怎么做？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.You think Keh stole the treasure?.Eskhind is rudeChoice.Text
string.ID: You don't need to be so rude.

strings.string: 你没必要这么无礼。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Why should I believe you?.Text
string.ID:
Why should you believe me? Well, why should you believe Keh? Ayvah, think about this!
I'm not asking you to give me your unconditional trust, understand? Only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable? Is that not just?

strings.string:
你为什么要相信我？好吧，那你为什么要相信凯？艾瓦，想想这件事！
我不是要你无条件信任我，明白吗？只是要你给我和给凯同等程度的信任。这不合理吗？这不公正吗？

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Why should I believe you?.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What are you suggesting I do?

strings.string: 你建议我怎么做？

string.ID:
Ayvah. I'd wanted Grand-Doe to be wrong about you kendren, but perhaps you are all violent fools after all.
I'm not asking you to trust me, only to extend to me the same level of trust you give Keh. Is that not reasonable?

strings.string:
艾瓦。我本希望大母鹿对你们肯德伦的看法是错的，但也许你们终究全是暴力傻瓜。
我不是要你信任我，只是要你给我和给凯同等程度的信任。这不合理吗？

string.ID: What are you suggesting I do?

strings.string: 你建议我怎么做？

string.ID: You don't need to be so rude.

strings.string: 你没必要这么无礼。

string.ID: You've wasted enough of my time. Prepare to die.

strings.string: 你已经浪费我够多时间了。准备受死。

string.ID:
Rude? How dare--
No, I... I apologize for my rudeness. Please understand that we have lost so much by leaving Bey Lah. My mind is not in a gentle place, and being revisited by the tyranny I left behind is causing newly-closed wounds to open.
Forgive my tone, but please understand: I did not steal Kindrish. You are being used.

strings.string:
无礼？你怎么敢——
不，我……我为自己的无礼道歉。请理解，我们离开贝拉已经失去了太多。我的心境并不柔和，而我离开的暴政如今又来纠缠，让刚刚闭合的伤口重新裂开。
原谅我的语气，但请明白：我没有偷金德里什。你正在被利用。

string.Context: Conversation Eskhind.Eskhind is rude.What should I do?Choice.Text
string.ID: What should I do?

strings.string: 我该怎么做？

string.ID:
The proof is in the petals, kendren. You want justice? Find out what really happened.
If you find evidence, Warden Neelahind will support you. Speak to her. She is loyal to Grand-Doe, but more loyal to the truth.
I will return to the village and we will sort this out. The Hindriarch will have to tolerate my presence until my name is cleared.

strings.string:
证明就在花瓣里，肯德伦。你想要正义？那就查明真正发生了什么。
如果你找到证据，守卫尼拉欣德会支持你。去和她谈谈。她忠于大母鹿，但更忠于真相。
我会回到村庄，我们会把这事理清。在洗清我的名字之前，欣德族女族长必须容忍我的存在。

string.ID: I'll look into this, but you'd better not go missing.

strings.string: 我会调查这件事，但你最好别失踪。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会的。生而饮水。

string.ID: Go tell Keh that I will remain in Bey Lah until this is sorted.

strings.string: 去告诉凯，在事情理清之前，我会留在贝拉。

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好。生而饮水。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月与日，=name=。

string.ID: How are things with Neelahind?

strings.string: 你和尼拉欣德怎么样？

string.ID: I have questions for you.

strings.string: 我有问题要问你。

string.ID: Wisdom and Will, Eskhind.

strings.string: 智慧与意志，埃斯欣德。

string.ID:
Things are good. Better than I dreamed. I owe you so much for your intervention, =name=.
I still can't quite believe that my feelings are requited. I am at once elated and terrified. But this is good. My future is brighter now.
Thank you.

strings.string:
一切都好。比我梦见的还要好。你的介入让我欠你太多，=name=。
我仍不太敢相信自己的感情得到了回应。我既欣喜若狂，又恐惧不安。但这很好。我的未来如今更明亮了。
谢谢你。

string.ID: May it brighten even further. Live and drink.

strings.string: 愿它更加明亮。生而饮水。

string.ID: What is it, kendren?

strings.string: 什么事，肯德伦？

string.ID: I have questions for you.

strings.string: 我有问题要问你。

string.ID: Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?

strings.string: 这张皱巴巴的纸是你的吗？

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 没什么。生而饮水。

string.ID: Ask away.

strings.string: 尽管问。

string.ID: Does this crumpled sheet of paper belong to you?

strings.string: 这张皱巴巴的纸是你的吗？

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你为什么离开贝拉？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 谁可能偷了金德里什？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我该寻找什么证据？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和守卫曾经很亲近，对吧？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德族女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪里？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时没有了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Why? Why did I leave a single parasang square piece of land upon which I was expected to live my entire life, forever obeying a woman whose sole qualification of rule is her gender and age? Why did I leave a place where we eat the same damned soup for nine out of ten meals and the height of occupational versatility is leatherworking?
The question isn't why I left, it's why I'm the only one who chose to do so, why none of my pleas were convincing to the hindren I love. If we would just open the borders, it would never have come to this.

strings.string:
为什么？我为什么要离开一块方圆不过一帕拉桑、却被期望终生居住其上的土地，永远服从一个唯一统治资格只是性别和年龄的女人？我为什么要离开一个十顿饭里有九顿都吃同一种该死汤、职业多样性的顶峰就是皮革加工的地方？
问题不是我为什么离开，而是为什么我是唯一选择离开的人，为什么我的恳求没有一个能说服我所爱的欣德伦。如果我们愿意开放边界，事情永远不会走到这一步。

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 谁可能偷了金德里什？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我该寻找什么证据？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和守卫曾经很亲近，对吧？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德族女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪里？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时没有了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
The Hindriarch is the most likely suspect, in my opinion. She might have kept it for herself or sold it. I've been suspicious of her pet bodyguard, Kesehind, for years--I wouldn't put it past him to steal the treasure himself.
That said, it might have been an outsider like you. I doubt any of the villagers had the nerve to steal such a valuable object, but I suppose it's faintly possible.
But it wasn't Neelahind. You won't find a purer heart in all of Qud than hers.

strings.string:
在我看来，欣德族女族长是最可能的嫌疑人。她可能把它据为己有，也可能卖掉了。我多年来一直怀疑她那条宠物护卫凯瑟欣德——他亲手偷走宝物，我也不会惊讶。
话虽如此，也可能是像你这样的外来者。我怀疑村里没人有胆量偷这么贵重的东西，但我想也有那么一点可能。
但不是尼拉欣德。整个库德都找不到比她更纯净的心。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你为什么离开贝拉？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我该寻找什么证据？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和守卫曾经很亲近，对吧？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德族女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪里？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时没有了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Objects out of place, certainly. Bey Lah produces little and sees almost no violence, so signs of the outside world should be easy to find.
You may wish to talk to the villagers, too. My people are starved for entertainment, gossip travels fast, and we are all notoriously poor liars.

strings.string:
当然是位置不对的物件。贝拉产出很少，也几乎没有暴力，所以外界的痕迹应该很容易找到。
你也可以和村民谈谈。我的族人缺少娱乐，流言传得很快，而且我们出了名不擅长撒谎。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你为什么离开贝拉？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 谁可能偷了金德里什？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和守卫曾经很亲近，对吧？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德族女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪里？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时没有了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Yes. We were close. More than close.
If it tore my heart to ragged halves to leave my people behind, leaving Neelahind shredded it into scraps.

strings.string:
是的。我们很亲近。不只是亲近。
如果离开我的族人把我的心撕成了破碎的两半，那么离开尼拉欣德则把它扯成了碎片。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你为什么离开贝拉？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 谁可能偷了金德里什？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我该寻找什么证据？

string.ID: The Hindriarch mentioned that you have a brother. Where is he?

strings.string: 欣德族女族长提到你有个兄弟。他在哪里？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时没有了。生而饮水。

string.ID: I have no brother. My two sisters are all the blood family I can claim.

strings.string: 我没有兄弟。我的两个姐妹就是我唯一能认领的血亲。

string.ID: Keh seems to believe otherwise.

strings.string: 凯似乎不这么认为。

string.ID: Why did you leave Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你为什么离开贝拉？

string.ID: Who might have stolen Kindrish?

strings.string: 谁可能偷了金德里什？

string.ID: What evidence should I be looking for?

strings.string: 我该寻找什么证据？

string.ID: You and the Warden were close, were you not?

strings.string: 你和守卫曾经很亲近，对吧？

string.ID: Nothing for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时没有了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Keh believes that she gets final say regarding who is a sister or brother. Regardless of what the sibling in question thinks.
That's part of why I left.

strings.string:
凯相信谁是姐妹、谁是兄弟，最终由她说了算。无论相关的手足自己怎么想。
这也是我离开的部分原因。

string.ID: May I ask further questions?

strings.string: 我可以继续问问题吗？

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink.

strings.string: 明白。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Oh. Oh no. Yes, that's. That's mine.
I meant to burn it. I probably should have burned it. I wish I had burned it.
May I please have it back?

strings.string:
哦。哦不。是的，那是。那是我的。
我本想烧掉它。我也许本该烧掉它。我真希望自己已经烧掉它。
可以请你把它还给我吗？

string.ID: So you can burn it?

strings.string: 这样你就能烧掉它？

string.ID: Hmm. No, I think not.

strings.string: 嗯。不，我觉得不行。

string.ID:
You have me helpless. That poem is my clumsy expression of a deep truth that frightens me. It is a risk that I lacked the strength to take or leave.
My heart quails in your hands, kendren.

strings.string:
你让我无计可施。那首诗是我对一项令我恐惧的深层真相的笨拙表达。那是一份我没有力量承担，也没有力量放弃的风险。
我的心在你手中颤抖，肯德伦。

string.ID: You wish you had burned such a vital truth?

strings.string: 你希望自己烧掉这么重要的真相？

string.ID: It shall quail a bit longer. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那就让它再颤抖一会儿吧。生而饮水。

string.ID:
No! Yes? I don't know.
Yes, I wish I burned it, but I wish I had given it. I wish I had never written it, or I had written it better, or I had simply confessed in person. I wish I had a harder heart.
I wish you would give it back, or burn it, or give it to her.

strings.string:
不！是吗？我不知道。
是的，我希望自己烧掉了它，但我也希望自己把它送出去了。我希望自己从未写过它，或者写得更好，或者干脆当面坦白。我希望自己有一颗更硬的心。
我希望你把它还给我，或者烧掉它，或者把它交给她。

string.ID: If I do give it back, what will you do with it?

strings.string: 如果我真的还给你，你会拿它怎么办？

string.ID: I could give it to her.

strings.string: 我可以把它交给她。

string.ID: This got a bit intense. Live and drink.

strings.string: 这有点太激烈了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I was trying not to think too hard about any of this until you found my poem, so... I can't say.
But I can't ignore this sign of my cowardice, not after you found it.

strings.string:
在你找到我的诗之前，我一直努力不去细想这一切，所以……我说不准。
但我不能无视这个怯懦的标记，在你找到它之后更不能。

string.ID: Take the poem. Be brave.

strings.string: 收下这首诗。勇敢些。

string.ID: Shall I deliver the poem for you?

strings.string: 要我替你送出这首诗吗？

string.ID: I will think further on this.

strings.string: 我会再想想。

string.ID:
Kendren... =name=. I will try.
I... thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string:
肯德伦……=name=。我会试试。
我……谢谢你。生而饮水。

string.ID: Live and drink, Eskhind.

strings.string: 生而饮水，埃斯欣德。

string.ID:
Deliver it? But how do you even know who--
Mm. Never mind. My head is spinning. I think that if... the poem were to find itself in the warden's hands, that would perhaps be a good thing. Maybe.

strings.string:
送出去？但你到底怎么知道是谁——
嗯。算了。我的头在转。我想如果……这首诗自己到了守卫手里，也许会是件好事。也许。

string.ID: Then perhaps it will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那也许它会的。生而饮水。

string.ID: No, Eskhind. Take the poem. Be brave.

strings.string: 不，埃斯欣德。收下这首诗。勇敢些。

string.ID:
I couldn't save them.
I tried. I tried to save them.

strings.string:
我没能救他们。
我试过了。我试着救他们。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想这首诗是你的。

string.ID: Condolences. Live and drink.

strings.string: 请节哀。生而饮水。

string.ID: I'm uneasy. What is this mounting dread? I cannot talk now.

strings.string: 我很不安。这不断增长的恐惧是什么？我现在不能说话。

string.ID:
If it isn't the hero kendren, =name=.
Welcome back to Bey Lah! Stay as long as you like.

strings.string:
这不是英雄肯德伦，=name= 吗。
欢迎回到贝拉！想待多久就待多久。

string.ID: Hindriarch, I have found Kindrish.

strings.string: 欣德族女族长，我找到了金德里什。

string.ID: How is life as Hindriarch?

strings.string: 当欣德族女族长的生活如何？

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客气。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Hah! Real justice? I never thought I'd see the like, not here. Well done!
I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.

strings.string:
哈！真正的正义？我从没想过自己会见到这种事，至少不会在这里。干得好！
我承认，我本来更希望避免成为欣德族女族长，但我希望把我的族人带向更民主的治理形式。然后我就能投票把自己赶下台。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

string.ID: Welcome back to Bey Lah, =name=. Stay as long as you like.

strings.string: 欢迎回到贝拉，=name=。想待多久就待多久。

string.ID: I believe this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是你的。

string.ID: How is life as Hindriarch?

strings.string: 当欣德族女族长的生活如何？

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

string.ID:
You have my gratitude for this exoneration, kendren. This worked out better than I expected thanks to you.
I'll admit, I would have preferred to avoid becoming Hindriarch, but I'm hoping to bring my people to a more Democratic form of governance. Then I can vote myself out.

strings.string:
感谢你为我洗清罪名，肯德伦。多亏了你，结果比我预想的更好。
我承认，我本来更希望避免成为欣德族女族长，但我希望把我的族人带向更民主的治理形式。然后我就能投票把自己赶下台。

string.ID: I believe this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我相信这首诗是你的。

string.ID:
Oh! Well. For you to bring me this after returning me to Bey Lah...
{{emote|*she smiles.*}}
Message received, =name=. If I expect my people to face their fear of the unknown, I owe it to them to face mine.
I will confess my feelings to Neelahind, give her the poem I wrote, and accept whatever reply she has for me. Thank you again.

strings.string:
哦！好吧。你在把我带回贝拉之后，又把这个带给我……
{{emote|*她笑了。*}}
消息收到了，=name=。如果我期望我的族人面对他们对未知的恐惧，我也有义务面对自己的恐惧。
我会向尼拉欣德坦白我的感情，把我写的诗交给她，并接受她给我的任何答复。再次感谢你。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不客气。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kendren! I am glad to see you.
Thank you again for bringing Neela around, and please forgive her reservation. She mourns the people she thought she knew, but our future will be brighter together.

strings.string:
肯德伦！很高兴见到你。
再次感谢你让尼拉回心转意，也请原谅她的保留。她正在哀悼那些她以为自己了解的族人，但我们的未来会因彼此相伴而更加明亮。

string.ID: Of course. Live and drink.

strings.string: 当然。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Kendren, thank you.
Things may seem grim, but I have a new strength with Neela by my side.

strings.string:
肯德伦，谢谢你。
事情也许显得阴沉，但有尼拉在我身边，我有了新的力量。

string.ID:
Oh, it's you. Need to rest by the fire?
It's fine, my wrath has clarified. You were never the problem. Live and drink.

strings.string:
哦，是你。需要在火边休息吗？
没关系，我的愤怒已经澄清。你从来不是问题所在。生而饮水。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想这首诗是你的。

string.ID: You're just trying to keep dear Esk informed, then? Or could it be that you're wondering if that home may be Bey Lah?

strings.string: 所以你只是想让亲爱的埃斯克知情？还是说，你在想那个家会不会是贝拉？

string.ID: You have my thanks, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 多谢你，欣德族女族长。

string.ID:
I am afeared to even mention this notion to the villagers. Can you imagine my epitaph?
"Here lies the youngest Hindriarch in Bey Lah's history, trampled to death because she suggested we invite in a people most readily described as 'lah with legs'."
If they trusted you more, maybe we could put it to a vote. But as it is? No. Sorry, =name=.

strings.string:
我甚至害怕向村民提起这个想法。你能想象我的墓志铭吗？
“这里安息着贝拉史上最年轻的欣德族女族长，她因提议邀请一支最容易被描述为‘长腿拉’的族群进入村庄而被踩死。”
如果他们更信任你，也许我们可以付诸投票。但现在这样？不行。抱歉，=name=。

string.ID: We are on the tips of our hooves, =name=! Any word about the slynth?

strings.string: 我们都踮着蹄尖等着呢，=name=！有斯林斯的消息吗？

string.ID:
Never greater has been my desire to be voted out of office.
Oh, not because of the slynth! Well, yes, because of the slynth, but it's because I'd rather be out there with them – scouting, guarding, even tending to lah would be better than all this dry supervisory work.
Room, board, assignments... it never occurred to me that immigration would require such intensive logistics.

strings.string:
我从未如此渴望被投票赶下台。
哦，不是因为斯林斯！嗯，是的，是因为斯林斯，但那是因为我更愿意和他们一起在外面——侦察、守卫，甚至照料拉，都比这些枯燥的监督工作好。
住宿、膳食、分配……我从没想过移民需要如此密集的后勤。

string.ID: My thanks, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 多谢，欣德族女族长。

string.ID:
Live and drink, =name=!
At long last I bear a lighter load of work coordinating our new family members. I won't claim that all of my people are fully comfortable with the slynth, but the faundren love them.

strings.string:
生而饮水，=name=！
终于，协调我们新家庭成员的工作负担轻了一些。我不会声称我的族人全都完全适应了斯林斯，但幼欣德伦很喜欢他们。

string.ID: My thanks again, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 再次感谢，欣德族女族长。

string.ID: I'm sorry.

strings.string: 对不起。

string.ID: {{emote|*The hindren pariah ignores you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*欣德伦弃民无视了你。*}}

string.ID:
Don't you have someone else to bother?
Live and drink piss.

strings.string:
你就没有别人可以烦吗？
生吧，喝尿去。

string.ID: I think this poem is yours.

strings.string: 我想这首诗是你的。
真无礼。

string.ID:
Oh, so you have! Amazing work, kendren. We owe you more than we can give, but here is what we can give nonetheless.
You are more than welcome here in Bey Lah any time.

strings.string:
哦，你确实找到了！干得太出色了，肯德伦。我们亏欠你的多过我们能给出的，但这仍是我们能给你的东西。
贝拉随时都非常欢迎你。

string.ID: Live and drink, Hindriarch.

strings.string: 生而饮水，欣德族女族长。

string.ID:
Extremely frustrating! But I am yet hopeful.
My people are resistant to change, but they don't seem opposed to the idea of a Democracy. I need to give them a measure of time before we hold an election, but they'll ultimately agree as long as I am acting Hindriarch.
Then, fates willing, they will vote me out. I'll be voting for Isahind, myself. Once I convince her to run.

strings.string:
极其令人沮丧！但我仍怀有希望。
我的族人抗拒改变，但他们似乎并不反对民主的想法。在举行选举前，我需要给他们一些时间，但只要我仍是代理欣德族女族长，他们最终会同意的。
然后，如果命运愿意，他们会投票把我赶下台。我自己会投给伊萨欣德。等我说服她参选之后。

string.ID: May fortune favor you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 愿幸运眷顾你。生而饮水。
=name=。
埃斯欣德。

string.ID: Bey Lah is gone. I hope you're happy.

strings.string: 贝拉完了。希望你满意。

string.ID: Our world is ending...

strings.string: 我们的世界正在终结……

string.ID: Live and drink, =name=.

strings.string: 生而饮水，=name=。

string.ID:
Perhaps it was too much to wish that Bey Lah would change.
But Esk is happy again. That makes me feel happy too.

strings.string:
也许期望贝拉改变，本来就是奢求。
但埃斯克又快乐起来了。这也让我感到快乐。

string.ID: I can't imagine why you would think we want your company, kendren.

strings.string: 我真想不通，你为什么会以为我们想要你的陪伴，肯德伦。

string.ID: Leave us alone.

strings.string: 别来烦我们。

string.ID: Thank you for what you've done for our sister.

strings.string: 谢谢你为我们的姐妹所做的一切。

string.ID: If you've nothing you need of me, kendren, I'd just as soon hold my peace.

strings.string: 如果你没有需要我做的事，肯德伦，我宁愿保持沉默。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: Very well. Live and drink.

strings.string: 很好。生而饮水。

string.ID: I suppose.

strings.string: 我想可以。

string.ID: Tell me about your family.

strings.string: 告诉我你的家人的事。

string.ID: Keh told me that Eskhind has a brother.

strings.string: 凯告诉我埃斯欣德有个兄弟。

string.ID: Who do you think stole Kindrish?

strings.string: 你认为谁偷了金德里什？

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 算了。生而饮水。

string.ID: ... did she.

strings.string: ……她这么说了。

string.ID: Where is he? Tell me what happened to him.

strings.string: 他在哪里？告诉我他出了什么事。

string.ID: But she doesn't, does she? Only sisters.

strings.string: 但她没有，对吧？只有姐妹。

string.ID:
I don't like to speculate on a matter I know so little of, nor one whose outcome so dearly affects my life.
If what you want is a strongly-worded accusation based on nothing, Liihart is the sister to talk to.

strings.string:
我不喜欢对自己知之甚少的事情妄加猜测，更何况这件事的结果会如此深刻地影响我的生活。
如果你想要的是一通毫无根据却措辞强硬的指控，利哈特才是你该去找的姐妹。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时就这些。生而饮水。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时就这些。生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*Meyehind's glare turns withering for the few seconds it takes before she turns her face and body away from you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*梅耶欣德的怒视在短短几秒内变得刺骨，随后她转过脸和身体，不再看你。*}}

string.ID:
What's to tell? We are outcasts, pushed to the margins by our people for the crime of harmless deviance.
It's beyond perverse to call us back just so Grand-Doe can punish us further.

strings.string:
有什么可说的？我们是被自己的族人推到边缘的弃儿，罪名只是无害的偏离。
把我们叫回来，只为了让大母鹿进一步惩罚我们，这已经扭曲到无以复加。

string.ID: That's all for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 暂时就这些。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Hm! No, Eskhind wrote that, but I thought she burned it.
If you return it to anyone, you should return it to her.

strings.string:
哼！不，那是埃斯欣德写的，但我以为她烧掉了。
如果你要还给谁，就该还给她。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID: Hey, =name=. Live and drink.

strings.string: 嘿，=name=。生而饮水。

string.ID:
This sucks.
...but you're not so bad.

strings.string:
这太糟了。
……但你没那么坏。

string.ID: ... what a waste.

strings.string: ……真是浪费。

string.ID:
Oh! =name=.
It makes me happy to see you.

strings.string:
哦！=name=。
见到你让我高兴。

string.ID:
Um... thank you.
Live and drink.

strings.string:
呃……谢谢你。
生而饮水。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Liihart stares at you for several quiet seconds.*}}
Live and drink.

strings.string:
{{emote|*利哈特安静地盯着你看了好几秒。*}}
生而饮水。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, reticent one.

strings.string: 生而饮水，沉默者。

string.ID: I said, may I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我说，我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: You are not partial to talking.

strings.string: 你不怎么喜欢说话。

string.ID: Well then. Live and drink.

strings.string: 那好吧。生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*she glares in silence*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*她沉默地瞪视*}}

string.ID: Answer me.

strings.string: 回答我。

string.ID: You are not partial to talking.

strings.string: 你不怎么喜欢说话。

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 算了。生而饮水。

string.ID: ... correct.

strings.string: ……正确。

string.ID: I'm trying to exonerate your sister. Can you help?

strings.string: 我在试着为你的姐妹洗清罪名。你能帮忙吗？

string.ID: So you can answer my questions. You just don't want to.

strings.string: 所以你能回答我的问题。你只是不想。

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 算了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Eskhind didn't do it. It was probably Keh.
That's all I know. I mind my business.
Wish you would too.

strings.string:
埃斯欣德没做。大概是凯。
我知道的就这些。我只管自己的事。
希望你也如此。

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 有道理。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Oh! Eskhind wrote that.
You should give that to Neelahind. It was supposed to go to Neelahind.

strings.string:
哦！那是埃斯欣德写的。
你应该把它交给尼拉欣德。它本来就是要给尼拉欣德的。

string.ID: Not Eskhind?

strings.string: 不是给埃斯欣德？

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID:
No, no, give it to Neelahind.
Esk will thank you later.

strings.string:
不，不，交给尼拉欣德。
埃斯克以后会感谢你的。

string.ID: I see, thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了，谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID: I'd rather not talk. Sorry.

strings.string: 我不太想说话。抱歉。

string.ID:
Strange and rocky times have befallen Bey Lah.
But I'm confident that we can get through this, as we always do. Shall we trade?

strings.string:
贝拉遭逢了奇怪而坎坷的时日。
但我相信我们能渡过难关，就像我们一直以来那样。要交易吗？

string.ID:
My friend! Thank you so much for helping our village!
Our prosperity means that I have new goods for you to peruse, if you're interested.

strings.string:
我的朋友！非常感谢你帮助我们的村庄！
我们的繁荣意味着我有新货可供你浏览，如果你有兴趣的话。

string.ID:
As if a new Hindriarch weren't enough, I hear we might become a Democracy! How thrilling.
This is a new chapter in Bey Lah's history, kendren. Would you care to trade?

strings.string:
仿佛有了新欣德族女族长还不够，我听说我们可能会变成民主制！多么激动人心。
这是贝拉历史的新篇章，肯德伦。你想交易吗？

string.ID:
Amazing! The youngest hindriarch in Bey Lah's preserved history, if only temporarily so.
Care to buy a souvenir to commemorate this historic occasion?

strings.string:
太惊人了！贝拉保存下来的历史中最年轻的欣德族女族长，哪怕只是暂时如此。
想买件纪念品来纪念这个历史时刻吗？

string.ID:
Oh! A real live kendren, here in our village! Live and drink, lovely friend!
If you'd care to trade, I have a modest amount of local goods I can offer.

strings.string:
哦！一个活生生的肯德伦，就在我们的村庄里！生而饮水，可爱的朋友！
如果你想交易，我可以提供少量本地货物。

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: I have all I need. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我需要的都有了。生而饮水。

string.ID: No, that's not mine. But it looks lovely!

strings.string: 不，那不是我的。但它看起来很美！

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID: Why are you talking to me?

strings.string: 你为什么和我说话？

string.ID: No sudden moves around the Hindriarch, kendren. I am watching you.

strings.string: 在欣德族女族长身边别有突然动作，肯德伦。我在看着你。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: Do I look like a poet to you, kendren?

strings.string: 我在你看来像诗人吗，肯德伦？

string.ID: I suppose not. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我想不像。生而饮水。

string.ID: I am Kesehind, protector of Hindriarch Keh, the Grand-Doe of Bey Lah.

strings.string: 我是凯瑟欣德，贝拉大母鹿、欣德族女族长凯的保护者。

string.ID: May I ask you some questions?

strings.string: 我可以问你几个问题吗？

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 不可以。
哦。

string.ID: You are either very brave or very foolish, to stop me in my path. Perhaps both. What do you want?

strings.string: 你拦住我的去路，要么非常勇敢，要么非常愚蠢。也许两者都是。你想要什么？

string.ID: Nothing. Live and drink.

strings.string: 没什么。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Be careful in the flower fields.
Even with Bey Lah marked on your map, it's easy to get lost. Lost travelers feed the lah.

strings.string:
在花田里小心些。
即使贝拉标在你的地图上，也很容易迷路。迷路的旅人会喂饱拉。

string.ID: I will be careful, thank you.

strings.string: 我会小心的，谢谢。

string.ID: Hold a moment, =player.formalAddressTerm=. Are you looking for work?

strings.string: 稍等片刻，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你在找活干吗？

string.ID: I am.

strings.string: 是的。

string.ID: I am not.

strings.string: 不是。

string.ID:
I can't help but wonder why you're telling me this in particular. I am not a mayor, nor even a citizen. I am a drifter, a pariah, and my 'people' are those who have no home anywhere else.
... and here I wonder a bit less. You're asking me to whisper into the winds on behalf of the slynth, aren't you?

strings.string:
我忍不住想，你为什么偏要把这事告诉我。我不是村长，甚至不是公民。我是漂泊者，是弃民，而我的“族人”是那些在别处都没有家的人。
……现在我没那么疑惑了。你是在请我替斯林斯向风中低语，对吧？

string.ID: What a strange fate, to pass from new sentience to outcast with no steps in between. Regardless, if it is their will and you vouch for them, that is enough for me. Tell the slynth that should they choose to wander, the wind will blow at their backs.

strings.string: 从新生意识直接成为流亡者，中间没有任何过渡，多么奇怪的命运。无论如何，如果这是他们的意愿，而你愿为他们担保，那对我就足够了。告诉斯林斯，如果他们选择漂泊，风会吹在他们背后。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Lulihart.

strings.string: 多谢你，卢利哈特。

string.ID: It is hardly so simple, =name=. We drifters hold no hierarchy. I can whisper all I like, but no winds will blow behind the slynth if your name cannot stir more than a breeze. Make yourself known to Pariahs and ask me again.

strings.string: 事情没那么简单，=name=。我们漂泊者没有层级。我可以随意低语，但如果你的名字只能搅起一缕微风，就不会有风吹在斯林斯背后。先让弃民们知道你，再来问我。

string.ID: Still gathering landing pads for your drifting vessels, then, =name=?

strings.string: 所以你还在为那些漂泊船只寻找着陆垫，=name=？

string.ID: Yes, I am.

strings.string: 是的。

string.ID:
New voices, strange and beautiful, carry on the salt breeze.
Some will no doubt be silenced by sun, blade, thirst, bullet, or glow, but they will not fall still alone.

strings.string:
新的声音，陌生而美丽，乘着盐风传来。
其中一些无疑会被烈日、刀刃、干渴、子弹或辉光止息，但他们不会孤独地倒下归静。

string.ID: My thanks, Lulihart.

strings.string: 多谢，卢利哈特。

string.ID:
Live and drink, =name=.
Have you seen your slynth out there? My sources tell me that they are, for the most part, traveling well enough with others. They stop by my tent from time to time to visit and smoke with me, as you do.
One might assume they were born for this kind of life.

strings.string:
生而饮水，=name=。
你见过外面的那些斯林斯了吗？我的消息源告诉我，他们大体上已经能和别人一起顺利旅行。他们时不时会来我的帐篷拜访，和我一起抽烟，就像你一样。
有人或许会以为他们天生就适合这种生活。

string.ID: My thanks again, Lulihart.

strings.string: 再次感谢，卢利哈特。

string.ID:
I see. In that case, rest and speak a bit with me, won't you? My worries can wait another day.
That said, if you change your mind, you'll come find me, won't you?

strings.string:
我明白了。既然如此，休息一下，和我说会儿话吧？我的忧虑可以再等一天。
话虽如此，如果你改变主意，会来找我的，对吧？

string.ID: Perhaps. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许吧。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Lovely. Take a seat. Chew the bark with me, and I will tell you what I know.
I've heard tell that my ancestral hometown, Bey Lah, is in some kind of trouble. They've opened their borders for the first time I know of and are specifically seeking to hire kendren -- that's their word for outsiders like you. Would you be willing to go see what they need?

strings.string:
很好。坐下吧。和我一起嚼嚼树皮，我会告诉你我知道的事。
我听说我的祖先故乡贝拉遇上了某种麻烦。据我所知，他们第一次开放了边界，并且专门想雇用肯德伦——那是他们对你这种外来者的称呼。你愿意去看看他们需要什么吗？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: How do you know this?

strings.string: 你怎么知道这事？

string.ID: Why do you care?

strings.string: 你为什么在乎？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你为什么不自己去那里？

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 很好，我会按你所请前往贝拉。

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。这任务不合我意。

string.ID:
My name is Lulihart. The blood of the hindren runs through my veins, but two of my three parents were kendren, so that blood is... dilute, and salt-brined from being born out here.
Dilute, salty blood. Heh.

strings.string:
我的名字是卢利哈特。欣德伦的血流在我的血管里，但我的三位父母中有两位是肯德伦，所以那血……稀薄，而且因生在这里而被盐水腌过。
稀薄、带盐的血。呵。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 很好，我会按你所请前往贝拉。

string.ID: How do you know about Bey Lah's trouble?

strings.string: 你怎么知道贝拉的麻烦？

string.ID: Why do you care about Bey Lah?

strings.string: 你为什么在乎贝拉？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你为什么不自己去那里？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。这任务不合我意。

string.ID:
My water goes to scouts to keep a distant eye on Bey Lah. To make sure that it is still there, still safe.
I have never been within a parasang of my people's land, but I know exactly where the once-hidden village stands. I will share this knowledge with you if you agree to consider whatever their request may be.

strings.string:
我的水交给斥候，让他们远远看着贝拉。确保它仍在那里，仍然安全。
我从未靠近过我族人的土地一帕拉桑之内，但我确切知道那座曾经隐秘的村庄坐落何处。如果你同意考虑他们可能提出的任何请求，我会把这项知识分享给你。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 很好，我会按你所请前往贝拉。

string.ID: Wait, who are you?

strings.string: 等等，你是谁？

string.ID: Why do you care?

strings.string: 你为什么在乎？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你为什么不自己去那里？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。这任务不合我意。

string.ID: Even blood as thin as mine ties me to the cervidian meadow. The hindren may not say so, but they are my family.

strings.string: 即使像我这样稀薄的血，也把我系在鹿属草甸上。欣德伦也许不会这么说，但他们是我的家人。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 很好，我会按你所请前往贝拉。

string.ID: And who are you?

strings.string: 那你是谁？

string.ID: How do you know Bey Lah's trouble?

strings.string: 你怎么知道贝拉的麻烦？

string.ID: Why don't you go there yourself?

strings.string: 你为什么不自己去那里？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。这任务不合我意。

string.ID:
I am not welcome in Bey Lah.
My blood is not pure, and I was not born in the meadow. These things make my name as salt in the mouths of true hindren.
They are misguided, but they are my misguided family. They stagnate as Qud changes around them. I worry.

strings.string:
贝拉不欢迎我。
我的血并不纯净，我也不是在草甸中出生。这些事让我的名字在真正欣德伦口中如同盐粒。
他们被误导了，但他们仍是我被误导的家人。当库德在他们周围改变时，他们停滞不前。我很担心。

string.ID: Very well, I will go to Bey Lah as you ask.

strings.string: 很好，我会按你所请前往贝拉。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: How do you know this?

strings.string: 你怎么知道这事？

string.ID: Why do you care?

strings.string: 你为什么在乎？

string.ID: Pass. This task is not to my liking.

strings.string: 算了。这任务不合我意。

string.ID:
Bless you, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I feel better knowing that at least one kendren will reach back to aid my kin. They are on the cusp of a new fate, and I wish to see it while I yet live.
Let me advise you of Bey Lah's location, and here is a little chew-boon for your trouble.

strings.string:
祝福你，=player.formalAddressTerm=。知道至少有一名肯德伦会伸手帮助我的亲族，我感觉好些了。他们正站在新命运的边缘，而我希望趁自己还活着时看见它。
让我告诉你贝拉的位置，这里还有一点嚼恩果，算作给你添麻烦的谢礼。

string.ID: Thank you, Lulihart. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，卢利哈特。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I hear that Bey Lah's status is once again quo. I hoped for a measure more of change, but thousands of years of tradition do not give so easily.
Thank you for helping my foolish people.

strings.string:
我听说贝拉的现状又回到了现状。我本希望能多一点改变，但数千年的传统不会轻易退让。
谢谢你帮助我愚蠢的族人。

string.ID:
I've heard that the youngest Hindriarch in history now leads Bey Lah, and their warden aims to join the Quetzal Caucus. You've worked wonders, kendren.
I can't wait to see what happens next.

strings.string:
我听说史上最年轻的欣德族女族长如今领导着贝拉，而他们的守卫打算加入羽蛇党团。你创造了奇迹，肯德伦。
我迫不及待想看接下来会发生什么。

string.ID:
Every flame burns low one day, but the warmth of my people's story still carries me forward.
Bey Lah has not survived joining Qud, but the hindren live on, and our legacy will never be wholly lost.
I wonder what became of Kindrish.

strings.string:
每团火焰终有一天都会低燃，但我族人故事的温暖仍会托着我前行。
贝拉没能在加入库德后存续，但欣德伦仍活着，我们的遗产永远不会完全失落。
我想知道金德里什后来怎样了。

string.ID: Come smoke with me, friend. Set a spell.

strings.string: 来和我抽一会儿烟吧，朋友。坐上一阵。

string.ID: Kendren! A moment of your time, please. You are =name=, yes? You seek to solve a mystery here in the village, yes?

strings.string: 肯德伦！请占用你片刻时间。你是 =name=，对吗？你想解开村里的谜案，对吗？

string.ID: Does this poem belong to you?

strings.string: 这首诗是你的吗？

string.ID: I am, and yes.

strings.string: 我是，也确实如此。

string.ID: How did you know all that?

strings.string: 你怎么知道这些？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: I don't have time for this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我没时间管这个。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Poem? Oh! This is a Shakespriggan sonnet, but I didn't write it--the rhymes are a bit facile, and love poems don't interest me.
I've been teaching Eskhind about sonnets, so she must have written this. But that means... oh, poor thing.

strings.string:
诗？哦！这是一首莎枝式十四行诗，但不是我写的——韵脚有点浅易，而且爱情诗不让我感兴趣。
我一直在教埃斯欣德十四行诗，所以这一定是她写的。但这意味着……哦，可怜的人。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I hoped you would ask! I closely study the works of the great bard, Willow Shakesprig. In particular, I am most fond of the stories of the Great Plant Detective, Hemlock Cones. Through these stories, I have learned to hone my perceptions and deductive skill to a fine point. It is my dearest hope that one day I shall be known not as Angohind, village bookworm... but Angohind, Master Detective.
My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?

strings.string:
我就盼着你问呢！我仔细研读伟大吟游诗人柳树·莎枝翁的作品。尤其是伟大植物侦探，铁杉·球果的故事，我最为喜爱。通过这些故事，我学会把自己的观察力和推理技巧磨得锋利无比。我最深切的希望是，有朝一日，人们提起我时不再说安戈欣德，村庄书虫……而是安戈欣德，侦探大师。
我的祖欣德禁止我调查村里的怪事，但她可没说我不能教你侦探工作的门道！你意下如何？

string.ID: I am listening.

strings.string: 我在听。

string.ID: I should... go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该……走了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Yes, yes of course.
I am Angohind: grandson of esteemed Elder Eselhind, young scholar of Shakesprig, and best dressed hindren in Bey Lah. I am also, as luck would have it, an aspirant investigator with an ear... for mystery.
My grandhind has forbidden me from looking into the strange doings in the village, but she said nothing about me teaching you the ins and outs of detective work! What say you?

strings.string:
是，是，当然。
我是安戈欣德：受人尊敬的埃塞尔欣德长老之孙，莎枝翁的年轻学者，也是贝拉穿着最讲究的欣德伦。幸运的是，我还是一名有志调查者，对谜团……颇有耳力。
我的祖欣德禁止我调查村里的怪事，但她可没说我不能教你侦探工作的门道！你意下如何？

string.ID: I am listening.

strings.string: 我在听。

string.ID: No thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不了，谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Oh, truly? You won't regret this, kendren, I promise! So, let's get to it!
Every mystery hinges on the detection and interpretation of evidence. As Hemlock Cones said:
Ere any prosecution can commence, Accusers must obtain some evidence. The solving lies in seeing and locating Supporting clues as well as implicating.

strings.string:
哦，真的吗？你不会后悔的，肯德伦，我保证！那么，我们开始吧！
每个谜案都取决于证据的发现和解读。正如铁杉·球果所说：
若要控诉得开端，指控者先取证端。 解谜在于眼与行，既寻佐证亦牵连。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我该如何寻找证据？

string.ID: What makes something evidence?

strings.string: 什么东西算作证据？

string.ID: What is implicating evidence?

strings.string: 什么是牵连证据？

string.ID: What is supporting evidence?

strings.string: 什么是佐证？

string.ID: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果证据指向多个罪犯怎么办？

string.ID:
Professor Cones taught me everything about finding evidence!
Though evidence you found upon the ground may yet be sound, If it will be sufficient is a toss-up. Examine all your suspects and their homes and all around, And find a witness who may dish the gossip.
You can find evidence by looking at things on the ground, but you can also look at your suspects to see if there's anything off about them. You can also ask around to see if anyone has seen or heard anything strange, and different witnesses may have different things to report.

strings.string:
球果教授把寻找证据的一切都教给了我！
地上所见证据或许真， 能否足用仍是未定论。 嫌犯宅边四处都查尽， 还须证人吐露闲话闻。
你可以通过查看地上的东西来寻找证据，但也可以观察嫌疑人，看看他们身上有没有不对劲之处。你还可以四处询问，看看是否有人看见或听见了怪事；不同证人可能会报告不同的事情。

string.ID: What about supporting evidence?

strings.string: 佐证呢？

string.ID: What makes something evidence?

strings.string: 什么东西算作证据？

string.ID: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我找到牵连多个嫌疑人的证据怎么办？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Evidence is any sign of something gone amiss. The Great Plant Detective gave some good examples in Act II of the tragedy of Gimlet:
So! Sweep the full estate for signs of {{W|trade}}, their shady night-time dealings to expose Now look for signs of {{W|craft}}, see what was made For to conceal a treasure hidden close. But darker still, if {{W|illness}} signs we find A desperate contagion may yet lurk And darkest yet, more {{W|violence}} may reply To those who stumble 'pon their grisly work.

strings.string:
证据就是任何表明事情出了差错的迹象。伟大植物侦探在《小锥子的悲剧》第二幕中给出了一些好例子：
看！搜遍宅邸寻 {{W|交易}}， 揭开夜里阴影买卖。 再看 {{W|制作}} 之迹，何物被造， 只为遮掩近处秘宝。 若见 {{W|疾病}} 之征，更暗尚在， 绝望传染或潜伏不改。 最暗之处，更多 {{W|暴力}} 回答， 回应误撞惨事之人步伐。

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我该如何寻找证据？

string.ID: What makes something evidence?

strings.string: 什么东西算作证据？

string.ID: What is implicating evidence?

strings.string: 什么是牵连证据？

string.ID: What is supporting evidence?

strings.string: 什么是佐证？

string.ID: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果证据指向多个罪犯怎么办？

string.ID:
Implicating evidence is what it sounds like: evidence that implicates someone's involvement in a crime. For example, if someone observed strange behavior in a person, or if you found something weird in a person's room, or even if you observe them behaving strangely =player.reflexive=! That's implicating evidence.
Most of the time, a piece of implicating evidence isn't proof of a crime in and of itself, but when presented alongside supporting evidence, implicating evidence is the seed of truth from which grows the long frond of justice.

strings.string:
牵连证据就是字面意思：把某人牵连进罪行的证据。比如，有人观察到某人的古怪行为，或者你在某人的房间里发现了奇怪东西，甚至你 =player.reflexive= 观察到他们举止异常！那就是牵连证据。
大多数时候，一项牵连证据本身并不能证明罪行，但当它与佐证一同呈现时，牵连证据便是真相的种子，从中长出正义的长叶。

string.ID: What about supporting evidence?

strings.string: 佐证呢？

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我该如何寻找证据？

string.ID: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我找到牵连多个嫌疑人的证据怎么办？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Supporting evidence can be any sign that something is amiss that you can't directly tie to an individual. One common example is a bloodstain, which indicates that violence was committed but doesn't tell you by whom.
At its heart, supporting evidence is most powerful when paired with implicating evidence. Once you have both, you'll be in a good position to accuse a suspect of wrongdoing.

strings.string:
佐证可以是任何表明事情不对劲，却无法直接与某个人相连的迹象。一个常见例子是血迹，它表明发生过暴力，却不会告诉你是谁所为。
从本质上说，佐证与牵连证据配合时最有力。一旦两者兼备，你就很适合指控某名嫌疑人犯下恶行。

string.ID: What about implicating evidence?

strings.string: 牵连证据呢？

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我该如何寻找证据？

string.ID: What if I find implicating evidence for multiple suspects?

strings.string: 如果我找到牵连多个嫌疑人的证据怎么办？

string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。生而饮水。

string.ID:
As Professor Cones said:
We know the reach of law, however long, Is not the finest judge of right and wrong. Choose not what evidence thou wilt present Ere its consequence is evident.
In short, you must use your judgment and intuition, kendren.

strings.string:
正如球果教授所说：
须知法律之臂纵然长， 未必最善判别错与良。 若其后果尚未显明前， 莫先择定何证呈堂上。
简而言之，你必须运用自己的判断和直觉，肯德伦。

string.ID: What if I accuse the wrong person?

strings.string: 如果我指控错人怎么办？

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Multiple culprits?.Evidence is not created equalChoice.Text
string.ID: You're saying that what evidence I choose to show will affect the outcome of the case?

strings.string: 你的意思是，我选择展示什么证据会影响案件结果？

string.ID: Then what's to keep me from simply choosing the outcome I want?

strings.string: 那有什么能阻止我直接选择自己想要的结果？

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我还有更多问题。

string.ID:
That's always a risk, kendren.
Neelahind knows everyone in the village very well. If you present supporting evidence that contradicts something the Warden knows to be true about the suspect, well, she probably won't believe you. In fact, she might not let you accuse that person again, so be careful.
If you make too many bad accusations, you might lose credibility with her entirely.

strings.string:
这始终是风险，肯德伦。
尼拉欣德非常了解村里的每个人。如果你提出的佐证与守卫所知的嫌疑人真实情况相矛盾，那么，她大概不会相信你。事实上，她可能不再允许你再次指控那个人，所以要小心。
如果你做出太多糟糕指控，可能会在她那里彻底失去可信度。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我还有更多问题。

string.ID: Thank you for the help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Well, your conscience, surely.
You wouldn't be so unethical as to manipulate the resolution of a crime to your own ends. W-would you?

strings.string:
嗯，当然是你的良心。
你不会如此不道德，为了自己的目的操纵一桩罪案的解决。对、对吧？

string.ID: As you say it. I have further questions.

strings.string: 如你所说。我还有更多问题。

string.ID: Well, I should get going. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧，我该走了。生而饮水。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.Text
string.ID:
Precisely. The evidence you present paints a picture that will forever hang in the halls of Bey Lah's history. Our fate is in your hands.
Hemlock Cones once said:
As like begets like in daily life so too in mystery. Should I paint pictures full of strife thus violence comes to be. If I in craft or trade should deal then deals shall deal by troth But if I pestilence reveal- no honey be enough.

strings.string:
正是。你呈现的证据会画出一幅图景，永远悬挂在贝拉历史的厅堂中。我们的命运在你手里。
铁杉·球果曾说：
日常之中相似生相似， 谜案之中亦复如是。 若我绘出满幅争斗， 暴力便由此而至。 若我处理制作或交易， 买卖便依誓约行事。 但若揭示瘟疫之影—— 蜂蜜再多也不足以医治。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.QuestionsChoice.Text
string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我还有更多问题。

string.Context: Conversation Angohind.Evidence is not created equal.EndChoice.Text
string.ID: Thank you for your help, Angohind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你的帮助，安戈欣德。生而饮水。

string.ID: Please, ask away!

strings.string: 请尽管问！

string.ID: How do I find evidence?

strings.string: 我该如何寻找证据？

string.ID: What is implicating evidence?

strings.string: 什么是牵连证据？

string.ID: What is supporting evidence?

strings.string: 什么是佐证？

string.ID: What if evidence indicates multiple culprits?

strings.string: 如果证据指向多个罪犯怎么办？

string.ID: What if I accuse the wrong person?

strings.string: 如果我指控错人怎么办？

string.ID: That is all. Live and drink, faundren.

strings.string: 就这些。生而饮水，幼欣德伦。

string.ID:
Welcome back, Detective =name=.
Everything's in order here, more or less.

strings.string:
欢迎回来，=name= 侦探。
这里一切大致井然。

string.ID:
You should be proud, Detective =name=.
The hand of justice can be harsh, but it is fair. You have been its agent here.

strings.string:
你应该感到自豪，=name= 侦探。
正义之手或许严厉，但它是公平的。你在这里成为了它的代理人。

string.ID: So much change! I've been investigating the 'Democracy' that Hindriarch Esk has been espousing, and it strikes me as rife with vulnerabilities to malicious actors. Perhaps it can be refined.

strings.string: 变化真多！我一直在研究欣德族女族长埃斯克所倡导的“民主制”，它让我觉得充满了会被恶意行动者利用的漏洞。也许它可以改进。

string.ID:
Stunning! Eskhind as Hindriarch?
Those poetry lessons I had been giving her must have inspired in her a sense of civic duty.

strings.string:
惊人！埃斯欣德成了欣德族女族长？
我给她上的那些诗歌课一定激发了她的公民责任感。

string.ID:
Is this really the world we live in?
How cruel.

strings.string:
这真是我们所生活的世界吗？
多么残酷。

string.ID:
Something strange is afoot here in Bey Lah, and no mistake.
But I am forbidden from investigating. If only there were another detective that I could advise...

strings.string:
贝拉这里确实有怪事正在发生，绝不会错。
但我被禁止调查。要是有另一位侦探能让我指导就好了……

string.ID: Live and drink, wanderer.

strings.string: 生而饮水，旅人。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID: Take your time. The journey will wait for you.

strings.string: 慢慢来。旅途会等你。

string.ID: Please don't ask me where Bey Lah is. I will not tell you.

strings.string: 请别问我贝拉在哪里。我不会告诉你。

string.ID: I dream of returning to Bey Lah sometimes, but I know that's not my fate.

strings.string: 我有时会梦见回到贝拉，但我知道那不是我的命运。

string.ID: Moon and sun, traveler.

strings.string: 月与日，旅人。

string.ID: Moon and sun, wisdom and will.

strings.string: 月与日，智慧与意志。
hhhhhhhhhhhhhh.

string.ID: My condolences. Live and drink.

strings.string: 请节哀。生而饮水。

string.ID: Have you seen or heard anything peculiar?

strings.string: 你看见或听见什么异常的事了吗？

string.ID: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...

strings.string: 那是一撮欣德伦毛吗？上面有血……

string.ID: Sorry, I didn't see anything.

strings.string: 抱歉，我什么也没看见。

string.ID: I've a bad feeling about all this.

strings.string: 我对此有种不好的预感。

string.ID: The threat is not over. Mark my words.

strings.string: 威胁还没有结束。记住我的话。

string.ID: We're not safe yet. I can feel it.

strings.string: 我们还不安全。我能感觉到。

string.ID: This resolution is not to my liking...

strings.string: 这个结局不合我意……

string.ID: I remain wary, but there is no question that Bey Lah thrives, even with open borders.

strings.string: 我依旧警惕，但毫无疑问，即便开放边界，贝拉也在兴盛。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Stay safe.

strings.string: 哦，是你。注意安全。

string.ID: I am uncomfortable with change, but it is a skill to train like any other.

strings.string: 变化让我不安，但适应变化也是一种技艺，和其他技艺一样可以训练。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID: I hope Hindriarch Esk can keep us safe.

strings.string: 我希望欣德族女族长埃斯克能护我们周全。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID: I will do my best to be civil with you, kendren, but we hindren are bred into wariness.

strings.string: 我会尽力以礼待你，肯德伦，但我们欣德伦生来就被教得戒备。

string.ID: Cause no trouble here, kendren.

strings.string: 别在这里惹事，肯德伦。

string.ID: Be kind, kendren. We are watching you.

strings.string: 友善些，肯德伦。我们在看着你。

string.ID: Why do you remain here? Please, finish your business.

strings.string: 你为什么还留在这里？请办完你的事。

string.ID: It feels strange to allow you to cross our borders unimpeded, but Grand-Doe wills it.

strings.string: 让你畅通无阻地穿过我们的边界，感觉很怪，但这是大母鹿的意愿。

string.ID: No good can come of allowing kendren into Bey Lah...

strings.string: 允许肯德伦进入贝拉，不会有什么好结果……

string.ID: What now? Nothing like this has ever happened before.

strings.string: 现在怎么办？这种事以前从未发生过。

string.ID: It's difficult to return to normal life after such an upheaval.

strings.string: 经历这样一场动荡后，很难回到正常生活。

string.ID: Forgive me, kendren, but the sight of you makes my hands quake.

strings.string: 请原谅我，肯德伦，但看见你会让我双手发抖。

string.ID: Oh? Is it really over? I'm afraid.

strings.string: 哦？真的结束了吗？我害怕。

string.ID: How Bey Lah prospers! We should have opened the village years ago.

strings.string: 贝拉多么繁荣！我们多年前就该开放村子。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.

strings.string: 哦，是你。谢谢你帮助村子。

string.ID: I will admit, Hindriarch Esk leads well.

strings.string: 我承认，欣德族女族长埃斯克领导得很好。

string.ID: Can we really trust such a young Hindriarch?

strings.string: 我们真的能信任这样年轻的欣德族女族长吗？

string.ID: I am both afraid and hopeful for our future. But perhaps this is what we need.

strings.string: 我对我们的未来既害怕又怀有希望。但也许这正是我们需要的。

string.ID: Oh, it is you. Thank you for helping the village.

strings.string: 哦，是你。谢谢你帮助村子。

string.ID: Ah, l-live and drink.

strings.string: 啊，生、生而饮水。

string.ID: Live and drink...

strings.string: 生而饮水……

string.ID: Live... live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 生……生而饮水，肯德伦。
呃。

string.ID: Please go away.

strings.string: 请走开。

string.ID: W-w-w-w-what are ... what are you...

strings.string: 你你你你……你是什么……

string.ID: Moon and sun, kendren.

strings.string: 月与日，肯德伦。

string.ID: Live and drink. Will you be staying long?

strings.string: 生而饮水。你会久留吗？

string.ID: Forgiveness begged, kendren. I have work to do.

strings.string: 请恕我失陪，肯德伦。我还有活要做。

string.ID: Live and drink, kendren. I am very busy.

strings.string: 生而饮水，肯德伦。我很忙。

string.ID: You're... kendren...

strings.string: 你是……肯德伦……

string.ID: Please don't hurt me.

strings.string: 请别伤害我。

string.ID: Ah... uhm. I... you, ah.

strings.string: 啊……呃。我……你，啊。

strings.string: {{emote|*那名欣德伦睁大眼睛盯着你*}}

string.ID: Kendren! Kendren! Tell us a story of the world outside when Grand-Doe is not listening!

strings.string: 肯德伦！肯德伦！趁大母鹿没听见，给我们讲个外面世界的故事吧！

string.ID: Um. Live and drink, kendren.

strings.string: 呃。生而饮水，肯德伦。

string.ID: Is it true that all kendren kill one another for sport?

strings.string: 所有肯德伦真的都会为了取乐互相残杀吗？

string.ID: Is it true that you kendren eat your dead?

strings.string: 你们肯德伦真的会吃自己的死人吗？

string.ID: Is it true that there are bears covered in quills to the east?

strings.string: 东方真的有浑身长刺的熊吗？

string.ID: Is it true that bears live to be a thousand years old?

strings.string: 熊真的能活一千年吗？

string.ID: Is it true that boars can shoot fire?

strings.string: 野猪真的会喷火吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren can't fall in love?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的不会坠入爱河吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren elders grow eyes upon their hands?

strings.string: 肯德伦长老真的会在手上长眼睛吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren pay for goods with crayons rather than water?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的不用水，而是用蜡笔买东西吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren worship rocks?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的崇拜石头吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren spend hours looking at slabs of wood?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的会花好几个小时盯着木板看吗？

string.ID: Is it true that nine out of ten kendren cannot speak or understand language?

strings.string: 十个肯德伦里真的有九个不会说话也听不懂语言吗？

string.ID: Is it true that instead of dying, kendren are frozen in tubes?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的不是死亡，而是被冻在管子里吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren children are thrown out of the nest right after being born?

strings.string: 肯德伦小孩真的一出生就被扔出巢吗？

string.ID: Is it true that all kendren say 'quetzal' when they are happy?

strings.string: 所有肯德伦高兴时真的都会说“格查尔”吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren chefs can fry water?

strings.string: 肯德伦厨师真的能煎水吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren all live far underground?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的全都住在很深的地下吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren live in great bubbles?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的住在巨大泡泡里吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren sleep in a snarcomfagus?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的睡在“瞌睡棺”里吗？

string.ID: Is there really a King of the Moon, kendren?

strings.string: 真的有月亮之王吗，肯德伦？

string.ID: I heard from my friend who heard it from their yma that the Grand-Doe says that hindren who leave Bey Lah grow an extra pair of arms. And the Grand-Doe says it so you know it's true.

strings.string: 我听朋友说，他是从他的伊玛那里听来的：大母鹿说，离开贝拉的欣德伦会多长出一对手臂。大母鹿都这么说了，所以你知道这肯定是真的。

string.ID: Is it true that when kendren eat mah lah soup, they explode?!

strings.string: 肯德伦吃玛拉汤时真的会爆炸吗？！

string.ID: Is it true that... um, oh. I forgot.

strings.string: 是真的吗……呃，哦。我忘了。

string.ID: Is it true that kendren don't have to ask permission to do the water ritual?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的不用请求许可就能举行饮水仪式吗？

string.ID: Is it true that you don't have a Grand-Doe?

strings.string: 你们真的没有大母鹿吗？

string.ID: How do kendren stay safe when you don't have a Grand-Doe to protect you?

strings.string: 没有大母鹿保护你们，肯德伦怎么保持安全？

string.ID: Um, kendren, does the yempuris phi really exist? Is it really coming to get us?

strings.string: 呃，肯德伦，yempuris phi 真的存在吗？它真的会来抓我们吗？

string.ID: Do you have glotrot? Do you have ironshank? Do you have funglefection? Have you ever had them? Is it gross? Can I see?

strings.string: 你有舌腐病吗？你有铁胫病吗？你有真菌感染吗？你得过它们吗？恶心吗？我能看看吗？

string.ID: Is it true that kendren sometimes die of cooking too hard?

strings.string: 肯德伦真的有时候会因为烹饪太用力而死吗？

string.ID: Kendren! Kendren! Take me with you! I want to see the Sixty Stilts!

strings.string: 肯德伦！肯德伦！带我一起走！我想看看六十高跷！

string.ID: I am busy. Live and drink, little one.

strings.string: 我很忙。生而饮水，小家伙。

string.ID: YOU ARE OF NO INTEREST.

strings.string: 你不值得关注。

string.ID: I'm watching you, traveler.

strings.string: 我盯着你呢，旅人。

string.ID: {{emote|*stares blankly*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*茫然地凝视着*}}

string.ID: Did I do well, Newfather?

strings.string: 我做得好吗，新父？

string.ID: Newfather! Look!

strings.string: 新父！看！

string.ID: Are you proud, Newfather?

strings.string: 你骄傲吗，新父？
新父！

string.ID: {{emote|*Out of an oculus pours a scanning cone of mosaic light. It's unclear if they regard you as an interloper, but they take no aggressive action.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一束马赛克般的扫描光锥从一只目镜中倾泻而出。你不清楚他们是否把你视作闯入者，但他们没有采取攻击行动。*}}

string.ID: Live and... remain ever rustless.

strings.string: 长生……永不锈蚀。

string.ID: Traveler. Put down your mangled trinkets and I'll repair them.

strings.string: 旅人。把你那些破损的小玩意放下，我会修好它们。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Tell me about this ancient village.

strings.string: 跟我说说这个古老村庄。

string.ID: Who is the man camped near the graveyard?

strings.string: 在墓地附近扎营的那个人是谁？

string.ID: What do you think of the plant you share this building with?

strings.string: 你怎么看和你共用这栋建筑的那株植物？

string.ID: Live and drink, tinker.

strings.string: 生而饮水，修匠。

string.ID:
{{emote|*She gives you a hard stare.*}}
I am a Daughter of Exile, but you should call me Yla Haj.

strings.string:
{{emote|*她冷冷地盯着你。*}}
我是流亡之女，但你该叫我伊拉·哈吉。

string.ID: Daughter of Exile?

strings.string: 流亡之女？

string.ID:
Tinker-nuns. The world sees fit to call us that, my sisters and me.
Do you know the story told of Rebekah the Exile? She was a teacher to Resheph, but he excommunicated her from the sultanate and banished her from the realm.
To know her, I've chosen a life of unbelonging. And among my sisters, I have the honor of permanent residence by her gravesite.
I'll tell you this, traveler: the shape of a society is visible only from the outside, and there is peace beyond a boundary.

strings.string:
修匠修女。世人觉得该这样称呼我们，称呼我和我的姐妹们。
你知道关于流亡者利百加的故事吗？她曾是瑞谢夫的老师，但他将她逐出苏丹国，也从疆域中放逐了她。
为了认识她，我选择了一种无所归属的生活。而在我的姐妹当中，我有幸能常驻在她的墓旁。
我告诉你吧，旅人：一个社会的形状，唯有从外部才能看清；界线之外，也有宁静。

string.ID: Wasn't Rebekah a healer? Why are you an order of tinkers?

strings.string: 利百加不是医者吗？为什么你们会是修匠修会？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Yla Haj pauses.*}}
You presume too narrow a meaning of "health".

strings.string:
{{emote|*伊拉·哈吉停顿了一下。*}}
你对“健康”一词的理解太狭窄了。

string.ID:
Ezra sits in the shadow of history, where small things grow. It's the moss beneath the statue, quite literally. For centuries monarchs concerned themselves with felling trees, and now of the Covenate only Ezra remains.
It's home to Rebekah's gravesite, so for the Daughters, it is a sacred place. You may notice more of us on pilgrimage.

strings.string:
埃兹拉坐落在历史的阴影里，小事物在这里生长。它确确实实就是雕像脚下的苔藓。几个世纪以来，君王们只顾着砍伐树木，如今盟会时代只剩下埃兹拉。
这里是利百加墓地所在，所以对流亡之女而言，这是圣地。你也许会注意到更多前来朝圣的姐妹。

string.ID:
Zothom. I don't see utility in unkindness, but he's a fool. Were it that proximity to meekness made one meek...
I have no use for a man who seeks salvation in the body of a dead woman.

strings.string:
佐索姆。我看不出刻薄有什么用，但他是个蠢人。要是靠近温顺之人就能让人变得温顺……
我用不着一个在死去女人的身体里寻找救赎的男人。

string.ID: I don't.

strings.string: 我不怎么看。

string.ID:
Live and drink, wayfarer.
Cause no strife here and we will have no quarrel.

strings.string:
生而饮水，路客。
不要在这里挑起纷争，我们便不会争执。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: You speak like a Warden.

strings.string: 你说话像个守望者。

string.ID: What are you doing here?

strings.string: 你在这里做什么？

string.ID:
I am no one of any importance.
But my name is Zothom, and some call me the Penitent.

strings.string:
我不是任何重要人物。
但我的名字是佐索姆，有些人称我为忏悔者。
忏悔者？

string.ID: You speak like a Warden.

strings.string: 你说话像个守望者。

string.ID: What are you doing here?

strings.string: 你在这里做什么？

string.ID: I am no Warden. My only fellowship is with my own shame.

strings.string: 我不是守望者。我唯一的同伴是自己的羞愧。

string.ID: Why are you ashamed?

strings.string: 你为何羞愧？

string.ID: My name is =name=. What is yours?

strings.string: 我的名字是 =name=。你叫什么？

string.ID: What are you doing here?

strings.string: 你在这里做什么？

string.ID: I watch over the Grave of Rebekah to atone for my deeds, and to find my credo.

strings.string: 我守望利百加之墓，以偿还我的所作所为，也为了寻找我的信条。

string.ID: Who is Rebekah?

strings.string: 利百加是谁？

string.ID: Your deeds?

strings.string: 你的所作所为？

string.ID: Your credo?

strings.string: 你的信条？

string.ID: Are you a Warden?

strings.string: 你是守望者吗？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID:
I was once a vile graverobber, the lowest of the low. Years ago I sought to plunder the Tomb of the Eaters, and set off to do so with a pair of confederates. I watched both of them die, slain by ancient artifice and entombed with the ancient dead.
I would have shared their fate, but for a coterie of mopango nesting in the catacombs. They kept me safe and fed me while I treated my wounds. It is in their honor that I seek a credo now.

strings.string:
我曾是卑劣的盗墓贼，低贱者中的最低贱者。多年前，我想掠夺食者之墓，便和两名同伙一同出发。我眼看着他们双双死去，被古老造物杀死，和古代死者一起埋葬。
若不是一群在地下墓穴筑巢的莫潘戈，我本会和他们命运相同。他们在我疗伤时保护我、供养我。正是为了向他们致敬，我如今才寻求一条信条。
莫潘戈？
信条？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

strings.string: 生而饮水，忏悔者。

string.ID: Is your motivation just?

strings.string: 你的动机正当吗？
是。
不。

string.ID:
Only those who pay their respects to the Grave of Rebekah will know the way into the tomb.
If you make it inside, the mopango will offer you solace and knowledge, and can tell you more about the Tomb's contents.

strings.string:
只有向利百加之墓致敬的人，才会知道进入墓中的道路。
如果你能进去，莫潘戈会给你慰藉与知识，也能告诉你更多关于墓中事物的情况。

string.ID: Who is Rebekah?

strings.string: 利百加是谁？

string.ID: The mopango?

strings.string: 莫潘戈？

string.ID: Can't you tell me anything else?

strings.string: 你不能再告诉我点别的吗？

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会的。生而饮水。

string.ID: May you share my fate, then.

strings.string: 那么，愿你与我同命。

string.ID: Tell me how to get in anyway.

strings.string: 无论如何，告诉我怎么进去。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 再看吧。生而饮水。
不能。

string.ID: Tell me about the mopango, then.

strings.string: 那就跟我说说莫潘戈。
好吧。

string.ID:
Yes. It is a rite of passage for the mopango people: a statement that inspires contemplation, discussion, and thought. An ideal credo has no single explanation or interpretation and is meant to inspire contemplation in those who hear it. For this reason, it is considered rude among mopango to ask the meaning of a credo.
Someday I will find mine.

strings.string:
是的。那是莫潘戈人的成年仪式：一句能激发沉思、讨论与思考的话。理想的信条没有单一解释或阐释，它的本意就是让听见它的人陷入沉思。因此，在莫潘戈之间询问信条的含义会被视为失礼。
终有一天，我会找到属于我的信条。

string.ID: Who are the mopango?

strings.string: 莫潘戈是什么人？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者之墓。

string.ID:
Mopango are plated, digging creatures whose armor scales glow a pale white. They are contemplative, sociable, and mostly peaceful. They commune with ancient objects, which is why a coterie of their kind lives in the Tomb of the Eaters.
They are patient even with rough-hewn wanderers such as we, but it's still not best to ask one to explain eir credo.

strings.string:
莫潘戈是披甲、善于挖掘的生物，甲鳞泛着淡白色光芒。他们爱沉思、重社交，大多和平。他们能与古物交流，所以才会有一群同族住在食者之墓里。
即便面对我们这样粗糙的游荡者，他们也很有耐心，但最好仍不要请其中一位解释其信条。

string.ID: I'd like to meet these mopango.

strings.string: 我想见见这些莫潘戈。
信条？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

strings.string: 生而饮水，忏悔者。

string.ID:
If you do find =player.reflexive= in the Tomb, the mopango settlement is nestled in the wall of the Northwest Catacombs. The entrance is guarded by a chain turret named Vivira, brightly-painted to distinguish em from eir brethren.
Resist your reflexive urge to fight or flee, as Vivira is friendly and open to parley. If you meet, tell em I sent you.

strings.string:
如果你真的在墓中找到了 =player.reflexive=，莫潘戈聚落就嵌在西北地下墓穴的墙壁里。入口由一座名叫维维拉的链炮塔守卫，身上涂着鲜艳色彩，用以和同类区分。
压住你战斗或逃跑的本能冲动，因为维维拉很友善，也愿意谈判。如果你们见面，告诉维维拉是我派你去的。

string.ID: Speak to a... turret? I suppose I will; live and drink.

strings.string: 和一座……炮塔说话？我想我会的；生而饮水。

string.ID: Speak to a... turret? No thank you; live and drink.

strings.string: 和一座……炮塔说话？不了，谢谢；生而饮水。

string.ID:
Rebekah was a physician, and an advisor to Resheph until she lost his favor. When, after years of exile, she lost her voice and her life, she was buried here, an outsider unfit to be interred with the honored dead. So she rests here.
I believe her proximity will help me find my credo.

strings.string:
利百加是一名医师，也是瑞谢夫的顾问，直到她失去他的恩宠。多年流亡之后，她失去了声音，也失去了生命，于是被葬在这里；她是外人，不配与受尊荣的死者同葬。所以她安息于此。
我相信靠近她会帮助我找到自己的信条。
信条？

string.ID: I need to enter the Tomb of the Eaters.

strings.string: 我需要进入食者之墓。

string.ID: Live and drink, Penitent One.

strings.string: 生而饮水，忏悔者。

string.ID: You are welcome in the village of Ezra, seedling. Sit with me and watch the sun breathe shadows over the day.
