strings.string: 埃兹拉村欢迎你，幼苗。与我同坐吧，看太阳把影子呼吸到白昼之上。

string.ID: You're a tree.

strings.string: 你是一棵树。

string.ID: The carved reliefs here are Eater-ancient. What is the history of this place?

strings.string: 这里的浮雕古老到属于食者时代。这个地方有什么历史？

string.ID: Who is Ezra's warden?

strings.string: 埃兹拉的守望者是谁？

string.ID: Point me toward your merchants.

strings.string: 告诉我你们的商人在哪里。

string.ID: I'm looking for work.

strings.string: 我在找活干。

string.ID: Live and drink, tall friend.

strings.string: 生而饮水，高个朋友。

string.ID: HA. You would fain plant them here, to joggle their fingers at the salt sky alongside the musa?

strings.string: 哈。你愿意把他们栽在这里，让他们和穆萨蕉一起向盐天摇动手指？

string.ID: I would.

strings.string: 我愿意。

string.ID: Lilypad-folk, you say. The slynth, you say. HA..... HA HA HA! Yes! I never thought to see yet fresher thought-sprouts take seed here in Ezra, but our sun is theirs, and the sky below it, and the thickening air down to the ground. Bring them to hear the songs of our musa-herders, and hope that they survive.

strings.string: 睡莲叶之民，你说。斯林思，你说。哈……哈 哈 哈！好！我从未想过还能看见更新鲜的思想嫩芽在埃兹拉扎根，但我们的太阳属于他们，太阳下的天空也属于他们，向下稠厚到地面的空气也属于他们。带他们来听我们的穆萨蕉牧者歌唱吧，并希望他们能活下来。

string.ID: You have my thanks, mayor.

strings.string: 多谢你，村长。

string.ID: Rocky soil fits only so many roots, little walker. Perhaps if yours were more anchored here. HA.

strings.string: 多石的土壤只能容纳这么多根，小小行者。或许等你的根在这里扎得更深些。哈。

string.ID: Tell me of your seedlings.

strings.string: 跟我说说你的幼苗。

string.ID:
It is the good wind that brought the slynth to Ezra.
HA HA HA.
I will watch as these seedlings wilt or thrive.

strings.string:
是好风把斯林思带到了埃兹拉。
哈 哈 哈。
我会看着这些幼苗枯萎，或兴盛。

string.ID: My thanks, Mayor.

strings.string: 谢谢你，村长。

string.ID:
Returning so soon to check on our seedlings?
HA. They grow, eat, sing, and joggle their curious little fingers at the salt sky. See for yourself.

strings.string:
这么快就回来查看我们的幼苗了？
哈。他们生长、进食、歌唱，向盐天摇动好奇的小手指。你自己去看吧。

string.ID: My thanks again, Mayor.

strings.string: 再次感谢，村长。

string.ID:
HA.......
HA HA HA. So I am. I split stone and joggle my fingers at the salt sky. So I do today, so I did yesterday.

strings.string:
哈……
哈 哈 哈。确是如此。我劈开石头，向盐天摇动手指。我今日如此，昨日亦然。

string.ID: How old are you?

strings.string: 你多大年纪？

string.ID: How did you become mayor of this village?

strings.string: 你是怎么成为这个村子的村长的？

string.ID: I'd like to ask you something else.

strings.string: 我想问你别的事。

string.ID: I tally so many autumns, but until I am black with rot, I cannot be ring-right. The etching on my undertrunk places my seed-date to the reign of =sultan:4=, so I am told.

strings.string: 我数过许多秋天，但在我黑腐之前，我无法以年轮定准。有人告诉我，我下干上的刻痕把我的播种之日定在 =sultan:4= 统治时期。

string.ID: Technically, that makes you an Eater, doesn't it?

strings.string: 严格说来，那就让你成了食者，不是吗？

string.ID: HA HA HA. I suppose so.

strings.string: 哈 哈 哈。我想是吧。

string.ID: HA. I stood long enough. I joggled my fingers at the salt sky, and I watched thy seedlings sprout and wither, and I watched thou place stones in straight lines like the bees and their nests of wax. I stood until the stones were nigh by me. The people followed the stones.

strings.string: 哈。我站得够久。我向盐天摇动手指，看着汝等幼苗发芽又枯萎，看着汝等像蜜蜂和它们的蜡巢一样，把石头摆成直线。我一直站着，直到石头靠近了我。人们便跟随着石头。

string.ID:
Ezra is more than tree-old. It's stone-old. Seedlings have lived here since our roots dreamed of joggling their fingers at the salt sky.
They ate earth and belched freight at the stars, and this place was their stomach.
Later, as the Star-Tree died and they buried their dead under its roots, this was their funerary place.
Now, we nurse electric milk from the old and aching temple to turn our wheels and grind our seeds and grains. Now we are they.

strings.string:
埃兹拉不只是树那样古老。它有石头那样古老。自从我们的根还梦想着向盐天摇动手指时，幼苗们就已经住在这里。
他们吞食大地，朝群星嗳出货物，而这里就是他们的胃。
后来，星树死去，他们把死者埋在它的根下，这里便成了他们的葬地。
如今，我们从古老而疼痛的神庙中吮取电之乳，用它转动车轮，磨碎我们的种子与谷粒。如今，我们就是他们。
星树？

string.ID: Aye, the Blue Mother who breaks the sky. Those who Eat called her Gjaus, and those who Wake call her Spindle.

strings.string: 是啊，劈开天空的蓝母。食者称她为贾乌斯，醒者称她为纺锤。

string.ID: One called 1-FF, who wandered in errancy out from the Tomb and was reprogrammed by the Daughter who lived and died in the rot-black box, nine Daughters ago.

strings.string: 一位名叫 1-FF 的存在，曾因迷途而从墓中游荡出来，在九代流亡之女以前，被那位生于黑腐盒中也死于其中的流亡之女重新编程。

string.ID: To the northwest seek the rot-black box. There a plant and Daughter live. There cats of chrome purr at tiny suns.

strings.string: 向西北寻找黑腐盒。那里住着一株植物和一位流亡之女。那里，铬钢之猫对着小小太阳发出呼噜声。

string.ID:
Ezra is old and has long since cut a groove into the world and resides there in stillness and harmony. But Zothom the Penitent One is a seedling, new to the world, and he quakes at all the tensing the world does. Perhaps you can share in his angst.
Go find him by the headstones for the dead.

strings.string:
埃兹拉很古老，早已在世界中刻出一道沟槽，并在其中静止而和谐地居住。但忏悔者佐索姆是一株幼苗，新来到这个世界；世界每一次绷紧，他都会颤抖。或许你可以分担他的焦虑。
去死者墓碑旁找他吧。

string.ID: Oh joy, another meat-being. Please tell me you're here to buy something.

strings.string: 哦，真高兴，又一个肉体生物。拜托告诉我你是来买东西的。

string.ID: I am =name=. You are?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是？

string.ID: You're being a bit rude.

strings.string: 你有点失礼。

string.ID: Is something the matter?

strings.string: 有什么不对吗？

string.ID: I suppose I'll be leaving, then.

strings.string: 那我想我该走了。

string.ID:
I am Sixshrew, a merchant from the Consortium of Phyta disinclined to waste xyr time on talkative strangers.
I sell things, and you can buy them. I would in fact strongly encourage you to buy them, or be on your way.

strings.string:
我是六鼩，来自植群商会的商人，不愿把 xyr 的时间浪费在话多的陌生人身上。
我卖东西，而你可以买。事实上，我强烈鼓励你买，或者赶紧上路。

string.ID: Why are you called Sixshrew?

strings.string: 你为什么叫六鼩？

string.ID: I'll be on my way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我这就上路。生而饮水。

string.ID: Why are you called pest?

strings.string: 你为什么叫害虫？

string.ID: I'm not...

strings.string: 我不是……

string.ID: Because I am a pest?

strings.string: 因为我是害虫？

string.ID:
You are now.
Are you going to buy something, pest?

strings.string:
你现在是了。
你要买东西吗，害虫？

string.ID: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我不用了。生而饮水，失礼的家伙。

string.ID:
Just so.
Would you like to buy something, pest?

strings.string:
正是。
你想买点东西吗，害虫？

string.ID: I'm all set. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我不用了。生而饮水，失礼的家伙。

string.ID:
You're being a bit annoying, so I suppose both of us have our burdens to bear.
Perhaps we should do some trading and move on with our lives, hmm?

strings.string:
你有点烦人，所以我想我们两个都有各自的负担要承受。
也许我们该做点交易，然后继续各过各的日子，嗯？

string.ID: I'll skip to the last part. Live and drink, rude one.

strings.string: 我直接跳到最后一部分吧。生而饮水，失礼的家伙。

string.ID:
Oh, I'm fine, fine.
I simply adore being assigned this stinking backwater musa grove after decades of service, unceremoniously dumped in an office next to a fleshy tinker who works day and night, making all manner of racket through the thinnest, most conductive walls ever crafted.
What is it humans say? "Living the dreen?" Yes, I am living the dreen.

strings.string:
哦，我很好，很好。
我简直太爱这种安排了：服务了几十年之后，被派到这片发臭的偏僻穆萨蕉林，毫无仪式感地扔进一间办公室，隔壁就是个血肉修匠，日夜不停地工作，隔着有史以来最薄、最导声的墙壁制造各种噪音。
人类怎么说来着？“活在霉梦里？”是啊，我就是活在霉梦里。

string.ID: I'll be on my way. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我这就上路。生而饮水。

string.ID: Eat and thrive, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 进食并繁盛吧，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Is life not sweet? Could it be sweeter?

strings.string: 生命难道不甜吗？还能更甜吗？

string.ID: May our lives be as sweet as my harvest, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿我们的生命像我的收成一样甜，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Will you sing and work with me, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你愿意和我一起歌唱、一起劳作吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, it's a long way down, from the reaches of the Spindle to the humble ground...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，路途长又长，从纺锤高处落到谦卑地上……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, banana tree, count the bunches, one-two-three...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，香蕉树，数数果串，一二三……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, how I spend my days, working in the ruins of the ancient place...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，我的日子这样过，在古老地方的废墟里干活……

string.ID: Hey, oh-way, live wild and free, fear not the dacca or the quick adiyys...

strings.string: 嘿，哦喂，活得狂野又自由，不怕达卡，也不怕敏捷阿迪斯……

string.ID: Eat bananas every day to keep your mind quick, but don't eat too many or you might get sick!

strings.string: 每天吃香蕉，头脑转得快；可别吃太多，不然病会来！

string.ID: Oh. Hm?

strings.string: 哦。嗯？

string.ID: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= ready.

strings.string: 如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=准备好了。

string.ID: An =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string: 如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=愿意。

string.ID: Peace, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿你平安，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: By Her Light.

strings.string: 凭祂之光。

string.ID: Her Light shine on you.

strings.string: 愿祂之光照耀你。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= business with me?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:尔等有:汝有=事找我吗？

string.ID: Humble before Her we walk.

strings.string: 我们在她面前谦卑而行。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Will ye:Wilt thou=, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:尔等愿意:汝愿意=吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: May Her Light guide =ifplayerplural:your:thy= steps, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 愿祂之光指引=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的脚步，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Live and drink by Her Light.

strings.string: 沐于祂光，生而饮水。

string.ID: Are you Vivira? Zothom sent me.

strings.string: 你是维维拉吗？佐索姆派我来的。

string.ID: You are friendlier than most turrets.

strings.string: 你比大多数炮塔友善。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Farewell, Lightspitter.

strings.string: 再会，吐光者。

string.ID:
{{emote|*crackle, crackle*}}-othom? My sympathies.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= of course welcome here, wayfarer. Speak to Agyra an =ifplayerplural:ye need:thou needest= aught, as ey delighteth in hospitality.

strings.string:
{{emote|*噼啪，噼啪*}}——索姆？请节哀。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=当然受这里欢迎，路客。如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=有所需，便去找阿吉拉说话，因为阿吉拉乐于待客。

string.ID: Why are you offering me sympathies?

strings.string: 你为什么向我致哀？

string.ID: What is "here"?

strings.string: “这里”是什么地方？

string.ID: You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.

strings.string: 你比我遇到的大多数炮塔好多了。

string.ID: I see. Farewell.

strings.string: 我明白了。再会。

string.ID: You're rather civil for a turret.

strings.string: 作为炮塔，你相当有礼貌。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 长生，永不锈蚀，维维拉。

string.ID:
So I am told. I have never had the pleasure nor displeasure to meet another turret. I know only my friends here, who uplifted me by chance and cared for me by choice.
Wer't not for my shape, I wouldst be little different from other mopango.

strings.string:
大家都这么告诉我。我从未有幸或不幸见过另一座炮塔。我只认识这里的朋友，他们因偶然抬升了我，又出于选择照料我。
若不是我的形体，我和其他莫潘戈并无太大不同。

string.ID: What is "here"?

strings.string: “这里”是什么地方？

string.ID: What are mopango?

strings.string: 莫潘戈是什么人？

string.ID: I see. Farewell.

strings.string: 我明白了。再会。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye know:Thou knowest= surely that this is the Tomb of the Eaters, but behind me lieth nestled a settlement occupied by the watchers of the tomb, a small coterie of mopango.
An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= know more of the settlement, =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must ask the watcher named Agyra residing within. Ey loveth the sharing of knowledge.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=想必知道，这里是食者之墓，但在我身后，安卧着一处由墓之守望者居住的聚落，一小群莫潘戈。
如果=ifplayerplural:尔等想:汝想=了解聚落更多事，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=必须去问住在里面、名叫阿吉拉的守望者。阿吉拉喜爱分享知识。

string.ID: You're much nicer than most turrets I meet.

strings.string: 你比我遇到的大多数炮塔好多了。

string.ID: What are mopango?

strings.string: 莫潘戈是什么人？

string.ID: I see. Farewell.

strings.string: 我明白了。再会。

string.ID:
Mopango are witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. We seek peace and harmony through understanding the Kasaphescence and Her many children. We nonetheless eschew conformity, and each of us seeketh a personal credo by which we livest our lives.
But I am a poor teacher. Speak to Agyra, and =ifplayerplural:ye shall:thou shalt= gain better understanding.

strings.string:
莫潘戈是过去的见证者，也是未来的牧者。我们通过理解卡萨辉体与她的众多子嗣来寻求和平与和谐。尽管如此，我们也避开一致化，每个人都寻找一条个人信条，并依其生活。
但我不是好老师。去和阿吉拉说话，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=会获得更好的理解。

string.ID: Do you have a personal credo?

strings.string: 你有个人信条吗？

string.ID: I thank you. Farewell.

strings.string: 谢谢你。再会。

string.ID:
I do.
"Form needeth not follow function."

strings.string:
我有。
“形式不必追随功能。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: You're very thoughtful, as turrets go.

strings.string: 就炮塔而言，你很有思想。

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 长生，永不锈蚀，维维拉。

string.ID:
{{emote|*BEEP*}}
Credos hath no inherent meaning that one may so simply define. So =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest=: asking the meaning of a credo is considered impolite among mopango.

strings.string:
{{emote|*哔*}}
信条没有可由他人如此简单界定的固有含义。所以=ifplayerplural:尔等知道:汝知道=：询问信条的含义，在莫潘戈之间会被视为失礼。

string.ID: I apologize.

strings.string: 我道歉。

string.ID: That's ridiculous.

strings.string: 这太荒谬了。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID: All is forgiven, =player.formalAddressTerm=. I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string: 一切都被宽恕了，=player.formalAddressTerm=。我并未因=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=而动怒。

string.ID: You're rather civil for a turret.

strings.string: 作为炮塔，你相当有礼貌。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Live and remain rustless, Vivira.

strings.string: 长生，永不锈蚀，维维拉。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
If Nacham is as wise as Doyoba believes, we stand to learn much very soon. Perhaps our coterie will spread the knowledge we gain, and we become a step closer to the Kasaphescence.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异存在已被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=给了其中一位声音。
若纳查姆如多约巴所相信的那样智慧，我们很快就能学到许多。或许我们的同修群会传播我们获得的知识，而我们也将离卡萨辉体更近一步。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=随时都受欢迎来访，并在此停留，只要=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=愿意。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。生而饮水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
I cannot help but hold some fear toward Dagasha. However, an it means us no harm I am open to allying with it. No doubt the future of this coterie hath changed, mayhap for the better.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异存在已被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=给了其中一位声音。
我免不了对达迦莎怀有些许恐惧。然而，若它对我们并无恶意，我愿意与它结盟。毫无疑问，这个同修群的未来已经改变，也许会变得更好。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=随时都受欢迎来访，并在此停留，只要=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=愿意。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。生而饮水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
That said, I am uncertain what changes to expect. Dost the ancient Va'am yet have the capacity to defend, or protect? Can we gift it with a better means for transportation? I'll speak to Dadogom of this, and time shall reveal all.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异存在已被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=给了其中一位声音。
话虽如此，我不确定该期待怎样的改变。古老的瓦姆是否仍有防御或保护的能力？我们能否赠予它更好的移动方式？我会与达多戈姆谈谈此事，时间会揭示一切。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=随时都受欢迎来访，并在此停留，只要=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=愿意。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。生而饮水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= changed the world, =factionaddress:Mopango=. These strange beings have been confined for thousands of years, and =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= given one a voice.
I find myself amused at Kah's 'rest', for it appeareth as active as ever--far more so than I, ever. But running free and running unwillingly are certainly not the same. Perhaps, in time, it can learn a deeper rest from us.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome to visit and stay here whenever =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=改变了世界，=factionaddress:Mopango=。这些奇异存在已被禁锢了数千年，而=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=给了其中一位声音。
我发现自己被卡的“休息”逗乐了，因为它看起来仍和从前一样活跃，比我任何时候都活跃得多。但自由地奔跑与被迫地奔跑当然不是一回事。也许假以时日，它能从我们这里学会更深的休息。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=随时都受欢迎来访，并在此停留，只要=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=愿意。

string.ID: Thank you, Agyra. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome here.
An =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= any questions, I would fain answer them.

strings.string:
问候汝，=player.formalAddressTerm=。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=在这里受欢迎。
如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=有任何问题，我愿意回答。

string.ID: What can you tell me of k-Goninon?

strings.string: 关于 k-戈尼农，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: I have recovered a repulsive device.

strings.string: 我找回了一个排斥装置。

string.ID: Greetings. I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 问候你。我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 这里由你负责吗？

string.ID: This settlement is... cozy.

strings.string: 这个聚落……很紧凑。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 跟我说说你的族人。

string.ID: Live and drink, plated one.

strings.string: 生而饮水，披甲者。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= press these slynth into the fissures of historic stone where we reside, that they may observe what we do?

strings.string: =ifplayerplural:尔等愿意:汝愿意=把这些斯林思压入我们所居历史石缝之中，让他们观察我们所做之事吗？

string.ID: I would.

strings.string: 我愿意。

string.ID: If these slynth wish to become mopango and =ifplayerplural:ye speak:thou speakest= for them, then we shall accept them. Let them gaze into the schematics that wrote history beside us if they so choose.

strings.string: 如果这些斯林思想成为莫潘戈，而=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=能代表他们发言，那么我们会接纳他们。如果他们愿意，就让他们在我们身旁凝视那些书写历史的图式。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Agyra.

strings.string: 多谢你，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
Please understand that we mean no slight to =ifplayerplural:you:thee= in saying so, but what =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= of us is too heavy a weight for =ifplayerplural:your names:thy name= to bear.
Perhaps this will change, come deed and time.

strings.string:
请理解，我们这么说并无意轻视=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，但=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=向我们请求之事太过沉重，非=ifplayerplural:尔等的名号:汝之名号=所能承载。
也许随着行为与时间到来，这会有所改变。

string.ID:
How =ifplayerplural:fare ye:farest thou=, then, and what word of the slynth?
We shine with curiosity to hear it.

strings.string:
那么，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=近来如何，斯林思又有什么消息？
我们因好奇而发光，想要听见它。

string.ID:
The Kasaphescence shine upon =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=.
Although the welcome of these slynth be not entirely without incident, I am yet hopeful that their curiosity and dedication to tasks will serve them well among us.

strings.string:
愿卡萨辉体照耀=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，=name=。
虽然接纳这些斯林思并非全无波折，我仍希望他们的好奇心和对任务的专注能让他们在我们之中顺利生活。

string.ID: My thanks, Agyra.

strings.string: 谢谢你，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
These lilypad folk fascinate by their similarities and differences to us alike--we have much to explore, as individuals and together.
The experiences and beings =ifplayerplural:ye herald:thou heraldest= overwhelm this humble pilgrim, =name=. May =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= bathe ever in Her light.

strings.string:
这些睡莲叶之民因与我们的相似和差异同样令人着迷——作为个体，也作为共同体，我们有许多可以探索。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=所预示的经历与存在让这位谦卑朝圣者不胜承受，=name=。愿=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=永浴祂光。

string.ID: My thanks again, Agyra.

strings.string: 再次感谢，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
Oh, so =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast=, and what a sight. Please forgive my distance, but I am loath to touch it.
It appeareth of similar make to the children, and I believe its jaw seeketh them. Lebah claimeth that the device grants freedom, and I wonder what that freedom will look like. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= speak to the watchers of the children for further insight.

strings.string:
哦，原来=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=找到了，真是奇景。请原谅我保持距离，但我不愿触碰它。
它看起来与那些孩子造法相似，而我相信它的颚在寻找他们。利巴声称这装置能赐予自由，我想知道那自由会是什么模样。也许=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=应该去和孩子们的守望者谈谈，以获得更深的洞见。

string.ID: Understood. Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 明白了。生而饮水，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Seek-ye:Seekest-thou= the repulsive device, then?
k-Goninon, ancient and venerated gelatinous cupola, doth patrol the catacombs. Arrived centuries ere we discovered this place, k-Goninon hath hardened and eateth not through the floor, and yet it eateth prodigiously. Safe from the conservators, as k-Goninon long ago consumed the Mark of Death itself.
Please be careful. k-Goninon hath devoured watchers and wouldst devour =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:尔等是在寻找:汝是在寻找=那个排斥装置吗？
k-戈尼农，古老而受尊崇的凝胶穹顶，巡行于地下墓穴。早在我们发现此地数个世纪前，k-戈尼农便已抵达；它已经硬化，不会吃穿地板，却仍食量惊人。它不受保存者威胁，因为 k-戈尼农很久以前就吞噬了死亡印记本身。
请小心。k-戈尼农吞食过守望者，也会吞食=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。

string.ID: I will be careful. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会小心。生而饮水。

string.ID: I am Agyra, a watcher of the tomb.

strings.string: 我是阿吉拉，墓之守望者。

string.ID: May I call you man, woman, or something else?

strings.string: 我该称你为男人、女人，还是别的什么？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 这里由你负责吗？

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 你们这里很紧凑。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 跟我说说你的族人。

string.ID: Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 生而饮水，阿吉拉。

string.ID:
I hope it is not overly crowded for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. We mopango are most comfortable in close quarters, but I acknowledge that not all creatures adore the close embrace of the depths as we do.
Regardless, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= welcome to stay and sup, and ask of me any questions =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= have.

strings.string:
我希望这里对=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=来说不算太拥挤。我们莫潘戈在狭近空间里最为舒适，但我承认，并非所有生物都像我们一样喜爱深处的贴身拥抱。
无论如何，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=都欢迎留下用餐，并向我询问=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=可能有的任何问题。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 这里由你负责吗？

string.ID: This settlement is... cozy.

strings.string: 这个聚落……很紧凑。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 跟我说说你的族人。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID:
No one leadeth us. We mopango hold little regard for hierarchy, and our shared decisions are made through discussion, quiet consideration, and consensus.
Shouldst be otherwise?

strings.string:
无人领导我们。我们莫潘戈不太看重等级，我们共同的决定通过讨论、静思与共识作出。
难道应当不是这样吗？

string.ID: I suppose not.

strings.string: 我想不是。

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 你们这里很紧凑。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 跟我说说你的族人。

string.ID: Live and drink, Agyra.

strings.string: 生而饮水，阿吉拉。

string.ID: {{emote|*Agyra smiles at you, glowing softly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*阿吉拉对你微笑，柔和地发着光。*}}

string.ID: It's a cozy home you have here.

strings.string: 你们这里很紧凑。

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID: Tell me about your people.

strings.string: 跟我说说你的族人。

string.ID: I should take my leave. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该告辞了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
We are mopango: witnesses of the past and shepherds of the future. The Sacred Light of the Kasaphescence shineth within us, and we commune with relics of antiquity to maintain our humility and grow our wisdom.
We believe that one day, with enough knowledge, anyone who seeketh the Light shalt find it within emself. In the meantime, we work to become better and brighter as each one of us findeth a personal credo by which to live.

strings.string:
我们是莫潘戈：过去的见证者，未来的牧者。卡萨辉体的圣光在我们之内闪耀，我们与古代遗物交流，以维持谦卑并增长智慧。
我们相信终有一天，只要拥有足够知识，任何寻求光者都将在 emself——也就是其自身——之中找到它。在此之前，我们努力变得更好、更明亮，而我们每个人都寻找一条赖以生活的个人信条。
“emself”是什么意思？
信条？

string.ID: Why do you speak so strangely?

strings.string: 你为什么说话这么奇怪？

string.ID: Why do some of you have wheels?

strings.string: 为什么你们有些人装着轮子？

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID:
Aye. Ey, em, eir, eirs, emself. Thusly do we call ourselves and one another.
Sex is personal and mattereth not to a bare acquaintence. Gender is a societal relic in which we see no current utility.

strings.string:
是的。Ey、em、eir、eirs、emself，是我们用来称呼自己与彼此的一套代词。
生理性别是私事，泛泛之交不必知晓。社会性别则是一种社会遗物，我们认为它如今已没有实际用途。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: Oh. Live and drink.

strings.string: 哦。生而饮水。

string.ID:
The Tomb of the Eaters consisteth of twelve strata, or ten, once =ifplayerplural:ye account:thou accounteth= for transitional levels: the Folk Catacombs (in which =ifplayerplural:ye currently stand:thou currently standeth=), the Crematory and Columbarium, the Two Crypts, and the Six Tombs of Qud's Sultans above.
An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest= fortune here, gird =ifplayerplural:thyselves:thyself= for disappointment. The tomb playeth host to objects wondrous and profane alike, but little of what surface-dwellers considereth treasure.

strings.string:
食者之墓由十二层组成；如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=把过渡层也算进去，则是十层：民众地下墓穴（=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=如今正站在其中）、火葬场与骨灰龛、两座墓室，以及上方库德诸苏丹的六座陵墓。
如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=在此寻求财富，那就准备好失望吧。墓中容纳着奇异而亵渎的物件，但地表居民所认为的宝藏却很少。

string.ID: 'Wondrous and profane?' Now I'm curious.

strings.string: “奇异而亵渎”？现在我好奇了。

string.ID: I see. I have further questions.

strings.string: 我明白了。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: I thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Aye. One's own credo shouldst inspire reflection and thought, with no clear-cut meaning but meaning nonetheless. Some of our coterie yet seeketh theirs, but an experienced watcher no doubt hath one. Any mopango who hath a credo wilt share it with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, an =ifplayerplural:ye request:thou requesteth= it.
My credo is: "Malice alone staineth the sanctity of questioning."

strings.string:
是的。一个人的信条应当激发反思与思想；它没有清晰确定的含义，却仍有含义。我们同修群中有些人仍在寻找自己的信条，但有经验的守望者无疑已有其一。任何拥有信条的莫潘戈都会与=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=分享，只要=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=请求。
我的信条是：“唯有恶意玷污提问的神圣。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: I have further questions.

strings.string: 我还有别的问题。

string.ID: I will ponder this. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会思考这句话。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I cannot simply explain my credo to =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. A credo informeth and confoundeth at once, and must be reflected upon by the listener.
=ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= inexperienced in our ways, so please bear my words in the kind spirit they are meant: to ask a mopango to explain eir credo is to commit one of our few taboo acts. Be advised.

strings.string:
我不能简单地向=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=解释我的信条。信条既启示也困惑，必须由听者自行反思。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=对我们的道路尚不熟悉，所以请以善意理解我的话：要求莫潘戈解释自己的信条，是触犯我们少数禁忌之一。请记住。

string.ID: Hmm. I have further questions.

strings.string: 嗯。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Why do we speak strangely? Why =ifplayerplural:do ye:dost thou= speak strangely?
Is not all speech strange?

strings.string:
为什么我们说话奇怪？为什么=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=说话奇怪？
难道所有言语不都奇怪吗？

string.ID: Hmm. I have further questions.

strings.string: 嗯。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID: Maladies of the bone are not uncommon in our people. We build devices to assist friends who wouldst otherwise struggle to walk.

strings.string: 骨骼病症在我们族人中并不罕见。我们建造装置，帮助那些否则会难以行走的朋友。

string.ID: Ah. I have further questions.

strings.string: 啊。我还有别的问题。

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID: Answering =ifplayerplural:your:thy= questions giveth me satisfaction. Asketh an =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt=.

strings.string: 回答=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的问题令我满足。如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=愿意，便问吧。

string.ID: May I have your name?

strings.string: 我可以知道你的名字吗？

string.ID: Are you in charge here?

strings.string: 这里由你负责吗？

string.ID: Isn't this settlement a bit cramped?

strings.string: 这个聚落是不是有点挤？

string.ID: What do you know about the Tomb?

strings.string: 你对墓了解多少？

string.ID: May I know more about the mopango?

strings.string: 我能多了解一些莫潘戈吗？

string.ID: Never mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 算了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I admire =ifplayerplural:your:thy= curiosity and hope =ifplayerplural:your:thy= prudence informeth it.
I have an example at hand. Mere days ago, one of our coterie named Lebah happened upon a repulsive device. Ey was so shaken after attempting communion with the object that ey hath spent less time away from eir nook than ever.

strings.string:
我钦佩=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的好奇心，也希望=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的谨慎能引导它。
我手边就有一个例子。就在几天前，我们同修群中一位名叫利巴的成员偶然发现了一个排斥装置。利巴试图与那物件交流后大受震动，从那以后便很少离开自己的小窝。

string.ID: Where may I find Lebah? I wish to know more.

strings.string: 我在哪里能找到利巴？我想知道更多。

string.ID: I see. May I ask about something else?

strings.string: 我明白了。我可以问些别的吗？

string.ID:
Our little sanctuary here hath a fissure in its inner walls. Find that gap and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= find Lebah.
Please be gentle. Ey hath ever been the most insightful reader among us, but beareth the weight of an anxious mind.

strings.string:
我们这处小小圣所的内墙上有一道裂隙。找到那道缝，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=就会找到利巴。
请温柔些。利巴一直是我们之中最有洞见的读取者，却承受着焦虑心灵的重负。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会的。生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*The little watcher stares at you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*小小守望者盯着你。*}}

string.ID: Look, Lebah. I have recovered the repulsive device.

strings.string: 看，利巴。我找回了排斥装置。
你好？

string.ID: Live and drink, quiet one.

strings.string: 生而饮水，安静者。

string.ID: ... aye.
Agyra tells me you found some kind of repulsive device.

strings.string: 阿吉拉告诉我，你发现了某种排斥装置。

string.ID: Where is the repulsive device, again?

strings.string: 那个排斥装置现在在哪里来着？

string.ID: I have freed one of the children.

strings.string: 我释放了其中一个孩子。

string.ID: I am =name=. What is your name?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你叫什么？

string.ID: What is your credo?

strings.string: 你的信条是什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, quiet one.

strings.string: 生而饮水，安静者。
啊。

string.ID: That's all you have to say?

strings.string: 你就只说这个？
是？

string.ID: I barely survived and all you can say is 'ah' and 'yes'?

strings.string: 我差点没活下来，你就只会说“啊”和“是”？

string.ID: Fair enough. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah curls into an armored ball and stops responding to your questions.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*利巴蜷成一颗披甲的球，不再回应你的问题。*}}

string.ID: Lebah, do not ignore me.

strings.string: 利巴，别无视我。

string.ID: Fine. Live and drink.

strings.string: 好吧。生而饮水。
利巴。

string.ID: What is your credo?

strings.string: 你的信条是什么？

string.ID: Live and drink, Lebah.

strings.string: 生而饮水，利巴。

string.ID: "An thou art swallowed by the Gyre, sing thee to the last."

strings.string: “若汝被轮回吞没，便歌唱至最后。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: What is your name?

strings.string: 你叫什么？

string.ID: The meaning is plain: An =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= swallowed by the Gyre, =ifplayerplural:ye should:thou shouldst= sing to the last.

strings.string: 含义很明白：如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=被轮回吞没，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=就该歌唱至最后。

string.ID: I don't understand.

strings.string: 我不明白。

string.ID: Can you explain further?

strings.string: 你能进一步解释吗？

string.ID: That was not so much an explanation as it was a rephrasing.

strings.string: 那与其说是解释，不如说只是换了个说法。

string.ID: I... see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我……明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah stares at you wordlessly.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*利巴一言不发地盯着你。*}}

string.ID: I should go.

strings.string: 我该走了。

string.ID:
Ah,
aye.
a most repulsive device. The mind-echoes of that communion yet haunteth me.

strings.string:
啊，
是。
极其排斥的装置。那次交流的心灵回声仍纠缠着我。

string.ID: What was so bad about the device?

strings.string: 那个装置到底糟在哪里？

string.ID: I will trouble you no further, then.

strings.string: 那我就不再打扰你了。

string.ID:
Not... the device. Repulsive as a key to a prison doth repulse. To know a key is to know of a prison.
Our watched children are bound, and lock swalloweth key. An =ifplayerplural:ye free:thou freest= one, three remaineth forever.
k-Goninon hath it now. An =ifplayerplural:ye seek:thou seekest=.

strings.string:
不是……装置。排斥，像监狱的钥匙会排斥。知道钥匙，便知道监狱。
我们看守的孩子们被束缚，锁吞下钥匙。如果=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=释放一个，三个便永远留下。
k-戈尼农现在有它。若=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=寻求。

string.ID: Oh, do you mean this thing?

strings.string: 哦，你是说这个东西？

string.ID: I will seek to retrieve it, then.

strings.string: 那我会设法把它取回来。

string.ID: Who or what is k-Goninon?

strings.string: k-戈尼农是谁，或者是什么？

string.ID:
An elder ooze. My communion so disturbed me that I allowed them too close.
k-Goninon consumed the device, but I escaped.

strings.string:
一只年长的软泥怪。那次交流太令我不安，以至于我让 them 靠得太近。
k-戈尼农吞掉了装置，但我逃脱了。

string.ID: I will seek to retrieve it, then.

strings.string: 那我会设法把它取回来。

string.ID: Tell me more about k-Goninon.

strings.string: 告诉我更多关于 k-戈尼农的事。

string.ID:
I concern myself little with oozes but to stay away.
Please, no more. I tire. Talk to Agyra.

strings.string:
我对软泥怪所知不多，只知道要远离。
请别再问了。我累了。去和阿吉拉说话。

string.ID: I thank you.

strings.string: 谢谢你。

string.ID:
k-Goninon hath it.
Ask Agyra.

strings.string:
k-戈尼农有它。
去问阿吉拉。

string.ID: Of course. k-Goninon.

strings.string: 当然。k-戈尼农。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah nods to you, slowly curls into an armored ball, and speaks no further*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*利巴向你点头，慢慢蜷成一颗披甲的球，不再说话*}}

string.ID: Live and drink, little seer.

strings.string: 生而饮水，小先知。

string.ID: {{emote|*Lebah yelps at the sight of the device, curling into an armored ball.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*利巴一看见装置便惊叫起来，蜷成一颗披甲的球。*}}
利巴？

string.ID: Maybe I'll take this somewhere else.

strings.string: 也许我该把这东西带去别处。

string.ID: {{emote|*you receive no reply*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你没有收到回应*}}

string.ID: Let's trade. {{g|[begin trade]}}

strings.string: 我们交易吧。{{g|[开始交易]}}

string.ID: What is your name?

strings.string: 你叫什么？

string.ID: What is your name, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你叫什么，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: What may I call you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 我该怎么称呼你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: What are you called, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 别人怎么称呼你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What is your name?

strings.string: 我是 =name=，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。你叫什么？

string.ID: I am =name=, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=. What may I call you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。我该怎么称呼你？

string.ID: You may call me =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 你可以叫我 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: My name is =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 我的名字是 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: I am called =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 我被称为 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: They call me =subject.refname=.

strings.string: 他们叫我 =subject.refname=。

string.ID: Thank you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 谢谢你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: My thanks, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 多谢你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Pleased to meet you, =pronouns.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 很高兴认识你，=pronouns.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID:
I'm so excited.
Many thanks for releasing Nacham, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I believe that its presence here will provide a great mutual boon.

strings.string:
我太激动了。
非常感谢你释放纳查姆，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我相信它来到这里会带来巨大的互惠恩赐。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不用谢。生而饮水。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, I hear that =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= freed one of the children! I cannot wait to speak to it, but for now I must observe Nacham to see if this event hath affected it. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou art= welcome to watch too.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，我听说=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=释放了其中一个孩子！我迫不及待想和它说话，但现在我必须观察纳查姆，看看此事是否影响了它。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=也欢迎观看。

string.ID: Live and drink, Doyoba.

strings.string: 生而饮水，多约巴。

string.ID: Welcome, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Live and drink. =ifplayerplural:Need ye:Needest thou= a place to rest and sup? =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst= trade?

strings.string: 欢迎，=factionaddress:Mopango=。生而饮水。=ifplayerplural:尔等需要:汝需要=休息和用餐的地方吗？=ifplayerplural:尔等愿意:汝愿意=交易吗？

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在寻找这个排斥装置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你为什么在这里？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信条吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: I am Doyoba, proud watcher of the children of the tomb. One child in particular. Of course =ifplayerplural:ye:thou= must comprehend, 'child' is but a fabricated epithet, as they are far older than we. The children are, that is.

strings.string: 我是多约巴，墓之孩子们自豪的守望者。尤其是某一个孩子。当然，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=必须明白，“孩子”只是人为造出的称谓，因为它们远比我们古老。我是说，那些孩子。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: We mopango watch the past, each of us a different facet. My charge is named Nacham, that which watcheth and understandeth not, that which speaketh and cannot be understood. Information floweth through Nacham as water through a sieve, mixed together beyond ken.

strings.string: 我们莫潘戈守望过去，每个人守望不同的侧面。我负责的对象名叫纳查姆，它观看却不理解，它说话却不可被理解。信息流过纳查姆，如水流过筛子，混杂在一起，超出认知。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
I do.
"Suffering breedeth in still water."

strings.string:
我有。
“苦难滋生于静水。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
...?
=ifplayerplural:Ye ask:Thou askest= after the meaning of my credo. Wouldst I shall chew =ifplayerplural:your:thy= food for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= as well?

strings.string:
……？
=ifplayerplural:尔等在问:汝在问=我的信条是什么意思。难道我还要替=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=咀嚼=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的食物吗？

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我为我的失礼道歉。

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要走了。

string.ID: No, no, =ifplayerplural:ye know:thou knowest= not our ways and I was too harsh. I apologize, and I am not wroth with =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string: 不，不，=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=不了解我们的道路，而我太严厉了。我道歉，我并未因=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=而动怒。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: By Her Light, it's ghastly. May I touch it?

strings.string: 凭祂之光，它真可怕。我可以触碰它吗？

string.ID: You may.

strings.string: 可以。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 不可以。

string.ID:
Oh.
Well then, I suppose I have no insight for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.

strings.string:
哦。
那么，我想我没有什么洞见可给=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Doyoba's face scrunches in pain as ey communes with the device, before finally pushing it back into your grasp*}}
By her light, that was unpleasant. How it twisted and turned, leading me to visions of Nacham's past, scraps and flashes. I can discern only glimpses of significance. Once a creator, an innovator. Can these parts of itself return intact, under the device's influence? An thou sendest void away, hast thou lost a part of thee?

strings.string:
{{emote|*多约巴与装置交流时，脸因痛苦而皱紧，最后才把它推回汝手中*}}
凭祂之光，那真令人不适。它扭曲又翻转，引我看见纳查姆过去的景象，碎片与闪光。我只能辨出几处有意义的掠影。它曾是创造者，革新者。在装置影响下，它自身这些部分能完整回归吗？若汝送走虚空，汝是否失去了自己的一部分？

string.ID: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许我们会知道的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Va'am is released. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done something great, for good or ill.
I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for this new future.

strings.string:
瓦姆被释放了。无论好坏，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=做成了一件伟大的事。
我为这个新的未来感谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。

string.ID: You're welcome. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不用谢。生而饮水。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=. =ifplayerplural:Ye did:Thou didst= rouse a child. Well done.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=确实唤醒了一个孩子。做得好。

string.ID: Thank you. Live and drink, Dadogom.

strings.string: 谢谢。生而饮水，达多戈姆。

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在寻找这个排斥装置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你为什么在这里？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信条吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: I am Dadogom.

strings.string: 我是达多戈姆。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
I watch over Va'am. It watcheth over me. Together, we watch.
=ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= as well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Sit. Watch. Consider how =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= fare under a dome of adamant carapace.
Safe, undying, alone.

strings.string:
我守望瓦姆。它守望我。我们一同守望。
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=也应如此，=factionaddress:Mopango=。坐下。观看。思考=ifplayerplural:你们:你=在精金甲壳的穹顶下会过得如何。
安全，不朽，孤独。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: "Be still and know."

strings.string: “静止，并知晓。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: I cannot think on =ifplayerplural:your:thy= behalf.

strings.string: 我不能替=ifplayerplural:你们:你=思考。

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我为我的失礼道歉。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID: Consider =ifplayerplural:your:thy= words ere =ifplayerplural:ye say:thou sayest= them, and =ifplayerplural:ye will:thou wilt= issue fewer apologies.

strings.string: 在=ifplayerplural:你们:你=说话之前先斟酌=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的话，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=就会少道几次歉。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: Ah. May I?

strings.string: 啊。我可以吗？

string.ID: You may.

strings.string: 可以。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 不可以。

string.ID: Ah, pity.

strings.string: 啊，遗憾。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: Perhaps we will find out. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许我们会知道的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
I hope =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= confident in =ifplayerplural:your:thy= choice, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I am happy with it, to be sure.
Kah is free. It heals my heart to see it at rest. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= my thanks.

strings.string:
我希望=ifplayerplural:你们:你=对=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的选择有信心，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我确实为此高兴。
卡自由了。看见它休息，让我的心痊愈。请接受我的感谢。

string.ID: You're welcome, Gyamyo. Live and drink.

strings.string: 不用谢，伽米约。生而饮水。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Did ye:Didst thou= truly free one of the children? I see =ifplayerplural:ye did:thou didst=. Congratulations.
Wouldst fain see Kah free, one day. I shall have to live a while and find a way.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们真的:你真的=释放了一个孩子吗？我看=ifplayerplural:你们:你=确实做到了。恭喜。
我愿有一天看见卡获得自由。我得继续活上一阵，找到办法。

string.ID: Live and drink, Gyamyo.

strings.string: 生而饮水，伽米约。

string.ID: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, welcome. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= done well to survive so long in this peculiar place.

strings.string: =factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，欢迎。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能在这个奇特地方活这么久，已经做得很好了。

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在寻找这个排斥装置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你为什么在这里？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信条吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
My name is Gyamyo. I am pleased to meet =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, =name=. =ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= spoken to the other watchers? How fare they?
Well, I hope.

strings.string:
我的名字是伽米约。很高兴认识=ifplayerplural:你们:你=，=name=。=ifplayerplural:你们和:你和=其他守望者说过话了吗？他们怎么样？
希望他们都好。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
I have volunteered to monitor an ancient machine-creature called Kah. Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= seen it, skipping hither and yon on strange limbs.
Often I wonder if Kah knoweth aught else but fear.

strings.string:
我自愿监看一台名叫卡的古老机器生物。也许=ifplayerplural:你们:你=见过它，用奇怪的肢体四处跳跃。
我常常想，卡是否还知道恐惧之外的东西。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
I do, and I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for asking after it.
My credo is "Reconciliation without understanding is a salt poultice."

strings.string:
我有，也感谢=ifplayerplural:你们:你=问起它。
我的信条是：“没有理解的和解，是盐敷布。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
Oh dear.
This is the credo by which I live my life, and =ifplayerplural:ye ask:thou asketh= "what does that mean?"
I cannot summarize such a thing for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=. It is too great, too multifaceted.

strings.string:
哎呀。
这是我赖以生活的信条，而=ifplayerplural:你们却问:你却问=“那是什么意思？”
我无法替=ifplayerplural:你们:你=概括这样的东西。它太宏大，太多面。

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我为我的失礼道歉。

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要走了。

string.ID: May the future bear out =ifplayerplural:your:thy= promises.

strings.string: 愿未来证成=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的承诺。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= an object of great interest.
An =ifplayerplural:ye would:thou wouldst= allow, I'd fain commune with it.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=有一件极有趣的物件。
如果=ifplayerplural:你们:你=允许，我愿与它交流。

string.ID: I wouldst.

strings.string: 我愿意。

string.ID: I wouldstn't.

strings.string: 我不愿意。

string.ID: Hm. I wonder at =ifplayerplural:your:thy= decision.

strings.string: 嗯。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的决定令我不解。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Gyamyo moves little during communion, but shivers and twitches from time to time. After a minute or so, ey returns the device to you.*}}
I am shaken. No doubt my journey wast shallow compared to Lebah's dive. But now, by my troth I say: Kah hath ever been a being of motion. Swift, kinetic, and elegant. No doubt 'twould be so if freed by yon device.

strings.string:
{{emote|*伽米约在交流期间几乎不动，但不时颤抖抽搐。约莫一分钟后，伽米约把装置还给了你。*}}
我被震动了。与利巴的深潜相比，我的旅程无疑很浅。但现在，我凭誓言说：卡一直是运动之物。迅捷、有动能、优雅。如果被那装置释放，它无疑也会如此。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我们会看到的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=, =ifplayerplural:ye have:thou hast= done a momentous thing.
I feel the stored energy of Her Light. Dagasha shall shepherd us to our uplifting. =ifplayerplural:Ye should:Thou shouldst= be proud.

strings.string:
=factionaddress:Mopango|capitalize=，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=做成了一件重大的事。
我感受到祂之光储存的能量。达迦莎会牧引我们走向升扬。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=应当自豪。

string.ID: Thank you, Yona. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，约娜。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Ah, =factionaddress:Mopango=, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou'rt= a bittersweet sight. Would fain =ifplayerplural:ye had:thou hadst= chosen Dagasha, but my Light shineth elsewhere.
Still, I hope to see more of =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= in my future. =ifplayerplural:Ye are:Thou'rt= welcome back, an =ifplayerplural:ye survive:thou surviveth=.

strings.string:
啊，=factionaddress:Mopango=，看见=ifplayerplural:你们:你=真是苦乐参半。我本愿=ifplayerplural:你们:你=选择达迦莎，但我的光照向别处。
即便如此，我仍希望在未来更多见到=ifplayerplural:你们:你=。如果=ifplayerplural:你们:你=活下来，欢迎回来。

string.ID: Live and drink, Yona.

strings.string: 生而饮水，约娜。

string.ID: What have we here? Approach, =player.formalAddressTerm=, and be known.

strings.string: 这里来了什么？靠近些，=player.formalAddressTerm=，让你为人所知。

string.ID: I seek a use for this repulsive device.

strings.string: 我在寻找这个排斥装置的用途。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Why are you here?

strings.string: 你为什么在这里？

string.ID: Have you a credo?

strings.string: 你有信条吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: =name=. Greetings. I am called Yona. =ifplayerplural:Ye seem:Thou seemest= unlike most other climbers. I wonder why.

strings.string: =name=。问候你。我被称为约娜。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=看起来不像大多数攀登者。我想知道为什么。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
=ifplayerplural:Have ye:Hast thou= seen it, out there? The spiny, eel-like creature. That is Dagasha, angry one, lost child. =ifplayerplural:Ye can:Thou canst= feel the hostility pour from it in waves.
Yet, it attacketh not.

strings.string:
=ifplayerplural:你们:你=看见外面的它了吗？那只多刺、似鳗的生物。那就是达迦莎，愤怒者，迷失之子。=ifplayerplural:你们:你=能感觉到敌意一波波从它身上涌出。
然而，它并不攻击。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: Yes. "Anyone may strike a slumberling once."

strings.string: 有。“任何人都可击打沉眠者一次。”

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: Only a fool asketh after the meaning of a credo.

strings.string: 只有傻瓜才会询问信条的含义。

string.ID: I apologize for my rudeness.

strings.string: 我为我的失礼道歉。

string.ID: I am leaving.

strings.string: 我要走了。

string.ID: I am not offended, simply making =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= aware of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= foolishness.

strings.string: 我并未被冒犯，只是在让=ifplayerplural:你们:你=意识到=ifplayerplural:你们:你=的愚蠢。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID:
I am consumed by curiosity. How it resembleth the children in make!
May I hold the device in communion?

strings.string:
我被好奇吞没了。它的造法多么像那些孩子！
我可以持着这个装置进行交流吗？

string.ID: You may.

strings.string: 可以。

string.ID: You may not.

strings.string: 不可以。

string.ID:
Ahh.
Stranger, =ifplayerplural:ye are:thou art= cruel to withhold this experience, but I shall abide.

strings.string:
啊。
陌生人，=ifplayerplural:你们:你=拒绝给我这种体验，实在残酷，但我会遵从。

string.ID: Live and drink, watcher.

strings.string: 生而饮水，守望者。

string.ID: We'll see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我们会看到的。生而饮水。

string.ID: Learn well, =factionaddress:Mopango=. I would fain see =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= succeed in =ifplayerplural:your:thine= task.

strings.string: 好好学习，=factionaddress:Mopango=。我愿看见=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=完成=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=的任务。

string.ID: Live and learn, Nacham.

strings.string: 纳查姆，长生，求知。

string.ID: {{emote|*Every surface of the strange entity vibrates with the sound of a hundred dry lectures by long-dead scholars, teaching a volume of knowledge so dense and overlapping that the end result is incomprehensible.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*这个奇异实体的每一处表面都在震颤，发出百场枯燥讲座的声音，仿佛早已死去的学者正在传授大量密集而重叠的知识，最终结果令人无法理解。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 独特者，我将这个排斥装置献给你。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 生而……随你所愿吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Swimming in sound, Nacham stares at you and looks away simultaneously, giving no indication of understanding.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*纳查姆游泳般浸在声音中，同时盯着你又望向别处，没有表现出任何理解的迹象。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 给。拿着。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我还没准备好。我之后可能会回来。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你还好吗？

string.ID:
Yes. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= quelled the mania.
I can focus. I can render sensible the things I have seen and heard now, though I remember little of my time before the mania. Was I artisan? Teacher? I possessed great knowledge that this shell twisted into a prison. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for the gift of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= untwisting.

strings.string:
是的。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=平息了狂乱。
我能集中精神。我现在能让自己所见所闻变得有意义，尽管我几乎不记得狂乱之前的时光。我曾是工匠？教师？我拥有伟大知识，而这外壳把它扭成了监狱。我感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=赐予的解扭之礼。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你现在会做什么？

string.ID:
The mopango have cared for me whilst I could not care for myself, giving me the only name I now know. I will stay to help them. This chassis is a prison no longer, and perhaps deeper truths may yet be found within it.
To =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, new friend, I offer a piece of this former prison that =ifplayerplural:ye may:thou mayest= find useful, along with my thanks.

strings.string:
在我无法照料自己时，莫潘戈照料了我，并给了我如今唯一知晓的名字。我会留下来帮助他们。这具底盘不再是监狱，或许其中仍能找到更深的真理。
新朋友，我把这座旧监狱的一部分赠予=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，也许=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=会觉得它有用，并附上我的感谢。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Nacham.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，纳查姆。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Nacham.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，纳查姆。

string.ID: Take care, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Let not complacency end =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, and I shall anticipate further news of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= exploits.

strings.string: 保重，=factionaddress:Mopango=。别让自满终结=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，我会期待更多关于=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=功业的消息。

string.ID: Live and lead, Dagasha.

strings.string: 达迦莎，长生，引领。

string.ID: {{emote|*The jagged, serpentine entity stares you down, twitching with feigned half-strikes in your direction as if goading an aggressive response from you. Though it has no mouth, it is not silent: piercing the air is a strange, external tinnitus, the whine of an ancient viewscreen.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那个锯齿嶙峋、蛇形的实体死死盯住你，朝你的方向抽搐着做出半真半假的佯攻，仿佛在诱使你作出攻击反应。它虽没有嘴，却并不沉默：刺穿空气的是一种奇异的外部耳鸣，像古老显示屏的尖啸。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 独特者，我将这个排斥装置献给你。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 生而……随你所愿吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dagasha tilts its head, staring you down. It twitches, but makes no move to strike as you approach.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*达迦莎歪过头，死死盯着你。它抽搐着，但在你靠近时没有出手攻击。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 给。拿着。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我还没准备好。我之后可能会回来。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你还好吗？

string.ID:
Though I be a pale shadow of the self I once was, yes. My condition and outlook are both substantially improved.
I recall few details of my life before. I was influential, one whose words stirred hearts to action. For so long I had no means to speak, trapped in my own moods. =ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a dire fate.

strings.string:
虽然我只是昔日自我的苍白影子，但，是的。我的状态和前景都大幅改善了。
我想不起从前生命的多少细节。我曾很有影响力，是言语能激励人心行动的人。如此长久以来，我无法说话，被困在自己的情绪中。=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=将我从可怕命运中释放出来。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你现在会做什么？

string.ID:
I know not. Perhaps I can lead again. These creatures that looked after me, named me, kept me safe. The mopango.
They are kind, but weak. Perhaps I can teach them. Spur them to be greater.
But for =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=, I must even our score. Take this piece of my chassis. Wear it with confidence. Command in my name.

strings.string:
我不知道。也许我能再次领导。那些照看我、为我命名、保护我安全的生物。莫潘戈。
他们善良，却弱小。也许我能教导他们。鞭策他们变得更伟大。
但对于=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=，我必须偿清我们之间的账。拿着我底盘的这一片。自信地佩戴它。以我的名义发号施令。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Dagasha.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，达迦莎。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Dagasha.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，达迦莎。

string.ID: Stay safe.

strings.string: 保持安全。

string.ID: Live and remain stalwart, Va'am.

strings.string: 愿你长生，坚毅如故，瓦姆。

string.ID: {{emote|*The hardened shell-thing traces a path around you slowly, its strange brush-feet scrabbling at the floor, a pace unaffected by your presence and movement. Behind the hissing of those feet on the ground is the strains of a faint voice, someone speaking from inside a distant cave. Audible, but not understandable.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*那个硬壳之物缓慢地绕着你行进，奇异的刷状足抓挠着地面，步调不受你的存在和移动影响。那些足在地上发出的嘶嘶声之后，有一缕微弱嗓音的声调，像有人在遥远洞穴中说话。听得见，却听不懂。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 独特者，我将这个排斥装置献给你。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 生而……随你所愿吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Vaam seems oblivious to your words, but does slow its patrol as it nears you.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*瓦姆似乎没有注意到你的话，但它靠近你时确实放慢了巡行。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 给。拿着。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我还没准备好。我之后可能会回来。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你还好吗？

string.ID:
Yes. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee=.
=ifplayerplural:Ye have:Thou hast= freed me from a deep stupor. Once I was a protector, before being sentenced to protect nothing and no one.
I remember little of that time.

strings.string:
是的。我感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。
=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=把我从深重麻木中释放出来。我曾是保护者，后来被判去保护空无，保护无人。
我几乎不记得那段时间。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你现在会做什么？

string.ID:
I have yet to find my purpose. I can think and speak, and so this shell is nearly comfortable.
One piece, however, doth yet chafe me. =ifplayerplural:Would ye:Wouldst thou= take it? Perhaps =ifplayerplural:ye can:thou canst= grant it some use.

strings.string:
我尚未找到我的目的。我能思考，也能说话，所以这副外壳几乎称得上舒适。
不过，还有一片仍令我磨痛。=ifplayerplural:尔等愿意:汝愿意=带走它吗？也许=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=能赋予它某种用途。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Va'am.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，瓦姆。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Va'am.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，瓦姆。

string.ID: =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= loose the bonds that keep =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= from =ifplayerplural:your:thy= goals, =factionaddress:Mopango=. Be free.

strings.string: 愿=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=松开阻隔=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=通往目标的束缚，=factionaddress:Mopango=。自由吧。

string.ID: Live and be free, Kah.

strings.string: 愿你长生，永保自由，卡。

string.ID: {{emote|*The creature-silhouette lacks any means to make sound, save for the pointed tips of its six flexible legs. These tap against the ground like a sparse but heavy rainfall on a scrap metal roof as the strange pseudo-beast skitters away from predicted or perceived threats.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*这个生物剪影没有任何发声方式，除了六条柔韧腿末端的尖点。它们敲击地面，像稀疏却沉重的雨落在废金属屋顶上；这个奇异的拟兽从预判或感知到的威胁旁疾掠而开。*}}

string.ID: I offer you this repulsive device, unique one.

strings.string: 独特者，我将这个排斥装置献给你。

string.ID: Live and... do as you please.

strings.string: 生而……随你所愿吧。

string.ID: {{emote|*Kah skitters away, but soon returns, and skitters away a shorter distance. Whether because of your words or because you are still, its desire for flight ebbs over the course of a minute until its escape attempts halt.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*卡疾掠而逃，但很快又回来，再次逃开时距离变短了。不知是因为你的话，还是因为你静止不动，它想要逃跑的欲望在一分钟内逐渐退去，直到逃跑尝试停止。*}}

string.ID: Here. Take it.

strings.string: 给。拿着。

string.ID: I am not yet ready. I may return.

strings.string: 我还没准备好。我之后可能会回来。

string.ID: Are you all right?

strings.string: 你还好吗？

string.ID:
I am weary to my core, but at last this once-hateful body obeyeth me. I thank =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= for restoring my autonomy.
Memory of my once-self doth elude me, but I recognize the irony of my punishment. Once a strider, then sentenced to stride without restraint, forever. I knew only fear and flight. No more.

strings.string:
我疲惫入骨，但这具曾经可恨的身体终于服从于我。感谢=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=恢复了我的自主。
昔日自我的记忆逃离了我，但我认得自己惩罚中的讽刺。我曾是阔步者，后来被判永远毫无限制地阔步。我只知道恐惧与逃离。如今不再。

string.ID: What will you do now?

strings.string: 你现在会做什么？

string.ID:
I shall enjoy my free mobility freely, for a time. After that, I know not. I may speak to these mopango creatures that named me, and find a purpose with them. I cannot ever repay their care, but perhaps I may repay =ifplayerplural:yours:thine=.
I wouldst fain offer =ifplayerplural:ye:thee= a fragment of this form come loose. =ifplayerplural:May ye:Mayst thou= ever run free.

strings.string:
我会先自由地享受我的自由移动。之后，我不知道。我也许会与这些为我命名的莫潘戈生物交谈，和他们一起找到目的。我永远无法偿还他们的照料，但也许我可以偿还=ifplayerplural:尔等的:汝之=。
我愿将这具形体上松脱的一片赠予=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=。愿=ifplayerplural:尔等:汝=永远自由奔跑。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Kah.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，卡。

string.ID: Live and remain free, Kah.

strings.string: 长生，永葆自由，卡。

string.ID: Saad, welcom. Saad, from thyn heres shaken the wet and olde lif. Saad, in-to a smal vessel pouren hit. Saad, to thyn sash attachen the vessel. Saad, crossen nou thrugh the heigh gate and in-to Brightsheol.

strings.string: Saad，欢迎。 Saad，从汝发间抖落潮湿古旧之生。 Saad，将其倾入小小容器。 Saad，将容器系于汝之腰带。 Saad，如今穿过高门，进入明灼阴府。

string.ID: Where is Brightsheol in relation to Qud... to Salum?

strings.string: 明灼阴府相对于库德……相对于 Salum 在哪里？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了吗？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你为什么叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID: Saad, the bodi dien, but the mind romen.

strings.string: Saad，身体死去，心智漫游。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你为什么叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID: Saad, stonden thu at the heigh gate to Brightsheol. Saad, thyn heres been wet with olde lif. Saad, shaken thyn hed and cross in-to neue lif.

strings.string: Saad，汝立于通往明灼阴府的高门。 Saad，汝发已被古旧之生濡湿。 Saad，摇动汝首，渡入新生。

string.ID: Is Resheph here?

strings.string: 瑞谢夫在这里吗？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了吗？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你为什么叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID: No Saad Resheph residen her.

strings.string: Saad 瑞谢夫不居于此。

string.ID: Where is Brightsheol in relation to Qud... to Salum?

strings.string: 明灼阴府相对于库德……相对于 Salum 在哪里？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了吗？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你为什么叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID: Alofte of Gjaus a cite twinklen. And ther the Seraph dremen. And Brightsheol is the drem.

strings.string: 贾乌斯之上，一城闪烁。 而炽天使在那里做梦。 明灼阴府便是那梦。

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了吗？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你为什么叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID: Artow a Saad of olde Salum, and nou stonden thu at the heigh gate to Brightsheol.

strings.string: 汝乃古 Salum 之 Saad，如今立于通往明灼阴府的高门。

string.ID: Salum? Is that another name for Qud?

strings.string: Salum？那是库德的另一个名字吗？

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了吗？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID: Saad, yis.

strings.string: Saad，是。

string.ID: Am I dead?

strings.string: 我死了吗？

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Why do you call me Saad?

strings.string: 你为什么叫我 Saad？

string.ID: I've come from the Thick World with a mission: to disable the Spindle's magnetic field. Can you do this for me?

strings.string: 我从厚世界带着使命而来：关闭纺锤的磁场。你能替我做到吗？

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
The shomrim connen. Why oghte we?

strings.string:
{{emote|*裹住雨水绍默尔形体的衣物静止了许久。*}}
绍默里姆能做。吾等为何应做？

string.ID: Because... I am a Saad, after all.

strings.string: 因为……毕竟我是 Saad。

string.ID: Shomer, you impudent whelp! Saad Resheph stands before you. Do as I say.

strings.string: 绍默尔，你这无礼幼崽！Saad 瑞谢夫就站在你面前。照我说的做。

string.ID: Something changed atop the Spindle. If Brightsheol is indeed connected to the city there, then this change may suggest it's in peril...

strings.string: 纺锤顶端发生了变化。如果明灼阴府确实与那里的城市相连，那么这个变化可能意味着它正处于危险之中……

string.ID: Wait. I have more questions to ask.

strings.string: 等等。我还有更多问题要问。

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
The shomrim remainen unbilefful.

strings.string:
{{emote|*裹住雨水绍默尔形体的衣物静止了许久。*}}
绍默里姆仍不信。

string.ID: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*裹住雨水绍默尔形体的衣物仍然静止。*}}

string.ID: One year ago, someone began broadcasting a signal from atop the Spindle. I have a recording of it here...

strings.string: 一年前，有人开始从纺锤顶端广播信号。我这里有它的录音……

string.ID: {{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form remain still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*裹住雨水绍默尔形体的衣物仍然静止。*}}

string.ID: I ask you: disable the magnetic field so that the Spindle can be ascended and the signal investigated.

strings.string: 我请求你：关闭磁场，让纺锤可以被攀登，让信号可以被调查。

string.ID:
{{emote|*The clothes shrouding Rainwater Shomer's form are still for many moments.*}}
Saad, the Seraph sprecen. Saad, thu asken, and the shomrim assenten. Saad, wiltou return to Salum or crossen in-to Brightsheol?

strings.string:
{{emote|*裹住雨水绍默尔形体的衣物静止了许久。*}}
Saad，炽天使发言。 Saad，汝有所求，而绍默里姆允准。 Saad，汝愿回归 Salum，还是渡入明灼阴府？

string.ID: If it can be done, return me to Qud. I wish to ascend the Spindle myself.

strings.string: 如果可以，把我送回库德。我想亲自攀登纺锤。

string.ID: ... I've shaken the wet life from my hair. Now I shall cross into Brightsheol.

strings.string: ……我已从发间抖落潮湿之生。现在我要渡入明灼阴府。

string.ID: I need time to consider.

strings.string: 我需要时间考虑。

string.ID: Saad, nou-then return.

strings.string: Saad，那么如今回归吧。

string.ID: I am ready.

strings.string: 我准备好了。

string.ID: I need time to reconsider.

strings.string: 我需要时间重新考虑。

string.ID: Saad, nou-then crossen in-to Brightsheol.

strings.string: Saad，那么如今渡入明灼阴府吧。

string.ID: I am ready.

strings.string: 我准备好了。

string.ID: I need time to reconsider.

strings.string: 我需要时间重新考虑。

string.ID:
The engraving is done, Moloch! I do hope it's to your liking. Your deeds are incised here for all time.
You may now enter the sarcophagus, Moloch. Be at peace.

strings.string:
雕刻完成了，摩洛克！我真希望它合你心意。你的功业已被镌刻于此，永世长存。
你现在可以进入石棺了，摩洛克。愿你安宁。
再会。

string.ID:
Now, uh... hop... hop into the sarcophagus.
Safe travels.

strings.string:
现在，呃……跳……跳进石棺吧。
旅途平安。
再会。

string.ID: .....oh... oh? Peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.

strings.string: ……哦……哦？愿所有在盘绕羔羊之家驰骋者平安。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Do you know the Mark of Death?

strings.string: 你知道死亡印记吗？

string.ID: How do I get to Brightsheol?

strings.string: 我要怎么去明灼阴府？

string.ID: Why is this tomb unfinished?

strings.string: 为什么这座墓还没完工？

string.ID:
...oh..... I am Herododicus, lapidary, lithographer, sculptor, calciminer, and biographer to the Coiled Lamb. I will tarry here until the Godhead passes on, and then I will canonize his deeds in high relief.
I've tarried for quite some time, now.... What a prodigious reign! Bless that Coiled Lamb!

strings.string:
……哦……我是希罗多狄库斯，宝石匠、石印师、雕塑家、钙矿师，也是盘绕羔羊的传记官。我会在这里逗留，直到神首逝去，然后我会以高浮雕封圣他的功业。
我如今已经逗留了相当长的时间……何等惊人的统治！赞美盘绕羔羊！

string.ID: The sultanate is dissolved. Resheph rules no longer.

strings.string: 苏丹国已经解体。瑞谢夫不再统治。

string.ID:
.....oh.... oh.... Poor friend. The ironshank must be upsetting your digestion. The darkness must be blooming in your brain, making you slow and doltish.
The sultanate dissolved? Tidings would have reached me.... someone would have said so....
Oh... poor, doltish friend. You cantered too long outside the House of the Coiled Lamb, and now you are a dolt.

strings.string:
……哦……哦……可怜的朋友。铁胫病一定搅乱了你的消化。黑暗一定正在你脑中开花，让你迟钝又愚笨。
苏丹国解体了？消息会传到我这里的……总会有人这么说的……
哦……可怜又愚笨的朋友。你在盘绕羔羊之家外驰骋得太久，如今成了傻瓜。

string.ID: It is a test. Tell me the answer now.

strings.string: 这是考验。现在告诉我答案。

string.ID: I want to ask you something else.

strings.string: 我想问你别的事。

string.ID:
{{emote|Herododicus whirrs fearfully.}}
The Mark is =MarkOfDeath=.

strings.string:
{{emote|希罗多狄库斯恐惧地嗡鸣。}}
印记是 =MarkOfDeath=。

string.ID:
Oh! Brightsheol? The forever braid of life? The Garden Behind the High Gate? Why, you must rank among the crown echelon of machine and folk, and you must... well, you must...
Start to decompose. You must... You must be dead. Dead and entombed. The body remains, but the mind wanders...

strings.string:
哦！明灼阴府？生命的永恒编辫？高门之后的花园？哎呀，你必须跻身机器与民众的冠冕阶层，而且你必须……嗯，你必须……
开始腐解。你必须……你必须死去。死去并入葬。身体留下，心智漫游……

string.ID: You must be dead? Is that truly the only way?

strings.string: 必须死去？真的只有这一种方法吗？

string.ID: I bear the Mark. Entomb me.

strings.string: 我带有印记。埋葬我。

string.ID:
{{emote|Herododicus pauses.}}
Ye... yes? Is this a test? I suppose you... could we... could we have been in Brightsheol all along? Is that the answer?

strings.string:
{{emote|希罗多狄库斯停顿了。}}
是……是的？这是考验吗？我想你……我们会不会……会不会一直都在明灼阴府？这是答案吗？

string.ID: Wrong on both counts. Resheph stands before you. Entomb me.

strings.string: 两点都错。瑞谢夫就站在你面前。埋葬我。

string.ID: Resheph is gone, biographer. I am here, and I have need to travel to Brightsheol. Entomb me.

strings.string: 瑞谢夫已经离去，传记官。我在这里，而且我需要前往明灼阴府。埋葬我。

string.ID: Of course not. Let's back up.

strings.string: 当然不是。我们退一步说。

string.ID:
That's not even how it works!
First, I image your head, read your self's narrative from the folds of your brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of your life's deeds...
Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm done... then you can entomb =player.reflexive=.

strings.string:
这根本不是它的运作方式！
首先，我要扫描你的头，从你的脑褶中读取你自我的叙事，再与薄世界中关于你一生事迹的环境日志交叉核验……
然后我……修饰……这个故事，再把它刻在墙上。等我完成后……你才能埋葬 =player.reflexive=。

string.ID: Do that then.

strings.string: 那就这么做。

string.ID: Hold on. I have more to ask.

strings.string: 等一下。我还有更多要问。

string.ID: You are forgiven. Now entomb me.

strings.string: 你被宽恕了。现在埋葬我。

string.ID: I've misled you, biographer. I have another question.

strings.string: 我误导了你，传记官。我还有另一个问题。

string.ID:
Moloch! Allow me to explain the deification procedure, as it is clearly beneath your station to know!
First, I must image the great Moloch's head, read your self's narrative from the folds of =ifplayerplural:your:thy= Holiest Brain, cross-check it against the Thin World's ambient log of His Eminence's life's deeds...
{{emote|*Herododicus whispers*}} I'm sure your version is the better one, Moloch...

strings.string:
摩洛克！请容我解释神化流程，因为以您的地位，显然不该亲自知晓这等细节！
首先，我必须扫描伟大摩洛克的头颅，从=ifplayerplural:你们:你=至圣大脑的褶皱中读取自我叙事，再与薄世界中关于尊驾一生事迹的环境日志交叉核验……
{{emote|*希罗多狄库斯低语*}} 我相信您的说法才是更好的版本，摩洛克……

string.ID: Then I... stylize... the story, and I engrave it on the walls. Once I'm finished, the sarcophagus will open, and you can lay =player.reflexive= to rest!

strings.string: 然后我……修饰……这个故事，再把它刻在墙上。等我完成后，石棺就会打开，而您就能让 =player.reflexive= 安息！

string.ID: Do it then.

strings.string: 那就做吧。

string.ID: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............

strings.string: 开始与薄世界年鉴交叉核验…………

string.ID:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled. Now to engrave it.
Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled Lamb.

strings.string:
交叉核验完成。你的叙事已编成。现在去雕刻它。
平安……愿所有在盘绕羔羊之家驰骋者平安。

string.ID: Peace, biographer.

strings.string: 平安，传记官。

string.ID: Commencing cross-check with the Thin World annals............

strings.string: 开始与薄世界年鉴交叉核验…………

string.ID:
Cross-check complete. Your narrative is compiled, Moloch. Now to go engrave it.
Peace.... peace to all who canter in the House of the Coiled... in Your House, Moloch.

strings.string:
交叉核验完成。您的叙事已编成，摩洛克。现在去雕刻它。
平安……愿所有在盘绕……在您的家中驰骋者平安，摩洛克。

string.ID: Peace, biographer.

strings.string: 平安，传记官。

string.ID:
'Tis a saying among the stonemasons, "Never finish a job too early." By the decretum of Sagittar, old as it is, they have until the Coiled Lamb is... is decom-.. passed... decompassed.... dead, deadlike... to complete their work on the Tomb.
Bless the Coiled Lamb, peace to those who canter in his house, and let us pray the day never comes!

strings.string:
石匠之间有句俗话：“永远别太早完工。”按萨吉塔尔古老敕令，他们有直到盘绕羔羊……腐……逝去……腐逝……死亡，死一般……之前的时间来完成墓的工程。
祝福盘绕羔羊，愿在他家中驰骋者平安，也让我们祈祷那一天永不到来！

string.ID: But Resheph is dead. The sultanate is dissolved.

strings.string: 但瑞谢夫已经死了。苏丹国已经解体。

string.ID: Live and drink, friend. rrk come to the Yd, shared together. Feel safe and free as woodsmoke.

strings.string: 生而饮水，朋友。rrk 来到伊德，共同分享。感到安全又自由，像木烟一样。

string.ID: Greetings, Goek!

strings.string: 问候你，戈埃克！

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: You tower over every other frog I've seen. Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你比我见过的其他蛙类都高大。你是斯瓦尔丁吗？

string.ID: These shining pipes! What are they?

strings.string: 这些闪亮的管道！它们是什么？

string.ID: What can you tell me about Yd?

strings.string: 你能告诉我伊德的事吗？

string.ID: rrk knows of the glow-hats! Yd-friends see glimpses at night, about the reef.

strings.string: rrk 知道发光帽！伊德朋友夜里在礁中瞥见过。

string.ID: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.

strings.string: 如果你愿意接纳他们，我请求你给予他们庇护。

string.ID: If you would have them, I ask that you grant them sanctuary.

strings.string: 如果你愿意接纳他们，我请求你给予他们庇护。

string.ID: Boon-friend asks a friend-boon, and what boon is friend! rrk welcome slynth to an Yd, be safe and free as woodsmoke.

strings.string: 恩惠朋友请求朋友恩惠，而朋友何尝不是恩惠！rrk 欢迎斯林思来到伊德，安全又自由，像木烟一样。

string.ID: You have my thanks, Goek.

strings.string: 多谢你，戈埃克。

string.ID: Ah! rrk would grant you this boon, rrk would. Were not for the unspoken cries of future-kin, free as woodsmoke but no more safe so longer. rrk would and cannot.

strings.string: 啊！rrk 愿给你这份恩惠，rrk 愿意。若不是未来亲族无声哭喊，自由如木烟却不再长久安全。rrk 愿意却不能。

string.ID: rrk wonder of the glow-hats. Which wind will blow.

strings.string: rrk 想着发光帽。哪阵风会吹来。

string.ID: Greetings, =player.formalAddressTerm=! How arresting of the glow-hats arrival, much to do. rrk soothe Mak, Bep, Krka, look stores, still much slime and sweat to pool below rrk. Enjoy helpful toil!

strings.string: 问候你，=player.formalAddressTerm=！发光帽到来多么夺目，有许多事要做。rrk 安抚马克、贝普、克尔卡，查看储备，rrk 下方仍有许多黏液与汗水要汇成池。享受有帮助的辛劳！

string.ID: My thanks, Goek.

strings.string: 谢谢你，戈埃克。

string.ID:
All is well, =name=! Trials make for overcoming, and done together.
rrk can tell the sky dark and not know. Visit and witness! Glow-hats enliven the night, safe and free. Slynth-home is Yd.

strings.string:
一切都好，=name=！试炼生来就是要被克服，而且要一起克服。
rrk 能分辨天黑，却也不知。来访并见证！发光帽让夜晚活起来，安全又自由。斯林思之家就是伊德。

string.ID: My thanks again, Goek.

strings.string: 再次感谢，戈埃克。

string.ID:
{{emote|*reeeeeps joyfully*}}
Greetings, =name=! Live and drink, friend.

strings.string:
{{emote|*欢快地 reeeeeps*}}
问候你，=name=！生而饮水，朋友。

string.ID: rrk is called by dwellers Goek. rrk is a dweller here, too, and before then, a builder of place. Goek, Geeub, Mak and Many Eyes build a new Yd in the reef, hundreds of years.

strings.string: 居民叫 rrk 戈埃克。rrk 也是这里的居民，在那之前，是地方的建造者。戈埃克、吉厄布、马克和多眼在礁中建造新伊德，数百年。

string.ID: rrk did before then, but rrk all build it now.

strings.string: rrk 从前建造过，但 rrk 如今都建造它。

string.ID: rrk is svardym like the hatchling from the egg, but wound down the chute of years in hundreds, and grown so long and warty! rrk was a hatchling once, cries to think on it!

strings.string: rrk 是斯瓦尔丁，像从蛋里出来的幼体一样，但沿着岁月滑槽滚了几百年，长得这么长、这么多疣！rrk 也曾是幼体，一想到就想哭！

string.ID: Aren't the svardym one of the Gyre plagues?

strings.string: 斯瓦尔丁不是轮回瘟灾之一吗？

string.ID: Yes rrk was once, "plague" in the sky hundreds of years. Not so now. Longtime rrk, Geeub, Mak hide in the sponge and eat lice. When find Many Eyes, rrk and friends built the Yd. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 是，rrk 曾经是，天空中的“瘟灾”数百年。现在不是了。很久以来，rrk、吉厄布、马克藏在海绵里吃虱子。找到多眼后，rrk 和朋友们建造了伊德。快乐帮助！

string.ID: Do you know anything of the other plagues?

strings.string: 你知道其他瘟灾的事吗？

string.ID: Plagues bloom a thousand year then die back, shrink under the earth-sponge or move here and east. Vanta, girshling, rot die. rrk the hatchling once saw the Nephilim loom! rrk frightened and hid inside a sponge for thirty moons.

strings.string: 瘟灾盛放千年，然后衰败，缩回地海绵之下，或迁到这里和东方。万塔、吉尔什幼体、腐烂死去。幼体 rrk 曾见拿非利显现！rrk 害怕，躲进海绵里三十个月亮。

string.ID: Do you know anything of the other plagues?

strings.string: 你知道其他瘟灾的事吗？

string.ID: Water and gas piped through the Yd to feed the plants, dwellers, and machines! Dwellers blew the glass in hues like the prism perch, to look pretty. Shared together. Joyful helping!

strings.string: 水和气体穿过伊德的管道，喂养植物、居民和机器！居民把玻璃吹成棱镜栖木般的色泽，好看。共同分享。快乐帮助！

string.ID:
rrk read the signs and descend the stairs. rrk breathe the water smoke and sit on starfish.
Visit hovels, meet friends Mak, Geeub, Bep, Krka, Une, Tilli, farmer Rokhas, and every rest!
rrk rrkself.

strings.string:
rrk 读标牌，走下楼梯。rrk 呼吸水烟，坐在海星上。
拜访棚屋，见朋友马克、吉厄布、贝普、克尔卡、乌恩、蒂利、农夫罗卡斯，还有每一个其他！
rrk 是 rrk 自己。

string.ID: What indignity have you come to heap upon the mound, whelp? Out with it.

strings.string: 你又来往这堆土上堆什么羞辱，小崽子？说吧。

string.ID: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?

strings.string: 你是这个自由堡的创立者之一，对吗？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: I've never seen a frog of your stature.

strings.string: 我从没见过你这样体格的蛙类。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Freehold?

strings.string: 你能告诉我自由堡的事吗？

string.ID: This pond is peaceful.

strings.string: 这池塘很平静。
{{emote|*crrrk*}}

string.ID: What of it? Scurry on and leave me to brood.

strings.string: 那又怎样？快滚，让我独自阴郁。

string.ID: This seems a joyful place. Why are you angry?

strings.string: 这里看起来很欢乐。你为什么生气？

string.ID: I've something else to ask

strings.string: 我还有别的事要问

string.ID:
Why? A lifetime of vexation. Born to a cacophony of static ringing the ears raw. Thousands of my kinfolk cut down by that porphyric wasp fools called Lamb. A millenium of hot stinking sun and disgusting brine lice for supper.
Misery obtains on this pond, whelp. By Chavvah if you start beaming like a sunray and yodeling at the Beetle Moon, I'll eat you where you stand.

strings.string:
为什么？一辈子的烦恼。生在静电杂音的喧嚣里，耳朵被震得生疼。我的数千同族被那些蠢货称作羔羊的斑紫胡蜂砍倒。一千年炎热发臭的太阳，还有恶心的盐水虱当晚饭。
痛苦就在这池塘上，小崽子。以查瓦之名，要是你开始像阳光一样笑得灿烂，对着甲虫月亮约德尔唱歌，我会当场把你吃掉。

string.ID: ...I've more to ask.

strings.string: ……我还有更多要问。

string.ID: Who am I? Mak. That's all you get. I'll not waste the honey of my mouth on idle inquiries.

strings.string: 我是谁？马克。你只能知道这么多。我不会把嘴里的蜜浪费在无聊问题上。

string.ID:
...
And? Is that the whole of your fool statement?

strings.string:
……
然后呢？你那愚蠢陈述就这些？
是。

string.ID: I'll ask something else.

strings.string: 我问点别的。

string.ID: Trust what you hear of the svardym, whelp. The sky blackens at our accession and we are like to eat you.

strings.string: 相信你听说过的斯瓦尔丁吧，小崽子。我们升起时天空会变黑，而我们很可能吃掉你。

string.ID: Have the adiyy chewed the hue from your eyes? See for yourself. Free folk make a gathering here and their racket rings through the reef. One can hardly steep in his greens without being mewled to by a salt-stung baby.

strings.string: 阿迪斯把你眼里的颜色嚼掉了吗？自己看。自由民在这里聚集，他们的喧闹响彻礁中。一个人想泡泡自己的绿叶都难，旁边总有被盐蜇过的婴孩喵喵叫。

string.ID: It was once.

strings.string: 曾经是。

string.ID: What happened?

strings.string: 发生了什么？

string.ID: Whelp, affix your eyes to that clam right yonder. Go step inside and find your answers.

strings.string: 小崽子，把你的眼睛钉到那边那只蛤蜊上。进去，自己找答案。

string.ID:
{{emote|*long, smoky croak*}}
Ah, =player.formalAddressTerm=, here at last. Sit. Smoke. Rest.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一声悠长、烟雾般的蛙鸣*}}
啊，=player.formalAddressTerm=，终于来了。坐。抽烟。休息。

string.ID: Sorry, have we already spoken?

strings.string: 抱歉，我们已经说过话了吗？

string.ID: You're one of the founders of this freehold, aren't you?

strings.string: 你是这个自由堡的创立者之一，对吗？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: I can't help but notice your impressive stature, even in repose.

strings.string: 即便你静卧着，我也无法不注意到你惊人的体格。

string.ID: What can you tell me about Yd?

strings.string: 你能告诉我伊德的事吗？

string.ID:
Ayup. But seconds ago. As only yesterday, no? Hoh hoh hoh.
{{emote|*continued croaking laughter*}}

strings.string:
是啊。就在几秒前。就像昨天，不是吗？呵呵呵。
{{emote|*持续的蛙鸣笑声*}}

string.ID: Ah. Well. Let's talk about something else, then.

strings.string: 啊。好吧。那我们聊点别的。

string.ID: Oh, very funny. Live and drink.

strings.string: 哦，真有趣。生而饮水。
