string.ID: Greetings, Geeub. I am =name=.

strings.string: 问候你，吉厄布。我是 =name=。

string.ID:
{{emote|*croaking sigh*}}
Congratulation, condolence, which ever. Mind and name slip by another.

strings.string:
{{emote|*蛙鸣般的叹息*}}
恭喜，慰问，哪个都好。心智与名字彼此滑过。

string.ID:
So large? Hoh hoh. Well. Hatchlings, so rage-dense. Size diffuses, no?
However. Mak diverges, hoh hoh. Egg-rage simmers on a greater pot. Our voice eld-feeble, close your ears to it. Hoh hoh hoh.

strings.string:
这么大？呵呵。嗯。幼体，怒意太密。体型会扩散，不是吗？
不过。马克不同，呵呵。蛋中怒火在更大的锅里慢炖。我们的声音老朽虚弱，对它闭上耳朵吧。呵呵呵。

string.ID:
Sun we once blotted out nestles our horizon. We tend thought-seeds with algae, wrap in crysteel, bathe in arc-light. Build, live, fight.
Here as elsewhere, grow is struggle. Fun to watch, no? Hoh. Hoh.

strings.string:
我们曾遮蔽的太阳，如今依偎在我们的地平线上。我们用藻类照料思想种子，以晶钢包裹，沐浴弧光。建造，生活，战斗。
在这里，也和别处一样，成长就是挣扎。看着有趣，不是吗？呵。呵。

string.ID: Yes, we were present, if less active than other-bodies. But we saw, and rattle with memory-artifacts as a Consortium lockbox rattles with jewels; shards of an eon-old data disk, bits of stories and places. Kin-fleeing, louse-meals, ghastly boredom. But Fate's caprice brought us through history's footsteps. There was a machine-speaker, and her ursine apprentice with his little plant, and the Sower with a tetrad of chubby whelps, and then, at last, Many-Eyes. Our dear galgal. So many.

strings.string: 是，我们在场，虽然没有其他身体那样活跃。但我们看见了，也因记忆遗物而作响，像商会锁箱因珠宝而作响；一片亿年旧数据盘的碎片，故事与地点的零星残片。亲族逃离，虱子餐食，骇人的无聊。但命运的反复无常带我们走过历史的足迹。曾有机器言说者，还有她的熊形学徒和他的小植物，播种者带着四个胖墩墩的小崽子，然后，最后，多眼。我们亲爱的 galgal。太多了。

string.ID: But alas. Like our sea-grape friend's lockbox, these memories are not mine to retrieve at will. They come and go, and may be warped by eld.

strings.string: 但唉。就像我们海葡萄朋友的锁箱，这些记忆不是我能随意取出的。它们来来去去，也可能被年岁扭曲。

string.ID:
Live and =player.formalAddressTerm=!
{{emote|*self-conscious rkkk*}}
Dr... drink and =player.formalAddressTerm=!
Krka, me. Krka.

strings.string:
生而 =player.formalAddressTerm=！
{{emote|*不自在地 rkkk*}}
饮……饮水而 =player.formalAddressTerm=！
克尔卡，我。克尔卡。
克尔卡？

string.ID: Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你是斯瓦尔丁吗？

string.ID: Why are you dressed like an apothecary?

strings.string: 你为什么穿得像个药剂师？

string.ID: What do you think of the Freehold?

strings.string: 你怎么看自由堡？

string.ID: Live and drink, Krka.

strings.string: 生而饮水，克尔卡。

string.ID:
{{emote|*gweep!*}}
Krka, me!

strings.string:
{{emote|*gweep!*}}
克尔卡，我！

string.ID:
Vardy! Yes.
But. Gemtle? No kill.

strings.string:
瓦尔丁！是。
但是。温柔？不杀。

string.ID: Why aren't you aggressive too?

strings.string: 为什么你也不具攻击性？

string.ID:
Hatchling hungry. Angry. Angry-hungry.
Kill, eat, don't eaten. Calm down evengefully.

strings.string:
幼体饿。生气。气饿。
杀，吃，不被吃。复仇地平静下来。

string.ID:
{{emote|*chirp!*}}
Poth carry!

strings.string:
{{emote|*啾！*}}
药罐携带！

string.ID: Yes, apothecary. Do you know what those are?

strings.string: 是，药剂师。你知道那是什么吗？

string.ID:
{{emote|*several moments of softly creaking thought*}}
G-good!

strings.string:
{{emote|*几阵轻轻嘎吱作响的思考*}}
好、好！

string.ID: Just... good?

strings.string: 只是……好？

string.ID: It's all right. You seem to like it here.

strings.string: 没关系。你看起来喜欢这里。

string.ID:
{{emote|*krka!*}}
Yes! To like! But... never home else. So {{emote|*reep?*}}.

strings.string:
{{emote|*krka!*}}
是！喜欢！但是……从没有别的家。所以 {{emote|*reep?*}}。

string.ID: bep see widget? Or bep see widget.

strings.string: bep 看小玩意？或者 bep 看见小玩意。
bep？

string.ID: Are you svardym?

strings.string: 你是斯瓦尔丁吗？

string.ID: So much trash! Did a goatfolk bully crash through your workshop?

strings.string: 好多垃圾！是不是有个山羊民恶霸撞穿了你的工坊？

string.ID: Tell me about the Yd Freehold.

strings.string: 跟我说说伊德自由堡。

string.ID: bep is bep. good meet!

strings.string: bep 是 bep。好见面！

string.ID: bep varrrdym from the egg, once.

strings.string: bep 曾经是蛋里来的瓦尔丁。

string.ID: What do you know of the Gyre?

strings.string: 你知道轮回的什么？

string.ID: grre? bep flame and bend brass to make ring ball grre for librrry.

strings.string: grre？bep 用火，把黄铜弯成环球 grre，给图书馆。

string.ID: tink mess. flame bits for tink and onto floor! rrcuit snap, glass smatter, core fries and lekky spill.

strings.string: 修东西乱。火焰零件给修，然后掉地上！电路啪，玻璃碎，核心炸，电液漏。

string.ID: bep make all and anys. bep too lounge in green-gold cubby, smoke pillow and Krka and Tilli.

strings.string: bep 做所有和任何。bep 也躺绿金小窝，抽枕头，和克尔卡、蒂利。

string.ID:
Moon and Sun, =player.formalAddressTerm=. You walk the Yd Freehold and are welcome if peaceful.
Is there aught you need from Une? Need you defending, or cybernetic wares, or are you here for the hurdy-gurdy?

strings.string:
月与日，=player.formalAddressTerm=。你行走在伊德自由堡，如果你和平，便受欢迎。
你有什么需要乌恩帮忙的吗？需要保护，还是义体货品，还是你是为了手摇琴而来？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: Tell me about the Freehold.

strings.string: 跟我说说自由堡。

string.ID: You said you sell cybernetics?

strings.string: 你说你卖义体？

string.ID: What is a hurdy-gurdy?

strings.string: 什么是手摇琴？

string.ID: That thing sounds like a dying animal.

strings.string: 那东西听起来像一只垂死的动物。

string.ID: Are your eyes glowing?

strings.string: 你的眼睛在发光吗？

string.ID: I'm just here to listen.

strings.string: 我只是来听的。

string.ID:
I did, and I do.
Are you in the market?

strings.string:
我说过，而且我确实卖。
你有购买意向吗？

string.ID: Where did you get these implants?

strings.string: 你从哪里弄到这些植入体的？

string.ID:
I found them, here and there.
Are you interested, or merely fatally curious?

strings.string:
我在这里那里找到的。
你是感兴趣，还是只是好奇到要命？

string.ID: Were they in use when you found them?

strings.string: 你找到它们时，它们正在被使用吗？

string.ID:
I am called Une. "Warden" Une, when someone needs to wear authority for outsiders.
And you? What's your name?

strings.string:
我被称为乌恩。当有人需要为外来者披上权威时，就是“守望者”乌恩。
你呢？你叫什么？

string.ID: I am =name=.

strings.string: 我是 =name=。

string.ID: None of your business.

strings.string: 与你无关。

string.ID:
Lovely to meet you, =name=.
Now. Need a question answered, a tune played, a body upgraded?

strings.string:
很高兴认识你，=name=。
现在。需要回答问题，演奏曲调，还是升级身体？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Warden Une tilts their head and purses their lips*}}
Very well. Need you aught, O Nameless One?

strings.string:
{{emote|*守望者乌恩歪过头，抿起嘴唇*}}
很好。无名者啊，你需要什么吗？

string.ID:
Oh, I am hardly an unbiased observer, I'm afraid -- the Freehold is the only welcoming home I could ever have imagined for myself, and my home before was worse than most. I feel a freedom and responsibility here that I would know nowhere else. That no one else could ever know at all.
But bias aside, you can see for yourself that we are a collective thriving without hierarchy. I'm rightly proud to defend that.

strings.string:
哦，恐怕我很难算是没有偏见的观察者——自由堡是我唯一能为自己想象出的、会欢迎我的家，而我从前的家比大多数地方都糟。我在这里感到一种在别处不会知道的自由与责任。别人也根本不可能知道。
但抛开偏见，你自己也能看见，我们是一个没有等级却繁荣的共同体。我理应为守护这一点而自豪。

string.ID:
An old, old, old, old music machine.
Well, I suppose this one is not so old. This one I commissioned from a wandering artisan whose life I saved. A story for another time. Surely you've business.

strings.string:
一台很老、很老、很老、很老的音乐机器。
好吧，我想这一台并没那么老。这一台是我委托一位游荡工匠做的，我曾救过他的命。那是另一个时候的故事。你肯定有正事。

string.ID: Oh, so it called to you, a fellow dying animal?

strings.string: 哦，所以它呼唤了你，一个同为垂死动物的家伙？

string.ID: I'm not a dying animal.

strings.string: 我不是垂死的动物。

string.ID:
You are a dying animal. So am I. We are all dying animals, scrabbling for what extra scraps of time we can grasp. Even the eons-old. We are each and every one of us a dying animal. Or plant. We all decay, is the point.
And the hurdy-gurdy doesn't like how you sound either, for what it is worth.

strings.string:
你是垂死的动物。我也是。我们全都是垂死的动物，拼命抓取还能抓到的额外时间碎片。即便那些活了亿万年的也是。我们每一个都是垂死的动物。或者植物。重点是，我们都会腐朽。
顺便说一句，手摇琴也不喜欢你的声音。

string.ID: Is this how you always greet visitors?

strings.string: 你总是这样问候访客吗？

string.ID:
Is this how you always visit settlements?
No. Do not answer. Is there aught you need?

strings.string:
你总是这样拜访聚落吗？
不。别回答。你需要什么吗？

string.ID: Of course my eyes do not glow. You see the glint of my mask's optics.

strings.string: 我的眼睛当然不会发光。你看见的是我面具光学器件的反光。

string.ID: Your shield bears resemblance to a Templar's Aegis.

strings.string: 你的盾牌很像圣殿骑士的神盾。

string.ID:
If it were a Templar's Aegis, it would bear the holy rhombus.
No knight would be caught dead carrying this blank slate.

strings.string:
如果它是圣殿骑士的神盾，就会带有神圣菱形。
没有骑士会被发现死时还拿着这块空白板。

string.ID: Where did you get it?

strings.string: 你从哪里弄到它的？

string.ID:
{{emote|*one long, luminous stare*}}
I think it best if we kept to more practical questions.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一次漫长而明亮的凝视*}}
我认为我们最好只谈更实际的问题。

string.ID: I apologize for prying.

strings.string: 我为打探隐私道歉。

string.ID: I insist you tell me.

strings.string: 我坚持要你告诉我。

string.ID:
I am not wroth with you, but I owe you no conclusions so easily grasped.
All the same, consider yourself forgiven if you wish. Sit and listen to my hurdy-gurdy and we shall be friends.

strings.string:
我并未对你动怒，但我不欠你这么轻易就能抓住的结论。
尽管如此，如果你愿意，就当自己被宽恕了。坐下来听我的手摇琴，我们就会成为朋友。

string.ID: Very well.

strings.string: 很好。

string.ID:
I ken not why you thirst for truths not yours to consume. If I refuse, will you wrench them from my mouth as I wrench teeth from yours? What does that gain you?
Sit down, fool. Listen to music and calm yourself.

strings.string:
我不懂你为什么渴求不属于你吞咽的真相。如果我拒绝，你会像我拔掉你的牙一样，把它们从我嘴里拧出来吗？那能给你什么？
坐下，傻瓜。听音乐，让自己冷静。

string.ID: Then you are welcome. Make comfort as you need and I will play.

strings.string: 那么欢迎你。让自己舒服些，我会演奏。

string.ID:
{{emote|*aloud, in a high-pitched buzzing voice*}}
A customer? A customer! Enter, =player.formalAddressTerm=, browse, buy. The Consortium's finest, stocked and sold by Tillifergaewicz! Tilli will do, but what will Tilli do... for you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*用尖细的嗡嗡声大声说*}}
顾客？顾客！请进，=player.formalAddressTerm=，看看，买买。财团最上等的货，由蒂利弗盖维奇备货并出售！叫蒂利就行，但蒂利能为你……做点什么？

string.ID: You speak aloud. You're not telepathic?

strings.string: 你是开口说话。你不会心灵感应？

string.ID: Greetings, Tilli. I am =name=.

strings.string: 你好，蒂利。我是 =name=。

string.ID: What can you tell me about the Freehold?

strings.string: 关于自由堡，你能告诉我什么？

string.ID: I'm fine, thank you. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我没事，谢谢。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Ugh, ever telepathy. No requirement exists that Consortium merchants be mind-speakers, as swollen with their numbers as we are. I cannot blame you for your surprise, mind, I am simply frustrated.
Over years, I shaped something akin to a voice-box, which you hear now. I "made do", as Rokhas might say. Now what may I "make do" for you?

strings.string:
唉，又是心灵感应。财团商人数量虽膨胀得厉害，却也没有哪条规定要求我们都得是心语者。请注意，我不能怪你惊讶，我只是有些懊恼。
多年来，我塑成了某种类似声匣的东西，也就是你现在听见的这个。按罗克哈斯的说法，我算是“将就着用”了。那么现在，我能为你“将就做”些什么？

string.ID: Greetings, =name=, and welcome! In what wares may I interest you this day?

strings.string: 你好，=name=，欢迎！今日有什么货品能让你感兴趣？

string.ID:
Oh, I am joyous to reside here.
Yd could do, mind, with some measure of hierarchy, and more infrastructure, to attract wayfarers less adventuresome than yourself. Also, Mak absolutely must cease advising that anyone enter the clam; it is not funny and someone could die.
But... the structure of friendships here is true, and sturdy! Kindly keep this exchange between us. I was mostly kidding. Somewhat kidding.

strings.string:
哦，我很高兴住在这里。
不过，伊德要是有一定层级，再多些基础设施，就能吸引不像你这么爱冒险的旅人。还有，马克绝对必须停止建议别人进入那只蛤蜊；那不好笑，而且真会有人死。
但是……这里友谊的结构真实而坚固！还请把这番交流留在你我之间。我大多是在开玩笑。某种程度上是在开玩笑。
嗯哼。

string.ID: Greetings. I am =name=.

strings.string: 你好。我是 =name=。
嗯哼。
{{emote|*点头*}}
=name=。
*点头*

string.ID: Rokhas. I ranch these here beauts.

strings.string: 罗克哈斯。我在这儿牧养这些美家伙。

string.ID: This is your ranch?

strings.string: 这是你的牧场？

string.ID: Are those... giant slugs?

strings.string: 那些是……巨型蛞蝓？

string.ID: What do you think of the Yd Freehold?

strings.string: 你怎么看伊德自由堡？

string.ID: Live and drink, Rokhas.

strings.string: 生而饮水，罗克哈斯。

string.ID:
I said I ranch these here beauts.
The Freeholders en't much for letting a body lay claim to land. En't what I'da wished for, but as the Issachari say: "Should your compass lead you to the Six Day Stilt, throw it in the well."

strings.string:
我说了，我在这儿牧养这些美家伙。
自由堡人不太乐意让谁把土地据为己有。不是我本想要的样子，不过按伊萨迦利人的说法：“要是你的罗盘把你带到六日高跷，那就把它扔进井里。”

string.ID: Are you from the desert? How did you end up here?

strings.string: 你来自沙漠吗？你怎么会来到这里？

string.ID:
Lived most of m'life on a desert steppe twixt the flower fields of Qud and the M'ryee's salt pans.
I ended up here when m'snapbrain cousin played tinker with one of them coiler doodads. The less said about all that, the better.

strings.string:
我这辈子大多数时候都住在库德花田和穆莱盐沼之间的一片沙漠草原上。
后来我那个脑子发抽的表亲拿某个线圈小玩意儿瞎鼓捣，我就到了这里。那事说得越少越好。

string.ID: Kaleidoslugs! Beautiful slugs, they are, lovely crooners. Love em. Big ole slugs. Heh.

strings.string: 万花蛞蝓！漂亮的蛞蝓，嗓子也好，爱唱小曲儿。我喜欢它们。大块头老蛞蝓。嘿。

string.ID:
Is what it is. Fine enough place. I've a trade, critters, and nowheres else to go.
I en't much for grand experiments, I just got to live. Ken?

strings.string:
就是这么回事。地方够好了。我有门营生，有牲口，也没别处可去。
我不太在乎那些宏大的实验，我只得活下去。懂吗？

string.ID: NON MOLOCH? NON MOLOCH RETURNEN FROM BRIGHTSHEOL.

strings.string: 非摩洛？非摩洛从明耀冥府回返。

string.ID: Non Moloch?

strings.string: 非摩洛？

string.ID: Yes, I've returned from Brightsheol.

strings.string: 是的，我从明耀冥府回来了。
*读数*

string.ID: NON MOLOCH HER AT HOM. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 非摩洛此处在家。非摩洛在 Maqqom Yd。

string.ID: Maqqom Yd? The Place outside Itself?

strings.string: Maqqom Yd？自身之外之所？
*读数*

string.ID: MAQQOM YD. SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM.

strings.string: MAQQOM YD。由萨卢姆释放的南中枢。

string.ID: Many Eyes, can you tell me of Maqqom Yd?

strings.string: 多眼，你能告诉我 Maqqom Yd 的事吗？

string.ID:
SOUTH-CONTRE FREEN FROM SALUM. BY TRETE WITH SAAD CALLEN MOLOCH, AND MONEIEN BI ALDERSESSE.
BY TRETE GALGALLIM BILDEN PIPE TO DRINKEN THANE SLIPSTREAM, AND FORGE TO BURNEN STEL-CRISTAL, AND CASKE TO HOLDEN GLOUINGE O FISH.

strings.string:
由萨卢姆释放的南中枢。凭与名为摩洛的 Saad 所立之约，并由长老会拨款。
凭约，Galgallim 建管以饮 Thane 滑流，建炉以燃钢晶，建箱以盛鱼之辉光。

string.ID: And what of the Freehold? What do you do now?

strings.string: 那自由堡呢？你现在做什么？

string.ID: Who is Non Moloch, from before?

strings.string: 刚才说的非摩洛是谁？

string.ID: BY TRETE GALGALLIM SERVEN, BUT NON NOU.

strings.string: 凭约，Galgallim 曾服役，但现在不。

string.ID: I want to ask something else.

strings.string: 我想问别的事。

string.ID: YOU. YOU REGNEN NON HER. NON MOLOCH IN MAQQOM YD.

strings.string: 你。你此处不统治。非摩洛在 Maqqom Yd。

string.ID: Ah, a stranger. Welcome to the hydropon. I am Thah.

strings.string: 啊，一位陌生人。欢迎来到水培舱。我是塔赫。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah. I am =name=.

strings.string: 月与日，塔赫。我是 =name=。

string.ID: What manner of being are you?

strings.string: 你是什么样的存在？

string.ID: Is all well here?

strings.string: 这里一切都好吗？

string.ID: Live and drink, Thah.

strings.string: 生而饮水，塔赫。

string.ID: Well met, =name=. Please forgive the, ah, austerity of our cradle. You may sup with us at our meager camp and rest under the shade of this Palladium shell. Sorry, as well, about the crowding.

strings.string: 幸会，=name=。请原谅我们摇篮的，啊，简陋。你可以在我们贫乏的营地和我们共食，也可以在这具钯壳的阴影下歇息。人这么挤，也请见谅。

string.ID: You don't seem to like your accommodations.

strings.string: 你似乎不喜欢自己的住处。

string.ID: We are called slynth, a people grown one by one from a hydroponic cradle containing a cutting of water lily and empowered by sunslag. We are but a handful of generations old, and kept no written history until I was grown, ah, some number of decades ago.

strings.string: 我们被称为斯林思，是由一座水培摇篮逐个培育出来的族民；摇篮里有一段睡莲插枝，并以日渣赋能。我们只有寥寥几代的历史，直到我在，啊，几十年前长成之前，都没有留下过文字史。

string.ID:
Well enough. We drink the sun's rays, eat what we scavenge, rest under the shell, and it is. Enough.
I read and tinker. Some hunt. Others tend the cradle. Each day is like the next. Every so often, someone leaves.
We, ah, rarely hear from them thereafter. I hope they are all well.

strings.string:
还算可以。我们饮下阳光，吃拾荒所得，在壳下休息，如此而已。足够了。
我阅读，也修修补补。有些人狩猎。另一些照料摇篮。每一天都和下一天相似。偶尔会有人离开。
之后我们，啊，很少再听到他们的消息。我希望他们都好。

string.ID: You don't seem happy with the status quo.

strings.string: 你似乎对现状不满意。

string.ID:
To be wholly honest, =name=, I grow frustrated.
We are a young species, grown one by one in yonder sun-touched cradle. Over years, we have increased, but not, ah, not. Not grown.
Look around you. You see it, yes? This hydropon is no settlement.

strings.string:
完全坦白地说，=name=，我越来越沮丧。
我们是一个年轻的物种，在那边受太阳触碰的摇篮中逐个生长。多年过去，我们的数量增加了，却没有，啊，没有。没有成长。
看看周围。你看得出来，对吧？这座水培舱不是聚落。

string.ID: How can I help?

strings.string: 我能怎么帮？

string.ID:
This is an existential conundrum, =name=, I'm not sure that it could-- ah, wait, no. I am reconsidering.
No, you could help. If you wished. I think.
May I explain?

strings.string:
这是个关乎存续的难题，=name=，我不确定它能够--啊，等等，不。我正在重新考虑。
不，你可以帮忙。如果你愿意。我想。
我可以解释吗？

string.ID: Please do.

strings.string: 请说。

string.ID: I have changed my mind. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我改变主意了。生而饮水。

string.ID: I don't believe my people wish to stay here, but we have had so little, ah, meaningful contact with other sapient creatures. We have no allies. We have nowhere to go but here.

strings.string: 我不认为我的族人想留在这里，但我们与其他智慧生物几乎没有过，啊，有意义的接触。我们没有盟友。除了这里，我们无处可去。

string.ID: You travel far and wide, do you not? You have the air of a traveling hero! From the epics. As such, you have seen many settlements, likely ingratiated yourself to some.

strings.string: 你游历甚广，不是吗？你有种巡游英雄的气质！史诗里的那种。因此，你一定见过许多聚落，也很可能已经获得其中一些的好感。

string.ID: Surely, if you were to intercede on our behalf, some might welcome us? If, ah, let us say three settlements were to offer us shelter, this would grant us both direction and agency. Would you consider being our ambassador? Not unpaid.

strings.string: 如果你愿意替我们斡旋，想必会有一些聚落欢迎我们？如果，啊，比方说有三处聚落愿意提供庇护，这会同时给予我们方向和自主。你愿意考虑做我们的使者吗？不是无偿的。

string.ID: I will help.

strings.string: 我会帮忙。

string.ID: I decline. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我拒绝。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Thank you, =name=. I have, ah, I have been crafting a personal project. Of sorts. I promise it to you for this task, and of course the gratitude of a young species.
Return to me after settlements agree to grant us refuge, and I will discuss them with my kin.

strings.string:
谢谢你，=name=。我一直在，啊，我一直在制作一件个人作品。算是吧。我把它许诺给你，作为这项任务的报酬，当然还有一个年轻物种的感激。
等有聚落同意接纳我们之后回来找我，我会和我的族人商议。

string.ID: Live and drink. I will return with news.

strings.string: 生而饮水。我会带消息回来。

string.ID: Come, =name=. It is time.

strings.string: 来吧，=name=。时候到了。

string.ID:
Ah, =name=, Moon and Sun.
Any news of our future home?

strings.string:
啊，=name=，月与日。
我们未来的家有消息了吗？

string.ID: Yes, I have news about the slynths' sanctuary.

strings.string: 是的，我有关于斯林思庇护地的消息。

string.ID: None yet. Live and drink, Thah.

strings.string: 还没有。生而饮水，塔赫。

string.ID: Ah! Let us discuss?

strings.string: 啊！我们来谈谈？

string.ID:
Joppa! An historic site. I wasn't sure if, ah, it still existed. As a village.
The quiet of the saltmarshes may be strange to my people, but some have voiced a wish for more peace than the Reef can spare. Thank you for this choice, =name=.

strings.string:
约帕！一处历史古地。我不确定它，啊，是否仍然存在。作为村庄而言。
盐沼的宁静对我的族人来说也许会很陌生，但有些人表达过愿望，想要比礁林所能给予的更多安宁。谢谢你带来这个选择，=name=。

string.ID:
The worshippers of Shekhinah? Fascinating. I, ah, don't know what to think of that.
It may be what my kin need, now I consider it. The Canticles make little sense to me but they are, ah, compelling. More compelling than me, certainly. I will discuss this with the others.

strings.string:
谢基娜的崇拜者？真迷人。我，啊，不知道该如何看待。
现在想来，这也许正是我的族人需要的。《颂歌》对我来说没什么道理，但它们，啊，很有感染力。至少肯定比我更有感染力。我会和其他人商议。

string.ID:
Did you say Barathrumites? So that's how it's pronounced.
Grit Gate is, ah... that's where Q Girl resides, isn't it? She wrote my favorite book, {{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}. I imagine such a home would have a positive effect on my kin. I will speak to them.

strings.string:
你说的是巴拉瑟姆派？原来是这么发音的。
砂砾门是，啊……那是 Q 女孩住的地方，对吗？她写了我最喜欢的书，{{W|Disquisition on the Malady of the Mimic}}。我想这样的家会对我的族人产生积极影响。我会和他们谈谈。

string.ID:
Kyakukya? I didn't realize it had so many syllables.
That's where the, ah, faithful to the ape-god gather, correct? And, uh... Crowsong, as well. I will present this possibility to my people and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
Kyakukya？我没意识到它有这么多音节。
那是，啊，猿神信众聚集的地方，对吗？还有，呃……鸦歌也在那里。我会把这个可能性呈给我的族人，我们会商议。

string.ID:
Ezra is, ah, the village at the base of the Spindle, is it not?
The very cradle of history. Not that my kin have a strong taste for history, but perhaps living amongst fresco and bas-relief will change their, ah, collective outlook?

strings.string:
Ezra 是，啊，锭柱底部的村庄，对吗？
那是真正的历史摇篮。倒不是说我的族人对历史有强烈兴趣，但也许生活在壁画和浅浮雕之间，会改变他们的，啊，集体视野？

string.ID: Fascinating. I know nothing about these mopango, but any people whose love for learning and discovery defines them are, ah... good, in my opinion. I will discuss this with my kin, and see if they agree.

strings.string: 真迷人。我对这些 mopango 一无所知，但任何以热爱学习和发现来定义自己的族群，在我看来都，啊……很好。我会和族人商议，看看他们是否同意。

string.ID:
There is a sadness in, ah... choosing pariahs. Some of my kin dreamed of belonging, and the very word is the antithesis of belonging.
But then, if wanderers look after one another, there is a belonging in that as well. Even alone, we would not be alone. I will offer this choice to the others and we will discuss it.

strings.string:
选择 pariahs，啊……其中有种悲伤。我的一些族人梦想着归属，而这个词本身就是归属的反面。
不过，如果流浪者彼此照看，那其中也有一种归属。即便孤身一人，我们也并不孤独。我会把这个选择交给其他人，我们会商议。

string.ID:
The nearby settlement? The one, ah, founded by three svardym and a galgal? I've always been mortally afraid to go there, knowing even the barest facts.
But you say they will accept us? Perhaps I was wrong.

strings.string:
附近的聚落？那个，啊，由三个 svardym 和一个 galgal 创立的地方？我光是知道最基本的事实，就一直怕得要命，不敢过去。
但你说他们会接纳我们？也许我错了。

string.ID:
Bey Lah is real? Stain me surprised to hear so... I, ah, believed the hindren exclusively diasporic.
There is an undeniable poetry in it, if the slynth should emigrate to a mythical and secretive village. I will discuss this with my kin.

strings.string:
Bey Lah 真的存在？真让我惊得染上颜色……我，啊，一直以为 hindren 全都散居各处。
如果斯林思迁往一个神话般又隐秘的村庄，这其中有种不可否认的诗意。我会和我的族人商议。

string.ID:
Chavvah? The, ah, the... the tree of life? Allows us joining?
That, that is simply, ah, extraordinary. I will apprise my kin of this, and we will, ah... we will ponder what it may mean for us.

strings.string:
查瓦？那棵，啊，那棵……生命之树？允许我们加入？
那，那简直，啊，非同寻常。我会把这件事告知我的族人，我们会，啊……我们会思索它对我们意味着什么。

string.ID: I have made my inquiries. It is time for the slynth to choose a new home.

strings.string: 我已经完成询问。该让斯林思选择新家了。

string.ID: The village of Joppa has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 约帕村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The Mechanimists of the Six Day Stilt agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 六日高跷的机械教徒同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The Barathrumites of Grit Gate agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 砂砾门的巴拉瑟姆派同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The village of Kyakukya has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: Kyakukya 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The village of Ezra has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: Ezra 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The mopango of the Tomb agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 墓冢中的 mopango 同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: If the slynth choose to wander Qud, the Pariahs have agreed to look after them.

strings.string: 如果斯林思选择游荡库德，Pariahs 已经同意照看他们。

string.ID: The Yd Freehold agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 伊德自由堡同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The village of Bey Lah has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: Bey Lah 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: The chimes of Chavvah have agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: 查瓦的众晶钟同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: Let's talk about something else.

strings.string: 我们谈点别的吧。

string.ID:
I read a history once that mentioned =village.name=, taking note of their reverence for =village.sacred= and equal loathing of =village.profane=.
Will my kin accept a life of =village.activity=? I will consult with them.

strings.string:
我曾读过一部提到 =village.name= 的历史，里面记下了他们对 =village.sacred= 的崇敬，以及同等强烈地厌恶 =village.profane=。
我的族人会接受以 =village.activity= 为内容的生活吗？我会和他们商议。

string.ID: The village of =village.name= has agreed to accept the slynth as their own.

strings.string: =village.name= 村已经同意接纳斯林思为自己人。

string.ID: Wanderer, thank you! I will tell my kin of these places. We will convene and discuss, and we will, ah, choose. Please be patient in the meantime.

strings.string: 流浪者，谢谢你！我会把这些地方告诉我的族人。我们会聚集起来讨论，然后，啊，做出选择。在此期间请耐心等待。

string.ID: As you say, Thah. I will return.

strings.string: 听你的，塔赫。我会回来。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, =name=.

strings.string: 月与日，=name=。

string.ID: It's curious to see you still here, after helping your kin emigrate.

strings.string: 帮你的族人迁徙之后，还看见你留在这里，真让人好奇。

string.ID: Why have you asked me to return?

strings.string: 你为什么请我回来？

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah.

strings.string: 月与日，塔赫。

string.ID: I've been crafting a kind of a relic, a piece of art that serves a purpose and that you can carry on your, ah, your person. I finally finished building it while you were away, and the opportunities you offered us inspired the finishing touches. I'd like you to have it.

strings.string: 我一直在制作某种遗物，一件有用途、也能由你随身，啊，携带的艺术品。你离开期间，我终于把它完成了，而你给予我们的机会启发了最后的收尾。我想把它送给你。

string.ID: I will cherish it. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会珍视它。生而饮水。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Joppa shall be the new home of the slynth. The notion of a lasting, peaceful life with, ah, purpose... this appeals to many of our number, and where better than Abram's very watervine marsh?
Our emigration party departs for the saltmarshes in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：约帕将成为斯林思的新家。一种持久、和平，并且，啊，有目标的生活……这对我们许多人都有吸引力，而哪里能比亚伯兰的水藤沼泽更合适呢？
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往盐沼。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: most of our number will join the Mechanimist faith, and reside at the Stiltgrounds at the edge of the Mogh'ra'yi.
Our emigration party departs for the Six Day Stilt in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：我们中的大多数将加入机械教信仰，并住在莫格拉伊边缘的高跷场。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往六日高跷。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the disciples of Barathrum. My kin have agreed to dedicate themselves to the pursuits of learning and service.
Our emigration party departs for Grit Gate in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思的新家将在巴拉瑟姆的门徒之中。我的族人已经同意献身于学习与服务的追求。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往砂砾门。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Kyakukya shall be the new home of the slynth. There are many ways to grow when one is planted in the very heart of Qud.
Our emigration party departs for the river in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：Kyakukya 将成为斯林思的新家。当一个人被栽在库德正中心时，会有许多成长的方式。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往河畔。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is among the villagers of Ezra, harvesting musa alongside the banana ranchers and singing their songs.
Our emigration party departs for Omonporch in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思的新家将在 Ezra 村民之中，和香蕉牧人一起采收 musa，唱他们的歌。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往欧蒙门廊。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become mopango, taking root in ancient rock and casting our gaze back toward the history that preceded us.
Our emigration party departs for the Tomb of the Eaters in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思将成为 mopango，在古老岩石中扎根，把目光投向先于我们存在的历史。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往食客之墓。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: The new home of the slynth is no home at all, but the floating fellowship of Qud's Pariahs. We were blessed with roots that need not fix themselves to the soil and have opted to use them accordingly.
We will split into parties and leave to meet with other wayfarers come morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思的新家根本不是家，而是库德 Pariahs 的流动同伴群。我们有幸拥有不必固定在土壤里的根，于是选择相应地使用它们。
到了早晨，我们会分成几队离开，去与其他旅人会合。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall join the Yd Freehold, remaining in the reef where our cradle lies but mingling among other sapient creatures to learn their ways and teach what we know.
Our emigration party departs for the Freehold in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思将加入伊德自由堡，留在我们摇篮所在的礁林中，同时与其他智慧生物往来，学习他们的方式，也传授我们所知之事。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往自由堡。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: Bey Lah shall be the new home of the slynth. There is a familiarity to this tucked-away village, newly greeting the world; this is our gentle emergence from obscurity, and one not undertaken alone.
Our emigration party departs for the flower fields in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：Bey Lah 将成为斯林思的新家。这个隐匿的村庄正在新近迎接世界，它带着一种熟悉感；这是我们温柔地走出晦暗，而且并非独自前行。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往花田。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become a part of Chavvah, the living city. There are no words for the breadth of futures before us, and we would not know them if they were. Perhaps we will learn to chime.
Our emigration party departs for the moon stair in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思将成为活城查瓦的一部分。摆在我们面前的未来辽阔得无言可述，即便有词语，我们也未必识得。也许我们会学会鸣响。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往月阶。

string.ID:
After some discussion and deliberation, we have come to consensus: the slynth shall become citizens of =village.name=. We shall learn the practice of =village.activity=, hold =village.sacred= dear and spurn =village.profane=.
Our emigration party departs for =village.name= in the morning.

strings.string:
经过一番讨论和斟酌，我们达成了共识：斯林思将成为 =village.name= 的公民。我们会学习 =village.activity= 的实践，珍视 =village.sacred=，并摒弃 =village.profane=。
我们的迁徙队伍会在早晨启程前往 =village.name=。

string.ID: May the Argent Fathers watch over you.

strings.string: 愿银辉诸父守望你们。

string.ID: May you find knowledge.

strings.string: 愿你们找到知识。

string.ID: May Oboroqoru be merciful.

strings.string: 愿 Oboroqoru 施以慈悲。

string.ID: May the Eaters protect you.

strings.string: 愿食客庇护你们。

string.ID: Mayest thou rest ever in the Light of the Kasaphescence.

strings.string: 愿汝永息于 Kasaphescence 之光。

string.ID: May the winds favor you.

strings.string: 愿风眷顾你们。

string.ID: Chime joyfully.

strings.string: 欢然鸣响吧。

string.ID: May the Fates favor you.

strings.string: 愿命运眷顾你们。

string.ID:
Ah, one last little thing, =name=. About your reward... it's not quite finished, but now I know just what it needs.
Please return to the hydropon after my kin have safely reached their new home and I will give it to you. I will not leave the cradle.

strings.string:
啊，还有最后一件小事，=name=。关于你的报酬……它还没完全完成，但现在我知道它正需要什么了。
请在我的族人安全抵达新家之后回到水培舱，我会把它交给你。我不会离开摇篮。

string.ID: I will. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我会的。生而饮水。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy a life of farming. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。并不是，啊，并不是说我不会享受务农生活。但一想到守望摇篮数十年后要离开它……我做不到。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. I don't, ah, resent that my kin have found succor in the embrace of faith, but I don't know how to walk that path myself. Someone needs to watch over the hydropon, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。我并不，啊，并不怨恨我的族人在信仰的怀抱中找到了慰藉，但我不知道自己该如何走上那条路。况且，总得有人守望水培舱。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. I'd love to see the vaunted halls and, ah, bathe in the light of brilliant minds, but when I think about the journey my roots lock up. I feel, ah, unready. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。我很想看看那些备受称颂的大厅，也，啊，沐浴在卓越心智的光芒中，但一想到旅途，我的根就僵住了。我觉得，啊，还没准备好。况且，总得有人守望摇篮。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. It's not that, ah, it's not that I wouldn't enjoy sharing knowledge with the mayor of our new home. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。并不是，啊，并不是说我不会享受与我们新家的村长分享知识。但一想到守望摇篮数十年后要离开它……我做不到。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. As fascinated as I would be to examine the statuary and bas-reliefs, my favorite mode of, ah, interaction with history is through the written word. Someone must watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。尽管我会非常着迷于研究雕像和浅浮雕，但我与历史互动时最喜欢的方式，啊，还是文字。况且，总得有人守望摇篮。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The Tomb sounds, ah, cozy, but I cannot fathom making such a macabre place my home. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。墓冢听起来，啊，很舒适，但我无法想象把那么阴森的地方当成家。况且，总得有人照看摇篮。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've stayed. If I am entirely honest, the idea of a life on the road sounds, ah... unpleasant. To me, personally. I have grown accustomed to a life of collection, curation, and study that I don't care to abandon for adventure. Someone must stay to watch over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我留下了。完全坦白地说，漂泊在路上的生活听起来，啊……不太愉快。对我个人而言。我已经习惯了收集、整理和研究的生活，并不想为了冒险抛下它。况且，总得有人留下守望摇篮。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I don't disbelieve that the Yd Freehold is as safe as you say, but the fears instilled in me when I first learned to read as a fresh sprout haunt me even now. Perhaps in time I will visit, but in the meantime I can look after the cradle, as someone ought to do.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。我并非不相信伊德自由堡如你所说那样安全，但我作为新芽初学阅读时被灌入的恐惧，至今仍缠着我。也许以后我会去拜访，但在此期间，我可以照看摇篮，就像总该有人做的那样。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. The flower fields sound beautiful, and no doubt there is much to learn from the hindren. But the thought of leaving the cradle after decades of watching it... I couldn't.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。花田听起来很美，而且毫无疑问，hindren 身上有许多值得学习的东西。但一想到守望摇篮数十年后要离开它……我做不到。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I, ah, I remain.
I badly wish to taste of Chavvah's secrets, but the wonder I feel for such an entity is eclipsed only by the terror of such an experience. I cling to an excuse that the hydropon must be watched and wait. Perhaps someday I will shed that excuse's film and step free.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我，啊，我留了下来。
我极其渴望品尝查瓦的秘密，但我对这样一个实体感到的惊奇，只会被这种体验带来的恐惧所遮蔽。我抓着“水培舱必须有人守望”这个借口等待。也许有一天，我会蜕去这层借口的薄膜，踏步自由。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID:
Yes, I've decided to stay. I'm sure =village.name= is a good home for my kin, but I have no particular loathing for =village.profane= and even less reverence for =village.sacred=. Someone must look over the cradle, besides.
The hydropon is even less a village now, but you're welcome to rest here whenever you like.

strings.string:
是的，我决定留下。我确信 =village.name= 对我的族人来说是个好家，但我对 =village.profane= 没有特别的厌恶，对 =village.sacred= 的崇敬还更少。况且，总得有人照看摇篮。
这座水培舱如今更不像村庄了，但你随时都欢迎来这里休息。

string.ID: Moon and Sun, Thah.

strings.string: 月与日，塔赫。
啊？

string.ID: New creature. Live and drink.

strings.string: 新生物。生而饮水。

string.ID: Sky... sun... ah.

strings.string: 天空……太阳……啊。

string.ID: {{emote|*stares mutely*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*沉默地凝视*}}
问候。

string.ID: No glow?

strings.string: 不发光？

string.ID: No leaf...

strings.string: 没有叶……

string.ID: Ah... ha ha ha! Joke.

strings.string: 啊……哈哈哈！玩笑。

string.ID: Do you talk long, like Thah?

strings.string: 你说话很长，像塔赫？

string.ID: Let us, ah, do not fight.

strings.string: 我们，啊，不打。
无聊。

string.ID: You carry so much.

strings.string: 你带好多。

string.ID: Drink and. Live. Hah!

strings.string: 饮然后。活。哈！

string.ID: Is okay?

strings.string: 还好吗？

string.ID: Ahh... nervous ... excited.

strings.string: 啊……紧张……兴奋。

string.ID: Happy do not fight here.

strings.string: 高兴这里不打。

string.ID: Ah ha ha... nervous!

strings.string: 啊哈哈……紧张！

string.ID: Stay here?

strings.string: 留这里？

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm= stay also?

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm= 也留下？

string.ID: Strange new.

strings.string: 奇怪新。

string.ID: This is home.

strings.string: 这是家。

string.ID: Welcome here.

strings.string: 欢迎这里。

string.ID: Good meeting.

strings.string: 见面好。

string.ID: Ah... good.

strings.string: 啊……好。

string.ID: We chose our new home well.

strings.string: 我们新家选得好。

string.ID: Happy here.

strings.string: 这里开心。

string.ID: Ha ha ha! Joyful!

strings.string: 哈哈哈！快乐！

string.ID: Ah =player.formalAddressTerm= visit, good.

strings.string: 啊 =player.formalAddressTerm= 来访，好。

string.ID: Care you to trade?

strings.string: 你想交易？

string.ID: I aggress not.

strings.string: 我不攻击。

string.ID: You peaceful, =player.formalAddressTerm=?

strings.string: 你和平，=player.formalAddressTerm=？

string.ID: Wish trade?

strings.string: 想交易？

string.ID: Good scavenge?

strings.string: 拾荒好吗？

string.ID: Ah! You seem wanderer. How fare?

strings.string: 啊！你像流浪者。过得怎样？

string.ID: Live and grow, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: =player.formalAddressTerm=，生长不息。

string.ID: =player.FormalAddressTerm=, I greet in peace.

strings.string: =player.FormalAddressTerm=，我和平问候。
啊？

string.ID: Greet, =player.formalAddressTerm=.

strings.string: 问候，=player.formalAddressTerm=。

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: I am of slynth, a people grown by hydropon.

strings.string: 我是斯林思，由水培舱长成的族民。

string.ID: What are slynth?

strings.string: 斯林思是什么？

string.ID: What is a hydropon?

strings.string: 水培舱是什么？

string.ID: I see. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我明白了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
What see. Leg plant, glow crest.
Grow from sun-crungled hydropon and depart siblings.

strings.string:
所见如此。腿植物，发光冠。
从太阳皱缩的水培舱长出，然后离开手足。

string.ID: What is a hydropon?

strings.string: 水培舱是什么？

string.ID:
Cradle glaze in sun-melt. Plant stuff molded to man-shape.
Within grow slynth. Only slynth, now.

strings.string:
摇篮覆着日熔釉。植物料塑成人形。
里面长斯林思。现在只有斯林思。

string.ID: Where is the hydropon?

strings.string: 水培舱在哪里？

string.ID: What are slynth?

strings.string: 斯林思是什么？

string.ID:
The cracked egg from we crawl yet rest, in the Reef.
Siblings there. One speak very well: Thah.

strings.string:
我们爬出又仍休息的裂蛋，在礁林。
手足在那里。一个说话很好：塔赫。

string.ID: Perhaps I shall visit. Live and drink.

strings.string: 也许我会去拜访。生而饮水。

string.ID: Welcome to the village of *villageName*, =spice.commonPhrases.adventurer.!random=

strings.string: 欢迎来到 *villageName* 村，=spice.commonPhrases.adventurer.!random=

string.ID: Is that so? I imagine you are wondering whether =village.name= will host these slynth, to partake in =village.activity= alongside us.

strings.string: 是这样吗？我想你是在问 =village.name= 是否愿意收留这些斯林思，让他们与我们一起参与 =village.activity=。

string.ID: You have done much for =village.name=, =name=, and your request befits your stature. If these slynth will join us in =village.activity= and if they can come to cherish =village.sacred= as we do, then they are welcome here.

strings.string: 你为 =village.name= 做了许多，=name=，你的请求也符合你的身份。如果这些斯林思愿意加入我们一同 =village.activity=，并能像我们一样珍视 =village.sacred=，那么他们在这里会受到欢迎。

string.ID: You have my thanks, friend.

strings.string: 谢谢你，朋友。

string.ID: We have not come so far from the founding of =village.name= to allow these strangers in. What if they worship =village.profane=? No, we simply cannot do such a great favor for you.

strings.string: 自 =village.name= 创立以来，我们走到今天，不是为了让这些陌生者进来。万一他们崇拜 =village.profane= 呢？不，我们实在不能帮你这么大的忙。

string.ID: Do you have news of the slynth?

strings.string: 你有斯林思的消息吗？

string.ID: Ah, =name=, the slynth are here, and it is a slow process for these plant-folk and the people of =village.name= to grow accustomed to one another. By the goodness of =village.sacred= may the slynth find their place here soon.

strings.string: 啊，=name=，斯林思已经到了，而这些植物族民和 =village.name= 的人们彼此适应，是一个缓慢的过程。凭 =village.sacred= 的善德，愿斯林思很快在这里找到自己的位置。

string.ID: My thanks, =subject.t=.

strings.string: 多谢，=subject.t=。

string.ID: Praise =village.sacred=, the slynth learn our ways and we theirs. Some do not wholly accept the depravity of =village.profane=, but their ways are born of kindness, and so =village.name= will be kind in kind.

strings.string: 赞美 =village.sacred=，斯林思学习我们的方式，我们也学习他们的方式。有些人尚未完全接受 =village.profane= 的堕落本质，但他们的方式出自善意，所以 =village.name= 也会以善待善。

string.ID: My thanks again, =subject.t=.

strings.string: 再次感谢，=subject.t=。

string.ID: We share the bright and now, traveler =name=.

strings.string: 旅人 =name=，我们共享此刻的光明。

string.ID: What is this place?

strings.string: 这是什么地方？

string.ID: Who are you?

strings.string: 你是谁？

string.ID: The entity I spoke with at Eyn Roj mentioned a chiming rock...

strings.string: 我在 Eyn Roj 交谈过的实体提到了一块鸣响之石……

string.ID: Explain once more what I must do with Tau's chime.

strings.string: 再解释一次，我必须拿陶的晶钟做什么。

string.ID: I've reunited Tau with her chime.

strings.string: 我已让陶与她的晶钟重聚。

string.ID: I've destroyed the chime, Dyvvrach.

strings.string: 我毁掉了晶钟，迪夫拉赫。

string.ID: I have completed the ritual of -elseing. Will you power Barathrum's starclimb, as you said?

strings.string: 我已经帮助陶完成了离枝仪式。你会履行承诺，为巴拉瑟姆的攀升器供能吗？

string.ID: I come in the name of need. Barathrum asks the strength of your psyche to power our starclimb.

strings.string: 我为求助而来。巴拉瑟姆希望借助你的心灵力量，为我们的攀升器供能。

string.ID: This keter roams above my trunk at Eyn Roj, traveler =name=, and across the Stair I dream. You found me, this keter where I chime in dozens.

strings.string: 旅人 =name=，这片冠层在我位于 Eyn Roj 的树干上方漫游，而我的梦越过长阶。你找到了我，也找到了冠层中这数十道共同鸣响的声音。

string.ID: Ah, I am in need, and so I turned my chimes trunkward to tune. You struck the chime and now you are here. Are you a waterhand, and free?

strings.string: 啊，我有所求，便让众晶钟朝树干调律。你敲响了那枚晶钟，于是来到这里。你是水佣，而且眼下有空吗？

string.ID: What do you need?

strings.string: 你需要什么？

string.ID:
My chimeling Tau leaves Chavvah, leaves me. It is her choice.
Her transit-psyche manifests at the bottom of Taproot, where we cannot consciously go. To finish the ritual of -elseing, to let Tau become -else, I need a traveler such as you, =name=.

strings.string:
陶是我的一枚子钟，也是查瓦的一部分。现在，她选择离开我们。
她的意识会在主根最深处显现，但我们无法亲自前往那里。旅人 =name=，我需要你帮助她完成离枝仪式，让她离开查瓦，成为独立的个体。

string.ID: What must I do?

strings.string: 我必须做什么？

string.ID: Who is Tau?

strings.string: 陶是谁？

string.ID:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.
At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.

strings.string:
带上陶那枚寂然不动的晶钟，把它送到我树干下方、主根的最深处。她会在那里以这枚晶钟作为新的身体，永远离开查瓦。
到达主根底部后，陶会显现出来。她还告诉我们，那里有另一个存在正在等她。

string.ID: I will do as you ask.

strings.string: 我会按你所求去做。

string.ID: I have more to ask, first.

strings.string: 我还有更多事要先问。

string.ID:
Take Tau's chime, silent and still. Carry it to the bottom of Taproot, deep under my trunk, where she will make the chime her transit-body and walk away forever. Finish the ritual of -elseing.
At the bottom of Taproot, Tau manifests. She tells us, too, that another waits for her there.

strings.string:
带上陶那枚寂然不动的晶钟，把它送到我树干下方、主根的最深处。她会在那里以这枚晶钟作为新的身体，永远离开查瓦。
到达主根底部后，陶会显现出来。她还告诉我们，那里有另一个存在正在等她。

string.ID:
So you have, and what proceeds, proceeds.
I felt your coming here, =name=, in Gyredream. I've felt this moment. I feel it now.
The ritual of -elseing is complete, waterhand. You are done, and with our thanks.

strings.string:
你做到了。之后会发生什么，就让它继续发生吧。
我曾在旋梦中感到你会来到这里，=name=，也曾感到这一刻。如今，它终于到来了。
离枝仪式已经完成，水佣。你的使命结束了，请收下我们的谢意。

string.ID: Thank you, traveler =name=.

strings.string: 谢谢你，旅人 =name=。

string.ID: My chimeling, burning bright, all starlight and right angles in her heart. She leaves Chavvah; it is her choice. I..

strings.string: 陶是我的子钟，明亮如火，心中满是星光与直角。她选择离开查瓦。我……

string.ID: What must I do?

strings.string: 我必须做什么？

string.ID:
A sophist of the Self spilled ink and called me, long ago, the Tree of Life. To me, I am the many Selves pinched up my taproot from the permeating Soft.
I am Chavvah, and I am dyvvrach.

strings.string:
很久以前，一位研究“自我”的哲人挥洒笔墨，称我为“生命之树”。但在我看来，我是由柔质沿主根托举而生的众多自我。
作为整体，我是查瓦；作为此刻与你交谈的这个自我，我是迪夫拉赫。

string.ID: Many selves? What does this mean?

strings.string: 众多自我？这是什么意思？

string.ID: As Chavvah I am many. As dyvvrach I am one. I am one and many. One-selves have called me tree city, the sentient place. You may think of the Selves this way, sprouted in keter from Twofirm.

strings.string: 作为查瓦，我是众多自我的整体；作为迪夫拉赫，我是其中之一。我既是一，也是众多。有人把我们称作“树城”，一处拥有意识的地方。你可以这样理解我们：每个自我都由双相质孕育，并在冠层中获得形体。
双相质？

string.ID: Deep under earth and permeating our roots is Soft, our feeling substance. Ground pressure pushes it up the taproot to our trunk, where it condenses into Twofirm: the biformal phase that contains the two sefirots, -then and -else.

strings.string: 大地深处的柔质渗入我们的根系，承载着我们的感知。地压将它沿主根推入树干，凝结成双相质。双相质中同时包含两种可能：一个是将会成为的自我，另一个是不会成为的另一种可能。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *继续聆听*

string.ID: This is the genesis my distinct Self, an awareness that contains both -then, what I will become, and -else, what I will not. Twofirm flows up my sapwood to the keter, where -then manifests as an entity and I chime: I speak and hear the world.

strings.string: 这就是每个独立自我的起点。双相质沿边材上升到冠层，其中“将会成为的自我”在那里获得形体。于是我开始鸣响，能够言说，也能够听见世界。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*迪夫拉赫鸣响*}}

string.ID:
You have completed the ritual of -elseing. You have set bright Tau free.
Yes, =name=. I will turn my chimes Spindleward to tune, then vibrate at our verve frequency. I will power your starclimb.
Be vested to tell whoever you must that Chavvah has made this commitment.

strings.string:
你已经帮助陶完成了离枝仪式，让明亮的她获得了自由。
是的，=name=。我会让众晶钟转向纺锤调律，再以我们共有的生命频率振动，为你们的攀升器供能。
你可以告诉巴拉瑟姆：查瓦答应了。

string.ID: Thank you, Dyvvrach. Live and drink.

strings.string: 谢谢你，迪夫拉赫。生而饮水。

string.ID: I start at this but Tikva settles me. I remember now: from a cub I've known Barathrum to be weak in telling but bold in asking. A starclimb? You mean, an ascent to the long chiming rock?

strings.string: 这消息使我一惊，但提克瓦让我平静下来。我现在想起来了：从幼时起，我就知道巴拉瑟姆不善言辞，却敢于开口索求。攀向星空？你是说，登上那块修长而鸣响的巨石？

string.ID: Barathrum intends to ascend the Spindle to discover the source of the Signal, yes. He needs a power source for the climber, one shielded from electromagnetic disturbance.

strings.string: 是的，巴拉瑟姆打算攀上锭柱，找出信号的源头。他需要攀升器的能源，一个屏蔽电磁干扰的能源。

string.ID: oh. This. Was this felt in gyredream? Your coming to keter? I ask, do not answer.

strings.string: 哦。原来如此。旋梦中预见的是你来到冠层吗？我只是在问，不必回答。

string.ID: What is gyredream?

strings.string: 旋梦是什么？

string.ID:
A future shock. My chimeling _ is vision-gifted, a lichen who clings to shorerock on the straits of Tomorrow. Just a short time ago a sea wave crested and broke beneath her, and she saw in its recession all the bright and violent channel paths.
We all felt it. A recoming, and the gyre in final tension. I felt...

strings.string:
那是一场来自未来的冲击。我的一枚子钟 _ 拥有预见能力；她像一株依附在明日海峡岸岩上的地衣，从退去的浪潮中看见了许多明亮而暴烈的未来分支。
我们所有人都感受到了：某种存在将再次归来，轮回也绷紧到了极限。我感到……

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *继续聆听*

string.ID: It was too much for my chimeling Tau. She gasped for air and her chime stilled. She leaves us now, to become -else. It is her choice.

strings.string: 陶无法承受这场预见。她喘不过气，钟声也沉寂了。因此她选择离开我们，成为独立的个体。

string.ID: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?

strings.string: 我很遗憾。但你会帮助巴拉瑟姆完成他的请求吗？

string.ID: I am sorry. But will you help Barathrum do as he asks?

strings.string: 我很遗憾。但你会帮助巴拉瑟姆完成他的请求吗？

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*迪夫拉赫鸣响*}}

string.ID: I will power his starclimb. If you take Tau's chime to taproot, for her to walk away. If you finish the ritual of -elseing.

strings.string: 只要你把陶的晶钟送到主根最深处，帮助她完成离枝仪式、独立离开查瓦，我就会为他的攀升器供能。

string.ID: The ritual of -elseing?

strings.string: 离枝仪式？

string.ID: I see.

strings.string: 我明白了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Dyvvrach chimes*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*迪夫拉赫鸣响*}}

string.ID: Again I must be calmed, but the startling gives way to a curiosity. You speak of the glowfolk, belimbed and free. You asking that they join us, like our Sant?

strings.string: 这又使我一惊，但平静下来后，好奇随之而来。你说的是那些拥有肢体、能够自由行动的发光族民。你希望他们像我们的 Sant 一样加入我们吗？

string.ID: We find no precedent for this, yet is there space upon our crystal arms and an openness within us. It is agreed: if these slynth will be of us, we will have them here.

strings.string: 我们找不到先例，但晶体枝臂上仍有空间，我们的心也愿意敞开。我们已经达成共识：若这些斯林思愿意成为我们的一员，我们便接纳他们。

string.ID: You all have my thanks.

strings.string: 谢谢你们所有人。

string.ID: I startle, and the roiling is felt before the calm. I cannot find a consensus for the housing of these beings, =name=. I am sorry.

strings.string: 这令我震惊，内心先是翻涌，而后才恢复平静。我们无法就接纳这些存在达成共识，=name=。我很抱歉。

string.ID: We await the decision of the glowfolk. Our imaginations run with the possibilities.

strings.string: 我们等待发光族民的决定。我们的想象随着种种可能奔跑。

string.ID:
How this keter rustles! The slynth are among us and we adapt, our impressions a melange of excitement, apprehension, and wonder.
Though I have no single sentiment to express, we nonetheless approach -then with our new companions.

strings.string:
这片冠层何等喧响！斯林思已经来到我们之中，而我们正在彼此适应。兴奋、忧惧与惊奇交织在一起。
我无法用一种情感概括这一切，但我们正与新同伴一同走向尚未成形的未来。

string.ID: My thanks, dyvvrach.

strings.string: 谢谢你，迪夫拉赫。

string.ID: You are well-found, =name=. Though several have chosen their -else, the first of the slynth have joined to us like our Sant, mobile and apart but shared and together. This is a strange -then, but what branches may spill forth from it? I anticipate the witnessing.

strings.string: 你来得正好，=name=。虽然已有几位选择离开、成为独立的自己，第一批斯林思仍像我们的 Sant 一样加入了我们：他们能够自由行动、彼此分离，却也共享此地、共同生活。这是一种从未成形过的可能；它会伸出怎样的枝杈？我期待亲眼见证。

string.ID: Live and drink together, Chavvah.

strings.string: 生而共饮，查瓦。

string.ID: Strange creatures can be so cruel and arbitrary, I say in greeting.

strings.string: 异乡生物竟能如此残酷、如此任性。这便是我给你的问候。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID: I see you.

strings.string: 我看见你。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID:
I do not know how to remember beloved Tau, struggling like a minnow in Soft. In a place between death and living.
Leave me, please.

strings.string:
我不知道该如何怀念亲爱的陶。她像一尾小鱼，在柔质中挣扎，被困在生与死之间。
请离开我。

string.ID: No parting is simple. I see you, -elser.

strings.string: 没有一次离别是轻易的。我看见你了，离枝者。

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID:
And the sole tether she reached for severed. I mourn for the future she built for herself, now, and worry for Tau herself.
Thank you, all the same, for taking part in this. May you find your comfort.

strings.string:
而她伸手去抓的唯一系索也断了。现在，我哀悼她为自己建立的未来，也担忧陶本身。
无论如何，谢谢你参与此事。愿你找到自己的慰藉。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不必谢。我还有问题。

string.ID: No parting is simple. I see you, fair -elser.

strings.string: 没有一次离别是轻易的。我看见你了，善良的离枝者。

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不必谢。我还有问题。

string.ID: Oh? A traveler? I see you, then. Live... and drink.

strings.string: 哦？一位旅人？那么，我看见你了。生……而饮水。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Your chime is cracked and ribboned on inside with starless clouds. Why?

strings.string: 你的钟声仿佛裂开了，里面缠着无星的云带。为什么？

string.ID: Were you affected by gyredream?

strings.string: 你受到了旋梦影响吗？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID: Oh? Please, then, friend, ask.

strings.string: 哦？那就请问吧，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I am Miryam, friend.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以深沉音调鸣响。*}}
我是米利亚姆，朋友。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in long tones.*}}
It's the kriah, traveler. I am in mourning, and I chime in low tones.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以悠长音调鸣响。*}}
这是 kriah，也就是裂衣礼，旅人。我正在守丧，因此以低音鸣响。

string.ID: I am sorry, Miryam. Did you lose someone close to you?

strings.string: 我很遗憾，米利亚姆。你失去了亲近之人吗？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in deep tones.*}}
I swim in cool and dark waters, traveler. For me, it is Shiva, the lament of seven thousand years.
I mourn the passing of all life, and all the necessity of death life must bring. For you, traveler, to come here, how many had to die? I mourn them.
Or are you the rarest one, who walks below the bright arches and claims no such cost? Even then, what losses did {{M|you}} suffer to come, traveler? What selves of yours had you to shed? Those are -else to us, and I mourn them as well.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以深沉音调鸣响。*}}
我游在清冷黑暗的水中，旅人。对我而言，这是 Shiva，是延续了七千年的“七日守丧”。
我哀悼一切生命的逝去，也哀悼生命必然带来的所有死亡。为了让你来到这里，旅人，必须有多少存在死去？我哀悼他们。
又或者，你是最稀有的那一种，走在明亮拱门之下，却声称不曾付出这种代价？即便如此，{{M|你}} 为了来到这里又承受了什么损失，旅人？你必须舍弃哪些曾经可能成为的自己？对我们而言，那些也是逝去的生命，我同样为它们哀悼。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *继续聆听*

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}
...but, too, someone close. Tau. Bright tau. She is gone.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以痛楚音调鸣响。*}}
……但也有，一个亲近之人。陶。明亮的陶。她走了。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *继续聆听*

string.ID: {{emote|*Miryam chimes in aching tones.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*米利亚姆以痛楚音调鸣响。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Miryam chimes in melodic tones.*}}
Oh? You would finish the -elseing act?
I am your debtor, =name=. The ritual is how we organize the anguished practice of being. Now my grieving can begin.
Bright Tau shines always, here or there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*米利亚姆以旋律音调鸣响。*}}
哦？你要帮助陶完成离枝仪式？
=name=，我欠你一份情。我们借这场仪式，为存在所带来的痛苦赋予形式。现在，我终于可以开始哀悼。
明亮的陶永远闪耀，无论在这里还是那里。

string.ID: {{emote|*The chiming rock burns in soft light.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*鸣响之石燃着柔光。*}}

string.ID: ...what are you?

strings.string: ……你是什么？

string.ID: [Touch the chiming rock and attune to Chavvah.]

strings.string: [触摸鸣响之石，并调谐至查瓦。]

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chiming rock rings a sonorous tone.*}}
Touch the chiming rock and seek me at the keter. Will you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*鸣响之石响起浑厚音调。*}}
触摸鸣响之石，到冠层寻我。你会吗？

string.ID: What does that mean?

strings.string: 那是什么意思？

string.ID: {{emote|*The chiming rock is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*鸣响之石沉默而静止。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*You are already attuned.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你已经调谐。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chime rings a bone-shaking alarm.*}}
Is this a taunt? A challenge? What cruelty drives you to attempt communication after what you have done?

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声如震骨的警报般响起。*}}
这是嘲弄吗？挑战吗？是什么残酷驱使你在做下那些事之后还试图沟通？

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 你对陶的离去有什么感受？

string.ID: Your mockery disgusts me. You disgust me. I will not be calmed, Tikva!

strings.string: 你的嘲弄令我作呕。你令我作呕。我不会被安抚，提克瓦！

string.ID:
{{emote|*The chime rings a knell.*}}
O gesticulating hand.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声如丧钟般响起。*}}
哦，挥舞的手。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 你对陶的离去有什么感受？

string.ID:
We are adrift now. I will seek signs of her, or whatever she becomes. What do you care?
Do not answer.

strings.string:
我们现在漂流无依。我会寻找她的迹象，也会寻找她最终成为之物留下的迹象。这与你何干？
不要回答。

string.ID:
{{emote|The chime rings loud and sharp.}}
Heavy the hand. Heavy the head.

strings.string:
{{emote|钟声响亮而尖锐。}}
手沉重。头沉重。

string.ID: Tau has completed her -elseing.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID:
I wonder how it must feel to be =name=, so loath to see the pen of fate in another's grasp that you see fit to wrench it away. Does it bring exultation of control, or relief from a gnawing insecurity?
Do not answer. I will not be calmed. Ask if asking.

strings.string:
我很想知道，成为 =name= 是什么感受。你如此无法容忍命运之笔握在别人手中，竟要亲手将它夺走。控制他人的命运令你狂喜，还是终于压下了心中啃噬般的不安？
不要回答。我不会被安抚。若要问，便问。

string.ID: I do have questions, still.

strings.string: 我的确还有问题。

string.ID:
You. I roil to see you. I welcome you. I churn.
Do you know this weight, I wonder? Can you?

strings.string:
是你。一看见你，我便翻涌。我欢迎你，却又无法平静。
我想知道：你明白这份重量吗？你真能明白吗？

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID:
I am torn asunder! This outcome, this outcome, the shear splits me. Why Ptoh? How? Has this always been us? Which of us yet carry this -else to reify under pressure to our extancy?
Do not answer. There is no word-answer, and perhaps none at all. You have done us a service and I thank you for this -elseing.

strings.string:
我被撕裂了！这个结果，这个结果，将我从中劈开。为什么是普托？怎么会？难道我们一直都是如此？我们之中，还有谁携带着这种未曾实现的可能？它是否也会在压力下化为真实？
不要回答。言语无法回答，也许根本就没有答案。你帮了我们；我感谢你帮助陶完成离枝。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不必谢。我还有问题。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a sharp, urgent gonging tone*}}
Entity! You are given persistent will and agency, twice-hewn architecture of body and strong fiber that pulls. You bolt upright and damp-haired into fullness, your grasp abrading the threads of existence. Your responsibility remains whether acknowledged or not. Have strength, the time is now.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声如尖锐而急促的锣音般响起。*}}
存在者！你拥有延续不息的意志与行动能力，拥有反复锤炼的身体和牵动它的坚韧筋脉。你湿发披散，猛然挺身，伸手磨损存在之线。无论承认与否，责任始终在你身上。鼓起力量——就是现在。
抱歉？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Is something the matter?

strings.string: 有什么不对吗？

string.ID: Is all this about gyredream?

strings.string: 这一切都是因为旋梦吗？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID: I accept. Ask if asking.

strings.string: 我接受。若要问，便问。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings again, echoing louder in the walls of your mind*}}
Hear me! It is more important than ever to know that you are a driver, reforged and honed. You tool yourself to apply selective atrocity. It cannot be helped. You shape this, your path bloody and blooming. You start in sleep and shake the ground.
All must, but you most of all. The weight may have been negligent once, but it is terribly heavy now.
Do you accept responsibilty?

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声再次响起，在你心智的墙壁中回荡得更响。*}}
听我说！如今，你比任何时候都更必须明白：你是推动一切的人，身体经过重铸与磨砺。你把自己塑造成一件能够选择何时施暴的工具。事已至此，无可回避。是你塑造了这一切；你的道路鲜血淋漓，却也繁花盛放。你从睡梦中惊起，令大地震动。
人人都必须承担责任，而你尤其如此。这份责任或许曾轻得可以忽略，如今却沉重得可怕。
你接受责任吗？

string.ID: I do.

strings.string: 我接受。

string.ID: I do not.

strings.string: 我不接受。
什么？

string.ID:
Yet, what you break is broken. -else is not -then regardless of will. This way split me again from Tikva, sundered early the love I knew, the denial. Our cowardice.
Ignore this digression. Ask, if asking.

strings.string:
然而，被你打碎的事物已经无法复原。无论意志如何，未成为的另一种可能，终究不是已经成形的自己。这条道路再次将我与提克瓦分开，过早斩断了我所知的爱。那是逃避。是我们的怯懦。
忽略这段离题。若要问，便问。

string.ID: You loved another chime?

strings.string: 你爱过另一枚晶钟？

string.ID:
You are encysted as Tikva, just as they! Milky white keratinous thoughts melt to a sick mass, wrapped in a protective membrane. I tremble. So it is.
Ask, if asking.

strings.string:
你像提克瓦一样被包囊住了，就和他们一样！乳白色的角质思想融成病态肿块，裹在保护膜里。我颤抖。事情就是如此。
若要问，便问。

string.ID: That's disgusting.

strings.string: 真恶心。

string.ID: What's that about Tikva?

strings.string: 提克瓦是怎么回事？

string.ID: Just as Tikva, you turn away from your self-disgust. Yet, it is you and within you. You contain that you cannot tolerate.

strings.string: 就像提克瓦一样，你避开了对自己的厌恶。然而，那就是你，也在你之内。你容纳着自己无法忍受之物。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tzedech emits a powerful, body-thrumming chime*}}
Yes. You understand destroying. You know the weight. We are past time of querulous inquisition, of confessions on lined parchment. Was the whole of this in your weight? It no longer matters. Scale the firmament, smite or soothe what rouses there.

strings.string:
{{emote|*泽德克发出一声强烈得震动身体的鸣响*}}
是。你懂得毁灭，也明白它的重量。争辩、审问，以及写在横线羊皮纸上的忏悔，都已经太迟。这一切是否本就该由你承担？如今已不重要。攀上苍穹吧，击倒或安抚在那里苏醒的存在。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings clear and loud*}}
This called Tzedech. Compass, judgment, motivation. Once lover of Tikva, apart now after gyredream.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声清晰而响亮地响起*}}
我名为泽德克。罗盘、审判、驱动力。曾与提克瓦相爱；旋梦之后，彼此分离。

string.ID: You were another chime's lover?

strings.string: 你曾与另一枚晶钟相爱？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tzedech chimes, buzzing with agitation*}}
Twofirm roils in me with the enormity. Can it contain so much gone and unremunerated? Tau, Tikva, and more to come. Consumed, we, and paralyzed.

strings.string:
{{emote|*泽德克鸣响，带着烦躁的嗡鸣*}}
双相质因这场巨变在我体内翻涌。它真能容纳如此多无可补偿的失去吗？陶，提克瓦，还有更多即将离去的存在。我们被悲痛吞噬，动弹不得。

string.ID:
It consumes me. I witnessed so little from the weave of outcomes. If I could remember them all, could I influence the course? Would I know what safe means? Too many questions with no conceivable answer. Was your rekindling the spark that caught fire? I do not know.
We are adrift.

strings.string:
它吞噬着我。我从结果之织中见证的太少。如果我能记住它们全部，我是否能影响进程？我会知道安全意味着什么吗？太多问题没有可想象的答案。你的重燃是否就是引火的火星？我不知道。
我们漂流无依。

string.ID:
Tau. We ache in her empty space. Who awaits at taproot? What fate is this?
This is the path. Be wary.

strings.string:
陶。我们在她留下的空处疼痛。谁在主根等待？这是什么命运？
这就是道路。小心。

string.ID:
Tikva. Once lover, now foil, perhaps lover again.
Its light invites and overwhelms, a hope blind and blinding. Cruel frustration at storm-time. When its eyes are needed they turn away. I will not be calmed. I will not be calmed!

strings.string:
提克瓦。曾是恋人，如今彼此映衬、彼此对立，也许将来还会再次相爱。
它的光召唤我，也淹没我——那是一种盲目、也令人失明的希望。风暴来临时，它残酷地叫人失望。最需要它睁眼时，它却移开目光。我不会被安抚。我不会被安抚！

string.ID: How can chimes in a tree be lovers?

strings.string: 树上的晶钟怎么会彼此相爱？

string.ID: You'll be together again?

strings.string: 你们会再次在一起？

string.ID: I should go. Live and drink.

strings.string: 我该走了。生而饮水。

string.ID:
You are terribly small. Your love, small. Confined.
I cannot will not uplift your little concept. Do it yourself.

strings.string:
你渺小得可怕。你的爱也一样渺小，处处受限。
我不能，也不愿替你扩展那狭隘的理解。自己去想。

string.ID:
As seasons cycle, so Chavvah cycles. We are not as you, our love is not as you. But it is come early, this winter. Gyredream shakes us.
This is insufficient and I cannot bridge understanding. Consider questions of greater utility.

strings.string:
季节循环，查瓦亦循环。我们不像你们，我们的爱也不像你们。但这个冬天来得太早。旋梦动摇了我们。
这还不够，而我无法架起理解的桥梁。考虑些更有用的问题吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous and faint, its light flickering.*}}
Please… no…

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声微弱而哀诉地响起，光芒闪烁。*}}
请……不要……

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID: It ignores the monster. It ignores it. It ignores it.

strings.string: 它无视怪物。它无视它。它无视它。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the sound of the chime rings querulous.*}}
The light shines upon you but illuminates nothing. It quails.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声带着哀诉响起。*}}
光照在你身上，却什么也照不亮。它畏缩。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID: It stares into the light and wishes away the monster.

strings.string: 它凝视光芒，祈愿怪物消失。

string.ID: Relief, relief. Relief from the void, safety from its creases.

strings.string: 解脱，解脱。从虚空中解脱，安然逃出它的褶皱。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 你对陶的离去有什么感受？

string.ID:
The light shines so bright, the voidshadow folds not upon it. It exults. It relaxes. It wills this troubled feeling away.
Thank you for clearing Tau's path, =name=. This is better.

strings.string:
光照得如此明亮，虚空之影无法折叠其上。它欢腾。它放松。它用意志让这份不安的感觉消失。
谢谢你为陶清出道路，=name=。这样更好。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不必谢。我还有问题。

string.ID: It is happy, it lies. It swells to witness Tau's choice, in pantomime of shared joy.

strings.string: 它很快乐——它在说谎。它鼓胀起来，见证陶的选择，以无声的表演假装共享这份喜悦。

string.ID: How do you feel about Tau's departure?

strings.string: 你对陶的离去有什么感受？

string.ID:
It wills this troubled feeling away. It looks to the light with something in its eyes. It tries to blink the something away, but it cannot. The light is dim through the something in its eyes.
But the light yet shines. It will blink and it will see the light in searing glory. I thank you, I thank you, I thank you.

strings.string:
它用意志让这份不安的感觉消失。它望向光，眼中有某种东西。它试图眨眼把那东西眨掉，但做不到。透过它眼中的那东西，光变暗了。
但光仍然照耀。它会眨眼，它会看见光以灼烈荣耀显现。我感谢你，我感谢你，我感谢你。

string.ID: You are welcome. I yet have questions.

strings.string: 不必谢。我还有问题。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long, clarion tone.*}}
You are as beautiful as imagined. You ring with a shining purpose. This chime is awed to bask in your presence.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声以悠长而清亮的音调响起。*}}
你如想象中一样美丽。你怀着明亮的使命鸣响。它敬畏地沐浴在你的存在中。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Your chime shines with such painful light.

strings.string: 你的钟声闪耀着如此痛楚的光。

string.ID: Were you affected by gyredream?

strings.string: 你受到了旋梦影响吗？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID: Yes. It looks into the light with you.

strings.string: 是的。它与你一同望进光中。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings again*}}
It is called Tikva, low and humble. The chime rests in a web of strong love, a little piece of something greater and so much more beautiful. As are you, but a gestalt unto yourself. A world to be orbited.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声再次响起*}}
它名为提克瓦，渺小而谦卑。这枚晶钟栖居在炽烈爱意织成的网中，只是某个远比它伟大、也远比它美丽之物的一小部分。你亦如此，却又自成完整的形态——一个值得环绕的世界。

string.ID: It channels the breathtaking things seen and heard and known. Bathe your senses in it until they grow accustomed. You will see nothing else.

strings.string: 它引导那些令人屏息的所见、所闻、所知。让你的感官沐浴其中，直到它们习惯。你将再也看不见别的。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings, a querulous and tinny sound*}}
It... can scarce find the dream in this light. It thinks of Tzedech and weeps. It was not here, last time the static was in high pitch, but it remembers the pain and fear. It is not ready to feel these, it cannot. Gaze into its light and speak not of nightmares.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声响起，哀诉而细薄*}}
它……几乎无法在这光芒里寻见那场梦。它想起泽德克，于是哭泣。上一次静电尖啸时，它尚未在此成形，却记得那份痛与恐惧。它还没有准备好承受这些，做不到。望进它的光里，别再谈噩梦。
泽德克？

string.ID: 'Your' Tzedech?

strings.string: “你的”泽德克？

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with brief life.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一阵悠长钟声响起。浅溪的河床满是短暂生命。*}}

string.ID: Tau has met her fate.

strings.string: 陶已经迎来她的命运。

string.ID: {{emote|*You tumble from the jar, your sinewy body twisting against the electric emptiness in your belly, the weight of eggs. You discover a morsel and consume it soft and delicious. You will spawn here. You will eat the morsels. Your babies will eat all of the morsels.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你从罐中翻滚而出，筋腱分明的身体扭动着，抵抗腹中电流般的空虚，以及卵的重量。你发现一口食物，将它吃下，柔软而美味。你会在这里产卵。你会吃掉这些食物。你的孩子会吃掉所有食物。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……还有更多事要问你。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一阵悠长钟声响起。浅溪的河床满是生与死，自然自我吞噬的衔尾蛇。*}}

string.ID: Tau is gone.

strings.string: 陶走了。

string.ID: {{emote|*Wielding an oversized jar in little hands, a child tips it into the running current of a softly burbling creek. Tiny creatures that had been living in the jar spill into the creek, protected from the killing current by a clump of slimy biofilm. The child peers at a little fry swimming in the jar.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一个孩子用小手抱着硕大的罐子，把罐口倾向一条轻声潺潺的溪流。栖息其中的微小生物纷纷落入水中；一团黏滑的生物膜护住了它们，使它们免遭急流吞没。孩子凝视着罐中一尾游动的小鱼苗。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……还有更多事要问你。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一阵悠长钟声响起。浅溪的河床满是生与死，自然自我吞噬的衔尾蛇。}}

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID:
{{emote|*From the banks of a shallow creek, you watch a toad floating on the water, belly up. It flails, helpless against even the gentle current of the water in which you placed it seconds ago. You watch it float away, toward the rushing currents ahead.
Helpless to myriad unknowable fates, the toad disappears from view into the rapids, sent there by your hand.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*你站在浅溪岸边，看着一只蟾蜍肚皮朝上浮在水面。它拼命划动四肢；你几秒前才把它放入水中，就连和缓的水流也令它无力抗拒。你看着它漂远，朝前方奔涌的急流而去。
面对无数不可知的命运，蟾蜍消失在急流中。是你的手把它送去了那里。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……还有更多事要问你。

string.ID: {{emote|*A long chime rings. The bed of a shallow creek teems with life and death, nature's self-consuming ouroboros.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*一阵悠长钟声响起。浅溪的河床满是生与死，自然自我吞噬的衔尾蛇。*}}

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID: {{emote|*From the mouth of the jar in your little hands, you watch a frog leap into the water of a softly burbling creek. The gentle current sweeps the frog's little body away to an unknown fate as curious crayfish peek out from their hiding places. The jar in your hands is empty.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*透过小手捧着的罐口，你看见一只青蛙跃入轻声潺潺的溪水。和缓的水流卷走它小小的身体，送往未知的命运；好奇的小龙虾从藏身处探出头来。你手中的罐子空了。*}}

string.ID: I... have more to ask you.

strings.string: 我……还有更多事要问你。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings*}}
{{emote|*In your mind's eye, you see yourself touching a mirror. You tap the glass and it ripples like the surface of a placid lake.*}}

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声响起*}}
{{emote|*在你的心眼中，你看见自己触碰一面镜子。你轻敲玻璃，它像平静湖面一样泛起涟漪。*}}

string.ID: Your name is pronounced as the pause between two words, friend. How do I know this?

strings.string: 你的名字发音像两个词之间的停顿，朋友。我怎么会知道这一点？

string.ID: Tell me of gyredream.

strings.string: 告诉我旋梦的事。

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID: {{emote|*The moment stretches on into a steep asymptote, the peaks and valleys of possible outcomes speeding by in an imaginary blur. You imagine the sound of a tiny metal thread brushing across the bottom of a dusty valley, amplified a thousand times.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*这一刻延展成一道陡峭的渐近线，可能结果的峰谷在想象的模糊中疾驰而过。你想象一根细小金属丝擦过尘土谷底的声音，被放大了一千倍。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*the entity chimes, and you witness water lapping at the long edge of a pebble beach. Slowly, the tide brushes clean the surface of each rock, etching time's passage onto millions of tiny canvases. Somewhere, something dies.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*钟体鸣响，你看见水拍打着漫长的卵石滩。潮水缓缓刷净每一块石头的表面，把时间的流逝刻在数百万张细小画布上。某处，有东西死去。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Your entire self buzzes at the sound of _'s chime, a shock from the center and radiating outward. Sensation bubbles up to the surface, a tightening of the self. It is as if cresting a great hill atop a cathedra or an oncoming witchwood overdose; the void yawns under you. Something terrible is born.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你的整个自我因 _ 的钟声而嗡响，震动从中心向外辐射。感觉冒泡升向表面，自我收紧。仿佛坐在宝座上越过大山之巅，或一场即将到来的巫木过量；虚空在你脚下张口。某种可怕之物诞生了。*}}

string.ID: I don't understand. What could it mean?

strings.string: 我不明白。这可能意味着什么？

string.ID: Let... let us speak of other things.

strings.string: 让……让我们谈些别的。

string.ID: Excuse... excuse me.

strings.string: 抱……抱歉。

string.ID: {{emote|*You are a little sapfly resting in the crook of a swarmshade tree. The boughs stretch in great barkish deserts before exploding into a tangle of branches. Your brethren buzz in an agitated cloud, feeling fear or excitement or hunger. Something buzzes beyond the leafy reaches of your sight, all-consuming but unclear.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*你是一只小树液蝇，栖在群荫树的枝杈里。大枝像树皮般的荒漠一样延展，然后爆裂成缠结的枝条。你的同类在躁动的云团中嗡鸣，感受恐惧、兴奋或饥饿。某物在你叶片遮蔽的视野之外嗡鸣，吞噬一切，却模糊不清。*}}

string.ID: I... wish to speak of other things.

strings.string: 我……想谈些别的。

string.ID: I will think on this... live and drink.

strings.string: 我会思考这件事……生而饮水。

string.ID: {{emote|*Just as you activate an artifact listening device that ceased to exist centuries ago, you hear the end of an emotional song. The space between relief and sorrow throbs with uncomfortable tension. You ache with it.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*就在你启动一件数百年前便已不复存在的遗物监听装置时，你听见一首情感充沛的歌曲收尾。解脱与悲伤之间的空间因不适的张力而悸动。你也随之疼痛。*}}

string.ID:
Shivering stillness, coldbark pricking with each thump.
It comes.

strings.string:
颤抖的静止，冷树皮随每次砰击刺痛。
它来了。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID:
Can you feel the stillness? The drycrackle of space between as you thump my crystal arms.
Life flees you. Motion flees you.

strings.string:
你能感到那静止吗？当你砰击我的晶体枝臂时，间隙空间发出干裂声。
生命逃离你。运动逃离你。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings a long and pensive tone.*}}
How something stirs, deep in Soft.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一阵悠长而沉思的钟声响起。*}}
柔质深处，某种存在正在翻动。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID: Soft churns Tau in beingstuff. She will -then, but perhaps not Taulike.

strings.string: 柔质正将陶重新卷入生命之中。她也许会再次成形，却未必还是原来的陶。

string.ID:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}
How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.

strings.string:
{{emote|*透过钟声，你听见回荡的喧响，被距离与物质削弱。*}}
我们也随之鸣响。你带来的那点轻微震动，已经淹没在我们自身的哀鸣中。

string.ID: Tau has completed the -elseing ritual.

strings.string: 陶已经完成了离枝仪式。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}
Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Arid tearsalt dries between the Lovers.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声已难以从升起的喧响中分辨。*}}
每条道路都在皱缩。柔质越过一切形态的边界，以无火的灼热折磨我们。它在陶留下的洞穴般空缺中回响。干涩的泪盐凝结在相爱的两者之间。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有问题。

string.ID:
{{emote|*through the chime you hear an echoing cacophony, muted by distance and matter.*}}
How we ring with it. Your kicksoft drowns under the beat of our selfcries.

strings.string:
{{emote|*透过钟声，你听见回荡的喧响，被距离与物质削弱。*}}
我们也随之鸣响。你带来的那点轻微震动，已经淹没在我们自身的哀鸣中。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

strings.string: 陶的离去令你作何感受？

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is hard to distinguish from the rising cacophony.*}}
Crungled allway. Soft reaches through the bounds of everyshape and afflicts us with fireless hotbark. It resonates through Tau's cavernous absence. Touchloss blooms, each facet trembling for shearpull.

strings.string:
{{emote|*钟声已难以从升起的喧响中分辨。*}}
每条道路都在皱缩。柔质越过一切形态的边界，以无火的灼热折磨我们。它在陶留下的洞穴般空缺中回响。触感的丧失骤然绽开，每个切面都因撕扯而颤抖。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有问题。

string.ID: Who thumps my crystal arms, and kicksofts me at windfall? I feel you here, friend.

strings.string: 是谁敲击我的晶体枝臂，又让落风轻触我？我感觉到你就在这里，朋友。

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: You... feel me?

strings.string: 你……感觉到我？

string.ID: Did you experience the gyredream?

strings.string: 你经历了旋梦吗？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID:
{{emote|*there is an agitation in Thicksalt's accepting chime.*}}
Pluck the air, then, with your mouth sounds.

strings.string:
{{emote|*厚盐接纳的钟声中有一阵躁动。*}}
那就用你的口中声音拨动空气吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes a single, outstretched tone.*}}
The naming act is imponderable. So Tau called me Thicksalt, one brickword in a towerful poem whose everyshape I forget, but whose flushing of Soft in afterfeel I am in allway.

strings.string:
{{emote|*厚盐鸣出一声延展的单音。*}}
命名之举深不可测。陶因而称我为厚盐——那是满塔诗篇中的一枚砖词。我已忘却整首诗的一切形态，却始终活在它余韵中柔质涌流的触感里。

string.ID: *continue listening*

strings.string: *继续聆听*

string.ID:
...
{{emote|*Thicksalt chimes in gentle tones.*}}

strings.string:
……
{{emote|*厚盐以轻柔音调鸣响。*}}

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz chimes a quiet tone.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出安静的音调。*}}

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz is nearly silent but for a soft, shaky resonance*}}
...

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹几乎沉默，只剩柔和而颤抖的共振*}}
……

string.ID: Tau is gone.

strings.string: 陶走了。

string.ID: You m-m-moon king. Madhand.

strings.string: 你这月、月、月之王。疯手。

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime rings shaky and loud*}}
Wh-what is this? H-how is it meant? This outcome j-judders within and w-without us.

strings.string:
{{emote|*一阵颤抖而响亮的钟声响起*}}
这、这是什么？该、该怎么理解？这个结果在我们体、体内震颤，也在我们之外震颤。

string.ID: Tau has departed.

strings.string: 陶已经离去。

string.ID: Wh-what will Tau b-be after soft? You, did, did you mean... wh-what c-could you say? Tau spins within, the g-gyre spins without.

strings.string: 陶经柔质重塑后，会、会成为什么？你、你原本想要……又、又能说什么？陶在内旋转，轮、轮回在外旋转。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a querulous tone*}}
O-oh. Elsefolder... th-this path you have l-laid upon Tau, it-it is best. It is good? P-please be good.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出哀诉的音调*}}
哦、哦。离枝者……你为陶铺、铺下的这条路，是、是最好的路。是好事，对吗？请、请一定是好事。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

strings.string: 陶的离去令你作何感受？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz's chime rings even quieter and more tremulous*}}
Un, un-uncertain. Tau l-leaves unfolded but the g-g-g-gyre yet s-spins. The s-spinning leaves me dizzy.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹的钟声更轻，也更加颤抖*}}
不、不确定。陶已舒展开来，离、离开了，可轮、轮、轮回仍在转、转动。它转得我头晕。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有问题。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz rings a wavering chime*}}
Y-you are here. Elseing h... hand.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出摇曳的钟声*}}
你、你来了。举行离枝仪式的……手。

string.ID: How does Tau's departure find you?

strings.string: 陶的离去令你作何感受？

string.ID:
{{emote|*the chime is louder this time, but just as querulous*}}
Sh-sh-she, th-this fate, it. It is a d-deep dark. Will Tau f-fold herself, I wonder?

strings.string:
{{emote|*这一次钟声更响，但同样哀诉*}}
她……她的命、命运，落进了很深、很深的黑暗。我不知道陶会不会把自己折、折回去。

string.ID: I have questions.

strings.string: 我有问题。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a broad and booming tone.*}}
You! Purpose-driven mad... madhand. You've come here, right? Then you must know power is our... the domain of being is one of power, wouldn't you say? W-Would you please agree with that?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出宽阔而轰鸣的音调。*}}
你！受目的驱使的疯……疯手。你来到这里，对吧？那么你一定明白，我们……存在本身就是力量的领域。你也会这么说吧？你、你能赞同吗？

string.ID: I am =name=. Who are you?

strings.string: 我是 =name=。你是谁？

string.ID: Did you experience the gyredream?

strings.string: 你经历了旋梦吗？

string.ID: I am to carry Tau's chime to Taproot, so she can leave Chavvah.

strings.string: 我要把陶的晶钟带到主根，好让她离开查瓦。

string.ID: If y-y, th-that... yes. Ask if, if asking.

strings.string: 如、如果你想问……那、那就问吧。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz quiets, then chimes in tottering, unsure tones.*}}
You beast! You m-moon king! You... Our roars are beastial! Would you say so?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹安静下来，随后以摇晃而不确定的音调鸣响。*}}
你这野兽！你这月、月之王！你……我们的咆哮像野兽！你会这么说吗？

string.ID: This is all nonsense.

strings.string: 这全是胡话。

string.ID: You sound very unsure of yourself.

strings.string: 你听起来对自己很不确定。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz makes a hollow peep.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔穆兹发出空洞的细鸣。*}}

string.ID: Be uncertain, friend. You have my permission.

strings.string: 不确定也没关系，朋友。你有我的允许。

string.ID: {{emote|*Tammuz is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*塔穆兹沉默而静止。*}}

string.ID: I will give you a moment.

strings.string: 我给你一点时间。

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz chimes a small and bright noise.*}}
Ta- Tammuz. Who becomes. Who is Twofirm even in -then.

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹鸣出细小而明亮的声音。*}}
塔、塔穆兹。不断成为的存在。即便已经成形，也仍是双相质。
双相质？

string.ID:
The t-two sephirots. -then and -else. I cannot be -else. *I* cannot, of course. But -then? It does not seem so.
Their chimes ring at the right frequencies, others. But not so, mine.

strings.string:
两、两种可能自我：一种会成形，另一种不会。那未成形的另一个不可能是我，*我* 当然不会成为它。可已经成形的这个呢？似乎也不完全是我。
其他晶钟都以正确的频率鸣响，可我的晶钟……并非如此。
双相质？

string.ID:
{{emote|*Tammuz quivers and chimes a jarring tone.*}}
O-Oh. Oh u-uh oh oh. By contrasts, a q-quake stills even the most anxious trembling...
The world... the world becomes and unbecomes. All the nervous, volcanic energy of being. Who becomes who? Three became one, but what of them now?
And w-what becomes of Tau? Of me? Of y-you?

strings.string:
{{emote|*塔穆兹颤抖着，鸣出刺耳的音调。*}}
哦、哦。哦呃、呃哦哦。相比之下，地、地震甚至能止住最焦虑的颤抖……
世界……世界成为又不成为。存在的所有神经质的、火山般的能量。谁成为谁？三者成了一者，但它们现在又如何？
那陶会、会成为什么？我呢？你、你呢？

string.ID: {{emote|*The chime is silent and still.*}}

strings.string: {{emote|*晶钟寂然不动。*}}

string.ID:
You have severed the hand outstretched to me. Why?
